en: So the troops tore into the plunder, taking sheep, cattle, and calves. They slaughtered them right on the ground and devoured them with the blood still in them.
war: sanglit nag-aragaw hira pagkuha han ira natikas ha ira mga kaaway, kinmuha hira hin mga karnero ngan hin mga baka, gin-ihaw ini nira dayon, ngan ginkaon an karne nga may-ada pa dugo.

en: When it was reported to Saul, “The troops are sinning against the LORD by eating meat with blood in it,” Saul said, “All of you are traitors! Roll a large stone over here right now.
war: Ginsumatan hi Saul, “Kitaa, nakakasala an mga tawo supak han Ginoo pinaagi hin pagkaon hin karne nga may-ada dugo.”

en: Go among the troops and say to them, ‘Everyone must bring their ox or sheep, and slaughter them here with me. Don’t sin against the LORD by eating meat with blood still in it.’” So everyone brought whatever they had and slaughtered it there.
war: Ginmoliat hi Saul, “Mga maglingo kamo! Kalidinga niyo in bato ngadi ha akon.”

en: And Saul built an altar to the LORD . It was the first altar he had built to the LORD .
war: Niyan nagsugo liwat hiya: “Sudoya an ngatanan nga mga tawo ngan ipadara nganhi an ira mga baka ngan mga karnero. Iihawon ngan kakaonon ini nira dinhe; kinahanglan diri hira makasala han Ginoo pinaagi hin pagkaon hin karne nga may-ada dugo.” Sanglit hito nga gab-i gindara nira ngatanan an ira kabakahan ngan gin-ihaw ini didto.

en: “Let’s go after the Philistines tonight and plunder them until morning,” Saul said. “We won’t leave them a single survivor!”
war: Nagtindog hi Saul hin altar ngadto han Ginoo , syahan ini nga altar nga iya gintindog.

en: “Do whatever you think is best,” the troops replied.
war: Nagsiring hi Saul han iya mga tawo, “Lugsong kita ngan sulonga ta ha gab-i an mga Filisteohanon, panikasi ta hira ngada han pagkaaga, ngan pamataya ta hira ngatanan.”

en: But the priest said, “Let’s ask God first.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Buhata an imo ginhuhunahuna nga maupay.”

en: So Saul questioned God: “Should I go after the Philistines? Will you hand them over to Israel?” But God did not answer him that day.
war: Kundi nagsiring an padi, “Pakianhi ta anay an Dyos.”

en: Then Saul said, “All you officers in the army, come forward! Let’s find out what sin was committed today.
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi Saul han Dyos, “Susulongon ko ba an mga Filisteohanon? Padadag-on mo ba kami?” Kundi waray bumaton an Dyos hito nga adlaw.

en: As surely as the LORD lives—the one who has saved Israel—even if it’s my own son Jonathan, that person will be executed.” Not one of the soldiers answered him.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Saul han mga pangulo han mga tawo, “Kadi kamo ngan panginanoa ta kon ano nga sala an nabuhat yana nga adlaw.

en: So Saul said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and my son Jonathan and I will be on the other.”
war: Nagsasaad ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga nagpapadaog han Israel, nga papatayon an salaan, bisan kon akon anak hi Jonatan.” Kundi waray gud may sinmagbang.

en: “Do whatever you think is best,” the troops said.
war: Niyan nagsiring ha ira hi Saul, “Tindog kamo ngatanan didto, ngan matindog kami ngan hi Jonatan didi.”

en: Then Saul asked the LORD God of Israel, “Why haven’t you answered your servant today? If the wrongdoing is mine or my son Jonathan’s, respond with Urim, but if the wrongdoing belongs to your people Israel, respond with Thummim.” Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the troops were cleared.
war: Binmaton hira, “Buhata an imo ginhuhunahuna nga maupay.”

en: Then Saul said, “Decide between me and my son Jonathan.” And Jonathan was selected.
war: Nagsiring hi Saul han Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, “ Ginoo , kay ano nga waray mo ako pamatii yana nga adlaw? O Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, pamatii ako pinaagi han baraan nga mga bato. Kon adto nga sala kan Jonatan o akon ba, pamatii ako pinaagi han Urim; kundi kon kanan imo mga tawo nga Israel, pamatii ako pinaagi han Tumim.” Hinsabotan nga salaan hira Jonatan ug Saul; ngan natalwas an mga tawo.

en: “Tell me what you’ve done,” Saul said to Jonathan.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Saul, “Pilia kon hi ako ba o hi Jonatan nga akon anak.” Ngan hi Jonatan an salaan.

en: So Jonathan told him. “I only took a very small taste of honey on the end of my staff,” he said. “And now I’m supposed to die?”
war: Niyan nagpakiana hi Saul kan Jonatan, “Ano ba an imo ginbuhat?”

en: “May God deal harshly with me and worse still if you don’t die today!” Saul swore.
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Kinmaon ako hin gutiay nga dugos. Iini ako—andam ako hin kamatay.”

en: But the troops said to Saul, “Why should Jonathan die when he has won this great victory for Israel? No way! As surely as the LORD lives, not one hair off his head will fall to the ground, because he did this today with God’s help.” So the troops rescued Jonathan, and he wasn’t executed.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Saul, “Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon diri ta ikaw patayon!”

en: Then Saul stopped chasing the Philistines, and the Philistines went back to their own country.
war: Kundi nagsiring an mga tawo kan Saul, “Papatayon ba hi Jonatan nga nakahatag hini nga dako nga pagdarag-an para han Israel? Diri! Nagsasaad kami pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo , nga waray bisan usa nga buhok han iya ulo in mawawara. An iya ginbuhat yana nga adlaw iya ginbuhat binuligan han Dyos.” Sanglit gintalwas han mga tawo hi Jonatan ngan waray pagpataya.

en: Saul secured his kingship over Israel. He fought against his enemies on every side: against Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the king of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he was victorious.
war: Katapos hito hinmunong hi Saul hin pagbukod han mga Filisteohanon, ngan inmoli hira ngadto han ira kalugaringon nga katunaan.

en: Samuel said to Saul, “The LORD sent me to anoint you king over his people Israel. Listen now to the LORD ’s words!
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel kan Saul, “Amo ako an ginsugo han Ginoo hin pagdihog ha imo nga hadi han iya mga tawo, an mga Israelita. Pamatii yana an igsisiring han Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum.

en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I am going to punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel: how they attacked the Israelites as they came up from Egypt.
war: Kakastigohon niya an mga tawo han Amalek kay pinakiawayan han ira mga ginikanan an mga Israelita han paggawas hini nira ha Ehipto.

en: So go! Attack the Amalekites; put everything that belongs to them under the ban. Spare no one. Kill men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.”
war: Kadtoa ngan sulonga an mga Amalekanhon ngan puoha an ngatanan nga ira mga butang. Ayaw pagsalini hin bisan usa nga butang; pataya an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an, kababayen-an, kabataan, ngan mga minasus-an; an kabakahan, kakarnerohan, mga kamilyo, ngan mga asno.”

en: Saul called out the troops and counted them at Telaim: two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand more troops from Judah.
war: Gintirok ni Saul ngan iya ginpanginano an iya kasondalohan didto ha Talem: may-ada 200,000 nga mga sondalo tikang ha Israel ngan 10,000 tikang ha Juda.

en: Then Saul advanced on the Amalekite city and laid an ambush in the valley.
war: Niyan kinmadto hiya ngan an iya mga tawo han syudad han Amalek, ngan gimnama hira didto hin usa nga walog.

en: Saul told the Kenites, “Get going! Leave the Amalekites immediately because you showed kindness to the Israelites when they came out of Egypt. Otherwise, I’ll destroy you right along with them.” So the Kenites left the Amalekites.
war: Ginpahimatngonan niya an mga Kenitanhon, mga tawo kanay mga ginikanan nalooy han mga Israelita han pag-abot hini nira tikang ha Ehipto: “Iwas kamo ngan bayai an mga Amalekanhon, basi diri ko kamo mahiupod hin pagpataya.” Sanglit binmaya an mga Kenitanhon.

en: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is near Egypt.
war: Ginpirde ni Saul an mga Amalekanhon, ha iya pakig-away tikang ha Habila ngadto ha Sur ha sinirangan han Ehipto.

en: He captured Agag the Amalekite king alive, but Saul placed all the people under the ban, killing them with the sword.
war: Ginbihag niya nga buhi hi Agag nga hadi han mga Amalekanhon, ngan pinamatay niya an ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: Saul and the troops spared Agag along with the best sheep, cattle, fattened calves, lambs, and everything of value. They weren’t willing to put them under the ban; but anything that was despised or of no value they placed under the ban.
war: Kundi waray pataya ni Saul ngan han iya mga tawo hi Agag, ngan waray nira pamataya an gimamaupayi nga mga karnero ngan mga baka, an gimamaupayi nga mga nati nga baka, an mga nati nga karnero, o iba pa nga mga butang nga mag-upay; pinamatay nira ngatanan an mga waray gamit o waray pulos.

en: Then the LORD ’s word came to Samuel:
war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Samuel,

en: “I regret making Saul king because he has turned away from following me and hasn’t done what I said.” Samuel was upset at this, and he prayed to the LORD all night long.
war: “Nagbabasol ako nga ginhimo ko nga hadi hi Saul; binmaya hiya ha akon ngan ginsupak niya an akon mga sugo.” Nasina hi Samuel ngan nakimalooy hiya han Ginoo ha bug-os nga gab-i.

en: Samuel got up early in the morning to meet Saul, and was told, “Saul went to Carmel, where he is setting up a monument for himself. Then he left and went down to Gilgal.”
war: Sayo pa han pagkaaga linmakat hiya hin pagbiling kan Saul. Hinbatian niya nga kinmadto hi Saul ha bungto han Carmelo, diin nagtindog hiya hin usa nga monumento para ha iya ngahaw, ngan katapos kinmadto hiya ha Gilgal.

en: When Samuel reached Saul, Saul greeted him, “The LORD bless you! I have done what the LORD said.”
war: Kinmadto hi Samuel kan Saul. Ginsiring ni Saul hi Samuel, “Bendisyonan ka unta han Ginoo , Samuel! Gintuman ko an sugo han Ginoo .”

en: “Then what,” Samuel asked, “is this bleating of sheep in my ears and mooing of cattle I hear?”
war: Pinmakiana hi Samuel, “Kay ano man nga hinbabatian ko in mga pag-ininga hin mga baka ngan pag-iniyak hin mga karnero?”

en: “They were taken from the Amalekites,” Saul said, “because the troops spared the best sheep and cattle in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God. The rest was placed under the ban.”
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Gintikas ini ha mga Amalekanhon han akon mga tawo. Iginsalin nira an gimamaupayi nga mga karnero ngan mga baka basi ighalad nira han Ginoo nga imo Dyos, ngan pinamatay namon an iba.”

en: Samuel then said to Saul, “Enough! Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night.”
war: “Igo na,” nagsiring hi Samuel, “ngan igsusumat ko ha imo an iginsiring ha akon han Ginoo kagab-i.”

en: “Tell me,” Saul replied.
war: “Sumati ako,” nagsiring hi Saul.

en: Samuel said, “Even if you think you are insignificant, aren’t you the leader of Israel’s tribes? The LORD anointed you king over Israel.
war: Binmaton hi Samuel, “Bisan kon gin-iisip mo nga gutiay ka la nga pagkatawo, amo ikaw an pangulo han mga tribo han Israel. Gindihogan ka han Ginoo nga hadi han Israel,

en: The LORD sent you on a mission, instructing you, ‘Go, and put the sinful Amalekites under the ban. Fight against them until you’ve wiped them out.’
war: ngan ginsugo ka niya hin pagpuo hito nga magraot nga Amalekanhon. Ginsugo ka niya hin pagpatay ha ira ngatanan.

en: Why didn’t you obey the LORD ? You did evil in the LORD ’s eyes when you tore into the plunder!”
war: Kay ano man nga waray ka magsugot ha iya? Kay ano nga nagdagmit ka la hin pag-agaw han tinikas, ngan pagbuhat han diri nakakalipay han Ginoo ?”

en: “But I did obey the LORD !” Saul protested to Samuel. “I went on the mission the LORD sent me on. I captured Agag the Amalekite king, and I put the Amalekites under the ban.
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Ginsugot ko man an Ginoo . Gintuman ko an sugo niya ha akon, ginbihag ko hi Hadi Agag, ngan pinamatay ko an ngatanan nga mga Amalekanhon.

en: Yes, the troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder—the very best items placed under the ban—but in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal.”
war: Kundi waray pataya han akon mga tawo an gimamaupayi nga mga karnero ngan mga baka nga ira nabihag; ira gindara lugod ini nganhi ha Gilgal basi ighalad han Ginoo nga imo Dyos.”

en: Then Samuel replied,
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Hain an pinalabi han Ginoo : an pagsugot ba ha iya o an mga halad ngan mga hayop nga tutuboron? Mauruupay an pagsugot ha iya kay hin paghalad ha iya han gimamaupayi nga mga karnero.

en: “Does the LORD want entirely burned offerings and sacrifices
war: An pag-ato ha iya sugad la kamaraot han pagdiwata, ngan an pagkamahitas-on sugad la hin ka sala han pagsingba hin mga diyosdiyos. Tungod kay iginsikway mo an sugo han Ginoo , ginhukasan ka niya hin pagkahadi.”

en: as much as obedience to the LORD ?
war: “Tinuod, nakasala ako,” binmaton hi Saul. “Akon ginsupak an sugo han Ginoo ngan an imo mga tugon. Nahadlok ako han akon mga tawo ngan tinugotan ko hira pagbuhat han ira karuyag.

en: Listen to this: obeying is better than sacrificing,
war: Kundi yana nakikimalooy ako ha imo, pasayloa an akon sala ngan bunyog gad ha akon hin pagbalik ngadto ha Gilgal, basi makagsingba ako han Ginoo .”

en: paying attention is better than fat from rams,
war: “Diri ako mabunyog ha imo,” binmaton hi Samuel. “Iginsikway mo an sugo han Ginoo , ngan iginsikway ka man niya nga hadi han Israel.”

en: because rebellion is as bad as the sin of divination;
war: Niyan tinmalikod hi Samuel hin pagbaya, kundi hinkaptan ni Saul an iya bado, ngan nagisi ini.

en: arrogance is like the evil of idolatry.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Samuel, “Yana nga adlaw gin-agaw han Ginoo ha imo an ginhadian han Israel, ngan iginhatag ini hin usa ka tawo nga mauruupay ha imo.

en: Because you have rejected what the LORD said,
war: Diri nagbubuwa o nagbabalhin han iya hunahuna an harangdon nga Dyos han Israel. Diri hiya tawo—diri hiya nagbabalhin han iya hunahuna.”

en: he has rejected you as king.”
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Nakasala ako. Kundi pasidunggi gad ako bisan gutiay la ha atubangan han mga pangulo han akon mga tawo ngan han bug-os nga Israel. Bunyog gad ha akon hin pagbalik basi makagsingba ako han Ginoo nga imo Dyos.”

en: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned because I disobeyed the LORD ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the troops and obeyed them.
war: Sanglit binmunyog ha iya hi Samuel ngadto ha Gilgal, ngan nagsingba hi Saul han Ginoo .

en: But now please forgive my sin! Come back with me, so I can worship the LORD .”
war: “Dad-a nganhi ha akon hi Hadi Agag,” nagsugo hi Samuel. Dinmaop ha iya hi Agag nga nangungurog hin kahadlok, nga naghuhunahuna ha iya ngahaw, “Hin kamapait nga butang an pagkamatay!”

en: But Samuel said to Saul, “I can’t return with you because you have rejected what the LORD said, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.”
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Sugad nga pinaagi han imo espada nawarayan anak in damo nga mga iroy, sanglit yana mawawarayan man anak an iroy nimo.” Ngan iya gintirotigbas hi Agag ha atubangan han altar didto ha Gilgal.

en: Samuel turned to leave, but Saul grabbed at the edge of his robe, and it ripped.
war: Katapos kinmadto hi Samuel ha Rama ngan inmoli hi Saul ngadto ha Gabaa.

en: Then Samuel told him, “The LORD has ripped the kingdom of Israel from you today. He will give it to a friend of yours, someone who is more worthy than you.
war: Samtang buhi pa hi Samuel, waray na gud hiya igkakita han hadi; kundi nagmabidoon hiya tungod ha iya. Nagbasol an Ginoo nga ginhimo niya hi Saul nga hadi han Israel.

en: The LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to grieve over Saul? I have rejected him as king over Israel. Fill your horn with oil and get going. I’m sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem because I have found my next king among his sons.”
war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Samuel, “Tubtob san-o an imo pagkamasulob-on tungod kan Saul? Iginsikway ko na hiya nga hadi han Israel. Kundi yana pun-a hin lana hin olibo an surudlan nga sungay ngan pakadto kan Isai nga taga-Betlehem, kay ginpili ko nga magin hadi in usa han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an.”

en: “How can I do that?” Samuel asked. “When Saul hears of it he’ll kill me!”
war: “Uunanhon ko hin pagkadto?” nagpakiana hi Samuel. “Kon mahiaro hini hi Saul, papatayon ako niya!”

en: “Take a heifer with you,” the LORD replied, “and say, ‘I have come to make a sacrifice to the LORD .’
war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “Pagdara hin usa nga nati nga baka ngan siring nga nakadto ka hin paghalad han Ginoo hin hayop nga tutuboron.

en: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will make clear to you what you should do. You will anoint for me the person I point out to you.”
war: Dapita hi Isai hin paghalad, ngan susumatan ko ikaw kon ano an imo bubuhaton. Didihogan mo nga hadi an akon igsumat ha imo.”

en: Samuel did what the LORD instructed. When he came to Bethlehem, the city elders came to meet him. They were shaking with fear. “Do you come in peace?” they asked.
war: Gintuman ni Samuel an iginsiring ha iya han Ginoo ngan kinmadto hiya ha Betlehem. Gintapo hiya han mga pangulo han syudad, nga nangungurog nga nagsiring ha iya, “Malinawon ba ini nga imo pagduaw ha amon?”

en: “Yes,” Samuel answered. “I’ve come to make a sacrifice to the LORD . Now make yourselves holy, then come with me to the sacrifice.” Samuel made Jesse and his sons holy and invited them to the sacrifice as well.
war: “Oo,” binmaton hiya. “Kinmanhi ako hin paghalad han Ginoo hin hayop nga tutuboron. Linisi an iyo kalugaringon ngan bunyog kamo ha akon.” Iya liwat pinapaglinis hi Isai ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan gindapit hira hin paghalad.

en: When they arrived, Samuel looked at Eliab and thought, That must be the LORD ’s anointed right in front.
war: Han pag-abot nira, hinkit-an ni Samuel hi Eliab nga anak ni Isai ngan naghunahuna hiya, “Amo gud ada ini nga tawo nga natindog dinhe ha atubangan han Ginoo an iya ginpili.”

en: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Have no regard for his appearance or stature, because I haven’t selected him. God doesn’t look at things like humans do. Humans see only what is visible to the eyes, but the LORD sees into the heart.”
war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Ayaw pagtan-awa an iya kahitaas ngan kagwapo. Nadiri ako ha iya, kay an akon paghunahuna diri sugad hin paghukom hin tawo. Tinatan-aw han tawo an iya pamahongpahong, kundi tinatan-aw ko an kasingkasing.”

en: Next Jesse called for Abinadab, who presented himself to Samuel, but he said, “The LORD hasn’t chosen this one either.”
war: Niyan gintawag ni Isai an iya anak nga hi Abinadab ngan gindara hiya ha atubangan ni Samuel. Kundi nagsiring hi Samuel, “Diri, waray liwat hiya pagpilia han Ginoo .”

en: So Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “No, the LORD hasn’t chosen this one.”
war: Niyan gindara ni Isai hi Sama. Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Diri, waray liwat hiya pagpilia han Ginoo .”

en: Jesse presented seven of his sons to Samuel, but Samuel said to Jesse, “The LORD hasn’t picked any of these.”
war: Ha sugad hini nga paagi gindara ni Isai ha atubangan ni Samuel an pito han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an. Ngan nagsiring ha iya hi Samuel, “Diri, waray usa hini ha ira nga ginpili han Ginoo .”

en: Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Is that all of your boys?”
war: Niyan nagpakiana ha iya hi Samuel, “May-ada ka pa ba iba nga anak nga kalalaken-an?”

en: “There is still the youngest one,” Jesse answered, “but he’s out keeping the sheep.”
war: Binmaton hi Isai, “May-ada pa gimamanghori, kundi aadto hiya nagmamangno han mga karnero.”

en: “Send for him,” Samuel told Jesse, “because we can’t proceed until he gets here.”
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Pakanhia hiya. Diri kita maghahalad ngada han iya pag-abot.”

en: So Jesse sent and brought him in. He was reddish brown, had beautiful eyes, and was good-looking. The LORD said, “That’s the one. Go anoint him.”
war: Sanglit ginpasugoan hiya ni Isai. Usa hiya nga gwapo, maupay an panlawas nga batan-on nga lalake, ngan maanyag an iya mga mata. Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Samuel, “Amo ini hiya—dihogi hiya!”

en: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him right there in front of his brothers. The LORD ’s spirit came over David from that point forward.
war: Kinuha ni Samuel an lana hin olibo ngan gindihogan niya hi David ha atubangan han iya kabugtoan. Ha gilayon pinakada kan David an espiritu han Ginoo ngan waray na bumulag ha iya tikang hito nga adlaw. Katapos, binmalik hi Samuel ngadto ha Rama.

en: Then Samuel left and went to Ramah.
war: Binmaya kan Saul an espiritu han Ginoo , ngan ginsakit hiya hin usa nga maraot nga espiritu nga iginpadara han Ginoo .

en: Now the LORD ’s spirit had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD tormented him.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an iya mga surugoon, “Maaram kami nga ginsasakit ka hin usa nga maraot nga espiritu nga iginpadara han Dyos.

en: Saul’s servants said to him, “Look, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.
war: Sanglit sugoa kami ngan magbibiling kami hin tawo nga maaram magharpa. Niyan kon makada ha imo an maraot nga espiritu, makakagtukar an tawo han iya arpa ngan hiuulian ka na liwat.”

en: If our master just says the word, your servants will search for someone who knows how to play the lyre. The musician can play whenever the evil spirit from God is affecting you, and then you’ll feel better.”
war: Ginsugo hira ni Saul, “Igbiling ako hin usa ka tawo nga maupay magtukar ngan dad-a hiya nganhi ha akon.”

en: Saul said to his servants, “Find me a good musician and bring him to me.”
war: Nagsiring in usa han iya mga surugoon, “May-ada tawo nga hi Isai nga taga-Betlehem, nga may anak nga lalake nga maupay magtokar hin arpa. Maisog ngan gwapo liwat hiya nga tawo, maupay nga sondalo, ngan maaram magpahimutang hin pulong. Aada ha iya an Ginoo .”

en: One of the servants responded, “I know that one of Jesse’s sons from Bethlehem is a good musician. He’s a strong man and heroic, a warrior who speaks well and is good-looking too. The LORD is with him.”
war: Sanglit nagpadara hi Saul hin mga surugoon ngadto kan Isai hin pagsiring, “Ipadara ha akon hi David nga imo anak nga nagmamangno han mga karnero.”

en: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, “Send me your son David, the one who keeps the sheep.”
war: Ginpadara ni Isai hi David ngadto kan Saul, ngan nagdara hi David hin usa nga nati nga kanding, usa nga asno nga kargado hin tinapay, ngan hin usa nga supot nga anit nga puno hin bino.

en: The Philistines assembled their troops for war at Socoh of Judah. They camped between Socoh and Azekah at Ephes-dammim.
war: Nagkatirok an mga Filisteohanon para hin araway didto ha Soco, usa nga bungto han Juda. Nagkampo hira didto hin usa nga dapit nga gintawag nga Efes Damim, butnga han Soco ug Azeca.

en: Saul and the Israelite army assembled and camped in the Elah Valley, where they got organized to fight the Philistines.
war: Nagtirok liwat hira Saul ngan an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Kahamub-an han Ela, diin nag-andam hira hin pakig-away han mga Filisteohanon.

en: The Philistines took positions on one hill while Israel took positions on the opposite hill. There was a valley between them.
war: Nagkatirok an mga Filisteohanon didto hin usa nga pungtod ngan an mga Israelita didto hin lain nga pungtod, ngan nabubutnga nira in usa nga kahamub-an.

en: A champion named Goliath from Gath came out from the Philistine camp. He was more than nine feet tall.
war: Ginmawas tikang han kampo han mga Filisteohanon in usa ka tawo. Hi Goliat an iya ngaran ngan taga syudad han Gat. Karuyag niya pangayat han mga Israelita. Kapin hin tulo ka metros an iya kahitaas,

en: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore bronze scale-armor weighing one hundred twenty-five pounds.
war: ngan nakakasul-ot hiya hin tumbaga nga panalipod ha lawas, nga natimbang hin mga 50 ka kilo, ngan hin tumbaga nga helmet.

en: He had bronze plates on his shins, and a bronze scimitar hung on his back.
war: May-ada niya polinas nga tumbaga ngan nakakadara hiya hin usa nga bronse nga bangkaw nga ikinakabilay niya ha iya sugbong.

en: His spear shaft was as strong as the bar on a weaver’s loom, and its iron head weighed fifteen pounds. His shield-bearer walked in front of him.
war: An iya bangkaw sugad kadako han likosan hin usa nga hablonan, ngan pito ka kilo an kabug-at han puthaw nga uloulo hini. Nag-uuna ha iya an nagdadara han iya taming.

en: He stopped and shouted to the Israelite troops, “Why have you come and taken up battle formations? I am the Philistine champion, and you are Saul’s servants. Isn’t that right? Select one of your men, and let him come down against me.
war: Tinmindog hi Goliat ngan ginoliatan an mga Israelita, “Nag-iinano kamo didto. Pagrungbay na kamo para hin away? Usa ako nga Filisteohanon, kamo mga oripon ni Saul! Pagpili kamo hin usa han iyo mga tawo nga igpapaaway ha akon.

en: If he is able to fight me and kill me, then we will become your slaves, but if I overcome him and kill him, then you will become our slaves and you will serve us.
war: Kon magdaog hiya ngan patayon ako, magigin oripon kami niyo; kundi kon ako an magdaog ngan patayon ko hiya, magigin oripon kamo namon.

en: I insult Israel’s troops today!” The Philistine continued, “Give me an opponent, and we’ll fight!”
war: Yana inaayat ko an kasondalohan han Israel. Pagpili kamo hin usa ka tawo nga igpapaaway ha akon!”

en: When Saul and all Israel heard what the Philistine said, they were distressed and terrified.
war: Han pakabati hini ni Saul ngan han iya mga tawo nagkahadlok hira hin duro.

en: Now David was Jesse’s son, an Ephraimite from Bethlehem in Judah who had eight sons. By Saul’s time, Jesse was already quite old and far along in age.
war: Hi David amo an anak ni Isai nga sakop han tribo ni Efraim, nga taga-Betlehem han Juda. May-ada hi Isai walo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan dida han panahon nga hadi hi Saul, lagas na hiya hin duro.

en: Jesse’s three oldest sons had gone with Saul to war. Their names were Eliab the oldest, Abinadab the second oldest, and Shammah the third oldest.
war: Inmupod kan Saul an tulo han iya gimamagurangi nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngadto han araway: hi Eliab an suhag, sunod hi Abinadab, ngan hi Sama an ikatulo.

en: (David was the youngest.) These three older sons followed Saul,
war: Hi David an gimamanghori nga anak. Samtang upod ni Saul an tulo nga gimamagorangi nga kabugtoan,

en: but David went back and forth from Saul’s side to shepherd his father’s flock in Bethlehem.
war: dayuday nag-inuulian hi David ngadto ha Betlehem hin pagmangno han mga karnero han iya amay.

en: For forty days straight the Philistine came out and took his stand, both morning and evening.
war: Waray hunong hin pangayat hi Goliat han mga Israelita kada aga ngan gab-i sulod hin kwarenta ka adlaw.

en: Jesse said to his son David, “Please take your brothers an ephah of this roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread. Deliver them quickly to your brothers in the camp.
war: Usa ka adlaw nagsiring hi Isai kan David, “Pagdara hin usa ka basket nga sinanlag nga pagkaon ngan hin napulo ka bug-os nga tinapay, ngan iduhol ini ha imo kabugtoan didto ha kampo.

en: And here, take these ten wedges of cheese to their unit commander. Find out how your brothers are doing and bring back some sign that they are okay.
war: Ngan dad-a liwat ini nga napulo nga mga kiso ngadto han kapitan. Panginanoa kon matiunan-o na an kahimtang han imo kabugtoan, ngan ha imo pagbalik pagdara hin bisan ano ha pagkamatuod nga iginkakita mo hira ngan maupay an ira kahimtang.

en: They are with Saul and all the Israelite troops fighting the Philistines in the Elah Valley.”
war: Aadto ha kahamub-an han Ela hira Hadi Saul, an imo kabugtoan, ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga nakikig-away han mga Filisteohanon.”

en: So David got up early in the morning, left someone in charge of the flock, and loaded up and left, just as his father Jesse had instructed him. He reached the camp right when the army was taking up their battle formations and shouting the war cry.
war: Binmuhat hi David hin sayo han pagkaaga, nagbilin hin tawo nga magmamangno han mga karnero, kinuha an mga pagkaon, ngan linmakat sumala han tugon ha iya ni Isai. Inmabot hiya didto han kampo dida han nagkakagawas na an mga Israelita tipakadto ha pag-awayan, nga nangogogliat han pakiaway.

en: Israel and the Philistines took up their battle formations opposite each other.
war: Nag-asdangay an Filisteohanon ngan Israelita nga mga kasondalohan. Andam na hira nga duha hin pakig-away.

en: David left his things with an attendant and ran to the front line. When he arrived, he asked how his brothers were doing.
war: Iginbilin ni David an pagkaon didto han opisyal nga tinaporan han mga higamit, dinmalagan hiya ngadto han dapit han pag-awayan, kinmadto han iya kabugtoan, ngan nakighimangraw hiya ha ira.

en: Right when David was speaking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, came forward from the Philistine ranks and said the same things he had said before. David listened.
war: Han nakikighimangraw hiya ha ira, ginmawas hi Goliat ngan gin-ayat an mga Israelita sugad han iya hadto pangayat. Ngan hinbatian hiya ni David.

en: When the Israelites saw Goliath, every one of them ran away terrified of him. (
war: Han paghikit-i la han mga Israelita kan Goliat, nagdadlagan hira tungod hin kahadlok.

en: Now the Israelite soldiers had been saying to each other: “Do you see this man who keeps coming out? How he comes to insult Israel? The king will reward with great riches whoever kills that man. The king will give his own daughter to him and make his household exempt from taxes in Israel.”)
war: May hinsiring ha ira, “Tan-awa daw hiya! Pamatii an iya pangayat! Nagsaad hi hadi Saul nga tatagan niya hin pahalipay an tawo nga makamatay ha iya, ipapaasawa liwat hini nga tawo an anak nga babaye han hadi, ngan diri na pababaydon hin mga buhis an panimalay han iya amay.”

en: David asked the soldiers standing by him, “What will be done for the person who kills that Philistine over there and removes this insult from Israel? Who is that uncircumcised Philistine, anyway, that he can get away with insulting the army of the living God?”
war: Nagpakiana hi David han mga tawo nga hirani ha iya, “Ano an ihahatag han tawo nga makamatay hini nga Filisteohanon ngan makatalwas han Israel hini nga kaarawdan? Hin-o gud ini nga pagano nga Filisteohanon nga nangangayat han kasondalohan han buhi nga Dyos?”

en: Then the troops repeated to him what they had been saying. “So that’s what will be done for the man who kills him,” they said.
war: Ira ginsumatan hiya kon ano an ihahatag han tawo nga makakamatay kan Goliat.

en: When David’s oldest brother Eliab heard him talking to the soldiers, he got very mad at David. “Why did you come down here?” he said. “Who is watching those few sheep for you in the wilderness? I know how arrogant you are and your devious plan: you came down just to see the battle!”
war: Hinbatian ni Eliab, an gimamagurangi nga bugto ni David, nga nakikighimangraw hi David han mga tawo. Nasina hiya kan David ngan nagsiring, “Nag-aano ka dinhe? Hin-o man an nagmamangno han imo mga karnero didto ha kamingawan? Listo ka gud! Kinmanhi ka la hin pagkita han araway!”

en: “What did I do wrong this time?” David replied. “It was just a question!”
war: “Kay ano gud an akon ginbuhat?” nagpakiana hi David. “Diri ba ako makakahimo hin pagpakiana?”

en: So David turned to someone else and asked the same thing, and the people said the same thing in reply.
war: Kinmadto hiya hin pagpakiana hin lain nga tawo ngan amo la gihapon an baton han mga tawo.

en: The things David had said were overheard and reported to Saul, who sent for him.
war: Hinbatian hin pipira ka tawo an iginsiring ni David ngan ginsumatan nira hi Saul, ngan iginpatawag hiya ni Saul.

en: “Don’t let anyone lose courage because of this Philistine!” David told Saul. “I, your servant, will go out and fight him!”
war: Nagsiring hi David kan Saul, “Harangdon nga Hadi, waray tawo nga kinahanglan mahadlok hini nga Filisteohanon! Ako an makadto ngan makikig-away ha iya.”

en: “You can’t go out and fight this Philistine,” Saul answered David. “You are still a boy. But he’s been a warrior since he was a boy!”
war: “Ayaw,” binmaton hi Saul. “Uunanhon mo hin pakig-away ha iya? Usa ka la nga bata, ngan anad na hin pakiaway ini nga sondalo ha bug-os niya nga kinabuhi!”

en: “Your servant has kept his father’s sheep,” David replied to Saul, “and if ever a lion or a bear came and carried off one of the flock,
war: Nagsiring hi David, “Harangdon nga Hadi, magmarangno ako han mga karnero han akon amay. Ha takna nga tinatabag hin usa nga liyon o lubo in usa nga nati nga karnero,

en: I would go after it, strike it, and rescue the animal from its mouth. If it turned on me, I would grab it at its jaw, strike it, and kill it.
war: linalanat ko dayon ini, inaaway ko, ngan inaagaw ko an nati. Ngan kon inaatubang ako han liyon o lubo, pinipitlok ko ini ngan tinutubal ko ngada han kamatay.

en: Your servant has fought both lions and bears. This uncircumcised Philistine will be just like one of them because he has insulted the army of the living God.
war: Nakamatay na ako hin mga liyon ngan hin mga lubo, ngan pagbubuhaton ko in sugad hini ngadto hini nga pagano nga Filisteohanon nga nangayat han kasondalohan han buhi nga Dyos.

en: “The LORD ,” David added, “who rescued me from the power of both lions and bears, will rescue me from the power of this Philistine.”
war: Gintalwas ako han Ginoo ha mga liyon ngan mga lubo; tatalwason ako niya hini nga Filisteohanon.”

en: “Go!” Saul replied to David. “And may the LORD be with you!”
war: “Maupay,” binmaton hi Saul. “Kadto na, ngan updan ka unta han Ginoo .”

en: Then Saul dressed David in his own gear, putting a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.
war: Iginpasul-ot niya kan David an iya kalugaringon nga hinganiban: bronse nga helmet nga iya ikinalo kan David, ngan hin bado nga hinganiban.

en: David strapped his sword on over the armor, but he couldn’t walk around well because he’d never tried it before. “I can’t walk in this,” David told Saul, “because I’ve never tried it before.” So he took them off.
war: Igintaklos ni David an kan Saul espada ha bawbaw han hinganiban ngan nagsari hiya hin paglakat, kundi waray hiya pakahimo, kay diri man hiya hiara hin pagsul-ot hini. “Diri ako makakaaway kon magsul-ot ako hini ngatanan, kay diri ako hiara hini,” ginsiring niya hi Saul. Sanglit ginhugkas niya ini ngatanan.

en: He then grabbed his staff and chose five smooth stones from the streambed. He put them in the pocket of his shepherd’s bag and with sling in hand went out to the Philistine.
war: Kinuha niya an iya tungkod, ngan pinmurot hiya ha sapa hin lima nga mga bato nga lison ngan iginsulod ini ha iya supot. Dara an iya andam na nga labyog, ginmawas hiya hin pag-atubang kan Goliat.

en: The Philistine got closer and closer to David, and his shield-bearer was in front of him.
war: Nagtikang pagdaop hi Goliat ngadto kan David, nga nag-uuna ha iya an paradara han iya taming. Nagtipahirani na hiya,

en: When the Philistine looked David over, he sneered at David because he was just a boy; reddish brown and good-looking.
war: tubtob nga hinkit-an niya hin maupay hi David. Gintamay niya hi David kay usa la hiya nga bata nga mahusay pagkit-on.

en: The Philistine asked David, “Am I some sort of dog that you come at me with sticks?” And he cursed David by his gods.
war: Nagsiring hiya kan David, “Ano an gamit hito nga tungkod? Usa ba ako nga ayam ha imo paghunahuna?” Ngan gintunglo niya hi David pinaagi han iya diyos.

en: “Come here,” he said to David, “and I’ll feed your flesh to the wild birds and the wild animals!”
war: “Kadi na,” gin-ayat niya hi David, “ngan itutubong ko an imo lawas ha katamsihan ngan kamanampan basi nira kaonon!”

en: But David told the Philistine, “You are coming against me with sword, spear, and scimitar, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel’s army, the one you’ve insulted.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Nakanhi ka kontra ha akon dara in espada, bangkaw, ngan hilaba nga tugsok, kundi nakanhi ako kontra ha imo ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum, nga Dyos han mga kasondalohan han Israel nga imo ginpinangayat.

en: Today the LORD will hand you over to me. I will strike you down and cut off your head! Today I will feed your dead body and the dead bodies of the entire Philistine camp to the wild birds and the wild animals. Then the whole world will know that there is a God on Israel’s side.
war: Yana gud nga adlaw igtutubyan ka han Ginoo ha akon gahom; pipirdehon ngan pupugotan ko ikaw han imo ulo. Ngan itutubong ko an mga lawas han kasondalohan nga Filisteohanon ngadto han katamsihan ngan kamanampan basi nira pangaonon. Niyan mahibabaro an bug-os nga kalibutan nga may-ada Dyos an Israel,

en: And all those gathered here will know that the LORD doesn’t save by means of sword and spear. The LORD owns this war, and he will hand all of you over to us.”
war: ngan hisasabotan han ngatanan dinhe nga diri an Ginoo nagkikinahanglan hin mga espada o mga bangkaw hin pagtalwas han iya mga tawo. Madaogon hiya ha pag-awayan, ngan igtutubyan kamo ngatanan ha amon gahom.”

en: The Philistine got up and moved closer to attack David, and David ran quickly to the front line to face him.
war: Dinmasmag hi Goliat kan David, ngan dinmalagan dayon hi David hin pagtapo ha iya.

en: David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone. He slung it, and it hit the Philistine on his forehead. The stone penetrated his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.
war: Kinmuot hiya han iya supot ngan kinmuha hin usa nga bato nga iya iginlabyog ngadto kan Goliat. Naigo an agtang ni Goliat ngan nahilubong an bato ha ulo ni Goliat, ngan nahipakulob ha tuna hi Goliat.

en: And that’s how David triumphed over the Philistine with just a sling and a stone, striking the Philistine down and killing him—and David didn’t even have a sword!
war: Sanglit, bisan waray usa nga espada, ginpirde ngan ginpatay ni David hi Goliat pinaagi la hin usa nga labyog ngan hin usa nga bato!

en: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine. He grabbed the Philistine’s sword, drew it from its sheath, and finished him off. Then David cut off the Philistine’s head with the sword.
war: Dinmalagan hiya ngadto kan Goliat; gintungtongan hiya, hinulbot niya an espada ni Goliat ginpatay ngan ginpugotan hiya.

en: When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they fled.
war: Han pakakita han mga Filisteohanon nga patay na an ira maisog nga sondalo, nagdadlagan hira.

en: The soldiers from Israel and Judah jumped up with a shout and chased the Philistines all the way to Gath and the gates of Ekron. The dead Philistines were littered along the Shaarim road all the way to Gath and Ekron.
war: Ginmoliat an mga tawo han Israel ug Juda, ngan ginlanat nira an mga Filisteohanon tubtob gud ngadto ha Gat, ngan ngadto han mga ganghaan han Ekron. Nagkatutumba an mga Filisteohanon nga samad dida ha dalan nga tipakadto ha Saaraim, tubtob ha Gatug Ekron.

en: When the Israelites came back from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.
war: Han pagbalik na han mga Israelita tikang han paglanat nira han mga Filisteohanon, pinanikasan nira an kampo han mga Filisteohanon.

en: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.
war: Ginkuha ni David an ulo ni Goliat ngan gindara ini ngadto ha Jerusalem, kundi iya ginhimos an mga hinganiban ni Goliat didto han iya kalugaringon nga tulda.

en: Now when Saul saw David go out to meet the Philistine, he asked Abner the army general, “Abner, whose son is that boy?”
war: Han pakakita ni Saul kan David nga tikadto na hin pakig-away kan Goliat, nagpakiana hiya kan Abner nga kapitan han iya kasondalohan, “Abner, kanay hiya anak?”

en: “As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I don’t know,” Abner answered.
war: “Waray ako kalibutan, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hi Abner.

en: As soon as David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan’s life became bound up with David’s life, and Jonathan loved David as much as himself.
war: Nahuman an hiruhimangraw nira Saul ug David. Katapos naruyag hin duro kan David hi Jonatan nga anak nga lalake ni Saul. Ginhigugma hi David ni Jonatan sugad han iya paghigugma ha iya ngahaw.

en: From that point forward, Saul kept David in his service and wouldn’t allow him to return to his father’s household.
war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw ginhawiran ni Saul hi David ngan waray na hiya paulia.

en: And Jonathan and David made a covenant together because Jonathan loved David as much as himself.
war: Nagsumpa hi Jonatan hin dayon nga pakigsangkay kan David, tungod han iya dako nga paghigugma ha iya.

en: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his armor, as well as his sword, his bow, and his belt.
war: Ginhugkas niya an panapton nga iya iginsusul-ot ngan iginhatag ini kan David, upod liwat an iya hinganiban, ngan an iya espada, pana, ug paha.

en: David went out and was successful in every mission Saul sent him to do. So Saul placed him in charge of the soldiers, and this pleased all the troops as well as Saul’s servants.
war: Nagmainuswagon hi David dida han ngatanan nga buruhaton nga iginsugo ha iya ni Saul, sanglit ginhimo hiya ni Saul nga usa nga opisyal han iya kasondalohan. Nakalipay ini han ngatanan nga mga opisyal ngan mga tawo ni Saul.

en: After David came back from killing the Philistine, and as the troops returned home, women from all of Israel’s towns came out to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with tambourines, rejoicing, and musical instruments.
war: Han nabalik na hi David katapos niya pakamatay kan Goliat, ngan han nangunguli na an mga sondalo, nagkagawas hin pagtapo kan Hadi Saul in kababayen-an tikang han ngatanan nga kaburubungtohan han Israel. Nag-awit hira hin malipayon nga mga kanta, nagsarayaw, ngan nagtokar hin mga tamburin ngan mga lira.

en: The women sang in celebration:
war: Dida han ira pagsaurog nagkanta an kababayen-an, “Nakamatay hi Saul hin yinukot, kundi hi David hin tinag napulo ka yukot.”

en: “Saul has killed his thousands,
war: Waray maruyag hini hi Saul, ngan nasina hiya hin duro. Nagsiring hiya, “Kay ano nga nasiring hira nga tinag napulo ka yukot an namatay ni David kundi ako yinukot la? Diri maiha, hihimoon nira nga hadi hi David.”

en: but David has killed his tens of thousands!”
war: Sanglit tikang hito nga adlaw maabugho ngan matinahapon na hiya kan David.

en: Saul burned with anger. This song annoyed him. “They’ve credited David with tens of thousands,” he said, “but only credit me with thousands. What’s next for him—the kingdom itself?”
war: Han pagkabuwas tigda la nga sinmulod kan Saul in maraot nga espiritu nga tikang ha Dyos, ngan nagyinakan hiya nga maraot an ulo didto han iya balay sugad hin usa nga tuyaw. Nagtukar hi David han arpa sugad han iya binubuhat adlaw-adlaw, ngan nakapot hi Saul hin usa nga bangkaw.

en: So Saul kept a close eye on David from that point on.
war: Naghunahuna hi Saul, “Itataod ko hiya ha bungbong,” ngan iya ginbangkaw hi David makaduha, kundi nakakalikay dayon hi David.

en: The next day an evil spirit from God came over Saul, and he acted like he was in a prophetic frenzy in his house. So David played the lyre as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand,
war: Nahadlok hi Saul kan David kay upod na kan David an Ginoo ngan ginbayaan na hiya.

en: and he threw it, thinking, I’ll pin David to the wall. But David escaped from him two different times.
war: Sanglit ginpaiwas hiya ni Saul ngan ginhimo hiya nga kapitan hin usa ka yukot nga mga tawo. Ginmandoan ni David an iya mga tawo ha didto pag-awayan,

en: Saul was afraid of David because the LORD was with David but no longer with Saul.
war: ngan nagmainuswagon hiya ha ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat, kay upod ha iya an Ginoo .

en: So Saul removed David from his service, placing him in command of a unit of one thousand men. David led the men out to war and back.
war: Hinkit-an ni Saul an pag-uswag ni David ngan nagdugang an iya kahadlok ha iya.

en: David was successful in everything he did because the LORD was with him.
war: Kundi hinmigugma kan David an ngatanan didto ha Israel ug Juda, kay mainuswagon gud hiya nga pangulo.

en: Saul saw that he was very successful, and he was afraid of him.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Saul kan David, “Iini hi Merab nga akon magurang nga anak nga babaye. Igpapaasawa ko hiya ha imo, kon mag-aalagad ka ha akon sugad nga maisog ngan maunongon nga sondalo, ngan makikig-away ka han mga kaaway han Ginoo .” (Naghunahuna hi Saul nga dida hini nga paagi papatayon hi David han mga Filisteohanon, ngan diri na kinahanglan nga hiya an magbuhat hini.)

en: Everyone in Israel and Judah loved David because he led them out in war and back again.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Hin-o man ako ngan ano gud an akon panimalay nga magin umagad ako han hadi?”

en: Saul said to David, “Look, here is my oldest daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage on this condition: you must be my warrior and fight the LORD ’s battles.” I won’t raise my hand against him, Saul thought; let the Philistines do that!
war: Kundi ha pag-abot na han panahon nga ipapaasawa na unta hi Merab kan David, iginpaasawa lugod hiya kan Adriel, nga taga-Mehola.

en: “I’m not worthy,” David replied to Saul, “and neither is my family or my father’s clan in Israel, to become the king’s son-in-law.”
war: Kundi nahigugma kan David hi Mical nga anak liwat ni Saul, ngan nalipay hi Saul han paghibaro niya hini.

en: And so when the time came for Saul’s daughter Merab to be married to David, she was given to Adriel from Meholah instead.
war: Naghunahuna hiya, “Ighahatag ko hi Mical ngadto kan David; gagamiton ko hiya hin pagbitik kan David, basi patayon hi David han mga Filisteohanon.” Sanglit nagsiring hi Saul kan David, hin ikaduha, “Magigin umagad ka nakon.”

en: Now Saul’s younger daughter Michal loved David. When this was reported to Saul, he was happy about it.
war: Ginsugo niya an iya mga opisyal hin paghimangraw hin hilit kan David ngan pagsumatan hiya, “Nalilipay ha imo an hadi ngan naruruyag ha imo an ngatanan nga mga opisyal; yana amo an maupay nga panahon para ha imo hin pangasawa han iya anak.”

en: I’ll give her to him, Saul thought; she’ll cause him problems, and the Philistines will be against him.
war: Sanglit iginsumat ini nira kan David, ngan binmaton hiya, “Dako ini nga dungog nga maumagad ako han hadi, dako gud para hin kablas ngan gutiay nga pagkatawo sugad ha akon.”

en: So Saul said to David a second time, “Become my son-in-law now.”
war: Ginsumatan hi Saul han mga opisyal han iginsiring hi David,

en: Saul instructed his servants, “Tell David in private: ‘Look, the king likes you, and all his servants love you. You should become the king’s son-in-law.’”
war: ngan ginsugo hira ni Saul hin pagsumat kan David: “An karuyag la ha imo han hadi sugad nga bugay para han karaslon amo an mga kayupapis han mga ikinatawo hin usa ka gatos nga patay nga mga Filisteohanon. Usa ini nga pagbulos han iya mga kaaway.” (Amo ini an larang ni Saul hin pagpatay kan David pinaagi han mga Filisteohanon.)

en: Saul’s servants whispered these things in David’s ear. But David said, “Do you think it’s a simple matter to become the king’s son-in-law? I don’t! I’m poor and insignificant.”
war: Iginsumat kan David han mga opisyal ni Saul an iginsiring ni Saul, ngan nakalipay kan David nga hiya an magigin umagad han hadi. San-o umabot an adlaw han kasal,

en: Saul’s servants reported what David said,
war: linmakat hira David ngan han iya mga tawo ngan pinamatay nira in duha ka gatos nga mga Filisteohanon. Gindara niya ngadto kan Saul an ira kayupapis han ira ikinatawo ngan gin-ihap ini ngatanan ha iya basi mahimo hiya nga umagad ni Saul. Sanglit iginpaasawa ni Saul kan David hi Mical nga iya anak.

en: and Saul replied, “Tell David this: ‘The king doesn’t want any bridal gift, just a hundred Philistine foreskins as vengeance on the king’s enemies.’” (Saul was hoping that David would die at the hands of the Philistines.)
war: Nakasabot gud hi Saul nga upod kan David an Ginoo ngan nahigugma liwat ha iya hi Mical nga iya anak.

en: When the servants reported this to David, he was happy to become the king’s son-in-law. Even before the allotted time had expired,
war: Sanglit nagdugang an iya kahadlok kan David, ngan iya kaaway hi David samtang buhi pa hiya.

en: David got up and went with his soldiers and killed one hundred Philistines. David brought their foreskins and counted them out for the king so he could become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave his daughter Michal to him in marriage.
war: Nagbalikbalik hin pakig-away an Filisteohanon nga mga kasondalohan, kundi ha kada araway, labaw nga mainuswagon hi David kay han iba nga mga opisyal ni Saul. Tungod hini nagin bantogan hin duro hi David.

en: Saul ordered his son Jonathan and all his servants to kill David, but Jonathan, Saul’s son, liked David very much.
war: Ginsumatan ni Saul hi Jonatan nga iya anak ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal nga nakahunahuna hiya hin pagpatay kan David. Kundi nahigugma hin duro hi Jonatan kan David,

en: So Jonathan warned David, “My father Saul is trying to kill you. Be on guard tomorrow morning. Stay somewhere safe and hide.
war: sanglit iya ginsumatan hi David, “Gin-iiparatay ka han akon amay. Sanglit likay gud buwas han aga; pakadto hin usa nga tago nga dapit ngan pagpabilin didto.

en: I’ll go out and stand by my father in the field where you’ll be. I’ll talk to my father about you, and I’ll tell you whatever I find out.”
war: Makadto ako ngan uupdan ko an akon amay didto han uma nga imo tinatagoan, ngan makikighimangraw ako ha iya hiunong ha imo. Susumatan ta na la ikaw kon ano an akon hibaroan.”

en: So Jonathan spoke highly about David to his father Saul, telling him, “The king shouldn’t do anything wrong to his servant David, because he hasn’t wronged you. In fact, his actions have helped you greatly.
war: Gindayaw ni Jonatan hi David ha atubangan ni Saul ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga karuyag man nimo pagpatay kan David nga imo surugoon? Waray man hiya nabuhat ha imo nga maraot; lugod maupay man hiya mag-alagad ha imo.

en: He risked his own life when he killed that Philistine, and the LORD won a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and were happy about it. Why then would you do something wrong to an innocent person by killing David for no reason?”
war: Igin-unong niya an iya kinabuhi han pagpataya niya kan Goliat, ngan ginbuhat han Ginoo in dako nga pagdarag-an para han Israel. Nalipay ka ngani han pakakita mo hini. Sanglit kay ano nga karuyag mo buhaton yana hin maraot hini nga tawo nga waray sala ngan patayon hi David hin waray ano man nga hinungdan?”

en: Saul listened to Jonathan and then swore, “As surely as the LORD lives, David won’t be executed.”
war: Pinamatian ni Saul an ginsiring ni Jonatan ngan nagsumpa hiya ha ngaran han Ginoo nga diri niya papatayon hi David.

en: So Jonathan summoned David and told him everything they had talked about. Then Jonathan brought David back to Saul, and David served Saul as he had previously.
war: Sanglit gintawag ni Jonatan hi David ngan ginsumatan niya han ngatanan; niyan iya gindara hi David ngadto kan Saul ngan nag-alagad hi David han hadi sugad han iya ginbuhat han una.

en: War broke out again. When David went out to fight the Philistines, he struck them with such force that they ran from him.
war: May-ada na liwat araway kontra han mga Filisteohanon. Ginsulong hira ni David ngan damo an iya pinamatay sanglit nangalagiw an mga Filisteohanon.

en: Then an evil spirit from the LORD came over Saul. He was sitting in his house with his spear in hand while David was playing music.
war: Usa ka adlaw sinmakob na liwat kan Saul in usa nga maraot nga espiritu nga tikang han Ginoo . Nalingkod hiya didto han iya balay nga nakapot han iya bangkaw, ngan nakadto hi David nagtotokar han iya arpa.

en: Saul tried to pin David to the wall with his spear, but David escaped Saul. Saul drove the spear into the wall, but David fled and got away safely. That night
war: Gintinguha ni Saul hin pagtaod kan David ha bungbong pinaagi han iya bangkaw, kundi nakalikay hi David, ngan ginmuot an bangkaw ha bungbong. Dinmalagan hi David ngan kinmalagiw.

en: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to keep watch on it and kill him in the morning. David’s wife Michal warned him, “If you don’t escape with your life tonight, you are a dead man tomorrow.”
war: Hito ngahaw nga gab-i nagsugo hi Saul hin mga tawo hin pagbantay han balay ni David ngan pagpatay ha iya pagkaaga. Ginpahimatngonan hi David ni Mical nga iya asawa, “Kon diri ka kumalagiw yana nga gab-i, mapatay ka buwas.”

en: So Michal lowered David through a window. He took off and ran, and he got away.
war: Ginpalusad hi David ni Mical ha bintana, ngan dinmalagan ngan kinmalagiw hiya.

en: Then Michal took the household’s divine image and laid it in the bed, putting some goat’s hair on its head and covering it with clothes.
war: Niyan kinuha ni Mical an diyosdiyos han panimalay, iginhigda ini niya dida han higdaan, ginpaolon ini hin ulonan nga hinimo hin barahibo hin kanding, ngan gintahoban.

en: Saul sent messengers to arrest David, but she said, “He’s sick.”
war: Han pag-abot na han mga tawo ni Saul pagkuha kan David, ginsumatan hira ni Mical nga masakit hiya.

en: Saul sent the messengers back to check on David for themselves. “Bring him to me on his bed,” he ordered, “so he can be executed.”
war: Kundi ginpabalik hira ni Saul. Ginsugo hira, “Dad-a hiya nganhi dida ha iya higdaan ngan papatayon ko hiya.”

en: When the messengers arrived, they found the idol in the bed with the goat’s hair on its head.
war: Sinmakob hira ngan ira hin-agian didto han higdaan an diyosdiyos han balay ngan an ulonan nga barahibo hin kanding nga inoonlan.

en: Saul said to Michal, “Why could you betray me like this, letting my enemy go so that now he has escaped?”
war: Nagpakiana hi Saul kan Mical, “Kay ano nga ginlimbongan mo ako hin sugad hini ngan ginpakalagiw mo an akon kaaway?”

en: Michal said to Saul, “David told me, ‘Help me get away or I’ll kill you!’”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Nagsiring hiya nga papatayon ako niya kon diri ko hiya buligan hin pagkalagiw.”

en: So David fled and escaped. When he reached Samuel at Ramah, he reported to him everything Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to stay in the camps.
war: Kinmalagiw hi David ngan kinmadto hiya kan Samuel didto ha Rama ngan iya ginsumatan hi Samuel han ngatanan nga ginbuhat ha iya ni Saul. Niyan kinmadto hiya ngan hi Samuel ha Naiot ngan nagpabilin hira didto.

en: When Saul was told that David was in the camps at Ramah,
war: Ginsumatan hi Saul nga nakadto hi David ha Naiot didto ha Rama,

en: he sent messengers to arrest David. They saw a group of prophets in a prophetic frenzy, with Samuel standing there as their leader. God’s spirit came over Saul’s messengers, and they also fell into a prophetic frenzy.
war: sanglit nagsugo hiya hin mga tawo hin pagdakop ha iya. Hinkit-an nira an hugpo hin mga manaragna nga sigi an panagna ngan hi Samuel amo an nag-uuna ha ira. Niyan sinmakob an espiritu han Dyos han mga tawo ni Saul, ngan sigi liwat an ira panagna.

en: This was reported to Saul, and he sent different messengers, but they also fell into a prophetic frenzy. So Saul sent a third group of messengers, and they did the very same thing.
war: Han paghibaro hini ni Saul, nagpadara hiya hin darudamo pa nga mga sinugo, ngan nanagna liwat ini hira. Nagpadara pa hiya hin mga sinugo ha ikatulo na, ngan amo gihapon an nahinabo ha ira.

en: At that point, Saul went to Ramah himself. He came to the well at the threshing floor that was on the bare hill there and asked, “Where are Samuel and David?”
war: Sanglit hiya na gud an kinmadto ha Rama. Han pag-abot niya ngadto han dako nga atabay didto ha Secu, nagpakiana hiya kon hain hira Samuel ug David ngan ginsumatan hiya nga nakadto hira ha Naiot.

en: “In the camps at Ramah,” he was told.
war: Han nagtitipakadto na hiya, sinmakob liwat ha iya an espiritu han Dyos, ngan nanagna hiya dida han dalan asta ngadto ha Naiot.

en: David fled from the camps at Ramah. He came to Jonathan and asked, “What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father that he wants me dead?”
war: Niyan kinmalagiw hi David ha Naiot didto ha Rama, ngan kinmadto hiya kan Jonatan. Nagpakiana hiya, “Ano ba an akon nabuhat? Ano an akon sala? Ano nga sayop an akon nabuhat han imo amay nga karuyag man niya hin pagpatay ha akon?”

en: Jonathan said to him, “No! You are not going to die! Listen: My father doesn’t do anything big or small without telling me first. Why would my father hide this from me? It isn’t true!”
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Diri unta itugot han Dyos nga patayon ka! Iginsusumat ha akon han akon amay an ngatanan nga binubuhat niya, maimportante ini o diri, ngan waray gud niya iginlilirong ha akon. Diri gud ini matuod.”

en: But David solemnly promised in response, “Your father knows full well that you like me. He probably said, ‘Jonathan must not learn about this or he’ll be upset.’ But I promise you—on the LORD ’s life and yours!—that I am this close to death!”
war: Kundi binmaton hi David, “Sayod gud an imo amay han imo pagmahal ha akon, ngan diri hiya karuyag magsumat ha imo han iya bubuhaton, kay mabibido ka hin duro. Nagsusumpa ako ha imo pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga haraniay na ako ha kamatayon!”

en: “What do you want me to do?” Jonathan said to David. “I’ll do it.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jonatan, “Tutumanon ko an bisan ano nga imo karuyag.”

en: “Okay, listen,” David answered Jonathan. “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I’m supposed to sit with the king at the feast. Instead, let me go and I’ll hide in the field until nighttime.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Buwas amo an Pyesta han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan, ngan kinahanglan nga makigsaro ako han hadi. Kundi kon maupay ini para ha imo, tugoti ako hin pagtago didto ha uma ngada han pagkasangbuwas han gab-i.

en: If your father takes note of my absence, tell him, ‘David begged my permission to run down to his hometown Bethlehem, because there is an annual sacrifice there for his whole family.’
war: Kon iliwon ako han imo amay, sumati hiya nga nagsarit ako ha imo hin pagdali ngadto ha Betlehem, kay panahon ini han tinuig nga paghalad didto han akon bug-os nga panimalay.

en: If Saul says ‘Fine,’ then I, your servant, am safe. But if he loses his temper, then you’ll know for certain that he intends to harm me.
war: Kon sumiring hiya, ‘Maupay man,’ waray kahadlokan ko; kundi kon masina hiya, hibabaroan mo nga magtitinguha gud hiya hin pagpatay ha akon.

en: So be loyal to your servant, because you’ve brought your servant into a sacred covenant with you. If I’m guilty, then kill me yourself; just don’t take me back to your father.”
war: Kundi kalooyi ako ngan tumana an iginsumpa mo ha akon. Kundi kon salaan man ako, ikaw na la an pagpatay ha akon! Kay ano nga dadad-on mo pa ako ngadto han imo amay basi patayon ako?”

en: “Enough!” Jonathan replied. “If I can determine for certain that my father intends to harm you, of course I’ll tell you!”
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Ayaw gad paghunahuna hin sugad! Kon hinbaroan ko la nga may tuyo an akon amay hin pagpatay ha imo, diri ko ba ikaw pagsusumatan?”

en: “Who will tell me if your father responds harshly?” David asked Jonathan.
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi David, “Hin-o man in magpapahibaro ha akon kon mangisog an imo amay hin pagbaton ha imo?”

en: “Come on,” Jonathan said to David. “Let’s go into the field.” So both of them went out into the field.
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Tana, pakadto kita ha kaumhan.” Sanglit kinmadto hira,

en: Then Jonathan told David, “I pledge by the LORD God of Israel that I will question my father by this time tomorrow or on the third day. If he seems favorable toward David, I will definitely send word and make sure you know.
war: ngan nagsiring hi Jonatan kan David, “Maaton unta saksi an Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel! Ha sugad hini nga takna buwas ngan sangbuwas pakikianhan ko an akon amay. Kon maupay an iya paghunahuna ha imo, pahibabaroon ko ikaw.

en: But if my father intends to harm you, then may the LORD deal harshly with me, Jonathan, and worse still if I don’t tell you right away so that you can escape safely. May the LORD be with you as he once was with my father.
war: Kon magtuyo hiya hin pagpatay ha imo, patayon unta ako han Ginoo kon diri ko ikaw pahibaroon hini basi makapalagiw ka. Umupod unta ha imo an Ginoo sugad han iya pag-upod han akon amay!

en: If I remain alive, be loyal to me. But if I die,
war: Ngan kon buhion pa ako, tumana gad an imo iginsumpa ngan unongi ako; kundi kon mamatay ako,

en: don’t ever stop being loyal to my household. Once the LORD has eliminated all of David’s enemies from the earth,
war: igpakita an amo ngahaw nga imo pagmahal han akon panimalay ha kadayonan. Ngan kon pagpuohon na han Ginoo an ngatanan mo nga kaaway,

en: if Jonathan’s name is also eliminated, then the LORD will seek retribution from David!”
war: diri la unta gihapon mabungkag an aton ginsaaran. Kon mabungkag ini, kakastigohon ka han Ginoo .”

en: So Jonathan again made a pledge to David because he loved David as much as himself.
war: Ha makausa pa ginpasaad ni Jonatan hi David hin paghigugma ha iya, kay ginhigugma ni Jonatan hi David sugad han iya paghigugma ha iya ngahaw.

en: “Tomorrow is the festival of the new moon,” Jonathan told David. “You will be missed because your seat will be empty.
war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya hi Jonatan, “Tungod nga Pyesta man han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan buwas, iiliwon ka kon waray ka didto han pangaon.

en: The day after tomorrow, go all the way to the spot where you hid on the day of the incident, and stay close to that mound.
war: Ha pagkasangbuwas labi na gud nga iiliwon ka; sanglit pakadto han dapit nga gintagoan mo han una, ngan tago ha luyo han tinambak nga mga bato didto.

en: On the third day I will shoot an arrow to the side of the mound as if aiming at a target.
war: Niyan mapana ako ngan pupontingon ko ito nga dapit hin makatulo.

en: Then I’ll send the servant boy, saying, ‘Go retrieve the arrow.’ If I yell to the boy, ‘Hey! The arrow is on this side of you. Get it!’ then you can come out because it will be safe for you. There won’t be any trouble—I make a pledge on the LORD ’s life.
war: Niyan pakakadtoon ko an akon surugoon pamiling han mga pana. Ngan kon sidngon ko hiya, ‘Kitaa, aadi didi an mga pana hini nga ligid ha imo, kuhaa ini,’ karuyag sidngon hito nga waray na kataragman ngan makakagawas ka. Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga waray mo sadang kahadlokan.

en: But if I yell to the young man, ‘Hey! The arrow is past you,’ then run for it, because the LORD has sent you away.
war: Kundi kon sidngon ko hiya, ‘Aadto an mga pana ha imo luyo,’ lakat dayon, kay ginpapalakat ka han Ginoo .

en: Either way, the LORD is witness between us forever regarding the promise we made to each other.”
war: Mahitungod han ginsaaran naton, an Ginoo an maaram nga tutumanon ta ini ha kadayonan.”

en: So David hid himself in the field.
war: Sanglit tinmago hi David didto han uma. Dida han Pyesta na han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan, kinmadto hi Hadi Saul hin pagkaon,

en: When the new moon came, the king sat at the feast to eat.
war: ngan linmingkod hiya dida han iya hin-aaraan nga dapit ha may bungbong. Linmingkod hi Abner sapit ha iya ngan hi Jonatan tugbang ha iya. Waray nalingkod dida han dapit ni David,

en: He took his customary seat by the wall. Jonathan sat opposite him while Abner sat beside Saul. David’s seat was empty.
war: kundi waray la mag-aringasa hi Saul hito nga adlaw, kay naghunahuna hiya, “May nahinabo ha iya, ngan diri pa hiya malinis sumala han seremonyas.”

en: Saul didn’t say anything that day because he thought, Perhaps David became unclean somehow. That must be it.
war: Han pagkabuwas, an sunod nga adlaw han Pyesta han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan, waray la gihapon nalingkod dida han dapit ni David, ngan nagpakiana hi Saul kan Jonatan, “Kay ano nga waray kumanhi hi David han pangaon kakulop o yana?”

en: But on the next day, the second of the new moon, David’s seat was still empty. Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why hasn’t Jesse’s son come to the table, either yesterday or today?”
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Nagsarit hiya ha akon nga makadto hiya ha Betlehem. Nagsiring hiya,

en: Jonathan answered Saul, “David begged my permission to go to Bethlehem.
war: ‘Tugoti gad ako hin pagkadto, kay nagsasaurog an amon panimalay han pyesta hin paghalad didto ha bungto, ngan nagsugo ha akon an akon bugto nga kumadto gud ako. Sanglit, kon sangkay ko man ikaw, tugoti ako hin pagkadto ngan pakigkita han akon mga kauropdan.’ Amo ito nga waray hiya dida han iya dapit dinhe han imo lamesa.”

en: He said, ‘Please let me go because we have a family sacrifice there in town, and my brother has ordered me to be present. Please do me a favor and let me slip away so I can see my family.’ That’s why David hasn’t been at the king’s table.”
war: Napungot hin duro hi Saul kan Jonatan ngan ginsiring hiya, “Anak ka hin masinupilon ngan malingo nga iroy! Yana maaram na ako nga naugop ka kan David, ngan ginpapakaalohan mo la an imo kalugaringon ngan ito nga iroy mo!

en: At that, Saul got angry at Jonathan. “You son of a stubborn, rebellious woman!” he said. “Do you think I don’t know how you’ve allied yourself with Jesse’s son? Shame on you and on the mother who birthed you!
war: Diri ka ba maaram nga samtang buhi pa hi David, diri ka gud mahihimo nga hadi hini nga nasod? Kadto na, ngan dad-a hiya nganhi—kinahanglan mamatay hiya!”

en: As long as Jesse’s son lives on this earth, neither you nor your dynasty will be secure. Now have him brought to me because he’s a dead man!”
war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Kay ano nga papatayon hiya? Ano an iya nabuhat?”

en: But Jonathan answered his father Saul, “Why should David be executed? What has he done?”
war: Dida hito, ginbangkaw ni Saul hi Jonatan hin pagpatay ha iya, ngan sinmabot hi Jonatan nga tuyo gud ni Saul hin pagpatay kan David.

en: At that, Saul threw his spear at Jonathan to strike him, and Jonathan realized that his father intended to kill David.
war: Binmuhat hi Jonatan ha lamesa nga napupungot gud ngan waray gud hiya kumaon hito nga adlaw—an ikaduha nga adlaw han Pyesta han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan. Duro gud an iya kabido hiunong kan David, kay ginpakaalohan hi David ni Saul.

en: Jonathan got up from the table in a rage. He didn’t eat anything on the second day of the new moon because he was worried about David and because his father had humiliated him.
war: Han pagkaaga kinmadto hi Jonatan ha uma hin pakigkita kan David, sumala han ira sabot. Ginpaupod niya in usa nga bata nga lalake,

en: In the morning, Jonathan went out to the field for the meeting with David, and a young servant boy went with him.
war: ngan ginsiring niya, “Dalagan ngan pamilnga an mga pana nga akon iginpunting.” Dinmalagan an bata ngan ipinunting ni Jonatan an pana ha unhan niya.

en: He said to the boy, “Go quickly and retrieve the arrow that I shoot.” So the boy ran off, and he shot an arrow beyond him.
war: Han pag-abot han bata ngadto han dapit nga nahulogan han pana, ginmoliat hi Jonatan, “Aadto pa ha unhan an pana!

en: When the boy got to the spot where Jonathan shot the arrow, Jonathan yelled to him, “Isn’t the arrow past you?”
war: Ayaw pagtinukdaw la dida! Dali!” Ginpurot han bata an pana ngan iginbalik ini ngadto han iya agaron,

en: Jonathan yelled again to the boy, “Quick! Hurry up! Don’t just stand there!” So Jonathan’s servant boy gathered up the arrow and came back to his master.
war: nga waray gud hiya kalibutan han karuyag sidngon; hi Jonatan ngan hi David la an maaram.

en: The boy had no idea what had happened; only Jonathan and David knew.
war: Iginhatag ni Jonatan an iya mga hinganiban ngadto han bata ngan ginpauli niya ngadto ha bungto.

en: Jonathan handed his weapons to the boy and told him, “Get going. Take these back to town.”
war: Han paghilakat na han bata, binmuhat hi David ha luyo han tinambak nga mga bato, linmuhod, ngan yinmukbo ha tuna makatulo. Magkasi nagtatangis hira David ug Jonatan nga naghaharokay; darodako ngani an kabidoan ni David kay han kan Jonatan.

en: As soon as the boy was gone, David came out from behind the mound and fell down, face on the ground, bowing low three times. The friends kissed each other, and cried with each other, but David cried hardest.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jonatan kan David, “Maada unta ha imo an Dyos. Kikitaon gud han Ginoo nga tutumanon ha kadayonan an aton ginsumpaan nga ginhimo nimo ngan nakon, ngan han imo ngan akon mga tulin.” Niyan linmakat hi David, ngan binmalik hi Jonatan ngadto ha bungto.

en: David came to Nob where Ahimelech was priest. Ahimelech was shaking in fear when he met David. “Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?” he asked.
war: Kinmadto hi David kan Ahimelec nga padi didto ha Nob. Ginmawas hi Ahimelec nga nangungurog hin pagtapo ha iya ngan nagpakiana, “Kay ano nga usa ka man la nga nakanhi?”

en: David answered Ahimelech the priest, “The king has given me orders, but he instructed me, ‘Don’t let anyone know anything about the mission I’m sending you on or about your orders.’ As for my troops, I told them to meet me at an undisclosed location.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Aanhi ako kay ginsugo ako han hadi. Gintugon ako niya nga diri ako magsumat bisan kan kanay han iya ginsugo ha akon. Hiunong han akon mga tawo, ginsiring ko hira nga tapoon ako nira didto hin usa nga dapit.

en: Now what do you have here with you? Give me five loaves of bread or whatever you can find.”
war: Sanglit yana ano man nga pagkaon an aada ha imo? Tagi ako hin lima ka bug-os nga tinapay o bisan ano nga aada ha imo.”

en: “I don’t have any regular bread on hand,” the priest answered David, “just holy bread—but only if your troops have abstained from sexual activity.”
war: Nagsiring an padi, “Waray ko ordinaryo nga tinapay, kundi tinapay la nga ginhalad na ha altar; ihahatag ko ini kon waray yana makighilawas an imo mga tawo.”

en: “Definitely,” David answered the priest. “Whenever I go out to war, women are off-limits; that’s our standard operating procedure. Even on regular missions, the men’s gear is kept holy. That’s even more true today, with the mission holy along with the gear.”
war: “Waray gud hira magbuhat hito,” binmaton hi David. “Dayuday an akon mga tawo naglilinis ha ira ngahaw sumala han seremonyas bisan kon nagawas kami hin ordinaryo la lalakton; asay pa ba yana nga may-ada namon importante nga tuyo!”

en: So the priest gave David holy bread, because there was no other bread except the bread of the presence, which is removed from the LORD ’s presence and replaced by warm bread as soon as it is taken away.
war: Sanglit iginhatag han padi an iginhalad na nga mga tinapay kan David, kay an nakada nga mga tinapay amo an mga tinapay nga iginhalad sa Dyos nga ginkuha niya tikang han baraan nga lamesa ngan ginliwanan ini hin bag-o nga tinapay.

en: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained in the LORD ’s presence. His name was Doeg. He was an Edomite and Saul’s head shepherd.
David asked Ahimelech, “Do you have a spear or sword on hand? I didn’t bring my sword or gear with me because the king’s mission was urgent.”
war: Iginkatuman nga hito nga adlaw nakadto hi Doeg nga taga-Edom, nga labaw nga magmarangno han kabakahan ni Saul, kay kinmadto hiya hin pagsingba.)

en: The priest said, “The sword of Goliath, the Philistine you killed in the Elah Valley, is here wrapped in a cloth behind a priestly vest. If you want it, take it, because there are no other swords here.”
war: Nagsiring hi David kan Ahimelec, “May-ada ba nimo bangkaw o espada nga ikakahatag ha akon? Uraura hin kaapiki an sugo han hadi nga waray ko na ngani panahon hin pagkuha han akon espada o hin bisan ano nga hinganiban.”

en: David said, “No sword is as good as that one! Give it to me!”
war: Binmaton hi Ahimelec, “Aanhi ha akon an espada ni Goliat nga Filisteohanon nga imo ginpatay didto ha Kahamub-an han Ela; aadto ini ha luyo han efod, ngan pinutos hin dugnit. Kuhaa ini, amo gudla ini an hinganiban dinhe.”

en: So David got up and continued running from Saul. He went to Achish, Gath’s king.
war: “Ihatag ini ha akon,” nagsiring hi David, “kay waray na mauruupay hini nga espada bisan diin.”

en: Achish’s servants said to him, “Isn’t that David, king of the land? He’s the one people sing about in their dances,
war: Sanglit linmakat hi David. Pinalagiw hiya kan Saul, ngan kinmadto hiya kan Hadi Aquis han Gat.

en: ‘Saul has killed his thousands,
war: Nagsiring an mga opisyal han hadi, “Diri ba ini amo hi David nga hadi han iya nasod? Amo ini an tawo nga ginkanta han kababayen-an han nagsasarayaw hira nga nasiring, ‘Nakamatay hi Saul hin yinukot, kundi nakamatay hi David hin tinag napulo ka yukot.’”

en: but David has killed his tens of thousands!’”
war: Gintirotimbang ni David ini nga ira mga pulong, ngan nahadlok hiya hin duro kan Hadi Aquis.

en: David took these words very seriously and became very frightened of Achish, Gath’s king.
war: Sanglit kon tampo ha ira hi David, nagpapakaluronglurong hi David, ngan an iya mga kiwa sugad hin usa nga tuyaw kon kinakaptan hiya nira. Nagbabagisbagis hiya ha mga ganghaan han syudad, ngan duro an iya paglalaway nga nahuhulos an iya bungot.

en: So he changed the way he acted with them, pretending to be insane while he was with them. He scratched marks on the doors of the city gates and let spit run down his chin.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Aquis han iya mga opisyal, “Kitaa daw! Tuyaw ini nga tawo! Kay ano nga gindara hiya niyo nganhi ha akon!

en: “Can’t you see he’s crazy?” Achish asked his servants. “Why bring him to me?
war: Kinukulangan pa ba ako hin mga tuyaw? Kay ano nga gindad-an ako niyo hin usa pa nga nakakasamok ha akon pinaagi han iya tinuyaw nga mga panggawi dinhe pa gud han akon kalugaringon nga balay?”

en: David left Gath and escaped to Adullam’s fortress. When David’s siblings and all his extended family learned of this, they went to join him there.
war: Kinmalagiw hi David tikang han syudad han Gat ngan kinmadto hiya hin usa nga lungib hirani han bungto han Adulam. Han paghibaro han iya kabugtoan ngan han iba han iya panimalay nga nakadto hiya, tinmampo hira ha iya.

en: Everyone who was in trouble, in debt, or in desperate circumstances gathered around David, and he became their leader. Approximately four hundred men joined him.
war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo nga gintalumpigos, o mga utangan, o mga diskontento, mga 400 ka tawo ngatanan, ngan nahimo hiya nga ira pangulo.

en: From there David went to Mizpeh in Moab. He said to the Moabite king, “Please let my father and mother stay with you until I know what God will do to me.”
war: Tikang didto nagpadayon hi David ngadto ha Mispa didto ha Moab, ngan nagsiring han hadi han Moab, “Mahimo ba nga maanhi la anay an akon amay ug iroy ha imo tubtob han pakasabot ko han kaburot-on han Dyos ha akon?”

en: So David left his parents with the Moabite king, and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the fortress.
war: Sanglit ibinilin ni David an iya mga kag-anak upod han hadi han Moab, ngan nag-ukoy hira didto samtang tinmago hi David didto han lungib.

en: Then the prophet Gad told David, “Don’t stay in the fortress any longer. Leave now and go to the land of Judah.” So David left and went to Hereth forest.
war: Niyan kinmadto kan David hi Gad nga manaragna ngan nagsiring, “Ayaw pag-ukoy dinhe; pakadto dayon han tuna han Juda.” Sanglit linmakat hi David ngan kinmadto hiya ha kagurangan han Haret.

en: Saul learned that David and his soldiers had been located. Saul was sitting under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, spear in hand, with all his servants waiting on him.
war: Usa ka adlaw nakadto hi Saul ha Gabaa, nalingkod hiya ha sirong hin usa nga kahoy nga tamarisko didto hin usa nga pungtod. Nakapot hiya hin bangkaw, ngan nag-aalirong ha iya an ngatanan niya nga mga opisyal. Ginsumatan hiya nga hinkit-an hi David ngan an iya mga tawo,

en: He said to them, “Listen up, Benjaminites! Will Jesse’s son give fields and vineyards to each and every one of you? Will he make each one of you commanders of units of one thousand men or commanders of units of one hundred?
war: ngan nagsiring hiya han iya mga opisyal, “Pamati kamo nga mga tawo ni Benjamin! Naghuhunahuna ba kamo nga tatagan kamo ngatanan ni David hin kaumhan ngan mga urubasan, ngan hihimoon kamo nga mga opisyal han iya kasondalohan?

en: Is that why all of you have conspired against me? No one informed me when my son made a covenant with Jesse’s son! Not one of you is concerned about me or informs me when my own son sets my servant against me in an ambush—but that’s what has happened today!”
war: Amo ba ito an hinungdan nga nakahunahuna kamo hin paglingo ha akon? Waray usa ha iyo nga nagsumat ha akon nga an akon kalugaringon nga anak ngan hi David may-ada ginsabotan. Waray ha iyo nanginginlabot ha akon, o nagsusumat ha akon nga hi David, usa han akon mga tawo, namimiling yana hin usa nga higayon hin pagpatay ha akon, ngan gin-aghat hiya han akon anak!”

en: Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s servants, responded, “I saw Jesse’s son go to Ahimelech, Ahitub’s son, at Nob.
war: Natindog didto hi Doeg nga taga-Edumea upod han mga opisyal ni Saul, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Hinkit-an ko hi David didto ha Nob han pagkadto niya kan Ahimelec nga anak ni Ahitub.

en: Ahimelech questioned the LORD for David, and gave him provisions as well as the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”
war: Nagpakiana hi Ahimelec han Ginoo kon ano an angay pagbuhaton ni David, ngan katapos, gintagan niya hi David hin pagkaon ngan han espada ni Goliat nga Filisteohanon.”

en: The king then sent for the priest Ahimelech, Ahitub’s son, and all his extended family, who were the priests at Nob. All of them came to the king.
war: Sanglit iginpakuha ni Hadi Saul hi Ahimelec nga padi ngan an ngatanan niya nga kauropdan nga kapadian didto ha Nob. Kinmadto ini hira ha iya.

en: “Listen here, son of Ahitub,” Saul said.
war: Nagsiring hi Saul kan Ahimelec, “Pamati, Ahimelec!”

en: “Yes sir,” he replied.
war: “Namamati ako ha imo,” binmaton hiya.

en: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me—you with Jesse’s son—giving him food and a sword and questioning God for him so that he is now against me, waiting in ambush, which is what has happened today?”
war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni Saul, “Kay ano nga nagsabot man kamo ngan hi David hin pakig-away ha akon? Kay ano nga tinagan mo hiya hin pagkaon ngan hin usa nga espada ngan nagpakiana ka han Dyos para ha iya? Yana inmato na hiya ha akon, ngan naghuhulat na la hiya hin usa nga higayon hin pagpatay ha akon!”

en: Ahimelech answered the king, “Out of all your servants, who is as trustworthy as David? He is the king’s son-in-law, does whatever you ask, and is well respected in your house.
war: Binmaton hi Ahimelec, “Hi David amo an labi kamatinumanon nga imo opisyal! Kalugaringon mo hiya nga umagad, kapitan han imo mga gwardya ngan tinahod gud han ngatanan didto han imo palasyo.

en: Was that the first time I questioned God for him? Of course not! But please, the king shouldn’t accuse me, his servant, or anyone in my father’s household of any wrongdoing, because your servant knew nothing whatsoever about this matter.”
