war: Tinuod, nagpakiana ako han Dyos para ha iya, ngan diri ini syahan pa la. Hiunong hin paglarang hin paglingo ha imo, diri mo ako angay igsumbong, Harangdon nga Hadi, o bisan hin-o han akon panimalay. Waray gud ako hini hinbabaroan.”

en: But the king said, “You will be executed, Ahimelech—you and all of your father’s household!”
war: Nagsiring an hadi, “Ahimelec, kinahanglan mamatay ka ngan an ngatanan mo nga kauropdan!”

en: The king ordered the guards waiting on him: “Go ahead and kill the LORD ’s priests because they’ve joined up with David too. They knew he was on the run but didn’t inform me.”
war: Niyan ginsiring niya an mga gwardya nga natukdaw hirani ha iya, “Pamataya niyo an kapadian han Ginoo ! Nakigsarabot hira kan David, ngan waray ako pagsumati nira nga kinmalagiw hiya, bisan kon maaram na hira nga daan hini.” Kundi dinmiri an mga gwardya hin pagpatay han kapadian han Ginoo .

en: But the king’s servants were unwilling to lift a hand to attack the LORD ’s priests.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Saul kan Doeg, “Ikaw an pagpatay ha ira!”—ngan pinamatay hira ngatanan ni Doeg. Hito nga adlaw iya ginpatay in 85 nga kapadian nga may katungod hin pagsul-ot han efod.

en: The king then ordered Doeg, “Doeg! You go attack the priests.” So Doeg the Edomite went and attacked the priests, killing eighty-five men who wore the linen priestly vest that day.
war: Iginpapatay liwat ni Saul an ngatanan nga mga umurokoy han Nob nga syudad hin kapadian: kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an, kabataan ngan mga minasus-an, kabakahan, kaasnohan, ngan kakarnerohan—pinamatay hira ngatanan.

en: He put the whole priestly city of Nob to the sword: men and women, children and infants, even oxen, donkeys, and sheep.
war: Kundi nakapalagiw hi Abiatar nga usa han mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Ahimelec, ngan kinmadto hiya ngan tinmampo kan David.

en: But one of the sons of Ahimelech, Ahitub’s son, escaped. His name was Abiathar, and he fled to David.
war: Iginsumat niya kan David an pagpataya ni Saul han kapadian han Ginoo .

en: Abiathar reported to David that Saul had slaughtered the LORD ’s priests.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Han paghikit-i ko kan Doeg hito nga adlaw, maaram ako nga magsusumat gud hiya kan Saul. Sanglit ako an may baratonon han kamatayon han ngatanan mo nga kauropdan.

en: David was told, “The Philistines are now attacking Keilah and looting the threshing floors!”
war: Hinbatian ni David nga ginsusulong han mga Filisteohanon an bungto han Keila ngan gintikas nira an bag-o pa la nga mga inani nga trigo.

en: David asked the LORD , “Should I go and fight these Philistines?”
war: Sanglit pinmakiana hiya han Ginoo , “Susulongon ko ba an mga Filisteohanon?”

en: “Go!” the LORD answered. “Fight the Philistines and save Keilah!”
war: “Oo,” binmaton an Ginoo . “Sulonga hira ngan talwasa an Keila.”

en: But David’s men said to him, “Look how frightened we are here in Judah. It’ll be worse if we go to Keilah against Philistine forces!”
war: Kundi nagsiring kan David an iya mga tawo, “Igo na an aton kahadlok dinhe ha Juda; labi na nga madugang an aton kahadlok kon kumadto pa kita ha Keila ngan sulongon an Filisteohanon nga kasondalohan.”

en: So David asked the LORD again, and the LORD reaffirmed, “Yes, go down to Keilah, because I will hand the Philistines over to you.”
war: Sanglit pinmakiana na liwat hi David han Ginoo , ngan nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Kadtoa ngan sulonga an Keila, kay padadag-on ko ikaw kontra han mga Filisteohanon.”

en: Then David and his soldiers went to Keilah and fought the Philistines, driving off their cattle and defeating them decisively. And that’s how David saved the residents of Keilah.
war: Sanglit kinmadto ha Keila hi David ngan an iya mga tawo ngan ginsulong nira an mga Filisteohanon; pinamatay nira in kadam-an ha ira ngan gintikas nira an ira kabakahan. Sanglit gintalwas ni David an bungto.

en: Now after Abiathar, Ahimelech’s son, fled to David, he had accompanied David to Keilah, bringing a priestly vest with him.
war: Han pagkalagiw ni Abiatar nga anak ni Ahimelec ngan pagtampo niya kan David didto ha Keila, gindara niya an efod.

en: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, “God has handed him over to me now because he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars!”
war: Nasumatan hi Saul nga kinmadto hi David ha Keila, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Igintubyan na han Dyos hi David ha akon gahom. Ginbitik ni David an iya kalugaringon pinaagi hin pagsulod niya hin pinaderan nga bungto nga may pinarig-on nga mga ganghaan.”

en: So Saul called up all his troops for war, to go down to Keilah and attack David and his soldiers.
war: Sanglit gin-andam ni Saul an iya kasondalohan hin pagsulong han Keila, ngan paglikos kan David ngan han iya mga tawo.

en: When David learned that Saul was planning to harm him, he told the priest Abiathar, “Bring the priestly vest now.”
war: Han paghibaro ni David nga nag-andam hi Saul hin pagsulong ha iya, nagsiring hiya kan Abiatar nga padi, “Dad-a nganhi an efod.”

en: Then David said, “ LORD God of Israel, I, your servant, have heard that Saul plans on coming to Keilah and will destroy the town because of me.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi David, “O Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, hinbatian ko nga nag-andam na hi Saul hin pagkanhi ha Keila ngan pagbungkag hini nga bungto tungod ha akon nga imo surugoon.

en: LORD God of Israel, will Saul come down as your servant has heard? Please tell your servant.”
war: Igtutubyan ba ako han mga umurokoy han Keila ngadto kan Saul? Makanhi ba gud hi Saul sumala han akon hinbatian? O Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, nakikimalooy ako ha imo nga pamatian mo ako!”

en: “Yes, he will come down,” the LORD answered.
war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “Makanhi hi Saul.”

en: Next David asked, “Will the citizens of Keilah hand me and my soldiers over to Saul?”
war: Nagpakiana na liwat hi David, “Ngan igtutubyan ba han mga umurokoy han Keila ako ngan an akon mga tawo ngadto kan Saul?”

en: “Yes, they will hand you over,” the LORD replied.
war: “Igtutubyan kamo,” binmaton an Ginoo .

en: So David and his troops—approximately six hundred men—got up and left Keilah. They kept moving, going from one place to the next. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he didn’t go there.
war: Sanglit binmaya dayon han Keila hi David ngan an iya mga tawo—mga 600 ngatanan—ngan nagpadayon hira hin paglakat ngan bisan la ngain hira. Han paghibaro ni Saul nga kinmalagiw na hi David ha Keila, waray na niya igpadayon an iya pagsulong han bungto.

en: David lived in the fortresses in the wilderness and in the hills of the Ziph wilderness. Saul searched for him constantly, but God did not hand David over to Saul.
war: Nagtinago hi David didto han sagkahon nga tuna ha kamingawan hirani ha Zif. Nagpadayon hi Saul hin pagbiling ha iya, kundi waray han Dyos igtubyan hi David ha iya.

en: While David was at Horesh in the Ziph wilderness he learned that Saul was looking to kill him.
war: Nahibaro hi David nga ginmawas hi Saul hin pagpatay ha iya.

en: Saul’s son Jonathan came to David at Horesh and encouraged him with God.
war: Nakadto hi David ha Hores, didto han kamingawan hirani han Zif.

en: Jonathan said to him, “Don’t be afraid! My father Saul’s hand won’t touch you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be your second in command. Even my father Saul knows this.”
war: Didto kinmadto ha iya hi Jonatan ngan gin-aghat hiya upod an mga pagpatapod han mga pagpanalipod han Dyos,

en: Then the two of them made a covenant before the LORD . David stayed at Horesh, but Jonathan went back home.
war: nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ayaw kahadlok. Diri makakadaot ha imo hi Saul nga akon amay. Maaram gud hiya nga amo ikaw an magigin hadi han Israel ngan magigin sugbong ako nimo.”

en: Some Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah. “David is hiding among us in the fortresses at Horesh on the hill of Hachilah, south of Jeshimon,” they said.
war: Nagsinumpaay hira nga duha hin pagpadig-on han ira kamagsangkay. Nagpabilin hi David didto ha Hores, ngan inmoli hi Jonatan.

en: “So whenever you want to come down, Your Majesty, do it! Leave it to us to hand him over to the king.”
war: May-ada pipira nga mga tawo nga taga-Zif nga kinmadto kan Saul didto ha Gabaa ngan nagsiring, “Nagtitinago hi David didto han amon katunaan han Hores, didto han Bukid han Haquila, ha timogan nga bahin han kamingawan han Juda.

en: “The LORD bless you because you have shown this kindness to me!” Saul said.
war: Maaram kami, Harangdon nga Hadi, nga karuyag gud nimo bihagon hi David sanglit pakadi han amon katunaan ngan tatalinguhaon namon nga madakop hiya.”

en: “Go now and get everything ready. Find out everything you can: where he stays, where he goes, who has seen him. I am told he is very shrewd.
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Bendisyonan unta kamo han Ginoo kag malooy man kamo ha akon!

en: Find out every hiding place he uses there and come back to me when you know for certain. I will then go with you. If David is in the area, I will hunt him down among any of Judah’s clans!”
war: Kadto na, ngan kitaa pa gud niyo; usisaha kon hain gud hiya ngan kon hin-o an nakakita ha iya didto. May nagsumat ha akon nga listo ini hiya.

en: So they got up and left for Ziph ahead of Saul.
war: Usisaha gud an mga dapit nga iya tinatagoan, ngan balik kamo dayon hin pagsumat ha akon. Niyan maupod ako ha iyo, ngan kon aadto pa hiya han katunaan, pamimilngon ko gud hiya, bisan kon akon pag-usisahon an bug-os nga tuna han Juda.”

en: Meanwhile, David and his soldiers were in the Maon wilderness in the desert plain south of Jeshimon.
war: Sanglit linmakat hira ngan binmalik ngadto ha Zif una kan Saul. Nakadto hi David ngan an iya mga tawo han kamingawan han Maon, didto hin usa nga maningaw nga kahamub-an ha timogan nga bahin han kamingawan han Juda.

en: When Saul and his troops went looking for him, David was told about it, so he went down to a certain rock there and stayed in the Maon wilderness. When Saul heard that, he went into the Maon wilderness after David.
war: Nagkalakat hira Saul ngan an iya mga tawo hin pamiling kan David, kundi nahibaro hini hi David ngan kinmadto hi David hin usa nga batoon nga pungtod didto han kamingawan han Maon ngan nagpabilin hiya didto. Han pakabati ni Saul hiunong hini, ginlanat niya hi David.

en: Even as Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was informed that David was in the En-gedi wilderness.
war: Han pagbalik ni Saul tikang han pakig-away niya han mga Filisteohanon, nasumatan hiya nga nakadto hi David han kamingawan hirani han Engadi.

en: So Saul took three thousand men selected from all Israel and went to look for David and his soldiers near the rocks of the wild goats.
war: Gindara ni Saul in tulo ka yukot han gimamaupayi nga mga sondalo ha Israel ngan kinmadto hira hin pamiling kan David ngan han iya mga tawo ha sinirangan han dapit nga ginngangaranan nga kababtoan han Ihalas nga Kanding.

en: He came to the sheep pens beside the road where there was a cave. Saul went into the cave to use the restroom. Meanwhile, David and his soldiers were sitting in the very back of the cave.
war: Inmabot hiya didto hin usa nga lungib nga hirani hin mga toril hin kakarnerohan ha ligid han dalan, ngan sinmulod hiya hin pag-uro. Nahinabo nga amo ngahaw ini an lungib nga tinatagoan ni David ngan han iya mga tawo, ngan nakadto hira ha surusulod han lungib.

en: David’s soldiers said to him, “This is the day the LORD spoke of when he promised you, ‘I will hand your enemy over to you, and you can do to him whatever you think best.’” So David snuck up and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
war: Nagsiring an mga tawo kan David, “Higayon mo na ini! Itinutubyan han Ginoo ha imo gahom an imo kaaway, ngan makakagbuhat ka ha iya han bisan ano nga imo karuyag.” Naghinayhinay hi David hin pagkamang ngan gintabasan niya an bado ni Saul nga waray makasabot hi Saul.

en: But immediately David felt horrible that he had cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
war: Kundi kahuman hini, nagbasol hi David,

en: “The LORD forbid,” he told his men, “that I should do something like that to my master, the LORD ’s anointed, or lift my hand against him, because he’s the LORD ’s anointed!”
war: ngan nagsiring hiya han iya mga tawo, “Pugngan unta ako han Ginoo hin pagdaot han akon agaron nga ginpili han Ginoo nga hadi! Kinahanglan diri ko gud hiya pagdaoton, kay amo hiya an hadi nga ginpili han Ginoo !”

en: So David held his soldiers in check by what he said, and he wouldn’t allow them to attack Saul. Saul then left the cave and went on his way.
war: Sanglit tinmoo kan David an iya mga tawo ngan waray nira sulonga hi Saul.

en: Then David also went out of the cave and yelled after Saul, “My master the king!” Saul looked back, and David bowed low out of respect, nose to the ground.
war: Binmuhat hi Saul, ginmawas han lungib, ngan nagpadayon hin paglakat.

en: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen when people say, ‘David wants to ruin you’?
war: Niyan ginmawas hi David sunod ha iya ngan gintawag ni David hi Saul, “Harangdon nga Hadi!” Linmingi hi Saul ngan yinmukbo hi David ha tuna hin paghatag hin katalahuran,

en: Look! Today your own eyes have seen that the LORD handed you over to me in the cave. But I refused to kill you. I spared you, saying, ‘I won’t lift a hand against my master because he is the LORD ’s anointed.’
war: ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga tinmoo ka man hin mga sumat hin mga tawo nga nasiring nga may-ada ako maraot nga nahuhunahunaan ha imo?

en: Look here, my protector! See the corner of your robe in my hand? I cut off the corner of your robe but didn’t kill you. So know now that I am not guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I haven’t wronged you, but you are hunting me down, trying to kill me.
war: Hinkit-an mo na nga yana didto ha sakob han lungib igintubyan ka han Ginoo ha akon gahom. Ginsiring ako han akon mga tawo nga patayon ko ikaw, kundi nalooy ako ha imo ngan ginsiring ko hira nga diri gud ako maglalabot ha imo, kay amo ikaw an ginpili han Ginoo nga hadi.

en: May the LORD judge between me and you! May the LORD take vengeance on you for me, but I won’t lift a hand against you.
war: Kitaa, amay ko, kitaa an tinabas han imo bado nga akon kinakaptan! Pinapatay ko unta ikaw, kundi gintabas ko la lugod ini. Angay na unta tuohan ini nga waray gud ako hunahuna hin pag-ato ha imo o hin pagpatay ha imo. Karuyag nimo hin pagpatay ha akon, bisan kon waray ako nabuhat nga sayop ha imo.

en: As the old proverb goes, ‘Evil deeds come from evildoers!’ but I won’t lift a hand against you.
war: Maghukom unta ha aton an Ginoo kon hin-o ha aton an sayop! Kastigohon ka unta tungod han imo pagkontraha ha akon, kay diri gud ako magdadaot ha imo.

en: So who is Israel’s king coming after? Who are you chasing? A dead dog? A single flea?
war: Maaram ka man han daan nga darawhonon, ‘Magraot la nga mga tawo an nagbubuhat hin maraot.’ Sanglit diri ko ikaw pagdadaoton.

en: May the LORD be the judge and decide between you and me. May he see what has happened, argue my case, and vindicate me against you!”
war: Hin-o an gin-iiparatay han hadi han Israel? Hin-o an iya ginbubukod! Usa nga patay nga ayam, usa nga purgas?

en: As soon as David finished saying all this to Saul, Saul said, “David, my son, is that your voice?” Then he broke down in tears,
war: An Ginoo amo an maghuhukom, ngan hiya an magbubuot kon hin-o ha aton an sayop. Hiya unta an manalipod ha akon, ngan magtalwas ha akon ha imo mga kamot!”

en: telling David, “You are more righteous than I am because you have treated me generously, but I have treated you terribly.
war: Han katapos na ni David pagyakan, nagsiring hi Saul, “Ikaw ba hi David nga akon anak?” Ngan nagtangis hiya.

en: Today you’ve told me the good you have done for me—how the LORD handed me over to you, but how you didn’t kill me.
war: Niyan nagsiring hiya kan David, “Matadong ka, ngan sayop ako. Maupay an imo mga ginbuhat ha akon, samtang ginbuhat ko in dako nga sayop ha imo!

en: When someone finds an enemy, do they send the enemy away in peace? May the LORD repay you with good for what you have done for me today.
war: Yana nga adlaw nagpakita ka han imo pagkamaupay ha akon, kay waray mo ako pataya, bisan kon igintubyan ako han Ginoo ha imo gahom.

en: Now even I know that you will definitely become king, and Israel’s kingdom will flourish in your hands.
war: Kon in usa ka tawo makadakop han iya kaaway, bubuhian pa niya? Bendisyonan ka unta han Ginoo tungod han imo ginbuhat ha akon yana nga adlaw!

en: Because of that, make a solemn pledge to me by the LORD that you won’t kill off my descendants after I’m gone and that you won’t destroy my name from my family lineage.”
war: Yana maaram ako nga ikaw an magigin hadi han Israel, nga magpapadayon an ginhadian ha ubos han imo pagdumara.

en: David made a solemn pledge to Saul. Then Saul went back home, but David and his soldiers went up to the fortress.
war: Kundi pagsaad ha akon ha ngaran han Ginoo nga imo tatalwason an akon mga tulin, basi diri gud hingalimtan an ngaran ko ngan han akon panimalay.”

en: Now Samuel died, and all Israel gathered to mourn for him. They buried him at his home in Ramah. David then left and went down to the Maon wilderness.
war: Namatay hi Samuel. Nagtirok an ngatanan nga mga Israelita ngan nagmabidoon hira tungod ha iya. Niyan ira ginlubong hi Samuel didto han iya puroy-anan ha Rama.

en: There was a man in Maon who did business in Carmel. He was a very important man and owned three thousand sheep and one thousand goats. At that time, he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
war: Katapos hini, kinmadto hi David ha kamingawan han Paran.

en: The man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and attractive woman, but her husband was a hard man who did evil things. He was a Calebite.
war: 2-3 May usa ka tawo didto nga sakop han banay ni Caleb nga ginngaranan nga Nabal, taga bungto hiya han Maon, ngan tag-iya hiya hin tuna hirani han bungto han Carmelo. Riko hiya hin duro, ngan tag-iya hiya hin 3,000 nga kakarnerohan ngan hin 1,000 nga kakandingan. Hi Abigail nga iya asawa, mahusay ngan may hibaro nga babaye kundi hi Nabal usa ka tawo nga maisog ngan maraot an batasan.

en: While in the wilderness, David heard that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
war: Nag-arot hi Nabal han iya mga karnero didto ha Carmelo,

en: So David sent ten servants, telling them, “Go up to Carmel. When you get to Nabal, greet him for me.
war: ngan hinbaroan ini ni David nga nakadto ha kamingawan,

en: Say this to him: ‘Peace to you, your household, and all that is yours!
war: sanglit nagsugo hiya hin napulo nga mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an hin pagkadto ha Carmelo, pamiling kan Nabal, ngan pangumosta ha iya.

en: I’ve heard that you are now shearing sheep. As you know, your shepherds were with us in the wilderness. We didn’t mistreat them. Moreover, the whole time they were at Carmel, nothing of theirs went missing.
war: Iya gintugon hira nga sidngon hi Nabal: “Sangkay ko, nangungumosta ha imo hi David, upod an iya gimamag-upayi nga mga ungara para ha imo, han imo panimalay, ngan han ngatanan nga imo mga butang.

en: Ask your servants; they will tell you the same. So please receive these young men favorably, because we’ve come on a special day. Please give whatever you have on hand to your servants and to your son David.’”
war: Nahibaro hiya nga nag-aarot ka han imo mga karnero. Karuyag niya nga hibaroan mo nga iginkaurosa namon an imo magmarangno hin mga karnero ngan waray namon paglabti hira. Waray gud nawara han ira ginmamangnoan ha bug-os nga panahon nga nakadto hira ha Carmelo.

en: When David’s young men arrived, they said all this to Nabal on David’s behalf. Then they waited.
war: Pakianhi la hira, ngan magsusumat hira ha imo. Kinmanhi kami ha panahon hin pyesta, ngan naghahangyo hi David nga pag-abiabihon mo kami hin maupay. Ighatag ha amon nga imo mga surugoon ngan kan David nga imo suok nga sangkay an imo mahihimo.”

en: But Nabal answered David’s servants, “Who is David? Who is Jesse’s son? There are all sorts of slaves running away from their masters these days.
war: Iginhatag han mga tawo ni David ini nga mensahe kan Nabal ha ngaran ni David, ngan hinmulat hira kon ano an igsisiring ha ira.

en: Why should I take my bread, my water, and the meat I’ve butchered for my shearers and give it to people who came here from who knows where?”
war: Ha katapos-taposan, binmaton hi Nabal, “Hi David? Hin-o hiya? Waray pa gud ako makabati hiunong ha iya! Puno an tuna hin kalagiw nga mga oripon yana nga mga adlaw!

en: So David’s young servants turned around and went back the way they came. When they arrived, they reported every word of this to David.
war: Diri ko ihahatag an akon tinapay ug tubig, ngan an mga hayop nga akon gin-ihaw para han akon mga paraarot hin karnero, ngadto hin mga tawo nga waray ko hibaroi kon mga taga diin hira!”

en: Then David said to his soldiers, “All of you, strap on your swords!” So each of them strapped on their swords, and David did the same. Nearly four hundred men went up with David. Two hundred men remained back with the supplies.
war: Binmalik an iya mga tawo ngadto kan David ngan ginsumatan hiya han iginsiring ni Nabal.

en: One of Nabal’s servants told his wife Abigail, “David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, but he just yelled at them.
war: “Igtaklos an iyo mga espada,” nagsugo hi David, ngan ira ngatanan ginbuhat ini. Igintaklos liwat ni David an iya espada ngan linmakat hiya upod in mga 400 han iya mga tawo. Ginbilin niya in 200 hin pagbantay han mga higamit.

en: But the men were very good to us and didn’t mistreat us. Nothing of ours went missing the whole time we were out with them in the fields.
war: Nagsiring in usa nga surugoon ni Nabal kan Abigail nga asawa ni Nabal, “Hinbatian mo ba? Nagsugo hi David hin iya mga surugoon tikang ha kamingawan ngan nangumosta han amon agaron, kundi iya gin-pakaalohan hira.

en: In fact, the whole time we were with them, watching our sheep, they were a protective wall around us both night and day.
war: Kundi maupay gud hira ha amon; waray gud kami paglabti nira, ngan ha bug-os nga panahon nga kaupod kami ha ira didto han kaumhan, waray gud nakawat han amon mga ginmamangnoan.

en: Think about that and see what you can do, because trouble is coming for our master and his whole household. But he’s such a despicable person no one can speak to him.”
war: Ginpanalipdan kami nira adlaw gab-i ha bug-os nga panahon nga kaupod kami nira hin pagmangno han amon mga panon.

en: Abigail quickly took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five sheep ready for cooking, five seahs of roasted grain, one hundred raisin cakes, and two hundred fig cakes. She loaded all this on donkeys
war: Paghunahunaa ini yana ngan himoa an imo angay pagbuhaton. Makaharadlok ini para han amon agaron ngan han bug-os niya nga panimalay. Maisog hiya nga diri gud hiya namamati bisan hin-o!”

en: and told her servants, “Go on ahead of me. I’ll be right behind you.” But she didn’t tell her husband Nabal.
war: Nagtirok dayon hi Abigail hin 200 ka bug-os nga tinapay, duha nga mga supot nga anit nga puno hin bino, lima nga mga inihaw nga karnero, mga usa ka bakid nga sinanlag nga liniso, usa ka gatos ka orapong nga ubas, ngan 200 nga torta nga may-ada binulad nga mga igos, ngan iginkarga ini dida hin mga asno.

en: As she was riding her donkey, going down a trail on the hillside, David and his soldiers appeared, descending toward her, and she met up with them.
war: Niyan nagsiring hiya han mga surugoon, “Pag-una kamo ngan masunod ako ha iyo.” Kundi waray la niya sumati an iya bana.

en: David had just been saying, “What a waste of time—guarding all this man’s stuff in the wilderness so that nothing of his went missing! He has repaid me evil instead of good!
war: Nakakasakay hiya han iya asno ngan dida hin linilikdoan hin usa nga pungtod ha gilayon nagkatapo hira ngan hi David ug an iya mga tawo nga tipakada ha iya.

en: May God deal harshly with me, David, and worse still if I leave alive even one single one who urinates on a wall belonging to him come morning!”
war: Nagpipinanhunahuna hi David, “Kay ano nga pinanalipdan ko pa an mga hiagi hito nga tawo dinhe ha kamingawan? Waray gud nakawat han iya ginpamangnoan, ngan amo ini an iya igbabalos ha akon han akon pagbulig ha iya?

en: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and fell facedown before him, bowing low to the ground.
war: Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon diri ko pamatayon an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo nga diri pa maaaga!”

en: She fell at his feet and said, “Put the blame on me, my master! But please let me, your servant, speak to you directly. Please listen to what your servant has to say.
war: Han paghikit-i la ni Abigail kan David, hinmaw-as hiya dayon ngan hinmapa hiya ha tuna,

en: Please, my master, pay no attention to this despicable man Nabal. He’s exactly what his name says he is! His name means fool, and he is foolish! But I myself, your servant, didn’t see the young men that you, my master, sent.
war: dida han tiilan ni David ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Pamatii gad ako, intawon! Tugoti ako hin pag-angkon han sayop.

en: I pledge, my master, as surely as the LORD lives and as you live, that the LORD has held you back from bloodshed and taking vengeance into your own hands! But now let your enemies and those who seek to harm my master be exactly like Nabal!
war: Ayaw gad pag-asahi hi Nabal nga waray pulos nga tawo! Amo gud hiya sugad han karuyag sidngon han iya ngaran—usa nga lurong! Waray ako didto han pag-abot han imo mga surugoon.

en: Here is a gift, which your servant has brought to my master. Please let it be given to the young men who follow you, my master.
war: An Ginoo amo an nagpugong ha imo basi diri ka maglugaring hin pagbulos ngan pagpatay han imo mga kaaway. Ngan yana nagsusumpa ako ha imo ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo nga kakastigohon an imo mga kaaway ngan an ngatanan nga karuyag magdaot ha imo sugad kan Nabal.

en: Please forgive any offense by your servant. The LORD will definitely make an enduring dynasty for my master because my master fights the LORD ’s battles, and nothing evil will be found in you throughout your lifetime.
war: Karawata gad ini nga regalo nga akon gindara ha imo, ngan ighatag ini ngadto han imo mga tawo.

en: If someone chases after you and tries to kill you, my master, then your life will be bound up securely in the bundle of life by the LORD your God, but he will fling away your enemies’ lives as from the pouch of a sling.
war: Pasayloa intawon ako han bisan ano nga sayop nga akon nabuhat. An Ginoo an maghihimo ha imo nga hadi, sugad man han imo mga tulin, kay ikaw an naasdang han iya mga pakig-away; ngan diri ka magbubuhat hin bisan ano nga maraot samtang buhi ka pa.

en: When the LORD has done for my master all the good things he has promised you, and has installed you as Israel’s leader,
war: Kon may sumulong ha imo ngan magtinguha hin pagpatay ha imo, babantayan ka hin maupay han Ginoo nga imo Dyos, sugad hin usa ka tawo nga nagbabantay hin mahal nga manggad. Kundi mahitungod han imo mga kaaway, iya iglalabog hira, sugad hin usa ka tawo nga nalabay hin mga bato pinaagi han iya labyog.

en: don’t let this be a blot or burden on my master’s conscience, that you shed blood needlessly or that my master took vengeance into his own hands. When the LORD has done good things for my master, please remember your servant.”
war: Ngan kon tumanon na han Ginoo an ngatanan nga mag-upay nga mga butang nga iginsaad niya ha imo, ngan himoon ka na nga hadi han Israel,

en: David said to Abigail, “Bless the LORD God of Israel, who sent you to meet me today!
war: diri ka na mabibido o magbabasol tungod hin pagpatay hin waray la hinungdan, o hin paglugaring hin pagbulos. Ngan, kon bendisyonan ka na han Ginoo , ayaw intawon hingalimti ako an imo nga oripon.”

en: And bless you and your good judgment for preventing me from shedding blood and taking vengeance into my own hands today!
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Dayawon an Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, nga nagsugo ha imo yana nga adlaw hin pagtapo ha akon!

en: Otherwise, as surely as the LORD God of Israel lives—the one who kept me from hurting you—if you hadn’t come quickly and met up with me, there wouldn’t be one single one who urinates on a wall left come morning.”
war: Salamat han Dyos tungod han imo maupay nga panhunahuna ngan han imo ginbuhat yana nga adlaw hin pagpugong ha akon han sala hin pagpatay ngan hin paglugaring hin pagbulos.

en: Then David accepted everything she had brought for him. “Return home in peace,” he told her. “Be assured that I’ve heard your request and have agreed to it.”
war: Ginpugngan ako han Ginoo hin pagdaot ha imo. Kundi nagsusumpa ako ha ngaran han buhi nga Dyos han Israel nga kon waray ka magdagmit hin pagtapo ha akon, nagkakamatay unta an ngatanan nga mga tawo ni Nabal ha pagkaaga!”

en: When Abigail got back home to Nabal, he was throwing a party fit for a king in his house. Nabal was in a great mood and very drunk, so Abigail didn’t tell him anything until daybreak.
war: Niyan ginkarawat ni David an gindara ha iya ni Abigail ngan ginsiring hiya, “Oli na la ngan ayaw na kabaraka. Tutumanon ko an imo karuyag.”

en: In the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him everything. Nabal’s heart failed inside him, and he became like a stone.
war: Binmalik hi Abigail ngadto kan Nabal nga hin-abutan niya didto han iya balay nga nagkombite hin angay la hin usa nga hadi. Hubog na hiya ngan malipayon, sanglit waray na la niya sumati ngada han pagkaaga.

en: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, and he died.
war: Niyan, han kahawhawi na ha iya, iginsumat ha iya ni Abigail an ngatanan. Inatake hiya hin tigda nga sakit ngan naparalisis hiya.

en: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Bless the LORD , who has rendered a verdict regarding Nabal’s insult to me and who kept me, his servant, from doing something evil! The LORD has brought Nabal’s evil down on his own head.” Then David sent word to Abigail, saying that he would take her as his wife.
war: Paglabay hin mga napulo ka adlaw, ginhampak han Ginoo hi Nabal ngan namatay.

en: When David’s servants reached Abigail at Carmel, they said to her, “David has sent us to you so you can become his wife.”
war: Han pakabati ni David nga namatay na hi Nabal, nagsiring hiya, “Dayawon an Ginoo ! Ginbulos niya hi Nabal tungod han iya pag-pakaalohi ha akon, ngan ginpugngan ako nga iya surugoon hin pagbuhat hin maraot. Ginkastigo han Ginoo hi Nabal tungod han iya kamaraot.”

en: She bowed low to the ground and said, “I am your servant, ready to serve and wash the feet of my master’s helpers.”
war: Niyan nagpadara hi David hin mga tawo ngadto kan Abigail hin pagsumat ha iya nga karuyag mangasawa hi David ha iya.

en: Then Abigail got up quickly and rode on her donkey, with five of her young women going with her. She followed David’s messengers and became his wife.
war: Kinmadto ha iya didto ha Carmelo an mga surugoon ni David ngan ginsiring hiya, “Ginsugo kami ni David hin pagkuha ha imo kay magigin-asawa ka niya.”

en: David also married Ahinoam from Jezreel, so both of them were his wives.
war: Hinmapa ha tuna hi Abigail ngan nagsiring, “Surugoon ako niya ngan andam ako hin panmusa han iya mga surugoon.”

en: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti, Laish’s son, from Gallim.
war: Binmuhat hiya dayon ngan sinmakay han iya asno. Binmunyog hiya han mga surugoon ni David, ngan gin-updan hiya han iya lima nga mga surugoon nga kababayen-an, ngan gin-asawa hiya ni David.

en: The Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah. “David is hiding on Hachilah’s hill, which faces Jeshimon,” they said.
war: May inmabot nga mga tawo nga taga-Zif ngadto kan Saul didto ha Gabaa ngan ginsumatan hiya nga aadto hi David natago ha Bukid han Haquila, ha ligid han kamingawan han Juda.

en: So Saul got up and went down to the Ziph wilderness to look for David there. He had three thousand handpicked soldiers from Israel with him.
war: Kinmadto dayon hi Saul han kamingawan han Zif upod in tulo ka yukot han gimamaupayi nga mga sondalo hin pamiling kan David.

en: Saul camped on Hachilah’s hill opposite Jeshimon beside the road, but David stayed in the wilderness. When David learned that Saul had come after him into the wilderness,
war: Nagkampo hira ha ligid han dalan didto ha Bukid han Haquila. Nakadto pa hi David han kamingawan, ngan han paghibaro niya nga inmabot hi Saul hin pagbiling ha iya,

en: he sent spies and discovered that Saul had definitely arrived.
war: nagsugo hiya hin mga mag-irinaw ngan hinbaroan niya nga tinuod nakadto hi Saul.

en: So David got up and went to the place where Saul camped, and saw the place where Saul and Abner, Ner’s son and Saul’s general, were sleeping. Saul was sleeping inside the camp with the troops camped all around him.
war: Kinmadto hiya dayon ngan hin-agian niya an dapit nga kinakaturogan nira Saul ug Abner nga anak ni Ner, nga kapitan han kasondalohan ni Saul. Nakaturog hi Saul ha sakob han kampo ngan nagkampo an iya mga tawo palibot ha iya.

en: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Joab’s brother Abishai, Zeruiah’s son, “Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?”
war: Niyan nagpakiana hi David kanda Ahimelec nga Hiteohanon ngan Abisai nga bugto ni Joab (hi Sarvia an iroy nira), “Hin-o ha iyo nga duha in maupod ha akon ngadto han kampo ni Saul!”

en: “I’ll go down with you,” Abishai answered.
war: “Ako,” binmaton hi Abisai.

en: So David and Abishai approached the troops at night and found Saul lying there, asleep in the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. Abner and the army were sleeping all around him.
war: Sanglit hito nga gab-i sinmulod hira David ug Abisai ngadto han kampo ni Saul, ngan hin-agian nira hi Saul nga nakaturog ha butnga han kampo nga inusok ha tuna an iya bangkaw hirani han iya ulo. Nangangaturog hira Abner ngan an iya kasondalohan palibot ha iya.

en: Abishai said to David, “God has handed your enemy over to you today! Let me pin him to the ground with my spear. One stroke is all I need! I won’t need a second.”
war: Nagsiring hi Abisai kan David, “Igintubyan na han Dyos an imo kaaway ha imo gahom yana nga gab-i. Tugoti ako hin pagbangkaw ha iya han iya kalugaringon nga bangkaw ngan pagtaod ha iya ha tuna hin usa la ka pagbangkaw—diri kinahanglan hin ikaduha.”

en: But David said to Abishai, “Don’t kill him! No one can lift a hand against the LORD ’s anointed and go unpunished.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi David, “Ayaw hiya pagpataya! Kakastigohon manta han Ginoo an bisan hin-o nga magpatay han iya pinili nga hadi.”

en: As surely as the LORD lives,” David continued, “it will be the LORD who will strike him down, or his day will come and he will die, or he’ll fall in battle and be destroyed.
war: Nagpadayon hi David, “Ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo , maaram ako nga an Ginoo ngahaw amo an magpapatay kan Saul, kon umabot na an iya panahon, pinaagi hin sakit, o hin kamatay ha pag-awayan.

en: The LORD forbid that I lift my hand against the LORD ’s anointed! But go ahead and take the spear by Saul’s head and the water jug and let’s go!”
war: Ipahirayo unta han Ginoo nga patayon ko an kanan Ginoo ginhimo nga hadi! Kuhaa ta la an iya bangkaw ngan an iya tibod hin tubig, ngan lakat kita.”

en: So David took the spear and the water jug that were by Saul’s head, and he and Abishai left. No one saw them, no one knew they were there, and no one woke up. All of them remained asleep because a deep sleep from the LORD had come over them.
war: Sanglit ginkuha ni David an bangkaw ngan an tibod hin tubig nga nakadto ha ligid han ulo ni Saul, ngan linmakat hiya ngan hi Abisai. Waray gud may nakakita ha ira, o nahibaro han nahinabo, o waray may nagmata hinmuokan hira ngatanan, kay ginpahimuok hira ngatanan han Ginoo .

en: David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of a hill with considerable distance between them.
war: Niyan tinmabok hi David ngadto ha luyo han kahamub-an ha bawbaw han pungtod, nga hirayo na ha ira,

en: Then David shouted to the army and to Abner, Ner’s son, “Abner! Aren’t you going to answer me?”
war: ngan ginoliatan niya an kasondalohan ni Saul ngan hi Abner, “Abner! Nakakabati ka ba ha akon!”

en: “Who are you to shout to the king?” Abner asked.
war: Nagpakiana hi Abner, “Hin-o ito nga naggiginoliat ngan nagpupukaw han hadi?”

en: David answered Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And you have no equal in Israel, right? Then why haven’t you kept watch over your master the king? One of the soldiers came to kill your master the king.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Abner, diri ba ikaw amo an tawo nga gamhanan ha Israel? Sanglit kay ano man nga diri mo pinananalipdan an hadi nga imo agaron? Yana pa gud la may-ada tawo nga sinmulod han kampo hin pagpatay han imo agaron.

en: What you’ve done is terrible! As surely as the LORD lives, all of you are dead men because you didn’t keep close watch over your master, the LORD ’s anointed. Have a look around! Where are the king’s spear and the water jug that were by his head?”
war: Waray ka magtuman han imo katungdanan, Abner! Nagsusumpa ako ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo nga angay kamo ngatanan magkamatay, kay waray niyo panalipdi an iyo agaron nga ginhimo nga hadi han Ginoo . Kitaa! Hain na man an bangkaw han hadi? Hain na an tibod hin tubig nga sapit gudla han iya ulo?”

en: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, “David, my son, is that your voice?”
war: Kinmilala hi Saul han tingog ni David, ngan nagpakiana, “David, hi ikaw ba, anak ko?”

en: David said, “Yes it is, my master the king.
war: “Oo, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hi David.

en: Why,” David continued, “is my master chasing me, his servant? What have I done and what wrong am I guilty of?
war: Ngan nagsiring pa hiya, “Kay ano, Harangdon nga Hadi nga ginbubukod mo ako nga imo surugoon? Ano gud an akon nabuhat? Ano an akon sala?

en: My master the king, please listen to what your servant has to say. If it is the LORD who has incited you against me, then let him accept an offering! But if human beings have done it, then let them be cursed before the LORD because they have now driven me off, keeping me from sharing in the LORD ’s inheritance. ‘Go!’ they tell me. ‘Worship other gods!’
war: Harangdon nga Hadi, pamatii an akon igsisiring. Kon an Ginoo amo an nag-aghat ha imo hin pagkontra ha akon, mahihimo pa nga mabalhin an iya hunahuna pinaagi hin usa nga paghalad ha iya; kundi kon mga tawo la an nagbuhat hini, pagtunglohon unta hira han Ginoo . Kay ginpaiwas ako nira tikang han tuna han Ginoo ngadto hin usa nga nasod diin mga langyaw la nga kadiyosan an akon masisingba.

en: Don’t let my blood spill on the ground apart from the LORD ’s presence, because the king of Israel has come out looking for a single flea like someone hunting a partridge in the mountains.”
war: Ayaw ako tugoti nga mamatay didto hin langyaw nga tuna nga hirayo han Ginoo . Kay ano nga makanhi an hadi han Israel hin pagpatay hin usa la nga purgas sugad ha akon? Kay ano nga pagbibilngon ako niya sugad hin usa nga ihalas nga tamsi?”

en: Then Saul said, “I have sinned! David, my son, come back! Because you considered my life precious today, I won’t harm you again. I have acted foolishly and have made a huge mistake.”
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Nakasayop ako. Balik, David nga akon anak! Diri ko na gud ikaw pagdadaoton, kay gintalwas mo an akon kinabuhi yana nga gab-i. Nalurong na ako. Ginbuhat ko in usa nga makalilisang nga butang!”

en: “Here is the king’s spear,” David answered. “Allow one of your servants to come over and get it.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Aadi an imo bangkaw, Harangdon nga Hadi. Pakadia hin pagkuha hini in usa han imo mga tawo.

en: David thought, One day I will be destroyed by Saul’s power. The best thing for me to do is to escape to Philistine territory. Then Saul will give up looking for me in Israelite territory, and I will escape his power.
war: Nagsiring hi David ha iya kalugaringon, “Usa hini nga mga adlaw papatayon ako ni Saul. Maupay pa nga kumalagiw ako ngadto ha Filistia. Niyan maundang hi Saul hin pagbiniling ha akon didto ha Israel, ngan mahigagawas ako ha kataragman.”

en: So David set out with his six hundred soldiers and went to Achish, Maoch’s son and Gath’s king.
war: Sanglit kinmadto dayon hi David ngan an iya 600 nga mga tawo kan Aquis nga hadi han Gat, nga anak ni Maoc.

en: David and his soldiers stayed there at Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives, Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabal’s widow from Carmel.
war: Nag-ukoy hi David ngan an iya mga tawo upod an ira mga panimalay didto ha Gat. Upod ni David an iya duha nga asawa: hira Ahinoam nga taga-Jezrael, ngan Abigail nga balo ni Nabal nga taga-Carmelo.

en: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he didn’t pursue him anymore.
war: Han paghibaro ni Saul nga pinmalagiw na hi David ngadto ha Gat, inmundang hiya hin pagpinamiling ha iya.

en: Then David said to Achish, “If you approve of me, please give me a place in one of the towns in the country so I can live there. Why should I, your servant, live in the capital city with you?”
war: Nagsiring hi David kan Aquis, “Kon sangkay ka man nakon, tagi ako hin usa nga gutiay nga bungto nga akon pag-uokyan. Diri kinahanglan nga mag-ukoy ako tampo ha imo didto han kapital nga syudad.”

en: So Achish gave the town of Ziklag to David at that time. That’s why Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah until now.
war: Sanglit iginhatag ha iya ni Aquis an bungto han Siclag, ngan tungod hini gintag-iya an Siclag han kahadian han Juda tikang pa hadto.

en: David lived in the Philistine countryside for a total of one year and four months.
war: Naukoy hi David didto ha Filistia sulod hin 16 ka bulan.

en: David and his soldiers went out on raids against the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites. They were the people who lived in the land from Telam to Shur all the way to the land of Egypt.
war: Sulod hito nga panahon, ginsulong ni David ngan han iya mga sakop an mga tawo han Gesur, Girzi, ug Amalec nga maiha na hin duro nga mga umurokoy didto hini nga mga katunaan. Ginsulong niya an ira tuna tubtob ha Sur, ngan ngadto pa gud ha Ehipto,

en: When David attacked an area, he wouldn’t leave anyone alive, man or woman. He would take the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothes and would then go back to Achish.
war: ngan pinamamatay nira an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an ug kababayen-an ngan gintikas nira an kakarnerohan, kabakahan, kaasnohan, kakamelyohan, ngan bisan pa an mga panapton. Katapos binmalik hiya ngadto kan Aquis,

en: When Achish asked, “Where did you raid today?” David would say, “The southern plain of Judah,” or “The southern plain of the Jerahmeelites,” or “The southern plain of the Kenites.”
war: nga napakiana ha iya, “Diin ka man sulong yana nga panahon?” Nagsumat ha iya hi David nga kinmadto hiya han timogan nga bahin han Juda, o han katunaan han tribo ni Jerameel, o han katunaan nga gin-ukyan han mga Kenitanhon.

en: David never spared a man or woman so they could be brought back alive to Gath. “Otherwise,” he said, “they might talk about us, and say, ‘David did this or that.’” So this was David’s practice during the entire time he lived in the Philistine countryside.
war: Ginhurot hin pamatay ni David an kalalaken-an ug kababayen-an, basi waray usa nga makabalik hin pagsumat kan Gat han tinuod nga ginbuhat niya ngan han iya mga tawo. Amo ini an ginbuhat ni David ha bug-os nga panahon han nakadto hiya ha Filistia.

en: Achish trusted David, thinking, David has alienated himself so badly from his own people in Israel that he’ll serve me forever.
war: Kundi sinmarig hi Aquis kan David ngan naghunahuna hiya, “Nasisinahan hiya hin duro han iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga mga Israelita sanglit mag-aalagad hiya ha akon ha bug-os niya nga kinabuhi.”

en: At that time, the Philistines gathered their troops for war to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, “Count on you and your soldiers marching out with me in the army.”
war: Hadto nga panahon gintirok han mga Filisteohanon an ira kasondalohan hin pakig-away han Israel, ngan nagsiring hi Aquis kan David, “Maaram ka na nga kinahanglan ikaw ngan an imo mga tawo dumapig ha akon hin pakig-away.”

en: “Excellent,” David answered Achish. “Now you’ll see for yourself what your servant can do.”
war: “Kinahanglan,” binmaton hi David, “surugoon mo ako, ngan makita ka han akon mahihimo.”

en: “Excellent,” Achish replied. “I will make you my permanent bodyguard.”
war: Nagsiring hi Aquis, “Maupay! Hihimoon ko ikaw nga gwardya ha akon ha bug-os ko nga kinabuhi.”

en: Now Samuel had died, and all Israel mourned him and buried him in Ramah, his hometown. And Saul had banned all mediums and diviners from the land.
war: Patay na hi Samuel hini nga panahon ngan nagmasulob-on an ngatanan nga mga Israelita tungod ha iya, ngan iginlubong hiya didto han iya natawhan nga bungto han Rama. Ginpaiwas ni Saul ha Israel an ngatanan nga mga paratigo ngan mga espiritista.

en: The Philistines gathered their forces and advanced to camp at Shunem. Saul gathered all Israel, and they camped at Gilboa.
war: Nagkatirok an Filisteohanon nga mga sondalo ngan nagkampo hira hirani han bungto han Sunem; gintirok man ni Saul an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira didto han bukid han Gilboa.

en: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was so afraid that his heart beat wildly.
war: Han paghikit-i ni Saul han Filisteohanon nga kasondalohan nahadlok hiya hin duro,

en: When Saul questioned the LORD , the LORD didn’t answer him—not by dreams, not by the Urim, and not by the prophets.
war: sanglit nagpakiana hiya han Ginoo kon ano an iya pagbubuhaton. Kundi waray gud pamatii hiya han Ginoo , bisan pinaagi hin mga inop, o hin paggamit hin Urim ug Tumim, o hin mga manaragna.

en: So Saul said to his servants, “Find me a woman who communicates with ghosts! I’ll then go to her and ask by using her techniques.”
war: Niyan nagsugo hi Saul han iya mga opisyal, “Igbiling ako hin usa nga babaye nga espiritista, ngan makadto ako ngan mapakiana ha iya.”

en: “There is such a medium in En-dor,” his servants replied.
war: “May-ada usa didto ha Endor,” binmaton hira.

en: So Saul disguised himself, dressing in different clothes. Then he and two men set out, going to the woman at nighttime.
war: Sanglit nagtabon hi Saul basi diri kilal-on; lain nga panapton an iya ginbado, ngan ha pagsirom na kinmadto hiya hin pakigkita han babaye upod in duha han iya mga tawo. Nagsiring hiya han babaye, “Igpakiana ako han mga espiritu ngan sumati ako kon ano an mahinanabo. Tawga an espiritu han tawo nga akon pagngangaranan.”

en: “Please call up a ghost for me! Bring me the one I specify,” Saul said.
war: Binmaton an babaye, “Waray ruhaduha nga maaram ka na han ginbuhat ni Hadi Saul. Ginpaiwas niya ha Israel an ngatanan nga mga paratigo ngan mga espiritista. Sanglit kay ano nga gin-iibiritik mo ako basi ako pagpatayon?”

en: “Listen,” the woman said to him, “you know what Saul has done, how he has banned all mediums and diviners from the land. What are you doing? Trying to get me killed?”
war: Niyan nagsumpa hi Saul ngan nagsiring, “Ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo nagsasaad ako nga diri ka kakastigohon tungod hini nga imo ginbubuhat.”

en: But Saul promised to her by the LORD , “As surely as the LORD lives, you won’t get into trouble for this.”
war: Nagpakiana an babaye, “Hin-o man an akon tatawgon para ha imo?”

en: So the woman said, “Who do you want me to bring up for you?”
war: “Hi Samuel,” binmaton hiya.

en: “Bring up Samuel,” he said.
war: Han pakakita la han babaye kan Samuel, kinmurinit hiya ngan nagsiring kan Saul, “Kay ano nga ginlimbongan mo ako? Amo ka hi Hadi Saul!”

en: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed at Saul, “Why have you tricked me? You are Saul!”
war: “Ayaw kahadlok!” nagsiring ha iya an hadi. “Ano an imo hinkit-an?”

en: “Don’t be afraid!” the king said to her. “What do you see?”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Hinkit-an ko in usa nga espiritu nga nagawas tikang han tuna.”

en: The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up from the ground.”
war: Pinmakiana hi Saul, “Ano an iya panagway?”

en: “What does he look like?” Saul asked her.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Tikanhi in usa nga tawo nga nakakakirugpos.”

en: “An old man is coming up,” she said. “He’s wrapped in a robe.” Then Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed low out of respect, nose to the ground.
war: Niyan nakasabot hi Saul nga hi Samuel ini, ngan hinmapa hiya ha tuna paghatag hin katalahuran.

en: “Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?” Samuel asked Saul.
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel kan Saul, “Kay ano nga ginsamok mo ako? Kay ano nga ginpabalik mo ako?”

en: “I’m in deep trouble!” Saul replied. “The Philistines are at war with me, and God has turned away from me and no longer answers me by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what I should do.”
war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Nasasamok ako hin duro! Nakikig-away ha akon an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginbayaan na ako han Dyos. Diri na hiya nabaton ha akon bisan pinaagi hin mga manaragna o hin mga inop. Sanglit gintawag ko ikaw, basi sumatan mo ako kon ano an sadang ko pagbuhaton.”

en: “Why do you ask me,” Samuel said, “since the LORD has turned away from you and has become your enemy?
war: Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Kay ano nga nagsangpit ka ha akon kon ginbayaan ka na man han Ginoo ngan kaaway mo na hiya?

en: The LORD has done to you exactly what he spoke through me: The LORD has ripped the kingdom out of your hands and has given it to your friend David.
war: Ginbuhat ha imo han Ginoo an iya iginsumat ha imo pinaagi ha akon: ginkuha niya an ginhadian ha imo ngan iginhatag ini ngadto kan David.

en: The LORD has done this very thing to you today because you didn’t listen to the LORD ’s voice and didn’t carry out his fierce anger against the Amalekites.
war: Ginsupak mo an sugo han Ginoo ngan waray mo pagpuoha an mga Amalekanhon ngan an ngatanan nga ira mga butang. Amo ini an ginbubuhat han Ginoo ha imo yana.

en: The Philistines assembled all their forces at Aphek, and the Israelites camped by the spring in Jezreel.
war: Gintirok han mga Filisteohanon an ngatanan nira nga mga sondalo didto ha Afec, samtang nagkampo an mga Israelita didto han burabod ha Kahamub-an han Jezrael.

en: As the Philistine rulers went out marching in units of hundreds and thousands, David and his soldiers were in the rear with Achish.
war: Nagkagawas an lima nga kahadian nga Filisteohanon, upod an ira mga hugpo hin tinaggatos ngan hin tinagyukot nga mga tawo; nakadto ha orhe hi David ngan han iya mga tawo, kaupod hi Hadi Aquis.

en: “Who are these Hebrews?” the Philistine commanders asked.
war: Hinkit-an hira han mga kapitan nga Filisteohanon ngan nagpakiana, “Ano an binubuhat dinhe hini nga mga Hebreo?”

en: “That’s David,” Achish told them, “the servant of Israel’s King Saul. He’s been with me a year or so now. I haven’t found anything wrong with him from the day he defected until now.”
war: Binmaton hi Aquis, “Amo ini hi David nga usa nga opisyal ni Hadi Saul han Israel. Maiha na an iya pagtampo ha akon. Waray gud hiya nabuhat nga kasaypanan tikang hiya tumampo ha akon.”

en: But the Philistine commanders were angry with Achish. “Send the man home!” they told Achish. “He can go back to the place you gave him, but he won’t go with us into battle. Couldn’t he turn against us in the middle of the fight? How better to please his former master than by taking the heads of our soldiers?
war: Kundi nasina kan Aquis an mga kapitan nga Filisteohanon ngan ginsiring hiya, “Paulia ito nga tawo ngadto han bungto nga imo iginhatag ha iya. Ayaw hiya paupda ha aton ha pag-awayan; bangin hiya kumontra ha aton ha panahon na han araway. Ano in mauruupay nga paagi para ha iya hin pakalipay han iya agaron kay han pagkamatay han aton mga tawo?

en: After all, this is the same David people sing about in their dances,
war: Labot pa, amo ini hi David nga ginkanta han kababayen-an han nagsasarayaw hira, ‘Nakamatay hi Saul hin yinukot, kundi nakamatay hi David hin tinagnapulo ka yukot.’”

en: ‘Saul has killed his thousands,
war: Gintawag ni Aquis hi David ngan ginsiring hiya, “Nagsusumpa ako ha ngaran han buhi nga Dyos han Israel nga inmunong ka ha akon; ngan malilipay liwat ako kon umupod ka ha akon ha pag-awayan. Kay asta ngada yana waray ko hin-agian nga sayop dida ha imo tikang han paghinganhi mo ha akon. Kundi diri nakarawat ha imo an iba nga mga hadi.

en: but David has killed his tens of thousands!’”
war: Sanglit uli nala anay ha maupay nga paglakat, ngan ayaw pagbuhat hin bisan ano nga makakapabido ha ira.”

en: So Achish summoned David and told him, “As surely as the LORD lives, you are an upstanding individual. I would very much like you to serve with me in the army because I haven’t found anything wrong with you from the day you came to me until now. But the rulers don’t approve of you.
war: Binmaton hi David, “Ano nga sayop an akon nabuhat? Kon sumala han imo siring waray mo hin-agian ha akon nga kasaypanan tikang han pag-alagad ko ha imo, kay ano nga diri ako maupod ha imo nga akon agaron ug hadi ngan makig-away kontra han imo mga kaaway?”

en: So go back home now, and go in peace. Don’t do anything to upset the Philistine rulers.”
war: “Nauyon ako hito,” binmaton hi Aquis. “Gin-iisip ko ikaw nga maunongon sugad hin usa nga anghel han Dyos. Kundi nagsiring an iba nga kahadian nga diri ka makakaupod ha amon ngadto ha pag-awayan.

en: “But what have I done?” David asked Achish. “What wrong have you found in me, your servant, from the day I came to you until now? Why shouldn’t I go and fight the enemies of my master the king?”
war: Sanglit, David, buwas han aga, ha pagpawa gudla, pagkabuhat kamo hin sayo ngan pagkalakat kamo ngatanan nga binmaya kan Saul ngan kinmanhi ha akon.”

en: “I agree,” Achish answered David. “I think you’re as good as one of God’s own messengers. Despite that, the Philistine commanders have ordered, ‘He can’t go into battle with us.’
war: Sanglit sayo pa han pagkaaga nagkalakat hira David ngan an iya mga tawo hin pagbalik ngadto ha Filistia, ngan nagpadayon an mga Filisteohanon ngadto ha Jezrael.

en: Three days later, David and his soldiers reached Ziklag. The Amalekites had raided the arid southern plain and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it down,
war: Paglabay hin duha ka adlaw inmabot hi David ngan an iya mga tawo ha Siclag. Ginsulong han mga Amalekanhon an timogan han Juda ngan han Siclag. Ginsunog nira an bungto,

en: taking the women and everyone in the city prisoner, whether young or old. They hadn’t killed anyone but carried them off and went on their way.
war: ngan ginbihag an ngatanan nga kababayen-an; waray nira ginpatay nga tawo, kundi gindara nira an ngatanan.

en: When David and his soldiers got to the town and found it burned down, and their wives, their sons, and their daughters taken prisoner,
war: Han pag-abot nira David ngan han iya mga tawo, hinkit-an nira nga sunog na an bungto ngan ginbihag an ira mga asawa ngan mga anak.

en: David and the troops with him broke into tears and cried until they could cry no more.
war: Nagtangis hira David ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan waray hira umundang ngada han panluya nira.

en: David’s two wives had been captured as well: Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabal’s widow from Carmel.
war: Ginbihag bisan an duha nga asawa ni David, hira Ahinoam ug Abigail.

en: David was in deep trouble because the troops were talking about stoning him. Each of the soldiers was deeply distressed about their sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.
war: Duro an kaguol ni David, kay napungot gud an iya mga tawo tungod han pagtikasa han ira mga anak, ngan karuyag nira pagbato kan David kundi gindasig hi David han Ginoo nga iya Dyos.

en: David said to the priest Abiathar, Ahimelech’s son, “Bring the priestly vest to me.” So Abiathar brought it to David.
war: Nagsiring hi David kan Abiatar nga padi, nga anak ni Ahimelec, “Dad-a ha akon an efod.” Ngan gindara ini ni Abiatar ngadto ha iya.

en: Then David asked the LORD , “Should I go after this raiding party? Will I catch them?”
war: Nagpakiana hi David han Ginoo , “Lalanaton ko ba adto nga mga parasulong ngan hiaabotan ko ba hira?”

en: “Yes, go after them!” God answered. “You will definitely catch them and will succeed in the rescue!”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Lanata hira; hiaabotan mo hira ngan mababawi mo an mga nabihag ug natikas nira.”

en: So David set off with six hundred men. They came to the Besor ravine, where some stayed behind.
war: Sanglit nagkalakat hira David ngan han iya 600 nga mga tawo. Pag-abot nira ha Sapa han Besor, nagpabilin didto an iba ha ira.

en: David and four hundred men continued the pursuit, while two hundred men stayed there, too exhausted to cross the Besor ravine.
war: Nagpadayon hi David han iya paglanat upod an 400 na la nga mga tawo kay uraura na hin kamaluya an 200 nga mga tawo hin pagtabok han sapa, sanglit pinmabilin hira.

en: They found an Egyptian in the countryside and brought him to David. They gave him bread, and he ate, and they gave him water to drink.
war: Hin-agian han mga tawo nga kaupod ni David in usa nga lalakehay nga Ehiptohanon didto ha kaumhan ngan gindara hiya ngadto kan David. Ginpakaon ngan ginpainom hiya nira,

en: They also gave him a piece of fig cake and two raisin cakes. He ate and regained his strength because he hadn’t eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and nights.
war: tinagan hin binulad nga igos, ngan hin duha ka orapong nga ubas. Katapos niya kumaon, nagmalaksi hiya; waray ngay-an hiya makakaon o makainom sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.

en: Then David asked him, “Whose slave are you? Where do you come from?”
war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni David, “Hin-o an imo agaron, ngan taga diin ka?”

en: “I’m an Egyptian servant boy,” he said, “and the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I got sick three days ago.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Usa ako nga Ehiptohanon nga oripon hin usa nga Amalekanhon. Ginbayaan ako han akon agaron tulo na ka adlaw an linmabay, kay nasakit ako.

en: We had raided the arid southern plain belonging to the Cherethites, the territory belonging to Judah, and the southern plain of Caleb. We also burned Ziklag down.”
war: Ginsulong namon an katunaan han mga Cretanhon didto han timogan nga dapit han Juda ngan an katunaan han banay ni Caleb, ngan ginsulong namon an Siclag.”

en: “Can you guide me to this raiding party?” David asked him.
war: Nagpakiana hi David, “Makatoltol ka ba han ginkampohan hito nga mga parasulong?”

en: “Make a pledge to me by God that you won’t kill me or hand me over to my master,” the boy said, “and I will guide you to the raiding party.”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Makakahimo ako basta magsaad ka ha akon, ha ngaran han Dyos, nga diri mo ako papatayon o igtutubyan ha akon agaron.”

en: So the boy led David to them, and he found them scattered all over the countryside, eating, drinking, and celebrating over the large amount of plunder they had taken from Philistine and Judean territory.
war: Ngan gintutdoan niya hi David han ginkampohan hini nga mga tawo.

en: David attacked them from twilight until evening of the next day. He killed them all. No one escaped except four hundred young men who got on camels and fled.
war: Han pag-abot nira han dapit nga gintutdo ha iya, kinita niya nga nagsasarang an mga parasulong, nagpipinangaon, nag-iinirignom, ngan nagsasaurog tungod han damo hin duro nga mga tinikas nga ira naagaw didto ha Filistia ug Juda.

en: David rescued everything that the Amalekites had taken, including his own two wives.
war: Han maagahon pa han pagkabuwas, ginsulong hira ngan pinakiawayan ni David tubtob han pagkagab-i. Waray gud ha ira nakalikay gawas la hin upat ka gatos nga batan-on nga kalalaken-an nga nagpakasakay hin mga kamelyo ngan nagpakakalagiw.

en: Nothing was missing from the plunder or anything that they had taken, neither old nor young, son nor daughter. David brought everything back.
war: Nabawi ni David an ngatanan nga mga tawo ngan an ngatanan nga natikas han mga Amalekanhon, upod an iya duha nga asawa.

en: David also captured all the sheep and cattle, which were driven in front of the other livestock. The troops said, “This is David’s plunder!”
war: Waray gud kulang bisan usa; nabawi ni David an ngatanan nga mga anak han iya mga tawo, ngan an ngatanan nga tinikas han mga Amalekanhon.

en: David reached the two hundred men who were too exhausted to follow him and had stayed behind at the Besor ravine. They came out to greet him and the troops who were with him. When David approached them, he asked how they were doing.
war: Nabawi liwat niya an ngatanan nga mga panon hin kakarnerohan ngan kabakahan; ginpauna ha ira an ngatanan nga kabakahan ngan nagsiring hira, “Kan David ini!”

en: But then all the evil and despicable individuals who had accompanied David said, “We won’t share any of the plunder we rescued with them because they didn’t go with us. Each of them can take his wife and children and go—but that’s it.”
war: Niyan binmalik hi David ngadto han 200 nga mga tawo nga uraura na hin kamaluya hin pagbunyog ha iya ngan nagpabilin na la didto ha Sapa han Besor. Dinmaop hira pagtapo kan David ngan han iya mga tawo, ngan ginsugat hira ni David ngan pinangumosta hira hin maupay.

en: “Brothers!” David said. “Don’t act that way with the things the LORD has given us. He has protected us and handed over to us the raiding party that had attacked us.
war: Kundi nagsiring in iba nga mag-isog ngan waray batasan nga mga tawo nga inmupod kan David, “Waray hira umupod ha aton, sanglit diri ta hira tatagan han aton mga naagaw. Ihahatag naton ha ira an ira mga asawa ngan mga anak ngan papaulion ta hira.”

en: How could anyone agree with you on this plan? The share of those who went into battle and the share of those who stayed with the supplies will be divided equally.”
war: Kundi binmaton hi David, “Kabugtoan ko, ayaw niyo ini buhata kay hatag ini ha aton han Ginoo ! Gintalwas kita niya ngan ginpadaog kita kontra han mga parasulong.

en: So from that day forward, David made that a regulation and a law in Israel, which remains in place even now.
war: Waray may maabuyon han iyo ginsiring! Kinahanglan pareho an pagbahin para han ngatanan. Makarawat hin pareho nga bahin an inmupod ngadto han pag-awayan ngan an nagpabilin pagbantay han mga higamit.”

en: When David returned to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah and to his friends. “Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORD ’s enemies,” he said.
war: Ginhimo ini ni David nga usa nga balaod, ngan ginsunod ini han mga Israelita tikang hadto.

en: It went to those in Bethel, Ramoth of the arid southern plain, Jattir,
war: Han pagbalik na ni David ngadto ha Siclag, ginpadad-an niya an iya kasangkayan nga mga pangulo han Juda hin bahin han mga naagaw upod an tugon, “Iini in usa nga regalo para ha iyo tikang han naagaw namon ha mga kaaway han Ginoo .”

en: Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa,
war: Iginpadara ini niya ngadto han mga tawo han Betel, ngadto han mga tawo han Rama didto han timogan nga bahin han Juda, ngan ngadto han mga tawo han mga bungto han Jatir,

en: When the Philistines attacked the Israelites, the Israelites ran away from the Philistines, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
war: Nakig-away an mga Filisteohanon kontra han mga Israelita didto ha Bukid Gilboa. Damo nga mga Israelita in pinamatay didto, ngan nangalagiw an iba ha ira, lakip hi Hadi Saul ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an.

en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
war: Kundi hin-abutan hira han mga Filisteohanon, ngan ginpatay hira Jonatan, Abinadab, ug Malquisua, an tulo nga mga anak ni Saul.

en: The battle was fierce around Saul. When the archers located him, they wounded him badly.
war: Naalikosan hi Saul han iya mga kaaway, ngan naigo hiya hin mga pana ngan grabe an iya mga samad.

en: Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and kill me with it! Otherwise, these uncircumcised men will come and kill me or torture me.” But his armor-bearer refused because he was terrified. So Saul took the sword and impaled himself on it.
war: Ginsiring niya an batan-on nga paradara han iya mga hinganiban, “Hulbota an imo espada ngan pataya ako, basi diri ako pagduyagan la ngan basi diri ini nga diri nakilala hin dyos nga mga Filisteohanon an makamatay ha akon.” Kundi nahadlok hin duro an batan-on hin pagbuhat hini. Sanglit hinulbot ni Saul an iya kalugaringon nga espada ngan nag-unay hiya.

en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also impaled himself on his sword and died with Saul.
war: Hinkit-an han batan-on nga patay na hi Saul, sanglit nag-unay liwat hiya han iya kalugaringon nga espada ngan namatay hiya upod kan Saul.

en: So Saul, his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his soldiers died together that day.
war: Amo ini an kaagi han kamatay ni Saul, han iya tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan han batan-on nga lalake; nagkamamatay hito nga adlaw an ngatanan nga mga tawo ni Saul.

en: When the Israelites across the valley and across the Jordan learned that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines came and occupied the towns.
war: Han paghibaro han mga Israelita didto ha luyo nga dapit han Kahamub-an han Jezrael ngan didto ha sinirangan han Salog Jordan nga nangalagiw na an mga sondalo han Israel ngan ginpatay na hira Saul ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an, binayaan nira an ira mga bungto ngan nangalagiw hira. Niyan nagkaabot an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan nira an mga bungto.

en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.
war: Han pagkabuwas, kinmadto an mga Filisteohanon hin pagtikas han mga patay, ngan ira hin-agian an mga lawas nira Saul ngan han iya tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga nalunay didto ha Bukid Gilboa.

en: They cut off Saul’s head and stripped off his armor, and then sent word throughout Philistine territory, carrying the good news to their gods’ temples and to their people.
war: Ginpugotan nira hi Saul, ginhukas an iya mga hinganiban, ngan iginpadara ini hin mga magsarangyaw ngadto han bug-os nga Filistia hin pagsumat han ira mga diyosdiyos ngan han ira mga tawo.

en: They put Saul’s armor in the temple of Astarte, and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
war: Niyan iginbutang nira an mga hinganiban ni Saul didto han templo han diyosa nga hi Astarte, ngan iginraysang nira an iya lawas ngadto han pader han syudad han Betsan.

en: But when all the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
war: Han paghibaro la han mga tawo han Jabes didto ha Galaad han ginbuhat han mga Filisteohanon kan Saul,

en: the bravest of their men set out, traveled all night long, and took the bodies of Saul and his sons off the wall of Beth-shan. Then they went back to Jabesh, where they burned them.
war: nagkagawas an duro kamag-isog nga mga tawo ngan nagbaktas hira ngadto ha Betsan ha bug-os nga gab-i. Gintanggal nira an mga lawas nira Saul ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an tikang han pader, iginbalik ini nira ngadto ha Jabes ngan ginsunog ini nira didto.

en: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
war: Katapos ginkuha nira an mga tul-an ngan iginlubong ini didto han bungto han Jabes ha puno han kahoy nga tuog ngan nagpuasa hira sulod hin pito ka adlaw.

en: From Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy.
war: Tikang kan Pablo, Silas ug Timoteo—

en: To the Thessalonians’ church that is in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: Ngadto han mga kaapi han singbahan ha Tesalonica, nga mga sakop han Dyos nga Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo:

en: Grace and peace to all of you.
war: Maiyo unta an grasya ngan an kamurayaw.

en: We always thank God for all of you when we mention you constantly in our prayers.
war: Dayuday nagpapasalamat kami han Dyos tungod ha iyo ngatanan, ngan dayuday ilinalakip kamo namon dida ha amon mga pag-ampo.

en: This is because we remember your work that comes from faith, your effort that comes from love, and your perseverance that comes from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ in the presence of our God and Father.
war: Kay gindudumdom namon ha atubangan han aton Dyos ngan Amay an ginpapakita han iyo mga mag-upay nga buhat tungod han iyo pagtoo, an kamaduruto niyo tungod han mapaso niyo nga gugma, ngan an karig-on han iyo paglaom dida han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.

en: Brothers and sisters, you are loved by God, and we know that he has chosen you.
war: Kabugtoan, maaram kami nga an Dyos nahigugma ha iyo ngan ginpili kamo nga magin iya kalugaringon.

en: We know this because our good news didn’t come to you just in speech but also with power and the Holy Spirit and with deep conviction. You know as well as we do what kind of people we were when we were with you, which was for your sake.
war: Kay gindara namon ha iyo an Maupay nga Sumat, diri pinaagi hin mga pulong la, kundi pinaagi liwat hin gahom ngan han Espiritu Santo, ngan upod an bug-os nga pagsarig han iya kamatuoran. Maaram kamo kon ginunan-o namon hin pag-ukoy han nakada pa kami ha iyo; para adto han iyo kaupayan.

en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord when you accepted the message that came from the Holy Spirit with joy in spite of great suffering.
war: Ginsubad niyo kami ngan an Ginoo; ngan bisan kon nag-antos gud kamo, ginkarawat niyo gihapon an mensahe, upod an kalipay nga natikang han Espiritu Santo.

en: As a result you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
war: Sanglit nahimo kamo nga susbaranan han ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon ha Macedonia ngan ha Acaya.

en: The message about the Lord rang out from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia but in every place. The news about your faithfulness to God has spread so that we don’t even need to mention it.
war: Kay diri la nga nagsarang tikang ha iyo an mensahe mahitungod han Ginoo didto ha Macedonia ngan ha Acaya, kundi nahibantog liwat ha ngatanan nga dapit an sumat mahitungod han iyo pagtoo han Dyos. Sanglit, diri na kinahanglan nga magyakan pa kami hini.

en: As you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, our visit with you wasn’t a waste of time.
war: Kabugtoan, maaram kamo ngahaw nga waray makawang an amon pagduaw ha iyo.

en: On the contrary, we had the courage through God to speak God’s good news in spite of a lot of opposition, although we had already suffered and were publicly insulted in Philippi, as you know.
war: Sayod kamo nga ginpakurian ngan ginpakaalohan na kami didto ha Filipos, san-o kami pumakadto ha iyo ha Tesalonica. Kundi gindasig kami han Dyos hin pagwali ha iyo han Maupay nga Sumat nga natikang ha iya, bisan kon damo gud an mga natipa.

en: Our appeal isn’t based on false information, the wrong motives, or deception.
war: Diri sayop an amon pagwali ug diri maraot an amon hangyo ha iyo, ngan waray kami maglimbong bisan kan kanay.

en: Rather, we have been examined and approved by God to be trusted with the good news, and that’s exactly how we speak. We aren’t trying to please people, but we are trying to please God, who continues to examine our hearts.
war: Lugod, dayuday nagyayakan kami sugad han kanan Dyos karuyag, tungod kay pagbuot man niya nga itapod niya ha amon an Maupay nga Sumat. Diri amon tuyo an paglipay hin mga tawo, kundi han Dyos nga sayod kon ano an panuyo han amon kasingkasing.

en: As you know, we never used flattery, and God is our witness that we didn’t have greedy motives.
war: Maaram na man kamo nga waray kami pakada hin pag-ulog-ulog ha iyo, ngan waray kami gamit hin mga pulong nga basi la katabonan an amon kahalot. An Dyos amo an amon saksi!

en: We didn’t ask for special treatment from people—not from you or from others—
war: Waray kami pagtinguha nga pagdayawon kami han mga tawo, ma tikang ha iyo o ma tikang han iba,

en: although we could have thrown our weight around as Christ’s apostles. Instead, we were gentle with you like a nursing mother caring for her own children.
war: bisan kon may katungod man ngani kami nga pagdayawon kami niyo kay mga apostoles man kami ni Cristo. Kundi han nakada pa kami ha iyo, mga buotan kami sugad hin iroy nga nagmamangno han iya mga anak.

en: We were glad to share not only God’s good news with you but also our very lives because we cared for you so much.
war: Tungod han gugma namon ha iyo, andam kami pagpaangbit ha iyo diri la han Maupay nga Sumat nga tikang ha Dyos, kundi bisan pa han amon kalugaringon nga mga kinabuhi, kay labis gud an amon pagmahal ha iyo.

en: You remember, brothers and sisters, our efforts and hard work. We preached God’s good news to you, while we worked night and day so we wouldn’t be a burden on any of you.
war: Kabugtoan, waray ruhaduha nga nahinunumdom pa kamo han amon mga pagkabudlay ngan pagginuol! Nagbudlay kami adlaw—gab-i, basi diri kami makasamok ha iyo samtang nagwawali kami ha iyo han Maupay nga Sumat nga tikang han Dyos.

en: You and God are witnesses of how holy, just, and blameless we were toward you believers.
war: Kamo ug an Dyos amo an mga saksi, nga an amon panggawi ngada ha iyo nga mga magtinuohon putli, matadong, ngan waray sadang ikasuson.

en: Likewise, you know how we treated each of you like a father treats his own children.
war: Sayod man kamo nga gintagad namon an tagsa ha iyo sugad gud han pagtagad hin usa nga amay han iya mga anak.

en: We appealed to you, encouraged you, and pleaded with you to live lives worthy of the God who is calling you into his own kingdom and glory.
war: Gindasig ngan ginliaw kamo namon, ngan ginsagdonan kamo namon pag-ukoy hin kinabuhi nga nakakalipay han Dyos nga amo an nagtatawag ha iyo basi kamo makaangbit han iya Ginhadian ngan himaya.

en: We also thank God constantly for this: when you accepted God’s word that you heard from us, you welcomed it for what it truly is. Instead of accepting it as a human message, you accepted it as God’s message, and it continues to work in you who are believers.
war: Ug amon liwat dayuday, ginpapasalamatan an Dyos. Kay an pagdad-i namon ha iyo han mensahe han Dyos, iyo ini pinamatian ngan kinarawat, diri nga mensahe hin tawo, kundi sugad nga mensahe gayod han Dyos. Kay nagbubuhat an Dyos dida ha iyo nga mga magtinuohon.

en: Brothers and sisters, you became imitators of the churches of God in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus. This was because you also suffered the same things from your own people as they did from the Jews.
war: Kabugtoan, an nahinabo ha iyo amo gihapon an nahinabo didto han mga singbahan han Dyos ha Judea, han mga magtinuohon nga sakop ni Cristo Jesus. Nag-antos kamo hin sugad nga pagpakurii han iyo kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga gin-antos niyo tikang han mga Judiyo

en: They killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They don’t please God, and they are hostile to the entire human race
war: nga nagpatay han Ginoo nga Jesus ngan han mga manaragna, ngan amo liwat an nagbukod ha amon. Diri gud hira nakakalipay han Dyos! Mga kaaway hira han ngatanan nga mga tawo!

en: when they try to stop us from speaking to the Gentiles so they can be saved. Their sins are constantly pushing the limit. God’s wrath has caught up with them in the end.
war: Nagtinguha pa ngani hira pagulang han amon pagwali ngadto han mga Hentil han mensahe nga makakatalwas ha ira. Ini nga ira ginbuhat amo an nakatig-ob han mga sala nga dayuday ira ginbuhat. Sanglit, ha kataposan, nahisakban hira han kapungot han Dyos!

en: Brothers and sisters, we were separated from you for a while physically but not in our hearts. We made every effort in our desire to see you again face-to-face.
war: Mahitungod ha amon, kabugtoan, han paghimulag namon ha iyo hin halipot la nga panahon—diri manggud adto ha amon panumdoman—dayuday nahinunumdom kami ha iyo. Makahiridlaw gud hin pagkita ha iyo ngan minimingaw kami ha iyo!

en: We wanted to come to you—I, Paul, tried over and over again—and Satan stopped us.
war: Karuyag namon bumalik ha iyo. Nagtinguha ako, hi Pablo, pagbalik ngada ha iyo diri la makausa, kundi gin-ulang kami ni Satanas.

en: What is our hope, joy, or crown that we can brag about in front of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Isn’t it all of you?
war: Kay kamo gudla an amon paglaom, an amon kalipay, ngan an hinungdan han amon pagparayaw han amon pagdarag-an ha atubangan han aton Ginoo nga Jesus kon bumalik na hiya.

en: You are our glory and joy!
war: Kamo gud an amon sadang iparayaw ngan ikalipay!

en: So when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it was a good idea to stay on in Athens by ourselves,
war: Sanglit han waray na kami makakailob hini nga kamingaw, nagpabilin kami la ha Atenas,

en: and we sent you Timothy, who is our brother and God’s coworker in the good news about Christ. We sent him to strengthen and encourage you in your faithfulness.
war: samtang nga ginsugo namon ngada ha iyo hi Timoteo nga aton bugto, ngan kabulig namon ha mga buruhaton han Dyos hin pagwali han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Cristo. Ginpakada namon hiya hin pagdasig ha iyo ngan hin pagparig-on han iyo pagtoo,

en: We didn’t want any of you to be shaken by these problems. You know very well that we were meant to go through this.
war: basi waray usa ha iyo in magtalaw tungod hini nga mga pagpakurii ha aton. Maaram kamo ngahaw nga ini nga pagpakurii ha aton kanan Dyos ini kaburut-on.

en: In fact, when we were with you, we kept on predicting that we were going to face problems exactly like what happened, as you know.
war: Kay han nakada pa kami ha iyo, ginsumatan kamo namon ngadaan nga pagpapakurian gud kita; ngan sumala han iyo nahibaroan, amo gud ini an nahinabo.

en: That’s why I sent Timothy to find out about your faithfulness when I couldn’t stand it anymore. I was worried that the tempter might have tempted you so that our work would have been a waste of time.
war: Tungod hini, ginpakada ko ha iyo hi Timoteo. Waray na ako makakailob, sanglit ginsugo ko hiya panginano kon ano na an iyo pagtoo. Nabaraka ako hin duro, nga bangin nasulay kamo han Yawa, ngan makawang la an ngatanan nga amon pagkinabudlay ug pagginuol.

en: Now Timothy has returned to us from you and has given us good news about your faithfulness and love! He says that you always have good memories about us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
war: Yana, nahibalik na ha amon hi Timoteo, ngan nagdara han makalilipay nga sumat mahitungod han iyo pagtoo ngan paghigugma. Nagsumat hiya ha amon nga dayuday nanunumdom kamo ha amon ngan karuyag niyo pakigkita ha amon, sugad nga kami karuyag man makigkita ha iyo.

en: Because of this, brothers and sisters, we were encouraged in all our distress and trouble through your faithfulness.
war: Sanglit, kabugtoan, ha butnga han amon mga kakurian ngan pag-antos, nadasig kami tungod han iyo pagtoo,

en: For now we are alive if you are standing your ground in the Lord.
war: kay yana nakakaginhawa na kami hin maupay kay marig-on an iyo pagtindog dida ha pag-alagad han Ginoo.

en: How can we thank God enough for you, given all the joy we have because of you before our God?
war: Yana makakagpasalamat na kami han Dyos tungod ha iyo. Nagpapasalamat kami tungod han amon kalipay ha atubangan han amon Dyos tungod ha iyo.

en: Night and day, we pray more than ever to see all of you in person and to complete whatever you still need for your faith.
war: Kinasingkasing an amon pangamuyo ha iya adlaw-gab-i, nga magkirigta kita ngan makahatag kami han ginkikinahanglan han iyo pagtoo.

en: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus guide us on our way back to you.
