war: Yana na an iyo higayon. Hinumdomi nga nagsiring an Ginoo , ‘Gagamiton ko hi David nga akon surugoon pagtalwas han akon mga tawo nga Israelita tikang han mga Filisteohanon ngan han ngatanan nga ira mga kaaway.’”

en: “Go home!” Abner told him. So he went home.
war: Naghimangraw liwat hi Abner han mga tawo nga sakop han tribo ni Benjamin, ngan katapos kinmadto hiya ha Hebron pagsumat kan David han ginkauyonan nga bubuhaton han mga tawo han Benjamin ngan han Israel.

en: Abner then sent word to Israel’s elders. “You’ve wanted David to be your king for some time now,” he said.
war: Han pag-abot ni Abner upod in 20 ka tawo ngadto kan David didto ha Hebron, ginkombitehan hira ni David.

en: “It’s time to act because the LORD has said about David: I will rescue my people Israel from the power of the Philistines and all their enemies through my servant David.”
war: Ginsiring ni Abner hi David, “Makadto na ako ngan tatalinguhaon ko nga makabig ngada han Imo Kaharangdon an bug-os nga Israel. Kakarawton ka nira nga hadi ngan maaangkon mo na an imo karuyag ngan maghahadi ka han bug-os nga tuna.” Ginpatapod ni David hi Abner nga waray maglalabot ha iya, ngan ginpagikan hiya.

en: Abner also spoke directly to the Benjaminites. He then went to inform David in person at Hebron regarding everything that all Israel and the house of Benjamin were willing to do.
war: Waray pag-iha inmabot hi Joab ngan an iba nga mga opisyal ni David tikang hin pagsulong, nga dara in damo hin duro nga mga tinikas. Kundi waray na didto ha Hebron hi Abner, kay ginpagikan ngan ginpatapod na hiya ni David.

en: When Abner, along with twenty others, reached David at Hebron, David threw a celebration for Abner and his men.
war: Han pag-abot ni Joab ngan han iya mga tawo, ginsumatan hiya nga kinmadto kan Hadi David hi Abner ngan ginpagikan hiya ngan ginpatapod nga waray mahinanabo ha iya.

en: Then Abner said to David, “Please let me get going so I can assemble all Israel for my master the king. Then they can make a covenant with you, and you will rule over everything your heart desires.” At that, David sent Abner off in peace.
war: Sanglit kinmadto han hadi hi Joab ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Ano ngani an imo ginbuhat? Kinmanhi na ha imo hi Abner—kay ano nga ginpagikan mo pa hiya?

en: Right then, David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing a great deal of loot with them. Abner was no longer with David in Hebron because David had sent him off in peace.
war: Kinmanhi hiya paglingo ha imo, ngan panginano han mga dapit nga imo kinakadtoan, ngan han imo ginbubuhat. Sayod ka man hini ngatanan!”

en: When Joab and all the troops with him returned, Joab was told that Abner, Ner’s son, had come to the king and that David had sent him off in peace.
war: Han pagbaya na niya kan David, iginpakuha ni Joab hi Abner ngan iginbalik hiya nira tikang ha Atabay han Sira; kundi waray kalibutan hini hi David.

en: Joab went to the king and asked, “What have you done? Abner came to you here! Why did you send him off? Now he’s gotten away!
war: Han pag-abot ni Abner didto ha Hebron, gindara hiya ni Joab ngadto ha ligid han ganghaan, nga sugad hin karuyag makighimangraw ha iya hin hilit, ngan didto ginbuno hiya ha tiyan. Sanglit ginpatay hi Abner kay iya man ginpatay hi Asahel nga bugto ni Joab.

en: Don’t you know the evil ways of Abner, Ner’s son? He came to trick you, to find out where you come and go, and to learn everything you do!”
war: Han paghibaro hini ni David, nagsiring hiya, “Sayod an Ginoo nga waray gud sala ako ngan an akon mga sakop han pagpataya kan Abner.

en: Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner. They brought him back from the well at Sirah, but David didn’t know anything of this.
war: Mahingada unta kan Joab ngan han iya panimalay an kastigo para hini! Mamay-ada unta tawo dida han iya panimalay nga masakit hin gonorea o sanla, o nga waray gamit ngan magluya, o mamatay ha pag-awayan, o mawaray igo nga pagkaon!”

en: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside next to the gate to speak with him in private. But instead Joab stabbed Abner in the stomach, and he died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.
war: Sanglit binmulos kan Abner hira Joab ngan hi Abisai nga iya bugto tungod han pagpataya kan Asahel nga ira bugto didto han pag-awayan ha Gabaon.

en: When David heard about this later, he said, “I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the LORD concerning the shedding of the blood of Abner, Ner’s son.
war: Niyan nagsugo hi David kan Joab ngan han iya mga tawo paggisi han ira mga panapton, pagsul-ot hin sako, ngan pagmabidoon para kan Abner. Ngan dida han paglubong naglakat hi Hadi David ha luyo han lungon.

en: May it fall upon the head of Joab and his entire family tree! May Joab’s family never be without someone with a discharge or a skin disease, someone who uses a crutch, someone who dies by the sword, or someone who is hungry!”
war: Iginlubong hi Abner didto ha Hebron, ngan nagtangis hin dako nga tingog an hadi didto han lubnganan, sugad man an ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: So that is how Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner, because he killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.
war: Ginkanta ni David ini nga pagnguyngoy para kan Abner:

en: Then David ordered Joab and all the troops who were with him, “Tear your clothes and put on funeral clothes! Mourn for Abner!” King David himself walked behind the body.
war: “Kinahanglan mamatay ba hi Abner sugad hin lurong?

en: They buried Abner in Hebron. The king wept loudly at Abner’s grave. All the troops cried too.
war: Iya mga kamot diri man hinigtan,

en: Then the king sang this funeral song for Abner:
war: iya mga tiil diri man pinandogan;

en: “Should Abner have died like a fool dies?
war: Natumba hiya sugad hin kapukan hin usa ha atubangan hin mga kriminal!”

en: Your hands weren’t bound,
war: Ngan gintangisan liwat hiya han mga tawo.

en: your feet weren’t chained,
war: Ha bug-os nga adlaw gintinguha han mga tawo nga kumaon hi David, kundi nagsumpa hiya, “Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon kumaon ako hin bisan ano nga diri pa natutunod an adlaw!”

en: but you have fallen
war: Nasayod ini hira ngan nalipay hira. Ha tinuod, nakalipay han mga tawo an ngatanan nga ginbuhat han hadi.

en: like someone falls before the wicked.”
war: Nasayod an ngatanan nga mga tawo ni David ngan an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha Israel nga waray labot an hadi han pagpataya kan Abner.

en: Then the troops cried over Abner again.
war: Nagsiring an hadi han iya mga opisyal, “Diri ba kamo maaram nga namatay yana nga adlaw in usa nga dako nga pangulo ha Israel?

en: Then all the soldiers came to urge David to eat something while it was still day, but David swore, “May God deal harshly with me and worse still if I eat bread or anything else before the sun goes down.”
war: Bisan kon ako an ginpili han Dyos nga hadi, naabat ako hin kaluya yana nga adlaw. Uraura hin kamagpintas para ha akon ini nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Seruia! Kastigohon unta han Ginoo han angay ha ira ini nga mga kriminal!”

en: When Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost his courage, and all Israel was alarmed.
war: Han paghibaro ni Isboset nga anak ni Saul nga ginpatay hi Abner didto ha Hebron, nahadlok hiya, ngan nalisang an bug-os nga mga tawo han Israel.

en: Saul’s son had two men who led the raiding parties—one was named Baanah and the other Rechab. Both were sons of Rimmon, a Benjaminite from Beeroth. (Beeroth was considered part of Benjamin.
war: May-ada hi Isboset duha nga mga opisyal. Amo ini hira an pangulo han hugpo para hin pagsulong, hira Baana ug Recab nga mga anak ni Rimon nga taga-Beerot nga sakop han tribo ni Benjamin. (Iniisip nga bahin han Benjamin an Beerot.

en: The people of Beeroth had fled to Gittaim and even now live there as immigrants.)
war: Nangalagiw ngadto ha Gitaim an tinuod nga mga umurokoy han Beerot, diin nag-ukoy hira tikang pa hadto.)

en: Now Saul’s son Jonathan had a boy whose feet were crippled. He was only 5 years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and so his nurse snatched him up and fled. But as she hurried to get away, he fell and was injured. His name was Mephibosheth.
war: Usa pa nga kaliwat ni Saul amo hi Mefiboset nga anak ni Jonatan. Lima pa la an iya panuigon han pagpataya kanda Saul ug Jonatan. Han pag-abot tikang ha Jezrael han sumat nga patay na hira Saul ug Jonatan, ginpurot hiya han iya magmarangno ngan kinmalagiw; kundi han duro nga pagdagmit han magmarangno nabuhian ngan nahulog hiya, ngan napiay.

en: Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, set out and reached Ishbosheth’s house at the heat of the day, right when he was lying down, taking an afternoon rest.
war: Kinmadto han balay ni Isboset hira Recab ug Baana, ngan inmabot hira didto nga naudtohan an adlaw, samtang napahuway hi Isboset.

en: They went straight into his house, as if getting wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and his brother Baanah escaped.
war: Ginpiraw an babaye nga nagbabantay han porta samtang nagsisisig hiya hin trigo, ngan nahingaturog hiya, sanglit nakasulod dayon hira Recab ug Baana.

en: They had entered the house while Ishbosheth was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed him and killed him, they cut off his head, took it, and traveled all night through the wilderness.
war: Han didto na hira ha sakob, sinmulod hira han katurogan nga kwarto ni Isboset, diin hinmumuokan hiya, ngan ginpatay nira hiya. Niyan ginpugotan hiya nira, gindara an ulo, ngan naglatas hira ha bug-os nga gab-i han Kahamub-an han Jordan.

en: They brought Ishbosheth’s head to David at Hebron. “Here is the head of Ishbosheth,” they told the king, “the son of Saul your enemy, who wanted you dead. Today the LORD has avenged our master the king on Saul and his descendants.”
war: Ginhatag nira an ulo kan Hadi David didto ha Hebron, ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Iini an ulo ni Isboset, nga anak ni Saul nga imo kaaway nga nag-iparatay ha imo. Yana nga adlaw gintugotan han Ginoo an Imo Kaharangdon hin pagbulos kan Saul ngan han iya mga tulin.”

en: David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has rescued me from all kinds of trouble,” he told them,
war: Ginbaton hira ni David, “Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga nagtalwas ha akon tikang han ngatanan nga kataragman!

en: “when someone told me Saul was dead back in Ziklag, thinking he was bringing good news, I grabbed him and killed him. That was the reward I gave him for his news!
war: An magsarangyaw nga kinmadto ha akon didto ha Siclag nga nagsumat ha akon han kamatayon ni Saul, naghunahuna nga dara niya in maupay nga sumat. Gindakop ngan ginpapatay ko hiya. Amo adto an suhol nga akon iginhatag ha iya tungod han iya maupay nga sumat!

en: What do you think I’ll do when evil people kill a righteous person in his own house on his own bed? Why shouldn’t I demand his blood from your hands and rid the earth of you both?”
war: Labaw pa gud hin kamaraot para han magraot nga mga tawo an pagpatay hin tawo nga waray sala, nga nakaturog la dida han iya kalugaringon nga balay! Yana bubulson ko kamo tungod han pagpatay niyo ha iya, ngan pupuohon ko kamo dinhe ha bawbaw han tuna!”

en: So David gave the order to his servants, and they killed Rechab and Baanah, cutting off their hands and feet and hanging them up by the pool at Hebron. But they took Ishbosheth’s head and buried it in the grave of Abner at Hebron.
war: Nagsugo hi David ngan ginpatay han iya mga sondalo hira Recab ug Baana, ngan gin-utod an ira mga kamot ngan mga tiil nga ira ginbitay hirani han linaw didto ha Hebron. Kinuha nira an ulo ni Isboset ngan iginlubong ini didto han lubnganan ni Abner ha Hebron.

en: All the Israelite tribes came to David at Hebron and said, “Listen: We are your very own flesh and bone.
war: Ngan kinmadto kan David didto ha Hebron an ngatanan nga mga tribo han Israel ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Imo kami kalugaringon ha unod ug dugo.

en: In the past, when Saul ruled over us, you were the one who led Israel out to war and back. What’s more, the LORD told you, You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will be Israel’s leader.
war: Han naglabay nga panahon, bisan han hadi pa namon hi Saul, nangulo ka na han mga tawo han Israel, didto ha pag-awayan, ngan nagsaad ha imo an Ginoo nga ikaw an magdudumara han iya mga tawo ngan magigin pangulo ka nira.”

en: So all the Israelite elders came to the king at Hebron. King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD , and they anointed David king over Israel.
war: Sanglit kinmadto kan David didto ha Hebron an ngatanan nga mga pangulo han Israel. Nagsumpa hi David hin pakig-urosa ha ira, gindihogan hiya nira, ngan nahimo hiya nga hadi han Israel.

en: David was 30 years old when he became king, and he ruled for forty years.
war: Hi David 30 na an panuigon han kahimo niya nga hadi, ngan naghadi hiya hin 40 ka tuig.

en: He ruled over Judah for seven and a half years in Hebron. He ruled thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.
war: Naghadi hiya han Juda didto ha Hebron sulod hin pito ka tuig hin tunga, ngan han bug-os nga Israel ug Juda didto ha Jerusalem sulod hin 33 ka tuig.

en: The king and his troops marched on Jerusalem against the Jebusites, who inhabited the territory. The Jebusites said to David, “You’ll never get us in here! Even the blind and the lame will beat you back!” “David will never enter here,” they said to each other.
war: Inmabot an panahon nga ginsulong ni Hadi David ngan han iya mga tawo an Jerusalem. Naghunahuna an mga Jebuseohanon nga nag-ukoy didto nga diri makakabihag han syudad hi David sanglit nagsiring hira ha iya, “Diri ka gud makakasulod ngadi; makakapugong ha imo bisan an mga buta ngan an mga lulid la.” (

en: But David did capture the fortress of Zion—which became David’s City.
war: Kundi nabihag ni David an ira madig-on nga kota han Sion, ngan ginkilala ini nga “Syudad ni David.”)

en: “On that day,” David said, “whoever attacks the Jebusites should strike the windpipe because David hates the lame and the blind.” That is why people say, “The blind and the lame will not enter the temple.”
war: Hito nga adlaw, nagsiring hi David ha iya mga tawo, “May-ada ba dinhe ha iyo nagdudumot han mga Jebuseohanon sugad han akon pagdumot? Pagdumot nga igo pumatay ha ira? Kon may-ada, sagka kamo ngan didto kamo sulod han aragian han tubig ngan sulonga niyo an mga buta ngan mga lulid.” (Amo ini nga iginsiring, “Diri makakasulod han balay han Ginoo an mga buta ngan mga lulid.”)

en: David occupied the fortress, so it was renamed David’s City. David built a city around it from the earthen terraces inward.
war: Katapos mabihag an madig-on nga kota, didto na pag-ukoy hi David ngan ginngaranan ini nga “Syudad ni David.” Gintindog niya an syudad ngan ginpalibotan ini hin pader tikang han dapit nga tinak-upan hin tuna didto han sinirangan nga ligid han pungtod.

en: David grew increasingly powerful, and the LORD of heavenly forces was with him.
war: Nagtikakusog la hi David, kay nakada ha iya an Ginoo nga Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum.

en: Tyre’s King Hiram sent messengers to David with cedar logs, bricklayers, and carpenters to build David a palace.
war: Nagsugo ngadto kan David hi Hadi Hiram han Tiro hin mga tawo nga may-ada dara nga mga troso nga sidro ngan hin mga panday ngan mga kantero para pagtindog hin palasyo.

en: Then David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingship was held in great honor for the sake of his people Israel.
war: Sanglit nakasabot hi David nga ginpadig-on hiya han Ginoo nga hadi han Israel, ngan nagmainuswagon an iya ginhadian tungod han iya mga tawo.

en: After he left Hebron, David married more secondary wives in Jerusalem and fathered more sons and daughters.
war: Han pagbalhin na ni David tikang ha Hebron ngadto ha Jerusalem, nadugangan pa an iya mga asawa ug aruasawa, ngan nagkamay-ada hiya damo pa nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an.

en: The names of his children in Jerusalem were as follows: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
war: Amo ini an mga anak nga natawo didto ha Jerusalem: hira Samua, Sobab, Natan, Solomon,

en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
war: Ibaar, Elisua, Nefeg, Jafia,

en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
war: Elisama, Eliada, ug Elifelet.

en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all marched up to find him, but David heard of it and went down to the fortress.
war: Nasumatan an mga Filisteohanon nga ginhimo hi David nga hadi han Israel, sanglit nagkagawas an ira kasondalohan hin pagdakop ha iya. Han paghibaro hini ni David, linmugsong hiya ngadto hin pinadig-on nga kota.

en: The Philistines arrived and spread out over the Rephaim Valley.
war: Nagkaabot ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan ini.

en: David asked the LORD , “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?”
war: Nagpakiana han Ginoo hi David, “Susulongon ko ba an mga Filisteohanon? Padadag-on mo ba ako?”

en: “Attack them,” the LORD replied, “because I will definitely hand the Philistines over to you.”
war: “Sulonga,” binmaton an Ginoo . “Padadag-on ko ikaw!”

en: So David arrived at Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines there. He said, “The LORD has burst out against my enemies, the way water bursts out!” That is why that place is called Baal-perazim.
war: Sanglit kinmadto ha Baal Perazim hi David, ngan ginpirde niya didto an mga Filisteohanon. Nagsiring hiya, “An Ginoo , sugad hin pagbulwang hin baha, nakabungkag han akon mga kaaway.” Sanglit ginngaranan adto nga dapit nga Baal Perazim.

en: The Philistines left their divine images behind, and David and his men carried them off.
war: Han pangalagiw han mga Filisteohanon, ginbayaan nira didto an ira mga diyosdiyos, ngan gindara ini ni David ngan han iya mga tawo.

en: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out across the Rephaim Valley.
war: Niyan binmalik ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan na liwat ini.

en: When David asked the LORD , God replied, “Don’t attack them directly. Circle around behind them and come at them from in front of the balsam trees.
war: Ginpakianhan na liwat ni David an Ginoo nga nagbaton, “Ayaw hira pagsulonga tikang dinhe, kundi libota ngan sulonga hira ha luyo, hirani han mga kahoy nga balsamo.

en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the trees, then attack, for God has attacked in front of you to defeat the Philistine army.”
war: Kon hibatian mo in mga aringasa sugad hin tubadok hin mga pitad ha bawbaw han kakahoyan, sulong dayon kamo, kay mag-uuna ako ha imo hin pagpukan han kasondalohan nga Filisteohanon.”

en: Once again David assembled the select warriors of Israel, thirty thousand strong.
war: Gintirok na liwat ni David an gimamag-upayi nga mga sondalo didto ha Israel, nga inmabot ngatanan hin 30,000 nga kalalaken-an,

en: David and all the troops who were with him set out for Baalah, which is Kiriath-jearim of Judah, to bring God’s chest up from there—the chest that is called by the name of the LORD of heavenly forces, who sits enthroned on the winged creatures.
war: ngan gindara ini niya ngadto ha Baala didto ha Juda, basi amo hira an magdara han Kahon han Ginsaaran han Dyos nga may-ada ngaran nga Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum, kanay trono aadto ha igbaw han mga kerubin.

en: They loaded God’s chest on a new cart and carried it from Abinadab’s house, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, Abinadab’s sons, were driving the new cart.
war: Ira ginkuha ini ha balay ni Abinadab didto ha bawbaw han pungtod ngan ira ginkarga ini ha bag-o nga karomata. Hira Uza ug Ahio nga mga anak ni Abinadab amo an nagpapalakat han karomata,

en: Uzzah was beside God’s chest while Ahio was walking in front of it.
war: nga nag-uuna han karomata hi Ahio.

en: Meanwhile, David and the entire house of Israel celebrated in the LORD ’s presence with all their strength, with songs, zithers, harps, tambourines, rattles, and cymbals.
war: Ha bug-os nira nga kusog, hira David ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nagsasarayaw ngan nagkakaranta ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo . Nagtotokar hira hin mga arpa, mga lira, mga gimbal, mga kastanwelas, ngan mga bombo.

en: When they approached Nacon’s threshing floor, Uzzah reached out to God’s chest and grabbed it because the oxen had stumbled.
war: Han pag-abot na nira han giriokan nga dapit han Nacon, natumba an mga baka ngan nagguguyod han karomata, ngan kinaptan dayon ni Uza an Kahon han Ginsaaran.

en: The LORD became angry at Uzzah, and God struck him there because of his mistake, and he died there next to God’s chest.
war: Nasina dayon kan Uza an Ginoo nga Dyos ngan ginpatay hiya tungod kay kinaptan man niya an Kahon han Ginsaaran. Namatay hi Uza didto ha ligid han Kahon han Ginsaaran,

en: Then David got angry because the LORD ’s anger lashed out against Uzzah, and so that place is called Perez-uzzah today.
war: sanglit tikang hadto gintawag nga Perez Uza adto nga dapit. Napungot hi David kay ginkastigo han Ginoo , ha iya kasina, hi Uza.

en: David was frightened by the LORD that day. “How will I ever bring the LORD ’s chest to me?” he asked.
war: Niyan nahadlok han Ginoo hi David ngan nagsiring hiya, “Uunanhon ko yana pakadara han Kahon han Ginsaaran?”

en: So David didn’t take the chest away with him to David’s City. Instead, he had it put in the house of Obed-edom, who was from Gath.
war: Sanglit naglarang hiya nga diri na la dad-on an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngadto ha Jerusalem; linmiko lugod hiya ngan gindara ini ngadto han balay ni Obed Edom nga taga syudad han Gat.

en: The LORD ’s chest stayed with Obed-edom’s household in Gath for three months, and the LORD blessed Obed-edom’s household and all that he had.
war: Nagpabilin ini didto hin pito ka bulan, ngan ginbendisyonan han Ginoo hi Obed Edom ngan an iya panimalay.

en: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed Obed-edom’s family and everything he has because of God’s chest being there.” So David went and brought God’s chest up from Obed-edom’s house to David’s City with celebration.
war: Nahibaro hi Hadi David nga tungod han Kahon han Ginsaaran ginpakaupay han Ginoo an panimalay ni Obed Edom ngan an ngatanan nga nakada ha iya panimalay. Sanglit kinuha niya an Kahon han Ginsaaran tikang han balay ni Obed Edom basi dad-on ini ngadto ha Jerusalem pinaagi hin maribhong nga pagsaurog.

en: Whenever those bearing the chest advanced six steps, David sacrificed an ox and a fatling calf.
war: Pakalakat la hin unom ka pitad han mga tawo nga nagpapasag han Kahon han Ginsaaran, ginpaukoy hira ni David samtang naghalad hiya han Ginoo hin tinubod nga todo nga baka ngan hin pinatambok nga nati nga baka.

en: David, dressed in a linen priestly vest, danced with all his strength before the LORD .
war: Nagsinayaw hi David, tugob hin kalipay, ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo , nga nakakatapis la hiya hin dugnit nga lino.

en: This is how David and the entire house of Israel brought up the LORD ’s chest with shouts and trumpet blasts.
war: Sanglit gindara niya ngan han ngatanan nga mga Israelita an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngadto ha Jerusalem inupdan hin rugyaw ngan tunog hin mga trompeta.

en: As the LORD ’s chest entered David’s City, Saul’s daughter Michal was watching from a window. She saw King David jumping and dancing before the LORD , and she lost all respect for him.
war: Han gindadara na ngadto ha syudad an Kahon, timnangbo ha bintana hi Mical nga anak ni Saul ngan hinkit-an niya hi Hadi David nga nagluluksolukso ngan nagsisinayaw ha atubangan han Kahon han Ginsaaran, ngan waray gud makalipay ha iya an ginbuhat ni David.

en: The LORD ’s chest was brought in and put in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it. Then David offered entirely burned offerings in the LORD ’s presence in addition to well-being sacrifices.
war: Gindara nira an Kahon ngan iginbutang ini dida han dapit nga burutangan hini ha sakob han Ginoo han Tulda nga gintindog ni David. Katapos naghalad hi David hin mga halad nga tinubod ngan hin mga halad hin pagdait.

en: When David finished offering the entirely burned offerings and the well-being sacrifices, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of heavenly forces.
war: Han kahuman niya paghalad, ginbendisyonan niya an mga tawo ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum,

en: He distributed food among all the people of Israel—to the whole crowd, male and female—each receiving a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake. Then all the people went back to their homes.
war: ngan tinagan hira ngatanan hin pagkaon. Tinagan niya an kada lalake ug babaye didto ha Israel, hin tag-usa ka bug-os nga tinapay, usa ka gurot nga sinugba nga karne, ngan mga pasas. Katapos nangoli an ngatanan.

en: David went home to bless his household, but Saul’s daughter Michal came out to meet him. “How did Israel’s king honor himself today?” she said. “By exposing himself in plain view of the female servants of his subjects like any indecent person would!”
war: Niyan, han pag-uli na ni David hin pagbendisyon han iya panimalay, ginmawas hi Mical hin pagtapo ha iya. Nagsiring hiya, “Pagkadako nga kadarayawan an naangkon han hadi han Israel yana nga adlaw! Sinmayaw hiya nga nagtatapis la sugad hin lurong ha atubangan han mga surugoon nga kababayen-an han iya mga opisyal hin waray kaawod!”

en: David replied to Michal, “I was celebrating before the LORD , who chose me over your father and his entire family, and who appointed me leader over the LORD ’s people, over Israel—and I will celebrate before the LORD again!
war: Binmaton hi David, “Nagsinayaw ako ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo nga nagpili ha akon nga liwan han imo amay ngan han iya panimalay ngan naghimo ha akon nga pangulo han iya mga tawo nga Israel. Ngan magpapadayon ako pagsayaw ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo ,

en: I may humiliate myself even more, and I may be humbled in my own eyes, but I will be honored by the female servants you are talking about!”
war: ngan magmamakaarawod pa ako labaw pa han akon ginbuhat. Bangin pakaalohan ako nimo, kundi dadayawon ako hadto nga kababayen-an!”

en: Michal, Saul’s daughter, had no children to the day she died.
war: Waray gud mag-anak hi Mical nga anak ni Saul, asta nga namatay.

en: When the king was settled in his palace, and the LORD had given him rest from all his surrounding enemies,
war: Madig-on na an kamutangan ni Hadi David didto han iya palasyo, ngan gintalwas na hiya han Ginoo han ngatanan niya nga mga kaaway.

en: the king said to the prophet Nathan, “Look! I’m living in a cedar palace, but God’s chest is housed in a tent!”
war: Niyan nagsiring an hadi kan Natan, “Nag-uokoy ako dida hin balay nga hinimo hin mga kahoy nga sidro, kundi aada la hin tulda an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Dyos!”

en: Nathan said to the king, “Go ahead and do whatever you are thinking, because the LORD is with you.”
war: Binmaton hi Natan, “Buhata an imo ginhuhunahuna, kay aada ha imo an Ginoo .”

en: But that very night the LORD ’s word came to Nathan:
war: Kundi hito nga gab-i nagsiring an Ginoo kan Natan,

en: Go to my servant David and tell him: This is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build the temple for me to live in.
war: “Kadtoa ngan sumati hi David, an akon surugoon, nga nasiring ako ha iya, ‘Diri ikaw an magtitindog hin templo nga akon uokyan.

en: In fact, I haven’t lived in a temple from the day I brought Israel out of Egypt until now. Instead, I have been traveling around in a tent and in a dwelling.
war: Tikang han paggawara ko han mga tawo han Israel ha Ehipto ngada yana, waray pa gud ako mag-ukoy hin templo. Dida han paglakaton ha kamingawan, nagbarobalhin ako pag-ukoy dida hin tulda.

en: Throughout my traveling around with the Israelites, did I ever ask any of Israel’s tribal leaders I appointed to shepherd my people: Why haven’t you built me a cedar temple?
war: Ha ngatanan nga akon paglakaton upod han mga tawo han Israel waray ako pakiana han mga pangulo nga akon gintudlok kay ano nga waray ako nira ighimo hin templo nga sidro.’

en: So then, say this to my servant David: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be leader over my people Israel.
war: “Sanglit sumati hi David nga akon surugoon nga nasiring ha iya hi ako nga Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum, ‘Ginkuha ko ikaw hin ka paramangno hin mga karnero didto han kaumhan ngan ginhimo ko ikaw nga pangulo han akon mga tawo nga Israel.

en: I’ve been with you wherever you’ve gone, and I’ve eliminated all your enemies before you. Now I will make your name great—like the name of the greatest people on earth.
war: Dayuday kaupod ako nimo bisan diin ka kadto, ngan ginpirde ko an ngatanan mo nga mga kaaway samtang nasulong ka ha ira. Hihimoon ko ikaw nga sugad ka bantogan han labi kagamhanan nga mga pangulo dinhe ha kalibutan.

en: I’m going to provide a place for my people Israel, and plant them so that they may live there and no longer be disturbed. Cruel people will no longer trouble them, as they had been earlier,
war: 10-11 Nagpili ako hin dapit para han akon mga tawo nga Israelita ngan akon hira iginpahimutang didto, diin mag-uokoy hira hin waray na magtatalumpigos ha ira. Tikang han pagsulod nira hini nga tuna, ginsulong hira hin mag-isog nga mga tawo, kundi diri na ini mahinanabo ha ira. Nagsasaad ako hin pagtalwas ha imo tikang han ngatanan mo nga mga kaaway ngan paghatag ha imo hin mga tulin.

en: when I appointed leaders over my people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies.
war: Kon mamatay ka na ngan iglubong tampo han imo mga ginikanan, hihimoon ko nga hadi in usa han imo mga anak ngan padidig-onon ko an iya ginhadian.

en: And the LORD declares to you that the LORD will make a dynasty for you.
war: Hiya amo an magtitindog hin templo para ha akon, ngan tatalinguhaon ko nga maghadi an iya katulinan ha kadayonan.

en: When the time comes for you to die and you lie down with your ancestors, I will raise up your descendant—one of your very own children—to succeed you, and I will establish his kingdom.
war: Magigin amay ako niya ngan magigin anak ko hiya. Kon makasayop hiya, kakastigohon ko hiya sugad hin pagkastigo han iya anak hin usa nga amay.

en: He will build a temple for my name, and I will establish his royal throne forever.
war: Kundi diri ko kukuhaon ha iya an akon tambulig, sugad han akon ginbuhat kan Saul nga akon ginkuha basi mahimo ka nga hadi.

en: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to me. Whenever he does wrong, I will discipline him with a human rod, with blows from human beings.
war: Dayuday magkakamay-ada mga tulin ngan magpapadayon an imo ginhadian. Diri gud matatapos an paghadi han imo katulinan.’”

en: But I will never take my faithful love away from him like I took it away from Saul, whom I set aside in favor of you.
war: Iginsumat ni Natan kan David an ngatanan nga iginpadayag ha iya han Dyos.

en: Your dynasty and your kingdom will be secured forever before me. Your throne will be established forever.
war: Niyan sinmulod hi David han Tulda han Ginoo , linmingkod, ngan nag-ampo hiya, “Diri ako takus, bisan ngani an akon panimalay han imo na ginbuhat ha akon, O Ginoo nga Dyos .

en: Nathan reported all of these words and this entire vision to David.
war: Kundi ginbubuhat pa nimo in labaw pa gud, O Ginoo nga Dyos ; nagsaad ka mahitungod han akon katulinan ha tiarabot nga katuigan. Ngan iginpakita mo ha akon an tiarabot ko nga mga katulinan, O Ginoo nga Dyos !

en: Then King David went and sat in the LORD ’s presence. He asked:
war: Ano pa in akon igsisiring ha imo! Nakilala ka ha akon nga imo surugoon.

en: Who am I, LORD God, and of what significance is my family that you have brought me this far?
war: Imo ini kaburot-on ngan paglarang hin pagbuhat hini; ginbuhat mo ini ngatanan nga dagko nga mga butang basi makagtutdo ka ha akon.

en: But even this was too small in your eyes, LORD God! Now you have also spoken about your servant’s dynasty in the future and the generation to come, LORD God!
war: Hin pagkagamhanan nimo, O Ginoo nga Dyos ! Waray gud masugad ha imo; maaram gud kami nga ikaw la an Dyos.

en: What more can David say to you? You know your servant, LORD God.
war: Waray iba nga nasod ha tuna nga sugad han Israel nga imo gintalwas hin pagkaoripon basi mahimo hira nga imo kalugaringon nga mga tawo. Nakapabantog ha imo ha bug-os nga kalibutan an dagko ngan urosahon nga mga butang nga imo ginbuhat para ha ira. Gintabog mo in iba nga mga nasod ngan an ira kadiyosan han pagsulong han imo mga tawo nga imo gintalwas tikang ha Ehipto basi magin imo kalugaringon hira.

en: For the sake of your word and according to your own will, you have done this great thing so that your servant would know it.
war: Ginhimo mo nga imo kalugaringon nga nasod an Israel ha kadayonan, ngan ikaw, O Ginoo , nahimo nga ira Dyos.

en: That is why you are so great, LORD God! No one can compare to you, no god except you, just as we have always heard with our own ears.
war: “Ngan yana, O Ginoo nga Dyos , tumana ha ngatanan nga panahon an iginsaad mo mahitungod ha akon ngan han akon katulinan, ngan tumana an imo iginsiring nga imo bubuhaton.

en: And who can compare to your people Israel? They are the one nation on earth that God redeemed as his own people, establishing his name by doing great and awesome things for them, by driving out nations and their gods before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt.
war: Mababantogan ka hin duro, ngan masiring ha kadayonan an mga tawo, ‘An Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum amo an Dyos han Israel.’ Ngan imo ipapadayon ha ngatanan nga panahon an akon katulinan.

en: You established your people Israel as your own people forever, and you, LORD , became their God.
war: O Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum nga Dyos han Israel! Nakadasig ini ha akon hin pag-ampo ha imo, kay iginpadayag mo ini ngatanan ha akon nga imo surugoon, ngan iginsumat mo ha akon nga imo hihimoon nga kahadian an akon katulinan.

en: Now, LORD God, confirm forever the promise you have made about your servant and his dynasty. Do just as you have promised
war: “Ngan yana, O Ginoo nga Dyos , ikaw amo an Dyos; dayuday nagtutuman ka han imo mga saad, ngan imo ginhimo ha akon ini nga makaaramdok nga saad.

en: so that your name will be great forever when people say, “The LORD of heavenly forces is Israel’s God!” May your servant David’s household be established before you,
war: Nahangyo ako ha imo nga bendisyonan mo an akon katulinan basi magpadayon hira pagpahimulos han imo kamaloloy-on ngan kamaupay. Ikaw, O Ginoo nga Dyos an nagsaad hini, ngan magpabilin unta ha kadayonan an imo bendisyon dida han akon katulinan.”

en: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them. David captured Metheg-ammah from Philistine control.
war: Waray kaiha ginsulong na liwat ni David an mga Filisteohanon, ginpirde hira, ngan waray na hin pagdumara han ira tuna.

en: David also defeated the Moabites and made them lie on the ground, measuring them with a rope. He measured two rope lengths for those who were to be killed and one rope length for those who were to be spared. The Moabites became David’s subjects and brought him tribute.
war: Ginpirde liwat niya an mga Moabitanhon; iya ginpapanhigda hira ha tuna, ngan ginpatay an duha han kada tulo ka tawo ha ira. Sanglit nasakop niya an mga Moabitanhon ngan nagbayad ha iya hin mga buhis.

en: Next David defeated Zobah’s King Hadadezer, Rehob’s son, as Hadadezer was on his way to put his monument along the Euphrates River.
war: Niyan ginpirde niya hi Hadadeser nga anak ni Rehob nga hadi han Siriahanon nga lalawigan han Soba, han tikadto hi Hadadeser hin pagdumara na liwat han katunaan ha ligid han iraya nga Salog Eufrates.

en: David captured one thousand chariots, seven hundred charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He cut the hamstrings of all but one hundred of the chariot horses.
war: Nabihag ni David in 1,700 han iya mga dikabayo nga sondalo ngan 20,000 han iya iba nga mga sondalo. Ginpili niya in mga kabayo nga igo hin usa ka gatos nga mga karuwahe ngan pinamiangan an iba nga mga kabayo.

en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Zobah’s King Hadadezer, David killed twenty-two thousand of them.
war: Nagpadara hin kasondalohan an mga Siriahanon han Damasco hin pagbulig kan Hadi Hadadeser; pinakiawayan hira ni David ngan pinamatay in 22,000 ka tawo.

en: David set up forts among the Arameans of Damascus. And the Arameans became David’s subjects and brought him tribute. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.
war: Katapos nagtindog hiya hin mga kampo hin kasondalohan didto han ira katunaan, ngan nasakop niya hira ngan nagbayad hin mga buhis ha iya. Ginpadaog han Ginoo hi David ha ngatanan nga dapit.

en: David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s servants and brought them to Jerusalem.
war: Gin-agaw ni David an bulawan nga mga taming nga dara han mga opisyal ni Hadadeser ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: King David also took a large amount of bronze from Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer.
war: Ginkuha liwat niya in kadam-an nga mga bronse tikang ha Beta ug Berotai nga mga syudad nga ginhahadian ni Hadadeser.

en: When Hamath’s King Toi heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
war: Hinbatian ni Hadi Toi han Hamat nga ginpirde ni David an ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni Hadadeser.

en: he sent his son Joram to King David to wish him well and congratulate him on his battle and defeat of Hadadezer, because Toi was an enemy of Hadadezer. Joram brought silver, gold, and bronze objects with him.
war: Sanglit ginsugo niya hi Joram nga iya anak pagpahalipay kan Hadi David ngan pagpasidungog ha iya kay ginpirde man niya hi Hadadeser nga makadamo na pakiawayi ni Toi. Gindad-an ni Joram hi David hin mga regalo nga hinimo hin bulawan, salapi, ug bronse.

en: King David dedicated these to the LORD , along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations that he had subdued:
war: Iginhalad ini ni Hadi David nga garamiton hin pagsingba upod han salapi ug bulawan nga iya nakuha didto han mga nasod nga iya napirde—

en: Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek, including the plunder of Zobah’s King Hadadezer, Rehob’s son.
war: an Edumea, Moab, Filistia, ug Amalek—sugad man hin bahin han naagaw niya kan Hadadeser.

en: So David made a name for himself. When he returned, he killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Salt Valley.
war: Labi nga nabantogan hi David han pagbalik niya tikang hin pamatay hin 18,000 nga mga Edomitanhon didto ha Kahamub-an han Asin.

en: He set up forts in Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s subjects. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.
war: Nagtindog hiya hin mga kampo hin kasondalohan ha bug-os nga Edumea, ngan nasakop niya an mga tawo didto. Ginpadaog han Ginoo hi David ha ngatanan nga dapit.

en: David ruled over all Israel and maintained justice and righteousness for all his people.
war: Naghadi hi David han bug-os nga Israel, ngan gintalinguha niya nga dayuday nga maupay an iya pagdumara ngan waray pinalabi nga iya mga tawo.

en: Zeruiah’s son Joab was in command of the army; Ahilud’s son Jehoshaphat was recorder;
war: Hi Joab kanay iroy amo hi Seruia amo an pangulo han kasondalohan; hi Josafat nga anak ni Ahilud amo an tinaporan han mga sinurat;

en: Ahitub’s son Zadok and Ahimelech’s son Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
war: hira Sadoc nga anak ni Ahitob ngan hi Ahimelec nga anak ni Abiatar amo an kapadian; hi Seraias amo an sekretaryo han korte;

en: Jehoiada’s son Benaiah was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
war: hi Benaia nga anak ni Joiada amo an tinaporan han mga gwardya ni David; ngan kapadian liwat an mga anak ni David.

en: David asked, “Is there anyone from Saul’s family still alive that I could show faithful love for Jonathan’s sake?”
war: Usa ka adlaw nagpakiana hi David, “May-ada pa ba nahibilin han panimalay ni Saul? Kon may-ada, karuyag ko magpakita hin kalooy ha iya tungod kan Jonatan.”

en: There was a servant from Saul’s household named Ziba, and he was summoned before David.
war: May-ada hadto surugoon han panimalay ni Saul nga ginngaranan kan Siba ngan ginpakadto hiya kan David. Pinmakiana an hadi, “Hi Siba ka ba?”

en: “Are you Ziba?” the king asked him.
war: “Oo, hi ako nga imo surugoon,” binmaton hiya.

en: “At your service!” he answered.
war: Pinmakiana ha iya an hadi, “May-ada pa ba nahibilin han panimalay ni Saul, basi ipakita ko ha iya an kalooy han Dyos?”

en: The king asked, “Is there anyone left from Saul’s family that I could show God’s kindness to?”
war: Binmaton hi Siba, “May-ada pa usa han mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Jonatan. Piay hiya.”

en: “Yes,” Ziba said to the king, “one of Jonathan’s sons, whose feet are crippled.”
war: “Hain man hiya?” pinmakiana an hadi.

en: “Where is he?” the king asked.
war: Binmaton hi Siba, “Aadto hiya han balay ni Maquir nga anak ni Amiel didto ha Lodebar.”

en: “He is at the house of Ammiel’s son Machir at Lo-debar,” Ziba told the king.
war: Sanglit iginpakuha ini nga tawo ni Hadi David.

en: So King David had him brought from the house of Ammiel’s son Machir at Lo-debar.
war: Han pag-abot ni Mefiboset nga anak ni Jonatan ngan apo ni Saul, yinmukbo hiya hin pagtahod ha atubangan ni David. Nagsiring hi David, “Mefiboset!” ngan binmaton hiya, “Amo ako, nga imo surugoon.”

en: Mephibosheth, Jonathan’s son and Saul’s grandson, came to David, and he fell to the ground, bowing low out of respect.
war: “Ayaw kahadlok,” binmaton hi David. “Kalolooyan ko ikaw tungod kan Jonatan nga imo amay. Ibabalik ko ha imo an ngatanan nga mga tuna ni Saul nga imo apoy, ngan dayuday aanhi ka na makaon saro ha akon.”

en: “Mephibosheth?” David said.
war: Yinmukbo liwat hi Mefiboset ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga magmamaupay ka hin duro ha akon nga sugad man la ako hin patay nga ayam?”

en: “Yes,” he replied. “I am at your service!”
war: Niyan gintawag han hadi hi Siba nga surugoon ni Saul ngan ginsiring, “Akon ihinahatag kan Mefiboset nga apo han imo agaron an ngatanan nga gintag-iya ni Saul ngan han iya panimalay.

en: “Don’t be afraid,” David told him, “because I will certainly show you faithful love for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the fields of your grandfather Saul, and you will eat at my table always.”
war: Ikaw, an imo mga anak, ngan an imo mga surugoon amo an mag-uuma han tuna para han panimalay ni Saul nga imo agaron, ngan ihahatag mo an mga abot ha ira. Kundi dayuday aanhi ha akon, kasaro ha akon lamesa hi Mefiboset.” (May 15 nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an hi Siba ngan 20 nga mga surugoon.)

en: Some time later, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.
war: Waray kaiha namatay hi Hadi Nahas han Amon ngan hi Hanun nga iya anak an naghadi.

en: David said, “I’ll be loyal to Nahash’s son Hanun, just as his father was loyal to me.” So David sent his servants with condolences concerning Hanun’s father.
war: Nagsiring hi David, “Kinahanglan ipakita ko kan Hanun an maunongon nga pakigsangkay, sugad han ginbuhat ha akon ni Nahas nga iya amay.” Sanglit nagpasugo hi David ngadto kan Hadi Hanun hin pagpasabot han iya kabidoan tungod han kamatay ni Hadi Nahas.

en: But when David’s servants arrived in Ammonite territory,
war: Han pag-abot han ginsugo ngadto ha Amon,

en: the Ammonite officials asked their master Hanun, “Do you really believe David is honoring your father because he has sent you condolences? Of course not! David has sent his servants to you to search the city, spy it out, and overthrow it.”
war: nagsiring han hadi an mga pangulo nga Amonitanhon, “Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga kadungganan ini ni imo tatay nga iginpadara ni David ini nga mga tawo pagpakita han iya kabidoan ha imo? Bangin diri! Iya ginsugo hira nganhi sugad nga mga mag-irinaw hin pag-usisa han syudad basi bihagon kita niya!”

en: So Hanun seized David’s servants and shaved off their beards, cut off half their garments, from their buttocks down, and sent them off.
war: Gindakop ni Hanun an mga sinugo ni David, gintusaran an luyo nga katunga han ira mga bungot, gintabasan ha may hawak an ira mga panapton, ngan ginpalakat hira.

en: When this was reported to David, he sent men to meet them because they were completely ashamed. The king said, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown. Then you can come back.”
war: Naawod hira hin duro hin pag-uli. Paghibaro ni David han nahinabo, nagpatugon hiya ha ira nga magpabilin la anay hira didto ha Jerico, ngan diri umuli ngada han pagtubo na liwat han ira mga bungot.

en: When the Ammonites realized that they had offended David, they sent for and hired the Arameans of Beth-rehob and the Arameans of Zobah, totaling twenty thousand foot soldiers; the king of Maacah with one thousand soldiers; and twelve thousand soldiers from Tob.
war: Nakasabot an mga Amonitanhon nga hi David ira na kaaway, sanglit nagsuhol hira hin 20,000 nga mga sondalo nga Siriahanon nga taga-Betrehob ug Soba, 12,000 nga mga tawo nga taga-Tob, ngan han hadi han Maaca upod in 1,000 nga mga tawo.

en: When David heard this, he sent Joab with the entire army of warriors.
war: Hinbaroan ini ni David ngan ginsugo niya hi Joab hin pagsulong ha ira upod an ngatanan nga kasondalohan.

en: The Ammonites marched out and formed a battle line at the entrance to the city. The Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the soldiers from Tob and Maacah remained in the countryside.
war: Nagkagawas an mga Amonitanhon ngan nag-andam pakig-away dida han aragian ngadto ha Raba nga kapital nira nga syudad, samtang an iba, an mga Siriahanon ngan an mga tawo nga tikang ha Tob ug Maaca, nag-andam didto ha kapatagan.

en: When Joab saw that the battle would be fought on two fronts, he chose some of Israel’s finest warriors and deployed them to meet the Arameans.
war: Hinsabotan ni Joab nga susulongon hiya han mga kaaway ha atubangan ngan ha talikoran, sanglit ginpili niya an gimamag-upayi nga mga sondalo han Israel ngan ginpaatubang hira han mga Siriahanon.

en: The rest of the army Joab placed under the command of his brother Abishai. When they took up their positions to meet the Ammonites, Joab said,
war: Iginbutang niya an iba han iya kasondalohan ha ubos han pagdumara ni Abisai nga iya bugto, nga ginpaatubang ini hira han mga Amonitanhon.

en: “If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you must help me, and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, I’ll help you.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Joab, “Kon hikit-an mo nga pinipirde na kami han mga Siriahanon, pakadi ngan buligi ako, ngan kon hikit-an ko nga pinipirde kamo han mga Amonitanhon, makada ako ngan bubuligan ko ikaw.

en: Be brave! We must be courageous for the sake of our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his eyes.”
war: Pagmakusog ngan pagmaisog! Pakig-away kita hin maupay tungod han aton mga tawo ngan tungod han mga syudad han aton Dyos. Ngan matuman unta an kaburot-on han Ginoo !”

en: When Joab and the troops who were with him advanced into battle against the Arameans, they fled from him.
war: Sinmulong hin pakig-away hi Joab ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan nangalagiw an mga Siriahanon.

en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from Abishai and retreated to the city. Then Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and went to Jerusalem.
war: Han pakakita han mga Amonitanhon nga nangangalagiw na an mga Siriahanon, pinmalagiw liwat hira tikang kan Abisai ngan inmisol ngadto han syudad. Niyan binmalik hi Joab tikang han iya pakig-away han mga Amonitanhon ngan inmoli ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: The Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, so they regrouped.
war: Han pakakita han mga Siriahanon nga ginpirde na hira han mga Israelita, gintirok nira an ngatanan nira nga kasondalohan.

en: Hadadezer sent for Arameans from beyond the Euphrates River. They came to Helam with Shobach leading them as commander of Hadadezer’s army.
war: Ginpasugoan ni Hadi Hadadeser an mga Siriahanon nga nakadto ha sinirangan nga daplin han Salog Eufrates, ngan inmabot hira ngadto ha Helam ha ubos han pagdumara ni Sobac nga pangulo han kasondalohan ni Hadi Hadadeser han Soba.

en: When this was reported to David he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, and went to Helam. The Arameans formed battle lines against David and fought with him.
war: Han paghibaroi hini ni David, iya gintirok an kasondalohan nga Israelita, tinmabok hiya han Salog Jordan, ngan inmabot ngadto ha Helam diin nag-andam an mga Siriahanon nga naatubang ha iya. Nagtikang an araway,

en: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David destroyed seven hundred of their chariots and forty thousand horsemen. David wounded their army commander Shobach, and he died there.
war: ngan gintabog han mga Israelita an kasondalohan nga Siriahanon. Pinamatay ni David ngan han iya mga tawo in 700 nga Siriahanon nga mga dikaruwahe ngan 40,000 nga mga dikabayo, ngan ginsamad nira hi Sobac, an pangulo han mga kaaway nga namatay didto ha pag-awayan.

en: In the spring, when kings go off to war, David sent Joab, along with his servants and all the Israelites, and they destroyed the Ammonites, attacking the city of Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.
war: Han tikahirani na an kathuraw, ha panahon han tuig nga nahiaaraan han mga hadi hin pakig-away, ginsugo ni David hi Joab, upod an iya mga opisyal ngan an Israelita nga kasondalohan; ginpirde nira an mga Amonitanhon ngan ira ginpalibotan an syudad han Raba. Kundi nagpabilin hi David didto ha Jerusalem.

en: One evening, David got up from his couch and was pacing back and forth on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing; the woman was very beautiful.
war: Usa ka kulopay, binmuhat hi David ha iya pagpahuway ngan sinmaka ngadto han atop han palasyo. Han naglalakatlakat hiya didto, hinkit-an niya in babaye nga nakarigo didto han iya balay. Mahusay hiya hin duro.

en: David sent someone and inquired about the woman. The report came back: “Isn’t this Eliam’s daughter Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?”
war: Sanglit nagsugo hi David hin pagpanginano kon hin-o hiya, ngan hinbaroan nga hi Batseba hiya nga anak ni Eliam ngan asawa ni Urias nga Hiteohanon.

en: So David sent messengers to take her. When she came to him, he had sex with her. (Now she had been purifying herself after her monthly period.) Then she returned home.
war: Iginpakuha hiya ni David; gindara hiya ngan nakighilawas ha iya hi David. (Kahuhuman pa gudla niya han iya binulan nga seremonyas hin paglinis.) Katapos inmoli hiya.

en: The woman conceived and sent word to David.
war: Waray kaiha nakasabot hiya nga burod na hiya ngan ginsumatan niya hi David.

en: “I’m pregnant,” she said.
war: Ginpatugonan ni David hi Joab, “Pakadia ha akon hi Urias nga Hiteohanon.” Sanglit gindara ni Joab hi Urias ngadto kan David.

en: Then David sent a message to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent Uriah to David.
war: Han pag-abot ni Urias, ginpakianhan hiya ni David han kahimtang ni Joab ngan han mga sondalo, ngan kon ano na an araway.

en: When Uriah came to him, David asked about the welfare of Joab and the army and how the battle was going.
war: Katapos nagsiring hiya kan Urias, “Uli na ngan pahuway anay.” Linmakat hi Urias ngan ginpalanatan hiya hin regalo ni David.

en: Then David told Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.”
war: Kundi waray umuli hi Urias; kinmaturog la lugod hiya didto han ganghaan han palasyo tampo han mga gwardya han hadi.

en: Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
war: Han paghibaroi la ni David nga waray umuli hi Urias, iya ginsiring, “Pag-uoli mo pa la katapos hin maiha nga pagbaya; kay ano nga waray ka man umuli?”

en: However, Uriah slept at the palace entrance with all his master’s servants. He didn’t go down to his own house.
war: Binmaton hi Urias, “Aadto ha pag-awayan an mga tawo han Israel ug Juda ngan upod nira an Kahon han Ginsaaran; nagkakampo ha kapatagan hi Joab nga akon kapitan ngan an iya mga opisyal. Uunanhon ko hin pag-uli, pagkaon ngan pag-inom, ngan pagdirig han akon asawa? Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han buhi nga Dyos nga diri gud ako makakahimo hin sugad nga butang!”

en: David was told, “Uriah didn’t go down to his own house,” so David asked Uriah, “Haven’t you just returned from a journey? Why didn’t you go home?”
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi David, “Kon sugad, pabilin na la dinhe yana nga adlaw ngan pababalikon ko ikaw buwas.” Sanglit nagpabilin hi Urias didto ha Jerusalem hito nga adlaw ngan han pagkabuwas.

en: “The chest and Israel and Judah are all living in tents,” Uriah told David. “And my master Joab and my master’s troops are camping in the open field. How could I go home and eat, drink, and have sex with my wife? I swear on your very life, I will not do that!”
war: Gindapit hiya hin panihapon ni David ngan ginhubog hiya. Kundi waray gihapon umuli hi Urias hito nga gab-i, kinmaturog lugod hiya nagkurumpat han iya taklap didto han kwarto han mga gwardya.

en: Then David told Uriah, “Stay here one more day. Tomorrow I’ll send you back.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day. The next day
war: Han pagkaaga nagsurat hi David kan Joab ngan iginpadara ini kan Urias.

en: David called for him, and he ate and drank, and David got him drunk. In the evening Uriah went out to sleep in the same place, alongside his master’s servants, but he did not go down to his own home.
war: Iginsurat niya: “Ikadto ha atubangan hi Urias diin makusog hin duro an araway; ngan isol ikaw ngan pabay-i hiya nga mamatay.”

en: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
war: Sanglit han ginlilibotan ni Joab an syudad, ikinadto niya hi Urias hin dapit nga iya hinsabtan nga makusog an kaaway.

en: He wrote in the letter, “Place Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle, and then pull back from him so that he will be struck down and die.”
war: Nagkagawas han syudad an kaaway nga kasondalohan, ngan pinakiawayan an kasondalohan ni Joab; may nagkamatay han mga opisyal ni David ngan namatay liwat hi Urias.

en: So as Joab was attacking the city, he put Uriah in the place where he knew there were strong warriors.
war: Niyan nagpadara hi Joab ngadto kan David hin sumat hiunong han away,

en: When the city’s soldiers came out and attacked Joab, some of the people from David’s army fell. Uriah the Hittite was also killed.
war: ngan iya gintugon an sinugo, “Katapos mo pagsumati kan David han ngatanan hiunong han araway,

en: Joab sent a complete report of the battle to David.
war: bangin masina hiya ngan pumakiana ha imo, ‘Kay ano hin paghirani niyo hin duro han syudad hin pakig-away ha ira? Diri ba kamo maaram nga magamit hira hin mga pana tikang han pader?

en: “When you have finished reporting all the news of the battle to the king,” Joab instructed the messenger,
war: Diri ba kamo nahinunumdom han kamatay ni Abimelec nga anak ni Jeroboset? Didto adto ha Tebes nga iginlabog hin babaye tikang han pader in gilingan nga bato nga amo an nakamatay ha iya. Sanglit kay ano nga dinmuok kamo han pader?’ Kon pakianhan ka hini han hadi, sumati hiya, ‘Namatay liwat hi Urias nga imo opisyal.’”

en: “if the king gets angry and asks you, ‘Why did you go so close to the city to fight? didn’t you know they would shoot from the wall?
war: Sanglit kinmadto kan David an sinugo ngan ginsumatan niya hi David han iginsugo ha iya ni Joab.

en: Who killed Jerubbaal’s son Abimelech? didn’t a woman throw an upper millstone on top of him from the wall so that he died in Thebez? Why did you go so close to the wall?’ then say: ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead too.’”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Makurukusog kay ha amon an amon mga kaaway ngan ginmawas hira han syudad pakig-away ha amon didto han kapatagan, kundi amon hira gintabog tipabalik ngadto han ganghaan han syudad.

en: So the messenger set off, and when he arrived he reported to David everything Joab sent him to say.
war: Niyan ginpamana kami nira tikang han pader, ngan nagkamatay in pira nga mga opisyal han Imo Kaharangdon; namatay liwat hi Urias nga imo opisyal.”

en: “The men overpowered us,” the messenger told David. “They came out against us in the open field, but we fought against them up to the entrance of the city gate.
war: Ginsiring ni David an sinugo, “Dasiga hi Joab ngan sumati hiya nga diri la mabaraka, kay waray gud maaram kon hin-o in mapatay didto hin pag-awayan. Sumati hiya nga sulongon hin makurukusog an syudad ngan kinahanglan nga maagaw ini.”

en: Archers shot down on your servants from the wall. Some of the king’s servants died. And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead too.”
war: Han paghibaro la ni Batseba nga namatay na an iya bana, nagmasulob-on hiya tungod han iya bana.

en: David said to the messenger, “Say this to Joab: ‘Don’t be upset about this because the sword is that way: taking the life of this person or that person. Continue attacking the city and destroy it!’ Encourage Joab!”
war: Han katapos na han panahon hin pagmasulob-on, gindara hiya ni David ngadto han palasyo; nahimo hiya nga asawa ni David, ngan nag-anak hiya hin lalake. Kundi waray malipay an Ginoo han ginbuhat ni David.

en: So the LORD sent Nathan to David. When Nathan arrived he said, “There were two men in the same city, one rich, one poor.
war: Ginpakadto han Ginoo kan David hi Natan, an manaragna. Nagsiring hi Natan kan David, “May duha ka tawo nga nag-ukoy didto hin usa nga bungto; riko an usa ngan pobre an ikaduha.

en: The rich man had a lot of sheep and cattle,
war: Damo an mga baka ngan mga karnero han riko,

en: but the poor man had nothing—just one small ewe lamb that he had bought. He raised that lamb, and it grew up with him and his children. It would eat from his food and drink from his cup—even sleep in his arms! It was like a daughter to him.
war: samtang an pobre may usa la nga nati nga karnero nga iya pinalit. Ginmangnoan han pobre ini nga karnero, ngan tinmubo ini didto han iya balay tampo han iya mga anak. Gintubongan niya ini han kalugaringon niya nga pagkaon, ginpainom tikang han iya irimnon, ngan ginpalingkod ini dida ha iya paa. Sugad la hin anak niya nga babaye an nati nga karnero.

en: “Now a traveler came to visit the rich man, but he wasn’t willing to take anything from his own flock or herd to prepare for the guest who had arrived. Instead, he took the poor man’s ewe lamb and prepared it for the visitor.”
war: Usa ka adlaw inmabot in usa nga bisita didto han balay han riko. Waray an riko maruyag pag-ihaw hin usa han iya mga hayop basi ipakaon han iya bisita; asay lugod niya kinuha an kanan pobre usa la nga nati nga karnero ngan gin-andam ini para han iya bisita.”

en: David got very angry at the man, and he said to Nathan, “As surely as the LORD lives, the one who did this is demonic!
war: Nasina hin duro hi David kontra han riko ngan nagsiring, “Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga angay mamatay an tawo nga nagbuhat hini!

en: He must restore the ewe lamb seven times over because he did this and because he had no compassion.”
war: Kinahanglan pagbaydan niya hin upat ka pilo an iya kinuha, tungod han pagbuhat niya hin sugad kamabangis nga butang.”

en: “You are that man!” Nathan told David. “This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I anointed you king over Israel and delivered you from Saul’s power.
war: “Ikaw amo adto nga tawo,” nagsiring hi Natan kan David. “Ngan amo ini an siring han Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel: ‘Ginhimo ko ikaw nga hadi han Israel ngan gintalwas ta ikaw kan Saul.

en: I gave your master’s house to you, and gave his wives into your embrace. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah. If that was too little, I would have given even more.
war: Iginhatag ko ha imo an iya ginhadian ngan an iya mga asawa; ginhimo ko ikaw nga hadi han Israel ug Juda. Kon diri pa ngani ini igo, ihinatag ko pa han imo in doble pa.

en: Why have you despised the LORD ’s word by doing what is evil in his eyes? You have struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and taken his wife as your own. You used the Ammonites to kill him.
war: Sanglit kay ano nga imo ginsupak an akon mga sugo? Kay ano nga ginbuhat mo ini nga karat-an? Imo ginpapatay didto ha pag-awayan hi Urias; ginpapatay mo hiya han mga Amonitanhon, ngan katapos gin-agaw mo an iya asawa!

en: Because of that, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite as your own, the sword will never leave your own house.
war: Sanglit mapatay hin makalilisang nga kamatayon in pira han imo mga panimalay ha kada katulinan, kay imo ako ginsupak ngan gin-agaw mo an asawa ni Urias.

en: “This is what the LORD says: I am making trouble come against you from inside your own family. Before your very eyes I will take your wives away and give them to your friend, and he will have sex with your wives in broad daylight.
war: Iginsusumpa ko ha imo nga susugoon ko in usa han imo kalugaringon nga panimalay hin pagsamok ha imo. Makakasabot ka hini kon kuhaon ko ha imo an imo mga asawa ngan ihatag ko hira ngadto hin iba nga tawo; ngan makikighilawas hiya ha ira dida ha kapaw-an han adlaw.

en: You did what you did secretly, but I will do what I am doing before all Israel in the light of day.”
war: Imo ini gintago nga sala, kundi ipabubuhat ko ini ha kapaw-an han adlaw, ha atubangan han bug-os nga Israel.’”

en: “I’ve sinned against the LORD !” David said to Nathan.
war: Nagsiring hi David, “Nakasala ako kontra han Ginoo .”

en: “The LORD has removed your sin,” Nathan replied to David. “You won’t die.
war: Binmaton hi Natan, “Pinapasaylo ka han Ginoo ; diri ka mapatay.

en: However, because you have utterly disrespected the LORD by doing this, the son born to you will definitely die.”
war: Kundi tungod kay nagpasipara ka han Ginoo han pagbuhat mo hini, mapatay an imo anak.”

en: Then Nathan went home.
war: Katapos inmoli hi Natan.

en: The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne for David, and he became very sick.
war: Ginbuot han Ginoo nga masakit hin grabe an bata nga igin-anak kan David han asawa ni Urias.

en: David begged God for the boy. He fasted and spent the night sleeping on the ground.
war: Nag-ampo hi David hin pakimalooy han Dyos nga mag-upay an bata. Nagpuasa hiya ngan kada gab-i nasulod hiya ngadto han iya kwarto ngan nahigda hiya ha salog ha bug-os nga gab-i.

en: The senior servants of his house approached him to lift him up off the ground, but he refused, and he wouldn’t eat with them either.
war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga opisyal han iya palasyo ngan ginpabuhat hiya nira, kundi dinmiri hiya ngan waray gud kumaon upod ha ira.

en: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child had died. “David wouldn’t listen to us when we talked to him while the child was still alive,” they said. “How can we tell him the child has died? He’ll do something terrible!”
war: Paglabay hin usa ka semana namatay an bata, ngan nahadlok hin pagsumat kan David an iya mga opisyal. Nagsiring hira, “Han buhi pa an bata, waray ngani bumaton ha aton hi David han paghimangraw ta ha iya. Uunanhon ta pakasumat ha iya nga patay na an iya anak? Bangin daw mag-unay hiya!”

en: But when David saw his servants whispering, he realized the child had died.
war: Han paghikit-i ni David nga naghuhuringhuring hira, nakasabot hiya nga patay na an bata. Sanglit iya ginpakianhan hira, “Patay na ba an bata?”

en: “Is the child dead?” David asked his servants.
war: “Oo, patay na,” binmaton hira.

en: “Yes,” they said, “he is dead.”
war: Binmuhat hi David, pinmarigo, nagsudlay, ngan nagliwan. Niyan kinmadto hiya han balay han Ginoo ngan nagsingba. Han pagbalik niya ngadto han palasyo, inmaro hiya hin pagkaon, ngan kinmaon hiya dayon han pagduroti ha iya.

en: Then David rose from the ground, bathed, anointed himself, and changed his clothes. He entered the LORD ’s house and bowed down. Then he entered his own house. He requested food, which was brought to him, and he ate.
war: “Diri kami nasabot hini,” nagsiring an iya mga opisyal. “Han buhi pa an bata, nagtangis ka tungod ha iya ngan waray ka gud kumaon; kundi han kamatay na lugod niya, binmuhat ka ngan kinmaon!”

en: “Why are you acting this way?” his servants asked. “When the child was alive, you fasted and cried and kept watch, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat food!”
war: “Oo,” binmaton hi David, “nagpuasa ngan nagtangis ako han buhi pa hiya. Naghunahuna ako nga bangin malooy ha akon an Ginoo ngan diri itugot nga mamatay an bata.

en: David replied, “While the child was alive I fasted and wept because I thought, Who knows? The LORD may have mercy on me and let the child live.
war: Kundi yana nga patay na hiya, kay ano nga magpupuasa pa ako? May gahom ba ako pagbuhi han bata? May adlaw nga mapakadto ako ha iya, kundi diri na gud hiya makakabalik nganhi ha akon.”

en: But he is dead now. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? No. I am going where he is, but he won’t come back to me.”
war: Niyan ginliaw ni David hi Batseba nga iya asawa. Nakighilawas hiya ha iya ngan nag-anak hin lalake hi Batseba ngan ginngaranan ni David kan Solomon. Ginhigugma han Ginoo an bata,

en: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba. He went to her and had sex with her. She gave birth to a son and named him Solomon. The LORD loved him
war: ngan ginsugo hi Natan nga manaragna nga pagngaranan nga Jedidia an bata, kay ginhigugma hiya han Ginoo .

en: and sent word by the prophet Nathan to name him Jedidiah because of the LORD ’s grace.
war: Nagpadayon hi Joab pakig-away kontra han Raba nga kapital nga syudad han Amon, ngan gutiay na gud la marikopo ini.

en: Meanwhile, Joab fought the Ammonites at Rabbah and captured the royal city.
war: Nagsugo hiya hin mga tawo hin pagsumat kan David: “Ginsulong ko an Raba ngan nakuha ko an kinukuhaan han syudad hin tubig.

en: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, “I have fought against Rabbah and captured the city’s water supply.
war: Yana tiroka an iba han imo kasondalohan, sulonga an syudad, ngan ikaw ngahaw in paglugaring hin pagsulong, kay diri ko karuyag nga angkonon an dungog hin pakarikopo han syudad.”

en: Some time later, David’s son Amnon fell in love with Tamar the beautiful sister of Absalom, who was also David’s son.
war: May mahusay nga bugto nga babaye hi Absalon nga anak ni David. Hi Tamar an ngaran hini nga babaye. Nahigugma ha iya hi Amnon nga lain nga anak ni David.

en: Amnon was so upset over his half sister that he made himself sick. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible in Amnon’s view to do anything to her.
war: Duro gud an iya paghigugma ha iya sanglit nasakit na la hiya, kay makuri gud makaasawa hiya kan Tamar; tungod kay uray man hiya, gindid-an hiya hin pakigkita hin kalalaken-an.

en: But Amnon had a very clever friend named Jonadab, who was David's brother Shimeah’s son.
war: Kundi may-ada hi Amnon sangkay nga listo. Hi Jonadab an iya ngaran ngan anak hiya ni Sama nga bugto ni David.

en: “Prince,” Jonadab said to him, “why are you so down, morning after morning? Tell me about it.”
war: Nagsiring kan Amnon hi Jonadab, “Anak ka man ada han hadi, kay ano nga kanunay ka man la mabidoon?”

en: So Amnon told him, “I’m in love with Tamar, the sister of my brother Absalom.”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Nahigugma ako kan Tamar, an babaye nga bugto ni Absalon nga akon bugto ha amay.”

en: “Lie down on your bed and pretend to be sick,” Jonadab said to him. “When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me some food to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I can watch and eat from her own hand.’”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Jonadab, “Pagpakasakitsakit ngan higda. Kon bumisita an imo amay, sidnga hiya, ‘Alayon pagpakanhi kan Tamar ngan hiya an magpakaon ha akon. Karuyag ko nga hiya an mag-andam han akon pagkaon dinhe ha akon atubangan, ngan hiya ngahaw an magpakaon ha akon.’”

en: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him, and Amnon told the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of heart-shaped cakes in front of me so I can eat from her hand.”
war: Sanglit nagpasakitsakit hi Amnon ngan hinmigda.

en: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: “Please go to your brother Amnon’s house and prepare some food for him.”
war: Kinmadto pakigkita kan Amnon hi Hadi David, ngan nagsiring ha iya hi Amnon, “Alayon hin pagpakanhi kan Tamar basi magluto hin pira ka bug-os nga torta dinhe ha akon atubangan, ngan hiya ngahaw an magdurot ha akon.”

en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house where he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made heart-shaped cakes in front of him, and then cooked them.
war: Sanglit ginpatugonan ni David hi Tamar nga nakadto ha palasyo nga sidngon: “Pakadto han balay ni Amnon ngan andami hiya hin pagkaon.”

en: She took the pan and served Amnon, but he refused to eat.
war: Kinmadto hi Tamar ngan hinkit-an niya nga nahigda hi Amnon. Kinmuha hiya hin arina, ngan iya ini ginmasa ngan naghimo hiya hin torta ha atubangan ni Amnon. Niyan ginhudno niya an torta,

en: “Everyone leave me,” Amnon said. So everyone left him.
war: ngan ginhaon ini niya ngan igindurot ha iya, kundi waray man hiya kumaon. Nagsiring hiya, “Pagawsa an ngatanan”—ngan nagkagawas hira ngatanan.

en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the bedroom so I can eat from your hand.” So Tamar took the heart-shaped cakes she had made and brought them to her brother Amnon in the bedroom.
war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya hi Amnon, “Dad-a ngadi ha akon higdaan an mga torta ngan ikaw ngahaw an magdurot ha akon.” Kinuha niya an mga torta ngan dinmaop ha iya.

en: When she served him the food, he grabbed her and said, “Come have sex with me, my sister.”
war: Han igindudurot na niya an torta kinaptan hiya ni Amnon ngan sidngon, “Dirig ha akon!”

en: But she said to him, “No, my brother! Don’t rape me. Such a thing shouldn’t be done in Israel. Don’t do this horrible thing.
war: “Ayaw,” nagsiring hiya. “Ayaw gad ako pagpirita hin pagbuhat hin sugad kamakaarawod nga butang! Maraot gud ito!

en: Think about me—where could I hide my shame? And you—you would become like some fool in Israel! Please, just talk to the king! He won’t keep me from marrying you.”
war: Uunanhon ko pa man pakaatubang han mga tawo? Ngan ikaw, pagpapakaalohan ka han mga tawo han Israel. Alayon hin paghimangraw han hadi, ngan maaram ako nga ihahatag ako niya ha imo.”

en: But Amnon refused to listen to her. He was stronger than she was, and so he raped her.
war: Kundi waray la hiya mamati kan Tamar; ngan tungod nga makurukusog man hi Amnon ha iya, linupigan ngan ginlugos hiya.

en: But then Amnon felt intense hatred for her. In fact, his hatred for her was greater than the love he had felt for her. So Amnon told her, “Get out of here!”
war: Niyan napungot ha iya hi Amnon; an iya kapungot yana labaw pa han iya paghigugma kan Tamar hadto. Nagsiring hiya kan Tamar, “Iwas!”

en: “No, my brother!” she said. “Sending me away would be worse than the wrong you’ve already done.”
war: “Diri ako,” binmaton hiya. “Larolabaw pa nga sala an pagpaiwas ha akon kay han imo pa gud la ginbuhat yana ha akon!”

en: But Amnon wouldn’t listen to her.
war: Kundi waray la pamati ha iya hi Amnon;

en: He summoned his young servant and said, “Get this woman out of my presence and lock the door after her.” (
war: gintawag niya an iya kalugaringon nga surugoon ngan ginsiring, “Kuhaa ini nga babaye ha akon atubangan. Pagawsa hiya ngan trangkahi an porta!”

en: She was wearing a long-sleeved robe because that was what the virgin princesses wore as garments.) So Amnon’s servant put her out and locked the door after her.
war: Ginpagawas hiya han surugoon ngan gintrangkahan an porta.

en: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the long-sleeved robe she was wearing. She put her hand on her head and walked away, crying as she went.
war: Hilaba an bado ni Tamar ngan hilaba an mga pako han bado kay amo nga bado an ginagamit hin princesa nga diri inasaw-an hadto nga mga adlaw.

en: Her brother Absalom said to her, “Has your brother Amnon been with you? Keep quiet about it for now, sister; he’s your brother. Don’t let it bother you.” So Tamar, a broken woman, lived in her brother Absalom’s house.
war: Ginsabragan niya hin agbon an iya ulo, ginggisi an iya bado nga hilaba, ngan linmakat hiya nga nagtitinangis nga tinatakpo han iya kamot an iya bayhon.

en: When King David heard about all this he got very angry, but he refused to punish his son Amnon because he loved him as his oldest child.
war: Han paghikit-i ha iya ni Absalon nga iya bugto, ginpakianhan hiya, “Ginlabtan ka ba ni Amnon? Alayon, bugto, ayaw nala pagkinasina hin duro. Bugto mo hiya ha amay, sanglit ayaw ini igsumat bisan kan kanay.” Ngan nag-ukoy hi Tamar nga mabidoon ngan nag-uusaan didto han balay ni Absalon.

en: Absalom never spoke to Amnon, good word or bad, because he hated him for raping his sister Tamar.
war: Han paghibaroi ni David han nahinabo, napungot hiya hin duro.

en: Two years later, Absalom was shearing sheep at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, and he invited all the king’s sons.
war: Ngan napungot hin duro hi Absalon kan Amnon tungod han paglugosa niya kan Tamar nga iya bugto, sanglit waray na gud hiya bisan pakighimangraw ha iya.

en: Absalom approached the king and said, “Your servant is shearing sheep. Would the king and his advisors please join me?”
war: Paglabay hin duha ka tuig, ginpaarotan ni Absalon an iya mga karnero didto ha Baalhazor nga hirani han bungto han Efraim, ngan gindapit niya an ngatanan nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an han hadi.

en: But the king said to Absalom, “No, my son. We shouldn’t all go, or we would be a burden on you.” Although Absalom urged him, the king wasn’t willing to go, although he gave Absalom a blessing.
war: Kinmadto hiya kan Hadi David ngan nagsiring, “Harangdon nga hadi, ginpapaarotan ko an akon mga karnero. Pakadto gad ikaw ngan an imo mga opisyal hin pagduyog han mga kalipay.”

en: Then Absalom said, “If you won’t come, then let my brother Amnon go with us.”
war: “Diri, anak ko,” nagbaton an hadi. “Dako nga imo tirimangnoon kon kumadto kami ngatanan.” Ginpirit hiya ni Absalon, kundi waray gud tumangdo an hadi, ngan ginpauli na la niya hi Absalon.

en: “Why should he go with you?” they asked him.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Absalon, “Kon diri man, tugoti gad pagkadto bisan na la hi Amnon nga akon bugto.”

en: But Absalom urged him until he sent Amnon and all the other princes. Then Absalom made a banquet fit for a king.
war: “Kay ano nga makadto hiya?” pinmakiana an hadi.

en: Absalom commanded his servants, “Be on the lookout! When Amnon is happy with wine and I tell you to strike Amnon down, then kill him! Don’t be afraid, because I myself am giving you the order. Be brave and strong men.”
war: Kundi nagpinirit gud hi Absalon, hasta nga ha kataposan, tinugotan ni David pag-upod kan Absalon hi Amnon ngan an iba pa nga mga anak niya nga kalalaken-an.

en: So Absalom’s servants did to Amnon just what he had commanded. Then all the princes got up, jumped onto their mules, and fled.
war: Nag-andam hi Absalon hin bangkite nga angay hin hadi,

en: While they were on the way, the report came to David: “Absalom has killed all of the princes! Not one remains.”
war: ngan gintugon an iya mga surugoon: “Kitaa niyo kon hubog na hi Amnon, ngan kon magsugo na ako, pataya hiya. Ayaw kahadlok. Aangkonon ko an pagpatay. Pagmaisog ngan ayaw kamo pag-alang!”

en: The king got up, tore his garments, and lay on the ground. All his servants stood near him, their garments torn as well.
war: Sanglit gintuman han mga surugoon an tugon ni Absalon ngan ira ginpatay hi Amnon. Sinmakay dayon han ira mga mula nga kabayo an iba nga mga anak ni David ngan nangalagiw hira.

en: But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah, said, “My master shouldn’t think that all the young princes have been killed—only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom’s plan ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.
war: Han nagtitipauli na hira, nasumatan hi David: “Ginpatay ni Absalon an ngatanan nga imo mga anak nga kalalaken-an—waray gud nahisalin ha ira!”

en: So don’t let this bother you, my master; don’t think that all the princes are dead, because only Amnon is dead,
war: Tinmindog an hadi, ginggisi tungod hin kabido an iya panapton, ngan natumba ha tuna. Ginggisi liwat an ira mga panapton han kaupod niya nga iya mga surugoon.

en: and Absalom has fled.” Just then the young man on watch looked up and saw many people coming on the road behind him alongside the mountain.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jonadab nga anak ni Sama nga bugto ni David, “Harangdon nga Hadi, waray nira pataya an ngatanan mo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an; hi Amnon la an ginpatay. Daan na gud nagdidinumot hi Absalon kan Amnon tungod han paglugosa ni Amnon kan Tamar nga iya bugto.

en: Jonadab told the king, “Look, the princes are coming, just as I, your servant, said they would.”
war: Sanglit ayaw pagtuod han sumat nga patay na an ngatanan mo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an; hi Amnon la an ginpatay.”

en: Now Joab, Zeruiah’s son, could see that the king’s mind was on Absalom.
war: Hinbaroan ni Joab nga anak ni Seruia nga nahihidlaw hin duro hi Hadi David kan Absalon,

en: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there. He said to her, “Pretend to be in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes. Don’t anoint yourself with oil. Act like a woman who has spent a long time mourning over someone who has died.
war: sanglit iginpakuha niya in listo nga babaye nga nag-ukoy didto ha Tekoa. Han pag-abot la niya, ginsiring hiya ni Joab, “Pagpasangil nga masulob-on ka; pagbado hin kanan pagbasol, ngan ayaw pagsudlay. Pagpatoo-too nga maiha ka na nga namamatyan.

en: Go to the king and speak to him as follows.” Then Joab told her what to say.
war: Niyan kadtoa an hadi ngan sidnga hiya han akon igsisiring ha imo.” Katapos ginsumatan hiya ni Joab han iya igyayakan han hadi.

en: When the woman from Tekoa came to the king, she fell facedown, bowing low out of respect. “King, help me!” she said.
war: Nasingadto han hadi an babaye, hinmapa hiya ha tuna ha paghatag hin katalahuran, ngan nagsiring, “Buligi gad ako, Harangdon nga Hadi!”

en: “What is wrong?” the king asked her.
war: “Ano an imo karuyag?” ginpakianhan hiya.

en: “It’s terrible!” she said. “I am a widow; my husband is dead.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Pobre ako nga balo. Patay na an akon bana.

en: Your servant had two sons, but the two of them fought in the field. No one could separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
war: May-ada ako duha nga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan usa ka adlaw nag-away hira didto ha kaumhan diin waray nakaghawid ha ira, ngan pinatay an usa ha ira.

en: Now the entire clan has turned against your servant. They say, ‘Hand over the one who killed his brother so we can execute him for murdering his brother, even though we would destroy the heir as well.’ So they would snuff out the one ember I have left, leaving my husband without name or descendant on the earth.”
war: Ngan yana kontra ako han akon kauropdan, ngan karuyag nira nga itubyan ko ngadto ha ira an akon anak, basi patayon nira tungod han pagpataya niya han iya bugto. Kon buhaton nira ini, mawawaray na ako anak! Waray na an akon kataposan nga paglaom, ngan waray na anak nga lalake an akon bana nga magpapadayon han iya ngaran.”

en: The king said to the woman, “Return home, and I will issue an order in your behalf.”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Uli nala, ngan akon ini paninimangnoon.”

en: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My master and king, let the guilt be on me and on my father’s household. The king and his throne are innocent.”
