war: Nagsiring hiya, “Harangdon nga Hadi, bisan ano an imo buhaton, aangkonon ko ngan han akon panimalay an kabasolan; diri hidadarahigan han sala ikaw ngan an hadianon nga panimalay.”

en: “If anyone speaks against you, bring him to me, and he will never trouble you again,” the king replied.
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Kon may magtarhog ha imo, dad-a hiya nganhi ha akon ngan diri ka na gud pagsasamokon niya.”

en: She said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God so that the one seeking revenge doesn’t add to the destruction and doesn’t kill my son.”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Harangdon nga Hadi, alayon pag-ampo han Ginoo nga imo Dyos, basi diri makasala hin darudako pa an akon uropod nga karuyag bumulos tungod han kamatay han akon usa nga anak pinaagi hin pagpatay han usa ko pa nga anak.”

en: “As surely as the LORD lives,” David said, “not one of your son’s hairs will fall to the ground.”
war: Binmaton hi David, “Nagsasaad ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga diri gud paglalabtan an imo anak.”

en: Then the woman said, “May your female servant say something to my master the king?”
war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Alayon, Harangdon nga Hadi, tugoti gad ako pagyakan hin makausa nala.”

en: “Speak!” he said.
war: “Sigi,” binmaton hiya.

en: The woman said, “Why have you planned the very same thing against God’s people? In giving this order, the king has become guilty because the king hasn’t restored his own banished son.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Kay ano hin pagbuhat mo hin sugad nga kasaypanan ngadto han mga tawo han Dyos? Waray mo tugoti hin pag-uli an kalugaringon mo nga anak nga nahibulag, sanglit an imo iginyakan yana pa gudla amo an maghuhukom han imo kalugaringon.

en: We all have to die—we’re like water spilled out on the ground that can’t be gathered up again. But God doesn’t take life away; instead, he makes plans so those banished from him don’t stay that way.
war: Mapatay kita ngatanan; sugad la kita hin tubig nga nahuwad ha tuna, ngan diri na mahibabalik. Bisan an Dyos diri nagbubuhi han mga patay na, kundi makakapauli an hadi hin tawo nga nahibulag ha iya.

en: “I have come to my master the king to talk about this because people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, I must speak with the king. Maybe the king will act on the request of his servant,
war: Yana, Harangdon nga Hadi, kinmanhi ako paghimangraw ha imo kay gintatarhog ako han mga tawo, sanglit nakahunahuna ako hin pakighimangraw ha imo ngan naglalaom ako nga imo bubuhaton an akon hinahangyo ha imo.

en: because the king will agree to deliver his servant from the power of anyone who would destroy both me and my son from the inheritance God gave.
war: Naghunahuna ako nga mamamati ka ha akon ngan tatalwason mo ako tikang hadton nag-iiparatay ha akon ngan han akon anak, ngan tungod hito maanaw na kami tikang han tuna nga iginhatag han Dyos ngadto han iya mga tawo.

en: Your servant thought, The word of my master the king will definitely comfort me, because my master the king is like one of God’s messengers, understanding good and evil. May the LORD your God be with you!”
war: Naghunahuna ako, nga makakahatag hin kalinaw ha akon an imo saad, kay sugad hin anghel han Dyos an hadi, ngan nakakasabot hiya han maupay ngan han maraot. Updan ka unta han Ginoo nga imo Dyos!”

en: The king answered the woman, “I must ask you something—don’t hide anything from me!”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Mapakiana ako ha imo, ngan kinahanglan sumatan mo ako han bug-os nga kamatuoran.”

en: The woman said, “Please, my master and king, speak.”
war: “Pakianhi ako, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hiya.

en: So the king said, “Has Joab put you up to this?”
war: Nagpakiana an hadi, “Hi Joab ba an nagtutdo ha imo hini?”

en: The woman answered, “As surely as you live, my master and king, no one can deviate a bit from whatever my master and king says. Yes, it was your servant Joab who directed me, and it was Joab who told your female servant to say all these things.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Harangdon nga Hadi, nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han ngatanan nga baraan nga diri gud ako makakalikay han imo pakiana. Tinuod gud ini nga hi Joab nga imo opisyal amo an nagtutdo ha akon kon ano an akon bubuhaton ngan kon ano an akon igsisiring.

en: Your servant Joab did this to change the way things look. But my master’s wisdom is like the wisdom of one of God’s own messengers—he knows everything that takes place in the land.”
war: Kundi ginbuhat niya ini basi matuhay ini nga butang. Sugad han anghel han Dyos kamaaram gud an Imo Kaharangdon, ngan sayod ka han ngatanan nga nahinanabo.”

en: So the king said to Joab, “All right then. I will do it. Go and bring back my boy Absalom.”
war: Waray pag-iha nagsiring an hadi kan Joab, “Naglarang na ako hin pagbuhat han imo karuyag. Kadtoa ngan kuhaa an batan-on nga hi Absalon ngan ibalik hiya nganhi.”

en: Joab fell facedown, bowing low out of respect, and he blessed the king.
war: Hinmapa ha tuna hi Joab ha atubangan ni David ha paghatag hin katalahuran ngan nagsiring, “Bendisyonan ka unta han Dyos, Harangdon nga Hadi! Maaram na ako yana nga nalilipay ka ha akon, kay pinamatian mo an akon hangyo.”

en: “Today your servant knows that you think well of me, my master and king,” Joab said, “because the king has followed up on his servant’s recommendation.”
war: Niyan binmuhat hiya ngan kinmadto ha Gesur, ngan iginbalik hi Absalon ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: So Joab got up, went to Geshur, and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.
war: Kundi nagsugo an hadi nga diri mag-ukoy didto han palasyo hi Absalon. “Diri ko karuyag kumita ha iya,” nagsiring an hadi. Sanglit nag-ukoy hi Absalon didto han iya kalugaringon nga balay ngan waray hiya pumakita ha atubangan han hadi.

en: The king said, “He must go straight to his own house. He must not see my face.” So Absalom went straight to his own house and did not see the king.
war: Waray na malabaw hin kabantogan ha bug-os nga Israel tungod han iya kagwapo kay kan Absalon; waray hiya karat-an tikang han iya alimpoporo ngadto han iya rapadapa.

en: No man throughout Israel was as praised for his good looks as Absalom. From the soles of his feet to the crown of his head there was nothing wrong with him.
war: Marabong an iya buhok ngan tinuig la an iya pagpaarot, kon duro na hin kahilaba ngan kabug-at an buhok. Matimbang ini hin sobra duha ka kilo, sumala han timbangan han hadi.

en: When he shaved his head—he had to shave his head at the end of each year because his hair was so heavy that he had to shave it—the weight of the hair from his head was two hundred shekels by the royal weight.
war: May tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an hi Absalon, ngan usa nga babaye nga ginngaranan kan Tamar, mahusay hin duro nga babaye.

en: Absalom had three sons and one daughter. The daughter’s name was Tamar. She was a beautiful woman.
war: Nag-ukoy hi Absalon hin duha ka tuig didto ha Jerusalem ngan waray hiya igkakita han hadi.

en: Some time later, Absalom got a chariot and horses for his own use, along with fifty men to run ahead of him.
war: Katapos hini, nag-andam hi Absalon para ha iya ngahaw hin usa nga karuwahe ngan hin mga kabayo ngan hin 50 nga mga sondalo nga mag-uupodupod ha iya.

en: Absalom would get up early and stand by the side of the road that went through the city gate. Whenever anyone had a lawsuit to bring before the king for judgment, Absalom would call to him, “What city are you from?” When the person said, “Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel,”
war: Nabatasan ni Absalon hin pagmata hin sugo ngan magtinukdaw ha ligid han dalan dida ha may ganghaan han syudad. Kon may naabot nga tawo nga karuyag makigkita han hadi kay may-ada niya sumbong nga turuhayan, tinatawag hiya ni Absalon ngan ginpapakianhan kon taga diin hiya. Katapos pagsumat ha iya han tawo kon ano nga tribo an iya nasasakopan,

en: then Absalom would say to him, “No doubt your claims are correct and valid, but the king won’t listen to you.
war: nagsiring hi Absalon, “Tinuod, may katadungan ka, kundi waray natindog para han hadi nga mamamati han imo sumbong.”

en: If only I were made a judge in the land,” Absalom would continue, “then anyone with a lawsuit could come to me, and I would give them justice.”
war: Ngan sinusumpayan pa niya, “Kon maghurukom pa unta ako! Kon may madangop ha akon nga may kalipongan o sumbong, pamamatian ko hiya ngan ihahatag ko ha iya an katadungan.”

en: Whenever anyone came near to Absalom, bowing low out of respect, he would reach his hand out, grab them, and kiss them.
war: Kon may nadaop kan Absalon nga tawo ngan nayukbo ha iya atubangan, idinuduhol dayon niya an iya kamot, kinakaptan, ngan hinahadkan niya an tawo.

en: This is how Absalom treated every Israelite who came to the king seeking justice. This is how Absalom stole the hearts of the Israelites.
war: Ginbuhat ini ni Absalon ha ngatanan nga Israelita nga nadangop han hadi hin pagpatuhay, sanglit nalukmay ni Absalon in damo nga mga Israelita.

en: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go to Hebron so I can fulfill a promise I made to the LORD .
war: Katapos hin upat ka tuig, nagsiring hi Absalon kan Hadi David, “Tugoti ako hin pagkadto ha Hebron basi makatuman ako han akon iginsaad han Ginoo .

en: Your servant made this promise when I lived in Geshur, in Aram. I promised that if the LORD would bring me back to Jerusalem, then I would worship the LORD in Hebron.”
war: Han nakadto pa ako ha Gesur didto ha Aram, nagsaad ako han Ginoo nga kon ibalik ako niya ngadto ha Jerusalem, masingba ako ha iya didto ha Hebron.”

en: “Go in peace,” the king said. So Absalom left and went to Hebron.
war: “Maupay na la nga imo paglakat,” nagsiring an hadi. Sanglit kinmadto ha Hebron hi Absalon.

en: But Absalom sent secret agents throughout the tribes of Israel with this message: “When you hear the sound of the trumpet, then say, ‘Absalom has become king in Hebron!’”
war: Kundi nagpadara hiya hin mga tawo ngadto han ngatanan nga mga tribo han Israel, hin pagsumat han mga tawo, “Kon hibatian niyo an tunog hin mga trompeta, goliat kamo, ‘Hadi na didto ha Hebron hi Absalon!’”

en: Two hundred invited guests went with Absalom from Jerusalem. They were innocent and knew nothing of this matter when they went.
war: May-ada duha ka gatos nga mga tawo nga inmupod kan Absalon, tikang ha Jerusalem nga mga dinapit niya ngan waray hira kalibutan han nahunahunaan ni Absalon.

en: While Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he summoned David’s advisor Ahithophel, who was from Giloh, to come from his hometown. So the conspiracy grew stronger, and Absalom’s following grew.
war: Ngan samtang naghalad hin mga hayop nga tuluboron, may ginpakadto niya ha bungto han Gilo pagkuha kan Ahitofel nga usa han mga parasagdon ni Hadi David. Nagtikakusog an hilit nga pagsupil ni Absalon han hadi, ngan nagtikadamo an iya mga sumurunod.

en: A messenger came to David, reporting, “The hearts of the Israelites have gone over to Absalom.”
war: Nagsumat kan David an usa nga ginsugo, “Damo na nga mga Israelita an inmapi kan Absalon.”

en: Then David told all the servants who were with him in Jerusalem, “Come on! We have to run for it, or we won’t be able to escape Absalom. Hurry, or he will catch up with us in no time, destroy us, and attack the city with the sword.”
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi David han ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal nga kaupod niya didto ha Jerusalem, “Kinahanglan umiwas kita dayon dinhe kon karuyag ta makalikay kan Absalon! Dagmit, kay bangin umabot na hiya ngan bihagon kita, ngan pamatayon an ngatanan dinhe han syudad!”

en: The king’s servants said to him, “Your servants are ready to do whatever our master the king decides.”
war: “Oo, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hira. “Andam kami pagbuhat han bisan ano nga imo igsiring ha amon.”

en: So the king left, with his entire household following him, but he left ten secondary wives behind to take care of the palace.
war: Sanglit linmakat an hadi nga upod an ngatanan niya nga panimalay ngan mga opisyal, gawas la hin napulo nga mga aruasawa nga iya ginbilin hin panimangno han palasyo.

en: So the king left, with all his people following him, and they stopped at the last house.
war: Han nabaya na han syudad an hadi ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga tawo, hinmapit hira dida han kataposan nga balay.

en: All the king’s servants marched past him, as did all the Cherethites, all the Pelethites, and the six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.
war: Tinmindog tupad ha iya an ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal samtang nalabay ha iya atubangan an hadianon nga mga gwardya. Linmabay liwat an 600 nga mga sondalo nga sinmunod ha iya tikang ha Gat,

en: The king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why are you coming with us too? Go back! Stay with King Absalom. You are a foreigner and an exile from your own country.
war: ngan nagsiring an hadi kan Itai nga ira pangulo, “Kay ano nga naupod ka ha amon? Balik ngan pabilin upod han bag-o nga hadi. Lumalangyaw ka nga kalagiw ngan hirayo ka han imo kalugaringon nga nasod.

en: You just got here yesterday. So today should I make you wander around with us while I go wherever I have to go? No. Go back, and take your relatives with you. May the LORD show you loyal love and faithfulness.”
war: Diri ka pa la maiha dinhe, sanglit kay ano nga mag-iinupod-upod ka ha akon? Diri ngani ako maaram kon mapakain ako. Balik ngan dad-a an imo mga kausa hin nasod—ngan hinaut unta nga malooy ha imo an Ginoo .”

en: But Ittai answered the king, “As surely as the LORD lives and as surely as my master the king lives, wherever my master the king may be, facing death or facing life, your servant will be there too.”
war: Kundi binmaton hi Itai, “Harangdon nga Hadi, nagsusumpa ako ha imo ha ngaran han Ginoo nga diri ako mabulag ha imo bisan ngain ka kadto, bisan pa kon kamatayon an aton dangatan.”

en: “Okay then,” David replied to Ittai. “Keep marching!”
war: “Kon sugad, maupay,” binmaton hi David. “Upod ha akon.” Sanglit inmupod hi Itai, dara an iya mga tawo ngan an ira mga sakop.

en: So Ittai the Gittite and all of his men and all the little children with him marched past.
war: Nagtangis hin dako nga tingog an mga tawo han mga dapit nga inaagian nira David ngan han iya mga kaupod. Tinmabok han Sapa han Kedron an hadi ngan tinmabok liwat an iya mga tawo nga nagpadayon ngadto ha kamingawan.

en: The whole countryside cried loudly as all the troops marched past. The king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops passed by on the Olive road into the wilderness.
war: Nakadto hi Sadoc nga padi ngan upod niya an mga Levita nga nagpapasag han baraan nga Kahon han Ginsaaran. Ira iginbutang ini ngan waray anay nira pag-alsaha tubtob nga maubos pagbaya han syudad an ngatanan nga mga tawo. Nakadto liwat hi Abiatar nga padi.

en: Zadok was there too, along with all the Levites carrying the chest containing God’s covenant. They set God’s chest down, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until all the troops had finished marching out of the city.
war: Niyan nagsiring an hadi kan Sadoc, “Ibalik ngadto han syudad an Kahon han Ginsaaran. Kon nalilipay ha akon an Ginoo , pababalikon ako niya ha mga san-o nga adlaw hin pagkita han Kahon ngan han dapit nga iya hinmumutangan.

en: Then the king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s chest back into the city. If the LORD thinks well of me, then he will bring me back and let me see it and its home again.
war: Kundi kon diri na hiya nalilipay ha akon—ada, buhaton na la niya ha akon an iya karuyag.”

en: But if God says, ‘I’m not pleased with you,’ then I am ready. Let him do to me whatever pleases him.”
war: Ngan nagsiring pa hiya kan Sadoc, “Tan-awa, dad-a hi Ahimaaz nga imo anak ngan hi Jonatan nga anak ni Abiatar ngan balik kamo ngadto han syudad.

en: “Do you understand?” the king said to the priest Zadok. “Go back to the city in safety—you and Abiathar with your two sons, your son Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan.
war: Aadto ako, mahulat ha mga tarabukan han salog didto ha kamingawan ngada han pakakarawat ko hin sumat tikang ha imo.”

en: I will be waiting in the desert plains until you send word telling me what to do.”
war: Sanglit iginbalik ngadto ha Jerusalem nira Sadoc ug Abiatar an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngan nagpabilin hira didto.

en: So Zadok and Abiathar took God’s chest back to Jerusalem and stayed there.
war: Nagpadayon hi David nga nagtitinangis ngadto ha igbaw han Bukid han mga Olibo; waray hiya sandalyas ngan tinahoban an iya ulo tungod hin kabidoan. Tinahoban liwat an mga ulo han ngatanan nga nasunod ha iya ngan nagtitinangis hira.

en: But David, his head covered, walked barefoot up the slope of the Mount of Olives crying. All the people who were with him covered their heads too and cried as they went up.
war: Han kasumati kan David nga tinmampo na hi Ahitofel kan Absalon, nag-ampo hiya, “O Ginoo , himoa gad nga waray kapulsanan an mga sagdon ni Ahitofel!”

en: David was told that Ahithophel was also among the conspirators with Absalom, so he prayed, “Please, LORD , make Ahithophel’s advice foolish.”
war: Han pakasampaw na ni David han pungtod diin may-ada didto dapit hin pagsingba, gintapo hiya ni Husai nga Arquitanhon, nga iya tinaporan nga sangkay, nga gisi an iya panapton ngan may lapok an iya ulo.

en: When David came to the summit where people used to worship God, Hushai from Erek met him. Hushai’s clothes were ripped, and dirt was on his head.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Diri ka makakabulig ha akon kon umupod ka ha akon,

en: David said to him, “If you come with me, you will be a burden to me.
war: kundi makakabulig ka ha akon kon bumalik ka ngadto han syudad ngan sumatan mo hi Absalon nga mag-aalagad ka na ha iya sugad han imo pag-alagad han iya amay. Ngan buhata an ngatanan nga imo mahihimo pagsupak han bisan ano nga igsagdon ni Ahitofel.

en: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, ‘King, I am your servant! Please spare my life! I was your father’s servant in the past, but now I am your servant,’ then you can help me by countering Ahithophel’s advice.
war: Aadto liwat hira Sadoc ug Abiatar nga mga padi; sumati hira han ngatanan nga imo hibabatian didto han palasyo han Gad.

en: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be with you there. So report everything you hear in the king’s palace to the priests Zadok and Abiathar.
war: Upod ha ira hira Ahimaaz ug Jonatan nga ira mga anak ngan ngadto ha ira ipadara an ngatanan nga sumat nga imo hibabatian.”

en: Their two sons, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan, are also there. Use them to report to me everything you hear.”
war: Sanglit binmalik ngadto han syudad hi Husai nga sangkay ni David, dida han tisakob na hi Absalon han syudad.

en: When David had passed a short distance beyond the summit, Ziba, Mephibosheth’s servant, met him with a pair of saddled donkeys loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred bunches of raisins, one hundred figs, and a jar of wine.
war: Han pakaunhan na ni David han sampaw han pungtod, ginsugat hiya ni Siba, surugoon ni Mefiboset, nga dara in duha nga asno, kargado hin 200 nga tinapay, 100 ka urapong nga mga ubas, 100 ka urapong nga mga prutas, ngan usa ka supot nga anit nga puno hin bino.

en: “What is all this for?” the king asked Ziba.
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi David, “Aanhon mo ito ngatanan?”

en: “The donkeys are for the royal family to ride,” Ziba explained. “The bread and summer fruit are for the young people to eat, and the wine is for those who get exhausted in the wilderness.”
war: Binmaton hi Siba, “Sarakyan han panimalay han Imo Kaharangdon an mga asno, pagkaon han imo mga tawo an mga tinapay ngan mga prutas, ngan irimnon nira an bino kon aboton hira in kakapoy didto ha kamingawan.”

en: “Where is your master’s grandson?” the king asked.
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an hadi, “Hain man hi Mefiboset nga apo ni Saul nga imo agaron?”

en: “He is still in Jerusalem,” Ziba answered the king, “because he thinks that the Israelites are now going to give his grandfather’s kingdom back to him.”
war: “Aadto hiya ha Jerusalem,” binmaton hi Siba, “kay naghuhunahuna hiya nga ibabalik na ha iya han mga Israelita an ginhadian ni Saul nga iya apoy.”

en: “Look here,” the king said to Ziba. “Everything that belonged to Mephibosheth now belongs to you.”
war: Nagsiring kan Siba an hadi, “Imo na an ngatanan nga gintatag-iya ni Mefiboset.”

en: Ziba said, “I bow out of respect! Please think well of me, my master and king.”
war: “Imo ako surugoon,” binmaton hi Siba. “Dayuday makalipay unta ako han Imo Kaharangdon.”

en: When King David came to Bahurim, a man from the same clan as Saul’s family came out from there. His name was Shimei; he was Gera’s son. He was cursing as he came out.
war: Han pag-abot ni David ngadto ha Bahurim, ginsugat hiya ni Simei nga anak ni Gera, nga usa han kauropdan ni Saul, nga waray hunong an pagbinuyayaw kan David.

en: He threw rocks at David and at all of King David’s servants, even though the entire army and all the warriors were on either side of him.
war: Ginbato ni Simei hi David ngan an iya mga opisyal, bisan kon ginlilibotan hi David han iya mga tawo ngan han iya mga gwardya.

en: This is what Shimei said as he cursed David: “Get out of here! Get out of here! You are a murderer! You are despicable!
war: Ginbinuyayaw hiya ni Simei ngan ginsiring, “Iwas! Iwas! Parapamatay! Kriminal!

en: The LORD has paid you back for all the blood of Saul’s family, in whose place you rule, and the LORD has handed the kingdom over to your son Absalom. You are in this trouble because you are a murderer!”
war: Gin-agaw mo an ginhadian ni Saul, ngan ginkakastigo ka na yana han Ginoo tungod han damo nga pinamatay mo han panimalay ni Saul. Iginhatag na han Ginoo an ginhadian ngadto kan Absalon nga imo anak, ngan napukan ka na, ikaw nga parapamatay!”

en: Zeruiah’s son Abishai said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my master the king? Let me go over and cut his head off!”
war: Nagsiring han hadi hi Abisai nga anak ni Seruia, “Harangdon nga Hadi, kay ano nga natugot ka la nga pagbinuyayawon ka hini nga ayam? Tugoti na gud ako hin pagdaop ha iya ngan pupugoton ko an iya ulo!”

en: But the king said, “My problems aren’t yours, you sons of Zeruiah. If he is cursing because the LORD told him to curse David, then who is to question, ‘Why are you doing this?’”
war: “Waray niyo labot hini,” nagsiring an hadi kan Abisai ug Joab nga iya bugto. “Kon gintunglo ako niya kay ginsugo hiya han Ginoo , hin-o man in magahom hin pagpakiana kay ano nga ginbuhat man niya ini?”

en: Then David addressed Abishai and all his servants: “Listen! My own son, one of my very own children, wants me dead. This Benjaminite can only feel the same—only more! Leave him alone. And let him curse, because the LORD told him to.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi David kan Abisai ngan ha ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal, “Karuyag han akon kalugaringon nga anak nga patayon ako niya; sanglit kay ano nga nahipapausa kamo hini nga Benjaminhon? Ginsugo hiya han Ginoo hin pagtunglo; sanglit pabay-i la hiya ngan tugoti hiya hin pagtunglo ha akon.

en: Perhaps the LORD will see my distress; perhaps the LORD will repay me with good for this cursing today.”
war: Manggad na la hikit-an han Ginoo an akon kasakitan ngan tagan ako hin mga kaupayan nga liwan han iya pagtunglo ha akon.”

en: So David and his men kept walking, while Shimei went along on the hillside next to him, cursing as he went, throwing rocks and dirt at him.
war: Sanglit nagpadayon hin pagkalakat hira David ngan an iya mga tawo. Ginsinunod hira ni Simei didto ha ligid han pungtod, nga nagbibinuyayaw, nagbibinato, ngan nagsisinabrag hin tuna ha ira.

en: The king and all the people who were with him reached the Jordan River exhausted, and he rested there.
war: Kinapoy hin duro hi David ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo han pag-abot nira han Jordan, ngan pinmahuway hira didto.

en: Now Absalom and all the Israelites entered Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
war: Sinmulod ha Jerusalem hi Absalon ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga tinmampo ha iya, ngan upod nira hi Ahitofel.

en: Then David’s friend Hushai, who was from Erek, approached Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
war: Han pagkakita la nira Absalon ug Husai, an sinarigan nga sangkay ni David, ginmoliat hi Husai, “Mabuhi an hadi! Mabuhi an hadi!”

en: But Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this how you show loyal love to your friend? Why didn’t you go with him?”
war: Pinmakiana ha iya hi Absalon, “Amo ba ini an imo pag-ugop kan David nga imo sangkay? Kay ano nga waray ka umupod ha iya?”

en: “No,” Hushai replied to Absalom, “I will belong to the one chosen by the LORD , by this people, and by all Israel, and I will stay with him.
war: Binmaton hi Husai, “Uunanhon ko man? Maupod ako han tawo nga ginpili han Ginoo , ngan han ngatanan nga mga Israelita. Magpapabilin ako ha imo.

en: What’s more, whom should I serve if not David’s son? I served your father, and so I will serve you in the same way.”
war: Labot pa, hin-o pa man an akon pag-aalagdon, kon diri an anak han akon agaron? Sugad nga nag-alagad ako han imo amay, mag-aalagad man ako ha imo.”

en: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your advice then. What should we do?”
war: Niyan inatubang ni Absalon hi Ahitofel ngan ginsiring, “Yana nga aanhi na kita, ano an imo sadang isagdon ha akon?”

en: Then Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me pick twelve thousand men, and I will go after David tonight.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Ahitofel kan Absalon, “Tugoti ako hin pagpili hin 12,000 nga mga tawo, ngan lalanaton ko hi David niyan nga gab-i.

en: I will attack him while he is tired and weak, and I will throw him into a panic. All the troops with him will run off. I promise to kill the king alone,
war: Susulongon ko hiya samtang binubutlaw ngan kinakapoy hiya. Kakalasan hiya, ngan mangangalagiw an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo. An hadi la an akon papatayon,

en: and I will bring all the people back to you like a bride comes back to her husband. It’s only one man’s life you are seeking; everyone else can be at peace.”
war: ngan dadad-on ko ha imo an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo sugad hin asawa nga na-uli ngadto han iya bana. Karuyag mo pagpatay hin usa la ka tawo; ngan paghatag hin kalinaw han iba nga mga tawo.”

en: This plan seemed excellent to Absalom and the Israelite elders.
war: Daw nakalipay ini nga sagdon kan Absalon ngan han ngatanan nga mga punoan nga Israelita.

en: But Absalom said, “Call Hushai from Erek. Let’s hear what he has to say as well.”
war: Nagsiring hi Absalon, “Tawaga liwat hi Husai, ngan pamatii ta kon ano man an iya igsisiring.”

en: When Hushai from Erek arrived, Absalom said to him, “This is what Ahithophel has advised. Should we follow it or not? What do you say?”
war: Han pag-abot ni Husai, ginsiring hiya ni Absalon, “Amo ini an iginsagdon ha amon ni Ahitofel; susundon ba namon ini? Kon diri, sumati kami kon ano an angay buhaton.”

en: Hushai said to Absalom, “This time, the advice Ahithophel has given isn’t right.
war: Binmaton hi Husai, “Diri maupay an iginsagdon ha iyo yana ni Ahitofel.

en: You know that your father and his men are warriors,” he continued, “and they are as desperate as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Your father is a seasoned fighter. He won’t spend the night with his troops.
war: Maaram ka man nga makarit nga paraaway hi David nga imo amay ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan magpintas hira sugad hin uso nga anakan nga inagawan han iya mga nati. Batid nga sondalo an imo amay ngan diri hiya natampo han iya mga tawo kon gab-i.

en: Even now he has probably hidden himself in one of the caves or some other place. When some of the troops fall in the first attack, whoever hears it will say, ‘The soldiers who follow Absalom have been defeated!’
war: Ito yana bangin natago hiya didto hin usa nga lungib o hin iba nga dapit. Ha pagsulonga ni David han imo mga tawo, masiring an bisan hin-o nga makabati hini nga napirde na an imo mga tawo.

en: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like a lion’s, will melt in fear because all Israel knows that your father is a warrior and that those who are with him are brave.
war: Niyan mahadlok an bisan hin-o nga giiisogi nga tawo, nga sugad hin mga liyon kamagpintas, kay maaram an ngatanan ha Israel nga makarit nga sondalo an imo amay, ngan mapintas nga paraaway an iya mga tawo.

en: So I would advise that all the Israelites, from Dan to Beer-sheba—a group as countless as sand on the seashore—be summoned to join you, and that you yourself go into battle.
war: An akon sagdon amo ini: tiroka an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga sugad kadamo han baras ha baybayon tikang ha Dan ngadto ha Berseba, ngan ikaw ngahaw an pagmando ha ira didto ha pag-awayan.

en: When we attack him wherever he might be, we will fall on him like dew that falls on the ground. No one will survive—not him and not one of the soldiers who are with him!
war: Hiaagian ta hi David bisan hain hiya, ngan susulongon ta hiya hin tigda, ngan waray gud mahibibilin nga buhi ha ira.

en: If he retreats into a city, all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it into a valley until not even a pebble of it will be found.”
war: Kon umisol hiya ngadto hin syudad, magdadara hin mga pisi an ngatanan naton nga mga tawo ngan pupukanon ta an syudad ngadto han kahamub-an tubtob nga waray gud mahibilin nga bato ha bawbaw han pungtod.”

en: Then Absalom and everyone in Israel agreed, “The advice of Hushai from Erek is better than Ahithophel’s advice.” This was because the LORD had decided to counter Ahithophel’s good advice so that the LORD could bring disaster on Absalom.
war: Nagsiring hi Absalon ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita, “Mauruupay an sagdon ni Husai kay han kan Ahitofel.” Nagbuot an Ginoo nga diri sundon an maupay nga sagdon ni Ahitofel, basi mapukan hi Absalon.

en: Hushai told the priests Zadok and Abiathar, “Here is what Ahithophel advised Absalom and the Israelite elders, and here is what I advised.
war: Niyan ginsumatan ni Husai hira Sadoc ug Abiatar nga mga padi han iya iginsagdon kanda Absalon ngan han mga punoan nga Israelita, ngan han iginsagdon ni Ahitofel.

en: Now send word immediately to David and tell him, ‘Don’t spend the night in the desert plains. You must cross over immediately. Otherwise, the king and all the troops who are with him will be swallowed up whole.’”
war: Iginsiring pa ni Husai, “Pagdagmit yana! Patugoni dayon hi David nga diri hiya magpabilin yana nga gab-i dida han mga tarabukan han salog didto ha kamingawan, kundi tumabok gud dayon han Jordan, basi diri madakop ngan patayon hiya ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo.”

en: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were standing by at En-rogel. A female servant would come and report to them, and they would then travel and report to King David because they couldn’t risk being seen entering the city.
war: Naghinulat didto han burabod han Enrogel, didto ha gawas la han Jerusalem, hira Jonatan nga anak ni Abiatar ngan hi Ahimaas nga anak ni Sadoc, kay diri hira buot hikit-an nga nasulod hira han syudad. Napakadto hin masukot in surugoon nga babaye pagsumat ha ira han mga nahinanabo, ngan hira liwat napakadto pagsumat kan Hadi David.

en: But a boy saw them and reported it to Absalom. So the two of them left immediately and came to a man’s house at Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.
war: Kundi usa ka adlaw hinkit-an hira hin lalakehay, nga nagsumat kan Absalon; sanglit nagdagmit hira pagtago didto han balay hin usa ka tawo ha Bahurim. May-ada hiya atabay hirani han iya balay, ngan tinmago hira didto.

en: The man’s wife took a covering and spread it over the well’s opening, then scattered grain over it so no one would notice.
war: Gintahoban han asawa han tawo an ganggang han atabay; ngan ginbularan niya hin trigo, basi waray makasabot.

en: When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house they demanded, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?”
war: Inmabot ngadto han balay an mga opisyal ni Absalon ngan nagpakiana han babaye, “Hain hira Ahimaas ug Jonatan?”

en: The woman told them, “They crossed over the stream.” They looked for them but found nothing, so they returned to Jerusalem.
war: “Tinmabok hira han salog,” binmaton hiya.

en: After they had left, Jonathan and Ahimaaz climbed out of the well. They went and reported to King David, “Get up! Cross the water immediately because Ahithophel has made plans against you!”
war: Nagpinamiling ha ira an mga tawo kundi kay waray man makaagi, binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: So David and all the troops who were with him got up and crossed the Jordan River. By daybreak there was no one left who hadn’t crossed the Jordan.
war: Han pagkalakat na nira, ginmawas ha atabay hira Ahimaas ug Jonatan ngan kinmadto hira pagsumat kan Hadi David. Ginsumatan nira hi David han iginlarang ni Ahitofel kontra ha iya ngan nagsiring hira, “Pagdagmit ngan tabok dayon han salog.”

en: Meanwhile, once Ahithophel saw that his advice hadn’t been followed, he saddled his donkey and went home to his own town. He gave instructions to his household, then hanged himself and died. He was buried in his father’s tomb.
war: Sanglit tinmabok han Jordan hira David ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan han pagkamaagahon didto na hira ngatanan ha tabok han Jordan.

en: David had reached Mahanaim by the time Absalom and all the Israelites who were with him crossed the Jordan River.
war: Han paghibaroi la ni Ahitofel nga waray pagsunda an iya sagdon, sinmakay hiya han iya asno, ngan inmoli ngadto han iya bungto. Katapos niya panhimos han iya mga butang, naghikog hiya. Iginlubong hiya didto han lubnganan han iya panimalay.

en: Absalom had put Amasa in charge of the army instead of Joab. Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra, an Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, who was Nahash’s daughter and the sister of Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
war: Nakadto na hi David han bungto han Mahanaim han pakatabok han Jordan ni Absalon ngan han iya mga tawo. (

en: Israel and Absalom camped in the territory of Gilead.
war: Iginbutang ni Absalon hi Amasa nga pangulo han kasondalohan nga liwan kan Joab. Anak hi Amasa ni Itra nga Ismaelita; hi Abigail amo an iroy niya, nga anak ni Nahas ngan bugto ni Seruia nga iroy ni Joab.)

en: When David arrived in Mahanaim, Nahash’s son Shobi, who was from Rabbah of the Ammonites; Ammiel’s son Machir, who was from Lo-debar; and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim
war: Nagkampo didto han tuna han Galaad hi Absalon ngan an iya mga tawo.

en: brought couches, basins, and pottery, along with wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils,
war: Han pag-abot ni David didto ha Mahanaim, ginsugat hiya ni Sobi, anak ni Nahas nga taga syudad han Raba didto ha Amon, ngan ni Maquir, anak ni Amiel nga taga-Lodebar, ngan ni Barzilai, taga-Rogelim didto ha Galaad.

en: Then David gathered the troops who were with him and appointed unit commanders over thousands and hundreds.
war: Gintirok ni Hadi David an ngatanan nga iya mga tawo, ginbahinbahin ini hira ngadto hin mga hugpo nga tinagyukot ngan tinaggatos, ngan ginbutangan hin mga opisyal nga magmamando ha ira.

en: David sent out the army—a third under Joab’s command, a third under the command of Abishai, Zeruiah’s son, and a third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, “I will march out with you myself.”
war: Niyan iya ginpagawas hira hin tulo ka hugpo nga pinangulohan nira Joab, Abisai nga iya bugto, ngan Itai nga taga-Gat. Ngan nagsiring han iya mga tawo an hadi, “Maupod ako ngahaw ha iyo.”

en: But the troops replied, “No! You must not march out! If we flee, they won’t care about us. Even if half of us die, they won’t care about us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. It is much better if you support us from the city.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Kinahanglan diri ka umupod ha amon. Waray la ini bali para han kaaway kon mangalagiw kami, o bisan pa mamatay in katunga ha amon; kundi bali ka hin napulo ka yukot ha amon. Mauruupay pa kon pumabilin ka la dinhe han syudad ngan magpadara ka hin bulig ha amon.”

en: The king said to them, “I will do whatever you think is best.” So the king stood beside the gate as all the troops marched out by hundreds and thousands.
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Bubuhaton ko an maupay nga iyo nahuhunahunaan.” Niyan tinmindog hiya ha ligid han ganghaan han syudad samtang nagkakagawas an iya mga tawo ha mga hugpo nga tinagyukot ngan tinaggatos.

en: The king gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: “For my sake, protect my boy Absalom.” All the troops heard what the king ordered regarding Absalom to all the commanders.
war: Nagsugo hiya kanda Joab, Abisai, ug Itai: “Tungod ha akon, ayaw niyo paglabti an batan-on nga Absalon.” Hinbatian han ngatanan nga kasondalohan an tugon ni David han iya mga opisyal.

en: So the troops marched into the field to meet the Israelites. The battle was fought in the Ephraim forest.
war: Ginmawas ngadto han kapatagan an kasondalohan ni David ngan pinakiawayan an mga Israelita didto ha Kagurangan han Efraim.

en: The army of Israel was defeated there by David’s soldiers. A great slaughter of twenty thousand men took place that day.
war: Pinirde han mga tawo ni David an mga Israelita; makalilisang adto nga pagkapirde, ngan 20,000 nga mga tawo an nagkamatay hito nga adlaw.

en: The battle spread out over the entire countryside, and the forest devoured more soldiers than the sword that day.
war: Nagsarang an araway didto han kapatagan, ngan darudamo nga mga tawo an nagkamatay didto ha kagurangan kay han nagkamatay didto ha pag-awayan.

en: Absalom came upon some of David’s men. Absalom was riding on a mule, and the mule went under the tangled branches of a large oak tree. Absalom’s head got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair while the mule under him kept on going.
war: Nahinabo nga iginkasugat hi Absalon hin mga tawo ni David. Nasakay hin mula hi Absalon, ngan han pagsuhot niya han marampag nga kahoy nga tuog, nahisang-at dida hin mga sanga an ulo ni Absalon. Binayaan hiya han mula ngan nahibilin nga nabitay ha kahoy hi Absalon.

en: One of the men saw this and reported to Joab, “I just saw Absalom hanging from an oak tree.”
war: Hinkit-an hiya hin usa han mga tawo ni David ngan nagsumat dayon kan Joab, “Hinkit-an ko nga nabitay hi Absalon didto hin kahoy nga tuog!”

en: Joab said to the man who told him, “You saw this? Why didn’t you kill him on the spot? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a belt.”
war: Binmaton hi Joab, “Kon hinkit-an mo man hiya, kay ano nga waray mo hiya pataya dida dayon? Tinatagan ta ikaw hin 30 ka bug-os nga salapi ngan hin usa nga paha.”

en: But the man said to Joab, “Even if I had a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I wouldn’t touch the king’s son! We heard what the king commanded you, Abishai, and Ittai—‘For my sake, take care of my boy Absalom.’
war: Kundi binmaton an tawo, “Bisan kon tagan mo ako hin usa ka yukot nga salapi, diri gud ako magpapasipara hin paglabot han anak han hadi. Hinbatian namon ngatanan an tugon han hadi ha imo, kan Abisai, ngan kan Itai, ‘Tungod ha akon, ayaw niyo paglabti an batan-on nga Absalon.’

en: If I had taken Absalom’s life behind the king’s back then—though nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me.”
war: Kundi kon ginsupak ko an hadi ngan ginpatay ko hi Absalon, hibabaroan ini gihapon han hadi, kay hinbabaroan niya an ngatanan—ngan diri ka ada mananalipod ha akon.”

en: Joab said, “I won’t waste time like this with you!” He took three sticks in his hand and drove them into Absalom’s chest while he was still alive in the oak.
war: “Diri na ako magkakarag ha imo hin panahon,” nagsiring hi Joab. Kinmuha hiya hin tulo nga mga bangkaw ngan iginbangkaw ini han dughan ni Absalon, samtang buhi pa hiya nga nabitay didto han kahoy nga tuog.

en: Then ten young armor-bearers of Joab surrounded Absalom, struck him, and killed him.
war: Niyan dinmaop kan Absalon in napulo han mga sondalo ni Joab, ngan ginhuman nira an pagpatay kan Absalon.

en: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped chasing the Israelites, because Joab held them back.
war: Nagpatrompeta hi Joab pagpaundang han araway, ngan binmalik an iya kasondalohan tikang han pagbukod han mga Israelita.

en: They took Absalom and threw him into a big pit in the forest. They piled over him a huge heap of stones. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.
war: Ginkuha nira an lawas ni Absalon, iginlabog ini ngadto hin hilarom nga luong didto ha kagurangan, ngan gintak-opan ini hin dako nga tambak hin mga bato. Nangalagiw an ngatanan nga mga Israelita, an tagsatagsa ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga urokyan.

en: When he was alive, Absalom had raised a large pillar for himself in the King’s Valley because he said, “I have no son to carry on the memory of my name.” He named the pillar after himself. It is called Absalom’s Monument to this day.
war: Han buhi pa hi Absalon, nagtindog hiya hin munomento para ha iya didto ha Kahamub-an han Hadi, kay waray niya anak nga magpapadayon han iya ngaran. Sanglit ginngaranan ini niya han iya ngaran, ngan ngada yana nga adlaw kinikilala ini nga Munomento ni Absalon.

en: Then Zadok’s son Ahimaaz said, “Please let me run and take the news to the king that the LORD has vindicated him against his enemies’ power.”
war: Niyan nagsiring kan Joab hi Ahimaas nga anak ni Sadoc, “Tugoti ako pagdalagan ngadto han hadi dara an maupay nga sumat nga gintalwas hiya han Ginoo tikang ha iya mga kaaway.”

en: Joab said to him, “You aren’t the one to bring the news today. You can bring news on another day, but not today, because the king’s son is dead.”
war: “Ayaw,” nagsiring hi Joab, “diri ka magdadara hin bisan ano nga maupay nga sumat yana nga adlaw. Makakahimo ka ha iba nga adlaw, kundi diri yana, kay patay na an anak han hadi.”

en: Then Joab said to a Cushite, “Go tell the king what you have seen.” The Cushite bowed low before Joab, then ran off.
war: Niyan nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya oripon nga Sudanhon, “Kadto na ngan sumati an hadi han imo hinkit-an.” Yinmukbo an oripon ngan dinmalagan.

en: But Zadok’s son Ahimaaz again said to Joab, “I don’t care what happens, just let me run after the Cushite too.”
war: Nagpadayon paghangyo hi Ahimaas, “Waray sapayan kon ano in mahinabo; tugoti gad ako pagdara liwat han sumat.”

en: “Why do you want to go, son?” Joab asked. “You’ll get no reward for going.”
war: Nagpakiana hi Joab, “Kay ano nga karuyag ka magbuhat hini, anak ko? Waray man pahalipay nga ihahatag ha imo tungod hini.”

en: “I don’t care what happens, I want to go,” Ahimaaz said.
war: Nagsiring gihapon hi Ahimaas, “Bisan ano in mahinabo, karuyag ko la kumadto.”

en: So Joab said to him, “Run off then!”
war: Nagsiring hi Joab, “Ta, hala, kadto na.” Sanglit nagdalagan hiya pagtalabok han Kahamub-an han Jordan, ngan waray pag-iha hin unhan niya an oripon.

en: Ahimaaz ran off, going by way of the plain, and passed the Cushite.
war: Nalingkod hi David dida han dapit nga nabubutnga han duha nga mga porta han syudad. Sinmaka an gwardya ngadto han bawbaw han pader ngan tinmungtong dida han atop han porta; linmantaw hiya ha unhan ngan hinkit-an niya in usa la nga tawo nga nagdidinalagan.

en: Now David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman on duty went up on the roof of the gate by the wall. He looked out and saw a man running alone.
war: Ginmoliat hiya ngadto ha ubos pagsumat han hadi, ngan nagsiring an hadi, “Kon usa la hiya, maupay nga sumat an iya dara.” Nagtikahirani na hiya han porta.

en: The watchman called out and reported this to the king. The king said, “If he’s alone, it’s good news.”
war: Niyan hinkit-an han gwardya in lain nga usa ka tawo nga nagdadalagan, ngan ginmoliat hiya ngadto han parabantay han porta, “Kitaa! Aadto in lain nga tawo nga nagdidinalagan!”

en: The man got nearer and nearer,
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Nagdadara liwat ini hin maupay nga sumat.”

en: and the watchman saw another man running and called down to the gatekeeper, “There’s another man running alone.”
war: Nagsiring an gwardya, “Nakikita ko nga sugad kan Ahimaas dumalagan an syahan nga tawo.”

en: The king said, “That one must be bringing good news too.”
war: “Maupay hiya nga tawo,” nagsiring an hadi, “ngan nagdadara hiya hin maupay nga sumat.”

en: The watchman said, “I can see that the first one runs like Zadok’s son Ahimaaz.”
war: Ginmoliat han hadi hi Ahimaas, hinmapa ha iya atubangan, ngan nagsiring, “Dayawon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos nga nagpadaog ha imo kontra han mga tawo nga sinmupil han Imo Kaharangdon!”

en: “He’s a good man,” the king said, “and is coming with good news.”
war: Nagpakiana an hadi, “Kumosta man an batan-on nga Absalon?”

en: Joab was told that the king was crying and mourning Absalom.
war: Ginsumatan hi Joab nga nagtangis ngan nagmabidoon tungod kan Absalon hi Hadi David.

en: So the victory that day was turned into mourning for all the troops because they heard that day that the king was grieving for his son.
war: Sanglit nahimo nga kabidoan han ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni David an kalipay han pagdarag-an hito nga adlaw, kay hinbatian nira nga mabidoon an hadi tungod han iya anak.

en: So that day the troops crept back into the city like soldiers creep back ashamed after they’ve fled from battle.
war: Mamingaw la hira nga binmalik ngadto han syudad, sugad hin mga sondalo nga naaawod kay kinmalagiw hira ha pag-awayan.

en: The king covered his face and cried out in a loud voice, “Oh, my son Absalom! Oh, Absalom, my son! My son!”
war: Tinahoban han hadi an iya nawong ngan nagtinangis hin dako nga tingog, “Ay anak ko! Akon anak nga Absalon! Absalon nga akon anak!”

en: Joab came to the king inside and said, “Today you have humiliated all your servants who have saved your life today, not to mention the lives of your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your secondary wives,
war: Kinmadto han balay han hadi hi Joab ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Ginpakaalohan mo yana nga adlaw an imo mga tawo—an mga tawo nga nagtalwas han imo kinabuhi ngan han kinabuhi han imo mga anak, ngan han imo mga asawa ngan mga aruasawa.

en: by loving those who hate you and hating those who love you! Today you have announced that the commanders and their soldiers are nothing to you, because I know that if Absalom were alive today and the rest of us dead, that would be perfectly fine with you!
war: Kinukontra mo adton mga nahigugma ha imo ngan asay mo inuugopan adton mga nagdudumot ha imo! Iginpadayag mo yana nga adlaw nga waray la pulos ha imo an imo mga opisyal ngan mga tawo. Hinkikit-an ko nga magmamalipayon ka pa ada kon buhi hi Absalon yana bisan kon maubos kami kamatay.

en: Now get up! Go out and encourage your followers! I swear to the LORD that if you don’t go out there, not one man will stick with you tonight—and that will be more trouble for you than all the trouble that you’ve faced from your youth until now.”
war: Kadtoa yana ngan dasiga an imo mga tawo. Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han ngaran han Ginoo nga kon dumiri ka, waray usa ha ira nga maupod ha imo buwas han aga. Amo ini an makaharadlok hin duro nga imo pag-aantoson ha bug-os mo nga kinabuhi.”

en: So the king went and sat down in the city gate. All the troops were told that the king was sitting in the gate, so they came before the king.
war: Niyan tinmindog an hadi, napakadto hirani han ganghaan han syudad ngan linmingkod didto. Hinbaroan han iya mga tawo nga nakadto hiya, ngan nag-alirong ha iya hira ngatanan.

en: Meanwhile, the Israelites had fled to their homes.
war: Hini nga panahon, nangalagiw na an ngatanan nga mga Israelita an kada tawo ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga urokyan.

en: Everyone was arguing throughout Israel’s tribes, saying, “The king delivered us from our enemies’ power, and he rescued us from the Philistines’ power, but now he has fled from the land and from controlling his own kingdom.
war: Ha bug-os nga nasod nagkasaramok hira ha ira la ngahaw. May hinsiring ha ira, “Gintalwas kita ni Hadi David ha aton mga kaaway. Ginbawi kita niya ha mga Filisteohanon, kundi ginbayaan niya an nasod basi makalikay hiya kan Absalon.

en: And Absalom, the one we anointed over us, is dead in battle. So why do you say nothing about bringing the king back?”
war: Gindihogan ta hi Absalon nga aton hadi, kundi ginpatay hiya didto ha pag-awayan. Sanglit kay ano nga waray man nagtitinguha hin pagpabalik kan Hadi David?”

en: When the things that all the Israelites were saying reached the king, David sent a message to the priests Zadok and Abiathar: “Say the following to the elders of Judah: ‘Why should you be the last to bring the king back to his palace?
war: Inmabot ngadto kan Hadi David an sumat han mga ginsiring han mga Israelita. Sanglit ginsugo niya hira Sadoc ug Abiatar nga mga padi, nga pakianhan an mga pangulo han Juda, “Kay ano nga kamo an mauorhe hin pagbulig basi mahibalik an hadi ngadto han iya palasyo?

en: You are my relatives! You are my flesh and bones! Why should you be the last to bring the king back?’
war: Kamo an akon kauropdan nga akon mga kadugo; kay ano nga kamo in mauorhe hin pagpabalik ha akon?”

en: And tell Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my flesh and bones too? May God deal harshly with me and worse still if you don’t become commander of my army from now on instead of Joab!’”
war: Gintugon liwat hira ni David nga sidngon hi Amasa, “Uropod ko ikaw. Tikang yana ibinubutang ko ikaw nga tinaporan han kasondalohan, liwan kan Joab. Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon diri ko ini buhaton!”

en: So he won over the hearts of everyone in Judah as though they were one person, and they sent word to the king: “Come back—you and all your servants.”
war: Nakakabig an mga pulong ni David han hingpit nga pag-ugop han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Juda, ngan ira ginpatugonan hi David nga bumalik na hiya upod an ngatanan niya nga mga opisyal.

en: So the king came back and arrived at the Jordan River. Judah came to Gilgal to meet the king and bring him across the Jordan.
war: Dida han pagbalik niya, ginsugat an hadi didto han Salog Jordan han mga tawo han Juda nga kinmadto ha Gilgal hin pagbunyog kan David han pagtabok niya han salog.

en: Gera’s son Shimei, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, hurried down with the people of Judah to meet King David.
war: Ha amo nga takna nagdagmit ngadto ha Jordan hin pagsugot kan Hadi David hi Simei nga Benjaminhon, nga anak ni Gera nga taga-Bahurim.

en: A thousand men from Benjamin were with him. Ziba too, the servant of Saul’s house, along with his fifteen sons and twenty servants, rushed to the Jordan ahead of the king
war: Upod niya in 1,000 nga mga tawo nga tikang han tribo ni Benjamin. Inmabot liwat hi Siba nga surugoon han panimalay ni Saul, upod an iya 15 nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan 20 nga mga surugoon, ngan linmugsong hira ngadto han Jordan una pa han hadi.

en: to do the work of ferrying over the king’s household and to do whatever pleased him.
war: Binuligan nira hin pagtabok han salog an hadianon nga hugpo ngan hin pagbuhat han bisan ano nga karuyag han hadi.

en: Gera’s son Shimei fell down before the king when he crossed the Jordan.
war: Han nag-aandam na pagtabok an hadi, hinmapa hi Simei ha atubangan niya

en: He said to the king, “May my master not hold me guilty or remember your servant’s wrongdoing that day my master the king left Jerusalem. Please forget about it, Your Majesty,
war: ngan nagsiring, “Harangdon nga Hadi, hingalimti na gad la an sayop nga akon nabuhat hadto nga adlaw han pagbaya mo han Jerusalem. Ayaw na gad pagdumot ha akon o hingalimti na adto.

en: because your servant knows that I have sinned. But look, I am the first person from the entire family of Joseph to come down today and meet my master the king.”
war: Maaram ako nga nakasala ako, sanglit gintalinguha ko nga ako an masyahan tikang han mga tribo ha amihanan hin pagsugot han Imo Kaharangdon yana nga adlaw.”

en: Zeruiah’s son Abishai responded, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for that—for cursing the LORD ’s anointed?”
war: Sinmagbang hi Abisai nga anak ni Seruia, “Kinahanglan patayon hi Simei, kay ginpakaraot niya an hadi nga ginpili han Ginoo .”

en: But David said, “My problems aren’t yours, you sons of Zeruiah. Why are you becoming my enemy today? Should anyone in Israel be put to death today? Don’t I know that today I am again king over Israel?”
war: Kundi nagsiring hi David kanda Abisai ug Joab nga iya bugto, “Hin-o in nagpakiana ha iyo? Iyo ba ako tatagan hin kasamok? Ako amo na an hadi han Israel yana, ngan waray Israelita nga papatayon yana nga adlaw.”

en: Then the king told Shimei, “You will not die.” And the king swore this to him.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Simei, “Nagsusumpa ako ha imo nga diri ka papatayon.”

en: Mephibosheth, Saul’s grandson, also came down to meet the king. He hadn’t taken care of his feet, trimmed his beard, or washed his clothes from the day the king left until the day he returned safely.
war: Niyan linmugsong hin pagsugat han hadi hi Mefiboset nga apo ni Saul. Waray hiya manhimsaw, magbarbas, o maglaba han iya panapton tikang han pagbaya han hadi han Jerusalem ngada han pagbalik niya nga madaogon.

en: When he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked him, “Mephibosheth, why didn’t you go with me?”
war: Han pag-abot ni Mefiboset tikang ha Jerusalem hin pagsugat han hadi, nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Mefiboset, kay ano nga waray ka umupod ha akon?”

en: “My master and king,” Mephibosheth answered, “my servant abandoned me! Because your servant is lame, I asked my servant, ‘Saddle a donkey for me so I can ride and go to the king.’
war: Binmaton hiya, “Maaram ka man, Harangdon nga Hadi, nga piay ako. Ginpamonturahan ko han akon surugoon an akon asno basi makasakay ako hin pagbunyog ha imo, kundi ginlingo ako niya.

en: So Ziba has slandered your servant to my master and king, but my master and king is a messenger of God. So do whatever seems best to you.
war: Ginbuwaan ka niya hiunong ha akon, Harangdon nga Hadi, kundi sugad ka hin anghel han Dyos, sanglit buhata an matadong ha imo.

en: Even though all the members of my grandfather’s family were nothing short of demonic toward my master and king, you still put your servant with those who eat at your table. So what right do I have to beg for still more from the king?”
war: Angay pamatayon han Imo Kaharangdon an ngatanan nga sakop han panimalay han akon amay, kundi iginhatag mo ha akon an katungod hin pagsaro ha imo lamesa. Waray ako katungod hin pag-aro ha Imo Kaharangdon hin iba pa nga mga kaupayan.”

en: “You don’t need to talk any more about this,” the king said to him. “I order you and Ziba to divide the property.”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Diri na kinahanglan nga magyakan ka pa. Naglarang na ako nga magbabahin kamo ngan hi Siba han mga hiagi ni Saul.”

en: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take all of it, since my master and king has come home safely.”
war: Binmaton hi Mefiboset, “Ihatag na la ini ngatanan kan Siba. Igo na ha akon nga nakauli an Imo Kaharangdon nga waray maraot nga nahinabo ha imo.”

en: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim. He accompanied the king to the Jordan River to send him off there.
war: Linmugsong liwat tikang ha Rogelim hi Barzilai nga taga-Galaad basi makaupod hiya han hadi hin pagtabok han Jordan.

en: Barzillai was very old, 80 years of age. He had supported the king during his stay at Mahanaim because Barzillai was a very wealthy man.
war: Lagas na hin duro hi Barzilai nga 80 na an iya panuigon. Riko hiya hin duro ngan gintagan niya an hadi hin pagkaon han nag-uokoy pa hiya didto ha Mahanaim.

en: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over the Jordan with me. I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Upod ha akon ngadto ha Jerusalem ngan pagmamangnoan ko ikaw.”

en: But Barzillai said to the king, “How many years do I have left that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
war: Kundi binmaton hi Barzilai, “Kay ano nga maupod pa ako han Imo Kaharangdon ngadto ha Jerusalem? Diri na maiha inin akon kinabuhi.

en: I am now 80 years old. Do I know what is good or bad anymore? Can your servant taste what I eat or drink? Can I even hear the voices of men or women singers? Why should your servant be a burden to my master and king?
war: An akon panuigon kapin hin 80 na ngan waray na nakakalipay ha akon. Diri na ako naabat hin rasa han akon kinakaon ngan iniinom, ngan diri na ako nabati han mga tingog hin mga magkaranta. Dako la ako nga arantoson han Imo Kaharangdon.

en: Your servant will cross a short way over the Jordan with the king, but why should the king give me such a reward?
war: Diri ako angay hin sugad ka dako nga balos. Sanglit mabunyog la ako ha imo ngadto ha uruunhan han Jordan.

en: Let your servant return so I may die in my own town near the grave of my parents. But here is your servant Chimham. Let him cross over with my master and king, and treat him as you think best.”
war: Katapos, tugoti ako pag-uli ngan mamatay hirani han lubnganan han akon mga kag-anak. Iini hi Quimam nga akon anak nga mag-aalagad ha imo; dad-a hiya, Harangdon nga Hadi, ngan buhata ha iya kon ano an maupay para ha imo.”

en: The king said, “Okay. Chimham will cross over with me, and I will treat him as I think best. And I will do for you anything you desire from me.”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Dadad-on ko hiya ngan bubuhaton ko ha iya an bisan ano nga imo karuyag. Ngan bubuhaton ko para ha imo an bisan ano nga imo pangaroan.”

en: So all the people crossed over the Jordan River, and the king stayed behind. The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and then Barzillai went back to his home.
war: Ngan tinmabok han Jordan hi David ngan an iya mga tawo. Hinadkan niya hi Barzilai ngan ginbendisyonan hiya; katapos, inmoli hi Barzilai.

en: When the king crossed over to Gilgal, Chimham went with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel escorted the king across.
war: Han pakatabok na han hadi nga binunyogan han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Juda ngan katunga han mga tawo han Israel, nagpadayon hiya ngadto ha Gilgal ngan inmupod ha iya hi Quimam.

en: Then everyone in Israel came and said to the king, “Why did our relatives the people of Judah steal you away, and bring the king and his household across the Jordan River, along with all of his soldiers?”
war: Niyan kinmadto han hadi an ngatanan nga mga Israelita ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Harangdon nga Hadi, kay ano nga naghunahuna an amon kabugtoan nga mga tawo han Juda, nga may nira katungod pagdara ha imo, han imo panimalay, ngan han imo mga tawo hin pagtabok han Jordan?”

en: Now a despicable man named Sheba, Bichri’s son, from Benjamin, was also there. He sounded the trumpet and said:
war: Nahinabo nga didto ha Gilgal may usa nga bastos nga tawo, hi Seba nga anak ni Bicri, nga sakop han tribo ni Benjamin. Nagtrompeta hiya ngan ginmoliat, “Mapukan hi David! Diri kami masunod ha iya! Mga tawo han Israel, panguli kita!”

en: “We don’t care about David!
war: Sanglit binmaya kan David an mga Israelita ngan inmupod hira kan Seba, kundi nagpabilin hin pag-ugop han hadi an mga tawo han Juda, ngan binmunyog hira kan David tikang ha Jordan ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: We have no stake in Jesse’s son!
war: Han pag-abot ni David ngadto han iya palasyo didto ha Jerusalem, kinuha niya an napulo nga mga aruasawa nga ginbilin niya hin pagpanimangno han palasyo, ngan ginpabantayan niya hira. Gintagan hira niya han ira mga kinahanglanon, kundi waray hiya makighilawas ha ira. Waray na hira gawasgawas ngada han ira kamatay, nga nag-ukoy hira sugad hin mga balo.

en: Go back to your homes, Israel!”
war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Amasa, “Tiroka an mga tawo han Juda ngan balik nganhi sangbuwas upod ha ira.”

en: So all the Israelites left David to follow Bichri’s son Sheba. But all the people of Judah stayed close to their king from the Jordan River all the way to Jerusalem.
war: Linmakat hi Amasa hin pagtirok ha ira, kundi waray hira bumalik han adlaw nga igintalaan han hadi.

en: When David arrived at his palace in Jerusalem, the king took the ten secondary wives he had left to take care of the palace and put them in a house under guard. He provided for them, but he didn’t have sex with them. They were confined until the day they died, and lived like widows.
war: Sanglit nagsiring an hadi kan Abisai, “Makakahatag ha aton hin darudako nga kasamok hi Seba kay kan Absalon. Dad-a an akon mga tawo ngan lanata hiya, kay bangin niya makuha in pira han ginpaderan nga mga bungto ngan makakalagiw ha aton.”

en: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call everyone in Judah here to me three days from now. You should be here too.”
war: Sanglit linmakat tikang ha Jerusalem upod kan Abisai an mga tawo ni Joab, an mga gwardya han hadi, ngan an ngatanan nga iba nga mga sondalo hin paglanat kan Seba.

en: So Amasa went to call Judah together, but he took longer than the allotted time.
war: Han pag-abot nira ngadto han dako nga bato didto ha Gabaon, gintapo hira ni Amasa. Nakakabado hin uniporme hin sondalo hi Joab, nga may-ada espada nga itinaklos ha iya paha. Han pagdaop niya kan Amasa, nahulog an iya espada.

en: David told Abishai, “Bichri’s son Sheba will cause more trouble for us than Absalom did. Take your master’s servants and chase after him before he finds fortified cities and escapes from us.”
war: Nagsiring hi Joab kan Amasa, “Kumosta ka, sangkay ko?” ngan kinaptan an iya bungot han tuo niya nga kamot basi hadkan hiya.

en: So Joab’s men marched out after Sheba—this included the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the warriors. They marched out of Jerusalem to pursue Bichri’s son Sheba.
war: Waray makatagam hi Amasa han espada nga kinakaptan ni Joab han iya luyo nga kamot, ngan binuno hiya ni Joab ha tiyan, ngan nahuwad ha tuna an iya tinai. Namatay hiya dayon, ngan waray na mag-otro hin pagbuno hi Joab.

en: When they got to the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was dressed in his soldier’s uniform. Over the tunic at his waist he wore a sword in its sheath. As Joab went forward it slipped out.
war: Niyan nagpadayon hi Joab ngan hi Abisai hin paglanat kan Seba.

en: “How are you, my brother?” Joab asked Amasa, and with his right hand he took hold of Amasa’s beard as if to kiss him.
war: Tinmindog ha ligid han lawas ni Amasa in usa han mga tawo ni Joab ngan ginmoliat, “Sumunod kan Joab an ngatanan nga naugop kan Joab ug David!”

en: But Amasa didn’t notice the sword in Joab’s hand. Joab struck him in the stomach with it so that Amasa’s intestines spilled out on the ground. He died without Joab striking him a second time. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba, Bichri’s son.
war: Nalunay ha butnga han dalan an lawas ni Amasa nga putos hin dugo. Hinkit-an han tawo ni Joab nga nahunong an ngatanan kon nalabay han patay nga lawas, sanglit gindanas niya an lawas ngadto ha kahawnan ngan iya gintahoban.

en: One of Joab’s men stood by Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, follow Joab!”
war: Han waray na an lawas dida ha dalan, sinmunod na kan Joab an ngatanan hin paglanat kan Seba.

en: Amasa was writhing in blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that everyone was stopping. When he saw this, he dragged Amasa from the road into a field and threw a robe over him.
war: Nagbaktas hi Seba han katunaan han ngatanan nga tribo han Israel ngan inmabot hiya ngadto han syudad han Abel Betmaaca, ngan nagtirok an ngatanan nga mga sakop han hugpo hin mga panimalay ni Bicri ngan sinmunod ha iya ngadto han syudad.

en: Once Amasa was moved out of the road, everyone who followed Joab marched past in pursuit of Bichri’s son Sheba.
war: Hinbaroan han mga tawo ni Joab nga nakadto hi Seba, sanglit kinmadto hira ngan ginpalibotan nira an syudad. Naghimo hira hin mga higtaas nga trensera ligid han pader, ngan gin-ukaban liwat nira an ilarom han pader basi marumpag.

en: Sheba went through all the Israelite tribes up to Abel of Beth-maacah. All the Bichrites assembled and followed Sheba in.
war: May-ada makinaadmananon nga babaye didto han syudad nga naggoliat tikang han pader. “Pamati! Pamati! Pakanhia hi Joab—karuyag ko makighimangraw ha iya.”

en: Then Joab’s men arrived and attacked Sheba at Abel of Beth-maacah. They piled up a ramp against the city, and it stood against the outer wall. All of Joab’s troops were hammering the wall, trying to bring it down.
war: Kinmadto hi Joab, ngan ginpakianhan hiya han babaye, “Amo ka ba hi Joab?”

en: Then a wise woman called from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come over here, so I can talk to him.”
war: “Oo, amo ako,” binmaton hiya.

en: So Joab approached her, and the woman said, “Are you Joab?”
war: “Pamati ha akon,” nagsiring an babaye.

en: “I am,” he answered.
war: “Namamati ako,” binmaton hiya.

en: “Pay close attention to the words of your female servant,” she said.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Hadto nga mga adlaw nasiring hira, ‘Pakadto ngan pangaro hin sagdon han syudad han Abel ngan matutuhay dayon’—ngan amo gud ito an ira ginbuhat.

en: “I’m listening,” Joab replied.
war: Bantogan ini nga amon syudad; makisasangkayon ngan diri masamok an mga tawo han syudad. Kay ano nga gin-iiburungkag mo ini? Karuyag ba nimo gub-on an kanan Dyos syudad?”

en: She said, “People used to say long ago: ‘Ask your question at Abel,’ and that settled the matter.
war: “Diri gud,” binmaton hi Joab. “Diri gud ako magruruba o magbubungkag han iyo syudad!

en: I am one of the peaceful and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to kill a city that is one of Israel’s mothers! Why would you annihilate the LORD ’s inheritance?”
war: Diri amo ito an amon tuyo. May usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan kan Seba nga anak ni Bicri, nga taga sagkahon nga katunaan han Efraim, nga nagtikang hin pagsupil kontra kan Hadi David. Itubyan ha akon ini nga tawo ngan mabaya ako han syudad.”

en: Joab answered, “I would never, ever annihilate or destroy such a thing!
war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Ilalabog namon luyo ha pader an iya ulo ngada ha imo.”

en: There was a famine for three years in a row during David’s rule. David asked the LORD about this, and the LORD said, “It is caused by Saul and his household, who are guilty of bloodshed because he killed the people of Gibeon.”
war: Dida han panahon han pagkahadi ni David may duro nga kagutom nga inmabot hin tulo ka tuig. Sanglit nagpakiana hi David han Ginoo hiunong hini, ngan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Nakasala hin pagpatay hi Saul ngan an iya panimalay; pinamatay niya an mga tawo han Gabaon.” (

en: So the king called for the Gibeonites and spoke to them.
war: Diri mga Israelita an mga tawo han Gabaon; gutiay la hira nga hugpo hin mga Amoreohanon nga ginsaaran han mga Israelita nga diri hira papatayon; kundi gintinguha ni Saul pagpuo ha ira tungod la han iya gugma para han mga tawo han Israel ug Juda.)

en: (Now the Gibeonites weren’t Israelites but were survivors of the Amorites. The Israelites had sworn a solemn pledge to spare them, but Saul tried to eliminate them in his enthusiasm for the people of Israel and Judah.)
war: Sanglit gintawag ni David an mga tawo han Gabaon ngan ginsiring hira, “Ano in akon mahihimo para ha iyo? Karuyag ko nga baydan an karat-an nga ginbuhat ngada ha iyo, basi makakarawat an mga tawo han Ginoo han iyo bendisyon.”

en: David said to the Gibeonites, “What can I do for you? How can I fix matters so you can benefit from the LORD ’s inheritance?”
war: Binmaton hira, “Diri matutuhay pinaagi hin salapi o bulawan an amon pakig-away kan Saul ngan han iya panimalay, ngan diri man namon karuyag pagpatay hin bisan hin-o nga Israelita.”

en: The Gibeonites said to him, “We don’t want any silver or gold from Saul or his family, and it isn’t our right to have anyone in Israel killed.”
war: “Kon sugad, ano man an iyo hunahuna nga akon bubuhaton para ha iyo?” nagpakiana hi David.

en: “What do you want?” David asked. “I’ll do it for you.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Karuyag ni Saul nga mapuo kami, ngan waray mahibilin nga buhi ha amon bisan diin dinhe ha Israel.

en: “Okay then,” they said to the king. “That man who opposed and oppressed us, who planned to destroy us, keeping us from having a place to live anywhere in Israel—
war: Sanglit itubyan ha amon in pito han iya mga tulin nga kalalaken-an, ngan amon hira bibitayon ha atubangan han Ginoo didto ha Gabaa, an bungto nga natawhan ni Saul nga ginpili nga hadi han Ginoo .”

en: hand over seven of his sons to us, and we will hang them before the LORD at Gibeon on the LORD ’s mountain.”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Itutubyan ko hira.”

en: “I will hand them over,” the king said.
war: Kundi tungod han pagsumpaay nira David ngan hi Jonatan waray ig-upod ni David hi Mefiboset nga anak ni Jonatan, nga apo ni Saul.

en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, Jonathan’s son and Saul’s grandson, because of the LORD ’s solemn pledge that was between them—between David and Saul’s son Jonathan.
war: Kundi iya kinuha hira Armoni ug Mefiboset nga mga anak ni Saul ngan an iroy nira hi Rizpa nga anak ni Aia; kinuha liwat niya an lima nga mga anak ni Adriel nga anak nga lalake ni Barzilai nga taga-Mehola, ngan an asawa ni Adriel amo hi Merab nga anak nga babaye ni Saul.

en: So the king took the two sons of Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Armoni and Mephibosheth, whom she had birthed for Saul; and the five sons of Saul’s daughter Merab, whom she birthed for Adriel, Barzillai’s son, who was from Meholah,
war: Igintubyan hira ni David ngadto han mga tawo han Gabaon ngan ginbitay hira didto han bukid ha atubangan han Ginoo —ngan urosa an pagkamatay nira nga pito. Pinamatay hira dida han syahan nga mga adlaw han pagkat-ani han sebada.

en: and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They hanged them on the mountain before the LORD . The seven of them died at the same time. They were executed in the first days of the harvest, at the beginning of the barley harvest.
war: Niyan kinmuha hin dugnit nga sako hi Rizpa nga aruasawa ni Saul, ngan anak ni Aia, ngan ginhimo ini niya nga basnig niya ngan didto hiya pag-inukoy han bato nga hinmumutangan han patay nga mga lawas, ngan didto hiya tikang han pagtikang han panahon hin kat-ani ngada han pagtikang han panahon hin kamauran. Kon adlaw ginbabantayan niya nga diri makahugdon an mga tamsi ngada han mga lawas, ngan kon gab-i ginbabantayan niya nga diri bangaon han mga mananap nga ihalas.

en: Aiah’s daughter Rizpah took funeral clothing and spread it out by herself on a rock. She stayed there from the beginning of the harvest until the rains poured down on the bodies from the sky, and she wouldn’t let any birds of prey land on the bodies during the day or let wild animals come at nighttime.
war: Han paghibaroi ni David han ginbuhat ni Rizpa,

en: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s secondary wife, had done,
war: ginkuha niya an mga tul-an nira Saul ug Jonatan nga iya anak tikang han mga tawo han Jabes didto ha Galaad. (Ira ginkawat ini didto han plasa han bungto ha Betsan diin ginbitay han mga Filisteohanon an mga lawas dida han adlaw han pagpataya nira kan Saul didto han Bukid Gilboa.)

en: he went and retrieved the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen the bones from the public square in Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them on the day the Philistines killed Saul at Gilboa.
war: Ginkuha ni David an mga tul-an nira Saul ug Jonatan ngan gintirok liwat an mga tul-an han pito nga mga tawo nga ginbitay.

en: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there and collected the bones of the men who had been hanged by the Gibeonites.
war: Niyan iginlubong nira an mga tul-an nira Saul ug Jonatan didto han lubnganan ni Cis nga amay ni Saul, didto ha Zela, didto han katunaan han Benjamin, nga gintuman nira an ngatanan nga iginsugo han hadi. Katapos, pinamatian na han Dyos an ira mga pag-ampo para han nasod.

en: The bones of Saul and his son Jonathan were then buried in Zela, in Benjaminite territory, in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish. Once everything the king had commanded was done, God responded to prayers for the land.
war: Nakig-away na liwat an Israel kontra han mga Filisteohanon, ngan inmupod hi David han iya mga tawo hin pakig-away ha ira. Ginul-an hi David dida han usa han mga araway.

en: Once again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel. David and the soldiers who were with him went down and fought the Philistines. When David grew tired,
war: May usa nga higante nga ginngaranan kan Isbibenob nga naghunahuna nga makakapatay hiya kan David. Nakakadara hiya hin bronse nga bangkaw nga sobra tulo ka kilo an kabug-at, ngan nakakataklos hin bag-o nga espada.

en: Ishbi-benob, a descendant of the Raphah, planned on killing David. The weight of his spear was three hundred shekels of bronze, and he was wearing new armor.
war: Kundi binuligan hi David ni Abisai nga anak ni Seruia. Ginsulong ngan ginpatay ni Abisai an higante. Niyan ira pinapagsaad hi David nga diri na gud hiya umupod ha ira ngadto ha pag-awayan. Nagsiring hira, “Ikaw an paglaom han Israel ngan diri namon karuyag nga mamatay ka.”

en: But Zeruiah’s son Abishai came to David’s aid, striking the Philistine down and killing him. Then David’s men swore a solemn pledge to him: “You will never march out to battle with us again! You must not snuff out Israel’s lamp!”
war: Katapos hini, may away na liwat didto ha Gob kontra han mga Filisteohanon, diin nakamatay hi Sibecai nga taga-Husa hin higante nga ginngaranan kan Saf.

en: Some time later, another battle with the Philistines took place at Gob. Then Sibbecai from Hushah killed Saph, a descendant of the Raphah.
war: May lain pa nga away didto ha Gob kontra han mga Filisteohanon, ngan nakamatay hi Elhanan nga anak ni Jair, nga taga-Betlehem kan Goliat nga taga-Gat, kanay bangkaw may pulo nga sugad ka dako hin alikosan hin hablonan.

en: There was yet another battle with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan, Jair’s son from Bethlehem, killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was as strong as the bar on a weaver’s loom.
war: Niyan may lain liwat nga away didto ha Gat, diin may higante nga makiawayon. Unom an iya mga tudlo ha kada kamot ngan ha kada tiil.

en: David spoke the words of this song to the LORD after the LORD delivered him from the power of all his enemies and from Saul.
war: Ginhimangraw ni David ngadto han Ginoo an mga pulong hini nga kanta dida han adlaw han pagtalwasa ha iya han Ginoo ha mga kamot ni Saul ngan han iba nga mga kaaway niya:

en: He said:
war: Akon bato, akon kota an Ginoo

en: The LORD is my solid rock, my fortress, my rescuer.
war: ngan hiya ha akon nagbawi.

en: My God is my rock—I take refuge in him!—
war: Akon darangpan nga bato an akon Dyos,

en: he’s my shield and my salvation’s strength,
war: akon taming ngan akon gahom.

en: my place of safety and my shelter.
war: Akon arayupan, akon darangpan,

en: My savior! Save me from violence!
war: akon manunubos ha mga magraogdaog.

en: Because he is praiseworthy,
war: Natawag ako han Ginoo ,

en: I cried out to the LORD ,
war: takos hiya han akon pagdayeg.

en: and I was saved from my enemies.
war: Ginggawas ako ha mga kasamokan.

en: Death’s waves were all around me;
war: An mga balod han kamatayon nakalumos ha akon.

en: rivers of wickedness terrified me.
war: An mga baha han akon kapukan nakadaog ha akon.

en: The cords of the grave surrounded me;
war: An mga pisi han kamatayon nakahikog ha akon.

en: death’s traps held me tight.
war: An mga bitik han kamatayon nakapalisang ha akon.

en: In my distress I cried out to the LORD ;
war: Ha akon kakurian, ginsangpit ko an Ginoo ;

en: I cried out to my God.
war: gintawag ko an akon Dyos.

en: God heard my voice from his temple;
war: Ha iya templo namati hiya ha akon,

en: my cry for help reached his ears.
war: ngan an akon pangaraba dinmangat ha iya durunggan.

en: The earth rocked and shook;
war: Nabay-og ug nangurog an tuna;

en: the sky’s foundations trembled
war: nabantad an patukoranan han langit.

en: and reeled because of God’s anger.
war: Kinmurog kay nasina hiya.

en: Smoke went up from God’s nostrils;
war: Ha iya irong inmusbok in aso, ha iya baba, inmulyab in kalayo.

en: out of his mouth came a devouring fire;
war: Naglalahinggab nga mga baga nagawas tikang ha iya.

en: flaming coals blazed out in front of him!
war: Binuksan niya an kalangitan, ngan tuna an iya linusaran,

en: God parted the skies and came down;
war: upod in mga dampog nga maitom ha iya mga tiil nailarom.

en: thick darkness was beneath his feet.
war: An anghel an iya sinasakyan, hataas an iya linolupdan.

en: God mounted the heavenly creatures and flew;
war: Masukot hiya hikit-an, ha bawbaw han kahanginan.

en: he was seen on the wind’s wings.
war: Tabon niya an kasisidman,

en: God made darkness his covering;
war: mga dampog hin tubig hiya ginugup-an.

en: water gathered in dense clouds!
war: Mga baga nga naglalahinggab, hin kalayo naulyab.

en: Coals of fire blazed out of the brightness before him.
war: An Ginoo ginmoliat ha kalangitan,

en: The LORD thundered from heaven;
war: han Gihahataasi in tingog hinbatian.

en: the Most High made his voice heard.
war: Tungod han iya pana hira nagsarang,

en: God shot arrows, scattering the enemy;
war: han kikidlat hira nanadlagan.

en: he sent the lightning and whipped them into confusion.
war: Nagmara an salad han kadagatan,

en: The seabeds were exposed;
war: patukoranan han tuna nabuksan.

en: the earth’s foundations were laid bare at the LORD ’s rebuke,
war: Kay han Ginoo nasinahan

en: at the angry blast of air coming from his nostrils.
war: ug an kaaway iya gindumtan.

en: From on high God reached down and grabbed me;
war: Ginggawad ako niya ngan ginggawas

en: he took me out of deep waters.
war: ha katubigan ngan ako natalwas.

en: God saved me from my powerful enemy,
war: Tikang han mga kaaway gintalwas ako

en: saved me from my foes, who were too much for me.
war: han mga nagdudumot nga mga tawo.

en: They came at me on the very day of my distress,
war: Waray ako makaato, kay makusog hira hin duro.

en: but the LORD was my support.
war: Ginsulong ako takna nga kakurian,

en: He brought me out to wide-open spaces;
war: kundi han Ginoo ako ginsalipdan.

en: he pulled me out, because he is pleased with me.
war: Gin-agaw ako niya ha kataragman;

en: The LORD rewarded me for my righteousness;
war: tungod kay ako iya nalilipayan.

en: he restored me because my hands are clean,
war: An Ginoo nabalos kay ako matadong;

en: because I have kept the LORD ’s ways.
war: ginpakaupay ako kay di' masupakon.

en: I haven’t acted wickedly against my God.
war: Balaod han Ginoo ako masugtanon,

en: All his rules are right in front of me;
war: han Dyos di' ako masinupilon.

en: I haven’t turned away from any of his laws.
war: Gintuman ko an mga balaod niya,

en: I have lived with integrity before him;
war: iya mga sugo waray ko pagsupaka.

en: I’ve kept myself from wrongdoing.
war: Maaram gud hiya nga diri ako salaan,

en: And so the LORD restored me for my righteousness,
war: nga nadiri ako pagbuhat hin karat-an.

en: because I am clean in his eyes.
war: Sanglit nabalos kay ako matadong,

en: You deal faithfully with the faithful;
war: sayod hiya nga diri ako masupakon.

en: you show integrity toward the one who has integrity.
war: Matinumanon ka hadton diri malingo,

en: You are pure toward the pure,
war: hadto waray sayop, maupay ka hin duro.

en: but toward the crooked, you are tricky.
war: Maputli ka hadton putli ha hunahuna,

en: You are the one who saves people who suffer,
war: ngan maisog ka hadton makasasala.

en: but your eyes are against the proud.
war: Gintatalwas mo an mapinaubsanon,

en: You bring them down!
war: ginpapaubos an mapinahitas-on.

en: You are my lamp, LORD ;
war: Ikaw, O Ginoo , an akon kapawa;

en: the LORD illumines my darkness.
war: an kasisidman ko imo pinapara.

en: With you I can charge into battle;
war: Kusog hin pakiaway ha akon imo hinatag,
