en: Peter and John stared at him. Peter said, “Look at us!”
war: Tinutokan hiya nira ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Siplat ha amon!”

en: So the man gazed at them, expecting to receive something from them.
war: Sanglit sinmiplat hiya ha ira nga naglalaom nga lilimosan hiya.

en: Peter said, “I don’t have any money, but I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, rise up and walk!”
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Waray gud ako kwarta, kundi ihahatag ko ha imo an aadi ha akon: ha ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo nga taga-Nazaret, ginsusugo ko ikaw, buhat ngan lakat!”

en: Then he grasped the man’s right hand and raised him up. At once his feet and ankles became strong.
war: Ngan kinaptan ni Pedro an tuo nga kamot han lulid ngan binuligan niya hin pagtukdaw. Nagmakusog dayon an mga tiil ngan mga mukobuko han lulid;

en: Jumping up, he began to walk around. He entered the temple with them, walking, leaping, and praising God.
war: linmukso hiya, tinmindog, ngan nagtikang hin paglakat. Niyan inmupod hiya ha ira ngadto ha Templo nga naglalakat ngan nagluluksolukso ngan nagdadayaw han Dyos.

en: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
war: An ngatanan nakakita ha iya nga naglalakat ngan nagdadayaw han Dyos;

en: They recognized him as the same one who used to sit at the temple’s Beautiful Gate asking for money. They were filled with amazement and surprise at what had happened to him.
war: ngan han pakakilala nira nga amo ini hiya an makililimos nga paralingkod didto han “Matahom nga Aragian” han Templo, nahipausa gud hira ngatanan han nahinabo ha iya.

en: While the healed man clung to Peter and John, all the people rushed toward them at Solomon’s Porch, completely amazed.
war: Samtang nagunit pa an lulid kanda Pedro ug Juan, nahipausa an ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan ini hira nagdadlagan ngadto ha ira didto han ginngangaranan nga “Balkon ni Solomon.”

en: Seeing this, Peter addressed the people: “You Israelites, why are you amazed at this? Why are you staring at us as if we made him walk by our own power or piety?
war: Han pakakita ni Pedro han mga tawo, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Mga taga-Israel, kay ano nga nahipausa man kamo hini, ngan gintututokan man kami niyo? Hunahuna ba niyo nga nakapalakat kami hini nga tawo tungod han amon kalugaringon nga gahom o pagkadyosnon?

en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the God of our ancestors—has glorified his servant Jesus. This is the one you handed over and denied in Pilate’s presence, even though he had already decided to release him.
war: An Dyos ni Abraham, ni Isaac, ngan ni Jacob, an Dyos han aton kaapoy-apoyan amo an naghatag han dyosnon nga kadungganan ha iya surugoon nga hi Jesus. Kundi igintubyan hiya niyo ngadto han mga punoan, ngan ginsalikway hiya niyo ha atubangan ni Pilato, bisan kon human na hi Pilato paglarang nga kabuhian hiya.

en: You rejected the holy and righteous one, and asked that a murderer be released to you instead.
war: Baraan ngan matadong hiya, kundi ginsalikway hiya niyo, ngan iyo lugod pinangaro kan Pilato nga buhian niya an usa nga kriminal.

en: You killed the author of life, the very one whom God raised from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
war: Ginpatay niyo an Burabod han Kinabuhi, kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos, ngan mga saksi kami hini.

en: His name itself has made this man strong. That is, because of faith in Jesus’ name, God has strengthened this man whom you see and know. The faith that comes through Jesus gave him complete health right before your eyes.
war: An gahom han iya ngaran amo an nakaupay hini nga tawo. Ini nga iyo hinkit-an ngan hinbaroan nahimo pinaagi han pagtoo ha iya ngaran. An pagtoo kan Jesus amo an nakaupay ha iya sugad han iyo hinkit-an.

en: “Brothers and sisters, I know you acted in ignorance. So did your rulers.
war: “Ngan yana, kabugtoan ko, maaram ako nga nahimo niyo ngan han iyo mga pangulo an iyo ginbuhat kan Jesus, tungod han iyo katapang.

en: But this is how God fulfilled what he foretold through all the prophets: that his Christ would suffer.
war: Daan na ginpahibaro han Dyos hadto pa nga panahon pinaagi han ngatanan nga mga manaragna, nga kinahanglan mag-antos an iya Mesiyas, ngan natuman ini ha sugad nga paagi.

en: Change your hearts and lives! Turn back to God so that your sins may be wiped away.
war: Sanglit pagbasol kamo ngan balik kamo ngadto ha Dyos, basi pasayloon niya an iyo mga sala.

en: Then the Lord will provide a season of relief from the distress of this age and he will send Jesus, whom he handpicked to be your Christ.
war: Kon buhaton niyo ini, maabot ha iyo an panahon han espirituhanon nga kusog tikang han Ginoo, ngan ipapadara niya hi Jesus nga amo an Mesiyas nga iya na ginpili para ha iyo.

en: Jesus must remain in heaven until the restoration of all things, about which God spoke long ago through his holy prophets.
war: Kinahanglan magpabilin hiya ha langit ngada han pag-abot han panahon hin pagbag-o han ngatanan nga mga butang, sugad han iginpasabot han Dyos hadton una pa nga mga panahon pinaagi han iya baraan nga mga manaragna.

en: Moses said, “ The Lord your God will raise up from your own people a prophet like me. Listen to whatever he tells you. ”
war: Kay nagsiring hi Moises, ‘Magpapadara ha iyo an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos hin manaragna nga tikang ha iyo kalugaringon nga katulinan, sugad han iya pagpadara ha akon. Kinahanglan pamatian niyo an ngatanan nga iya igsusumat ha iyo.

en: “ Whoever doesn’t listen to that prophet will be totally cut off from the people. ”
war: An diri magtuman han igyayakan hadto nga manaragna, igbubulag hira tikang han katawhan han Dyos ngan pupuohon hira.’

en: All the prophets who spoke—from Samuel forward—announced these days.
war: Nagpasabot liwat mahitungod hini yana nga mga adlaw an mga manaragna nga may-ada mensahe, pati hi Samuel ngan an ngatanan nga sinmunod ha iya.

en: You are the heirs of the prophets and the covenant that God made with your ancestors when he told Abraham, “ Through your descendants, all the families on earth will be blessed. ”
war: An mga saad han Dyos pinaagi han iya mga manaragna iginpahinungod ha iyo, ngan nakaangbit kamo han ginsabotan nga ginhimo han Dyos ngan han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan. Sumala han iginsiring niya kan Abraham, ‘Tatagan ko hin kaupayan an ngatanan nga katawhan han tuna pinaagi han imo mga tulin.’

en: After God raised his servant, he sent him to you first—to bless you by enabling each of you to turn from your evil ways.”
war: Sanglit ginpili han Dyos an iya surugoon ngan gin-una hin pagpadara ngada ha iyo, hin pagpakaupay ha iyo pinaagi hin pagpabaya ha iyo han iyo magraot nga mga ginawian.”

en: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple guard, and the Sadducees confronted them.
war: Han nagyayakan pa ha mga tawo hira Pedro ug Juan, nagkaabot in kapadian, an pangulo han mga gwardya han Templo, ug in mga Sadusiyo.

en: They were incensed that the apostles were teaching the people and announcing that the resurrection of the dead was happening because of Jesus.
war: Napungot hira kay an duha nga mga apostoles nagtinutdo han mga tawo nga nabanhaw hi Jesus, ngan nagpamatuod ini nga may pagkabanhaw an mga patay.

en: They seized Peter and John and put them in prison until the next day. (It was already evening.)
war: Sanglit gindakop hira ngan ginpriso ngada han pagkasunod nga adlaw kay tikagab-i na adto.

en: Many who heard the word became believers, and their number grew to about five thousand.
war: Kundi tinmuo in damo han nagpakabati han mensahe, ngan inmabot na hin mga 5,000 an mga tawo.

en: The next day the leaders, elders, and legal experts gathered in Jerusalem,
war: Han pagkabuwas nagkatirok didto ha Jerusalem an mga pangulo nga Judiyo, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and others from the high priest’s family.
war: Nakigkita hira han Labaw nga Padi nga hi Anas, ngan kan Caifas, kan Juan, kan Alejandro, ngan han iba pa nga mga sakop han panimalay han Labaw nga Padi.

en: They had Peter and John brought before them and asked, “By what power or in what name did you do this?”
war: Ginpaatubang ha ira an mga apostoles ngan ginpakianhan nira, “Gin-unan-o niyo hin pagbuhat hini? Ano an iyo gahom, ngan kanay ngaran an iyo ginamit?”

en: Then Peter, inspired by the Holy Spirit, answered, “Leaders of the people and elders,
war: Binmaton hi Pedro nga puno han Espiritu Santo, “Mga pangulo han mga tawo ngan mga katigurangan:

en: are we being examined today because something good was done for a sick person, a good deed that healed him?
war: kon ginpapakianhan kami yana mahitungod han maupay nga amon ginbuhat hini nga lulid, ngan kon naunan-o nga naupay na hiya,

en: If so, then you and all the people of Israel need to know that this man stands healthy before you because of the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene—whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead.
war: kinahanglan masayod kamo ngatanan ngan an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha Israel, nga ini nga tawo nga natindog ha iyo atubangan naupay na pinaagi han gahom han ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo nga taga-Nazaret, nga iyo iginraysang ha kros, kundi ginbanhaw han Dyos.

en: This Jesus is the stone you builders rejected; he has become the cornerstone!
war: Amo ini hi Jesus an hinnanabihan han Kasuratan nga nasiring:

en: Salvation can be found in no one else. Throughout the whole world, no other name has been given among humans through which we must be saved.”
war: ‘An bato nga gintamay niyo nga mga magtirindog hin balay,

en: The council was caught by surprise by the confidence with which Peter and John spoke. After all, they understood that these apostles were uneducated and inexperienced. They also recognized that they had been followers of Jesus.
war: nahimo lugod nga labi ka importante nga bato.’

en: However, since the healed man was standing with Peter and John before their own eyes, they had no rebuttal.
war: Hiaagian an katalwasan pinaagi gud la ha iya. Kay ha bug-os nga kalibutan waray lain nga ngaran nga iginhatag han Dyos ha mga tawo, nga sadang makatalwas ha aton.”

en: After ordering them to wait outside, the council members began to confer with each other.
war: Nahipausa an mga sakop han Labaw nga Hukmanan han kaisog nga ginpakita nira Pedro ug Juan, ngan han ira kasayod nga ordinaryo la ini nga mga tawo nga waray mga hibaro. Nasabtan nira nga mga kaupod-upod ngay-an hira ni Jesus.

en: “What should we do with these men? Everyone living in Jerusalem is aware of the sign performed through them. It’s obvious to everyone and we can’t deny it.
war: Kundi waray gud nira sadang igriwa kay nakita hira han tawo nga naupay na nga natindog upod nira Pedro ug Juan.

en: To keep it from spreading further among the people, we need to warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.”
war: Sanglit ginpagawas hira han ruwang han Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan naghirohimangraw hin hira la,

en: When they called Peter and John back, they demanded that they stop all speaking and teaching in the name of Jesus.
war: ngan naggiparopakiana, “Aanhon man naton ini nga mga tawo? Maaram an ngatanan nga mga umurokoy ha Jerusalem nga ini nga talagsaon nga milagro ginbuhat nira ngan diri kita makakalirong hini.

en: Peter and John responded, “It’s up to you to determine whether it’s right before God to obey you rather than God.
war: Kundi basi diri mahisamwak ini nga butang ngadto han mga tawo, pagdidid-an ta ini hira hin paghimangraw bisan kan kanay han ngaran ni Jesus.”

en: As for us, we can’t stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
war: Sanglit iginpatawag liwat nira an duha nga mga apostoles ngan gintugon nga diri na gud hira magyakan o magtutdo han ngaran ni Jesus.

en: They threatened them further, then released them. Because of public support for Peter and John, they couldn’t find a way to punish them. Everyone was praising God for what had happened,
war: Kundi binmaton hira Pedro ug Juan, “Kamo ngahaw an paghukom kon hain an matadong ha atubangan han Dyos: pagsugot ba ha iyo o pagsugot ba han Dyos?

en: because the man who had experienced this sign of healing was over 40 years old.
war: Kay diri kami kapupugngan hin pagyakan han amon hinkit-an ngan hinbatian.”

en: After their release, Peter and John returned to the brothers and sisters and reported everything the chief priests and elders had said.
war: Tungod hini gindid-an hira hin mahigpit han Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan katapos, ginbuhian hira. Nakasabot hira nga waray gud nira mahihimo hin pagkastigo ha ira, kay nagdadayaw han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga tawo tungod han nahinabo.

en: They listened, then lifted their voices in unison to God, “Master, you are the one who created the heaven, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
war: Sobra na hin 40 ka tuig an edad han tawo nga ginbuhatan hini nga milagro hin pagtambal.

en: You are the one who spoke by the Holy Spirit through our ancestor David, your servant:
war: Han pagbuhii na ha ira, binmalik hira Pedro ug Juan ngadto han ira hugpo ngan ginsumatan nira ini hira mahitungod han iginsiring han labaw nga kapadian ngan han katigurangan.

en: “ Why did the Gentiles rage ”,
war: Han pakabati nira hini, nag-urosa hira hin pag-ampo sa Dyos: “Agaron ngan Magburuhat han langit, han tuna, han dagat, ngan han ngatanan nga aada ha ira!

en: “ and the peoples plot in vain? ”
war: Nagyakan ka pinaagi han Espiritu Santo, pinaagi kan David nga amon ginikanan, nga imo surugoon, han iya pagsiring,

en: “ The kings of the earth took their stand ”
war: ‘Kay ano nga napungot an mga Hentil,

en: “ and the rulers gathered together as one ”
war: kay ano nga naghunahuna an mga tawo hin mga butang nga waray kapulsanan?

en: “ against the Lord and against his Christ. ”
war: Nag-andam an kahadian han tuna,

en: Indeed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with Gentiles and Israelites, did gather in this city against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
war: ngan nagkatirok an mga punoan

en: They did what your power and plan had already determined would happen.
war: kontra han Ginoo ngan han iya Mesiyas.’

en: Now, Lord, take note of their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with complete confidence.
war: Kay ha tinuod nagkatirok dinhe hini nga syudad hira Herodes ug Poncio Pilato kaupod han mga Hentil ngan han mga tawo han Israel kontra kan Jesus, an imo baraan nga Surugoon nga imo ginhimo nga Mesiyas.

en: Stretch out your hand to bring healing and enable signs and wonders to be performed through the name of Jesus, your holy servant.”
war: Nagkaurosa hira hin pagbuhat han bisan ano, nga pinaagi han imo gahom ug pagbuot, imo na nga daan ginlarang nga mahinanabo.

en: After they prayed, the place where they were gathered was shaken. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking God’s word with confidence.
war: Ngan yana, Ginoo, kitaa an ira mga pagtarhog nga ira ginhimo, ngan ihatag ha amon nga imo mga surugoon an kamaisog hin pagpasangyaw han imo mensahe.

en: The community of believers was one in heart and mind. None of them would say, “This is mine!” about any of their possessions, but held everything in common.
war: Ipadapat an imo mga kamot hin panambal, ngan itugot nga buhaton unta an mga urosahon ngan mga milagro pinaagi han ngaran han imo baraan nga Surugoon nga hi Jesus.”

en: The apostles continued to bear powerful witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and an abundance of grace was at work among them all.
war: Kahuman nira pag-ampo, nabay-og an dapit nga ira ginkatirokan. Napuno hira ngatanan han Espiritu Santo ngan nagtikang hira hin pagwali nga madasigon han mensahe han Dyos.

en: There were no needy persons among them. Those who owned properties or houses would sell them, bring the proceeds from the sales,
war: An hugpo han mga magtinuohon usa la ha hunahuna ug kasingkasing. Waray usa ha ira nga nasiring nga tag-iya hiya han iya mga butang, kundi nag-angbitay hira han ngatanan nga mga butang nga ira naaangkon.

en: and place them in the care and under the authority of the apostles. Then it was distributed to anyone who was in need.
war: Upod in dako nga gahom nagsaksi an mga apostoles han pagkabanhaw han Ginoo nga hi Jesus, ngan ginpakaupay gud han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon.

en: Joseph, whom the apostles nicknamed Barnabas (that is, “one who encourages”), was a Levite from Cyprus.
war: Waray usa dida han ira hugpo in nagkikinahanglan. Adton may mga uma o mga balay, iginbabaligya ini, gindadara an kwarta nga palit hini,

en: He owned a field, sold it, brought the money, and placed it in the care and under the authority of the apostles.
war: ngan ginhahatag ngadto han mga apostoles, ngan ginbabahinbahin an kwarta ha tagsatagsa sumala han iya kinahanglan.

en: However, a man named Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property.
war: Kundi may usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan nga Ananias kanay asawa ginngaranan nga Safira. Nagbaligya hiya hin iya hiagi,

en: With his wife’s knowledge, he withheld some of the proceeds from the sale. He brought the rest and placed it in the care and under the authority of the apostles.
war: kundi gin-ibanan niya an kwarta nga palit hini para ha iya kalugaringon, ngan inuyonan ini han iya asawa. An salin ginhatag niya ngadto han mga apostoles.

en: Peter asked, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has influenced you to lie to the Holy Spirit by withholding some of the proceeds from the sale of your land?
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Ananias, kay ano nga tinmugot ka nga madaog ka ni Satanas ngan magbuwa ka han Espiritu Santo pinaagi hin pag-iban han kwarta nga palit han hiagi?

en: Wasn’t that property yours to keep? After you sold it, wasn’t the money yours to do with whatever you wanted? What made you think of such a thing? You haven’t lied to other people but to God!”
war: San-o mo igbaligya an hiagi, ikaw an tag-iya hadto, ngan kahuman mo igbaligya, imo gihapon an kwarta. Sanglit kay ano man nga nakahunahuna ka hin pagbuhat hin sugad? Diri mga tawo an imo ginbuwaan kundi an Dyos!”

en: When Ananias heard these words, he dropped dead. Everyone who heard this conversation was terrified.
war: Han pakabati gud la hini ni Ananias, natumba hiya ngan namatay. Duro an kahadlok han ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini.

en: Some young men stood up, wrapped up his body, carried him out, and buried him.
war: Dinmaop an mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an, ginputos an iya lawas, gindara hiya ha gawas, ngan iginlubong.

en: About three hours later, his wife entered, but she didn’t know what had happened to her husband.
war: Pag-agi hin mga tulo ka oras, sinmulod an iya asawa, kundi diri hiya maaram han nahinabo.

en: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you and your husband receive this price for the field?”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Pagsumati ako: amo ba la ini an bayad han iyo hiagi nga iyo ginbaligya?”

en: She responded, “Yes, that’s the amount.”
war: “Oo,” binmaton hi Safira, “amo la ito.”

en: He replied, “How could you scheme with each other to challenge the Lord’s Spirit? Look! The feet of those who buried your husband are at the door. They will carry you out too.”
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Kay ano nga ginsarihan man niyo nga duha an Espiritu han Ginoo? Aada pa yana ha porta an mga tawo nga naglubong han imo bana, ngan hira liwat an magdadara ha imo.”

en: At that very moment, she dropped dead at his feet. When the young men entered and found her dead, they carried her out and buried her with her husband.
war: Natumba hiya dayon ha tiilan ni Pedro ngan namatay. Sinmulod an mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an ngan hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya. Gindara hiya nira ha gawas ngan iginlubong sapit han iya bana.

en: Trepidation and dread seized the whole church and all who heard what had happened.
war: Duro gud an kahadlok han bug-os nga singbahan ngan han ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini.

en: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. They would come together regularly at Solomon’s Porch.
war: Ginbuhat han mga apostoles dida han mga tawo in damo nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon. Nagkatirok an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon didto han Balkon ni Solomon.

en: No one from outside the church dared to join them, even though the people spoke highly of them.
war: Waray taga gawas han hugpo nga nagpasipara hin pagtampo ha ira bisan kon hitaas an pagtahod ha ira han mga tawo.

en: Indeed, more and more believers in the Lord, large numbers of both men and women, were added to the church.
war: Kundi nagtikadamo an mga tawo nga nahidugang han ira hugpo—kadam-an nga kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an nga tinmoo han Ginoo.

en: As a result, they would even bring the sick out into the main streets and lay them on cots and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow could fall on some of them as he passed by.
war: Tungod han ginbuhat han mga apostoles, iginggawas an mga magsakit ngadto han kadalanan, ngan ginpahigda hira ha mga bantayaw ngan mga banig, basi ha paglabay ni Pedro, malambongan na man la in bisan pira ha ira.

en: Even large numbers of persons from towns around Jerusalem would gather, bringing the sick and those harassed by unclean spirits. Everyone was healed.
war: Ngan nagkaabot in damo nga mga tawo tikang han kaburubungtohan nga hirani ha Jerusalem, dara an ira mga magsakit ngan an may-ada magraot nga espiritu, ngan nagkauupay ini hira ngatanan.

en: The high priest, together with his allies, the Sadducees, was overcome with jealousy.
war: Niyan an Labaw nga Padi ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga kaupod nga mga sakop han hugpo han mga Sadusiyo naawa hin duro han mga apostoles, sanglit nagkaurosa hira hin pagpugong ha ira.

en: They seized the apostles and made a public show of putting them in prison.
war: Gindakop nira an mga apostoles ngan iginsulod ha prisohan.

en: An angel from the Lord opened the prison doors during the night and led them out. The angel told them,
war: Kundi hito ngahaw nga gab-i gin-abrehan hin usa nga anghel han Ginoo an mga portahan han prisohan ngan ginpagawas an mga apostoles, ngan nagsiring ha ira,

en: “Go, take your place in the temple, and tell the people everything about this new life.”
war: “Kadto ngan tindog kamo didto ha Templo ngan pagsumati an mga tawo mahitungod hini nga bag-o nga kinabuhi.”

en: Early in the morning, they went into the temple as they had been told and began to teach.
war: Gintuman ini han mga apostoles, ngan han maagahon pa sinmulod hira han Templo ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo.

en: When the high priest and his colleagues gathered, they convened the Jerusalem Council, that is, the full assembly of Israel’s elders. They sent word to the prison to have the apostles brought before them.
war: An Labaw nga Padi ngan han iya mga kaupod nagtawag han ngatanan nga katigurangan nga Judiyo ngadto hin usa nga katirok han Labaw nga Hukmanan. Niyan nagsugo hira hin pagkuha han mga apostoles ha prisohan basi umatubang ha ira.

en: However, the guards didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
war: Kundi han pagkadto didto han mga opisyal, waray na didto an mga apostoles. Sanglit binmalik hira ngadto han Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan nagsumat,

en: “We found the prison locked and well-secured, with guards standing at the doors, but when we opened the doors we found no one inside!”
war: “Han pag-abot namon ha prisohan, hinkit-an namon nga trinangkahan ini hin maupay ngan binantayan an mga portahan han ngatanan nga mga gwardya; kundi han pag-abrehi na namon han mga portahan, waray namon hinkit-an nga tawo ha sulod!”

en: When they received this news, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were baffled and wondered what might be happening.
war: Han pakabati hini han kapitan han mga gwardya han Templo, ngan han mga puno han kapadian, nahipausa hira kon ano an nahinabo han mga apostoles.

en: Just then, someone arrived and announced, “Look! The people you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people!”
war: Niyan inmabot in usa ka tawo nga nagsiring ha ira, “An mga tawo nga iyo ginpriso aadto na ha Templo nagtututdo han mga tawo!”

en: Then the captain left with his guards and brought the apostles back. They didn’t use force because they were afraid the people would stone them.
war: Sanglit kinmadto ha Templo an kapitan upod an iya mga sakop, ngan gindakop nira an mga apostoles. Kundi waray hira gumamit hin kusog kay nahadlok hira nga bangin pagbatoon hira han mga tawo.

en: The apostles were brought before the council where the high priest confronted them:
war: Ginpasulod nira an mga apostoles, ginpaatubang han Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan ginpakianhan hira han Labaw nga Padi.

en: “In no uncertain terms, we demanded that you not teach in this name. And look at you! You have filled Jerusalem with your teaching. And you are determined to hold us responsible for this man’s death.”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Amon kamo gindid-an hin mahigpit nga diri kamo magtutdo ha ngaran hini nga tawo, kundi kitaa an iyo ginbuhat! Iginpasarang niyo ha bug-os nga Jerusalem an iyo pagturon-an, ngan karuyag pa niyo nga kami an pagbasolon han iya pagkamatay!”

en: Peter and the apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than humans!
war: Binmaton hi Pedro ngan an iba nga mga apostoles, “Kinahanglan pagsugton namon an Dyos, diri an mga tawo.

en: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a tree.
war: Nagbanhaw kan Jesus an Dyos han amon kaapoy-apoyan kahuman niyo pataya hiya pinaagi hin pagraysangan ha iya ha kros.

en: God has exalted Jesus to his right side as leader and savior so that he could enable Israel to change its heart and life and to find forgiveness for sins.
war: Ngan ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos ngadto ha iya tuo sugad nga Pangulo ngan Magtaralwas, hin paghatag ha mga tawo han Israel hin higayon hin pagbasol, ngan basi mapasaylo an ira mga sala.

en: We are witnesses of such things, as is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
war: Mga saksi kami hini nga mga butang—kami ngan an Espiritu Santo nga amo an hatag han Dyos hadton mga nagsusugot ha iya.”

en: When the council members heard this, they became furious and wanted to kill the apostles.
war: Han pakabati hini han mga kaapi han Labaw nga Hukmanan, uraura gud an ira kasina, nga karuyag nira ipapatay an mga apostoles.

en: One council member, a Pharisee and teacher of the Law named Gamaliel, well-respected by all the people, stood up and ordered that the men be taken outside for a few moments.
war: Kundi tinmindog in usa ha ira, usa nga Parisiyo nga ginngaranan nga Gamaliel, usa nga magturutdo han Balaod, nga tinahod kaupay han ngatanan nga mga tawo. Nagsugo hiya nga pagawson anay an mga apostoles,

en: He said, “Fellow Israelites, consider carefully what you intend to do to these people.
war: ngan ginsiring niya an Labaw nga Hukmanan: “Mga taga-Israel, panginano kamo hin maupay han iyo pagbubuhaton hini nga mga tawo.

en: Some time ago, Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and some four hundred men joined him. After he was killed, all of his followers scattered, and nothing came of that.
war: May-ada hadto tawo nga Teudas an ngaran, nga napadako nga pagkatawo, ngan tinmampo ha iya in mga upat ka gatos nga mga tawo. Kundi ginpatay hiya ngan nagkaburublag an ngatanan niya nga mga sakop, ngan nakawang an iya panlimbasog.

en: Afterward, at the time of the census, Judas the Galilean appeared and got some people to follow him in a revolt. He was killed too, and all his followers scattered far and wide.
war: Ha panahon liwat han pagsensos pinmakita hi Judas nga taga-Galilea, ngan nakakabig hiya hin damo nga mga tawo, kundi ginpatay liwat hiya ngan nagkaburublag an ngatanan niya nga mga sakop.

en: Here’s my recommendation in this case: Distance yourselves from these men. Let them go! If their plan or activity is of human origin, it will end in ruin.
war: Sanglit sugad hini yana nga hinabo, nasiring ako ha iyo nga ayaw kamo paghilabot hini nga mga tawo. Pabay-i niyo hira kay kon kanan tawo la ini nga ira ginlarang ngan ginbuhat, makakawang gud ini.

en: If it originates with God, you won’t be able to stop them. Instead, you would actually find yourselves fighting God!” The council was convinced by his reasoning.
war: Kundi kon tikang sa Dyos ini, diri gud kamo makakadaog ha ira. Masabot pa la kamo nga nakikig-away kamo han Dyos!”

en: After calling the apostles back, they had them beaten. They ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, then let them go.
war: Ginsunod han Labaw nga Hukmanan an sagdon ni Gamaliel.

en: About that time, while the number of disciples continued to increase, a complaint arose. Greek-speaking disciples accused the Aramaic-speaking disciples because their widows were being overlooked in the daily food service.
war: Waray pag-iha, han nagtitikadamo na an mga tinun-an, nagkamay-ada larolantugi an mga Judiyo nga Griego an yinaknan kontra han mga tuminungnong nga Judiyo. Nagkamay-ada pag-uba an mga Judiyo nga Griego an yinaknan kay napapasibay-an an ira mga balo nga kababayen-an han adlaw-adlaw nga panhatag han ira garastohon nga kwarta.

en: The Twelve called a meeting of all the disciples and said, “It isn’t right for us to set aside proclamation of God’s word in order to serve tables.
war: Sanglit gintirok han dose nga mga apostoles an bug-os nga hugpo han mga magtinuohon ngan ginsiring hira, “Diri maupay para ha amon nga bayaan namon an pagwali han pulong han Dyos tungod hin panimangno hin mga butang bahin hin salapi.

en: Brothers and sisters, carefully choose seven well-respected men from among you. They must be well-respected and endowed by the Spirit with exceptional wisdom. We will put them in charge of this concern.
war: Sanglit, kabugtoan, pagpili kamo dida ha iyo hin pito ka tawo nga maupay an kinabuhi ngan puno han Espiritu Santo ug kinaadman, ngan itatapod namon ha ira ini nga buruhaton.

en: As for us, we will devote ourselves to prayer and the service of proclaiming the word.”
war: Tungod hini magagamit namon an amon bug-os nga panahon hin pag-ampo ngan pagwali.”

en: This proposal pleased the entire community. They selected Stephen, a man endowed by the Holy Spirit with exceptional faith, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
war: Naruyagan han bug-os nga hugpo an iginlarang han mga apostoles, sanglit ginpili nira hi Esteban nga puno hin pagtoo ngan han Espiritu Santo, ngan hira Felipe, Procuro, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, ug Nicolas na taga-Antioquia, usa nga Hentil nga nakabig ngadto ha tuluohan han mga Judiyo.

en: The community presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
war: Gindara hira han hugpo ngadto han mga apostoles, ngan an mga apostoles nag-ampo ngan nagpandong han ira mga kamot ha ira.

en: God’s word continued to grow. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased significantly. Even a large group of priests embraced the faith.
war: Ngan nagpadayon paglurab an pulong han Dyos. Nagtikadamo an mga magtinuohon ha Jerusalem ngan kadam-an nga kapadian nga Judiyo in tinmampo.

en: Stephen, who stood out among the believers for the way God’s grace was at work in his life and for his exceptional endowment with divine power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.
war: Hi Esteban nga usa ka tawo nga puno han grasya ug gahom han Dyos nagbuhat hin dagko nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon dida han mga tawo.

en: Opposition arose from some who belonged to the so-called Synagogue of Former Slaves. Members from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and Asia entered into debate with Stephen.
war: Kundi sinmupak ha iya in mga tawo nga kaapi han sinagoga han ginngangaranan nga Talwas nga mga tawo, nga may mga Judiyo nga taga-Cirene ngan taga-Alejandria. Nakiglantugi kan Esteban hira ngan iba pa nga mga Judiyo nga taga-Cilicia ngan taga-Asia.

en: However, they couldn’t resist the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.
war: Kundi an Espiritu naghatag kan Esteban hin dako nga kinaadman, sanglit waray gud hira makakabaton ha iya.

en: Then they secretly enticed some people to claim, “We heard him insult Moses and God.”
war: Sanglit nagsuhol hira hin mga tawo hin pagpasiring, “Nakabati kami ha iya nga nagpapakaraot kan Moises ngan han Dyos!”

en: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the legal experts. They caught Stephen, dragged him away, and brought him before the Jerusalem Council.
war: Dida hini nga paagi gintukso nira hin kasina kan Esteban an mga tawo, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod. Gindakop nira hi Esteban ngan gindara ngadto ha atubangan han Labaw nga Hukmanan.

en: Before the council, they presented false witnesses who testified, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and the Law.
war: Niyan ginpasulod nira in mga tawo hin pagbuwa kontra ha iya. Nagsiring ini hira, “Pirme nagyiyinakan ini nga tawo kontra han aton baraan nga Templo ngan han Balaod ni Moises.

en: In fact, we heard him say that this man Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and alter the customary practices Moses gave us.”
war: Nakabati kami nga nagsiring hiya nga pagrurub-on hini nga Jesus nga taga-Nazaret ini nga Templo ngan pagliliwaton an ngatanan nga mga turumanon nga iginbilin ni Moises ha aton!”

en: Everyone seated in the council stared at Stephen, and they saw that his face was radiant, just like an angel’s.
war: Tinmutok kan Esteban an ngatanan nga nalingkod ha Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan kinmita hira nga an nawong ni Esteban sugad hin nawong hin usa nga anghel.

en: The high priest asked, “Are these accusations true?”
war: Nagpakiana kan Esteban an Labaw nga Padi, “Matuod ba ini?”

en: Stephen responded, “Brothers and fathers, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he settled in Haran.
war: Nagbaton hi Esteban: “Kabugtoan ngan mga ginikanan, pamatii ako niyo! Han waray pa hi Abraham nga aton ginikanan pag-ukoy didto ha Haran, nagpakita ha iya an Dyos han Kagamhanan didto ha Mesopotamia.

en: God told him, ‘Leave your homeland and kin, and go to the land that I will show you.’
war: Ngan ginsiring hiya, ‘Bayai an imo panimalay ngan an imo nasod ngan kadto han tuna nga igpapakita ko ha imo.’

en: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After Abraham’s father died, God had him resettle in this land where you now live.
war: Sanglit binayaan niya an tuna han Caldea ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto ha Haran. Han kamatay han amay ni Abraham, ginpabalhin hiya han Dyos nganhi hini nga tuna nga inuokyan niyo yana.

en: God didn’t give him an inheritance here, not even a square foot of land. However, God did promise to give the land as his possession to him and to his descendants, even though Abraham had no child.
war: Waray pa hadto maghatag an Dyos kan Abraham hin bisan ano nga bahin hito nga tuna, nga iya kalugaringon nga bahin, bisan na man la usa ka dangaw nga tuna. Kundi nagsaad an Dyos nga ighahatag ini ha iya, ngan hiya na ngan an iya mga sumurunod an magtatag-iya hini. Waray pa mga anak hi Abraham han pagsaad han Dyos hini.

en: God put it this way: “ His descendants will be strangers in a land that belongs to others, who will enslave them and abuse them for four hundred years. ”
war: Amo ini an siring han Dyos ha iya: ‘Mag-uokoy an imo mga tulin didto ha langyaw nga tuna diin magigin mga oripon ngan pagraraogdaogon hira sulod hin 400 ka tuig.

en: “ And I will condemn the nation they serve as slaves, ”God said, “ and afterward they will leave ” that land and serve me in this place.
war: Kundi sisirotan ko an mga tawo nga pagsisirbehan nira, ngan katapos, magawas hira hito nga tuna ngan magsisingba hira ha akon dinhe hini nga dapit.’

en: God gave him the covenant confirmed through circumcision. Accordingly, eight days after Isaac’s birth, Abraham circumcised him. Isaac did the same with Jacob, and Jacob with the twelve patriarchs.
war: Ngan iginhatag han Dyos kan Abraham an seremonyas han pagtori sugad nga tigaman han ginsabotan. Sanglit gintori ni Abraham hi Isaac ha ikawalo ka adlaw tikang hiya matawo; gintori liwat ni Isaac hi Jacob, ngan gintori ni Jacob an iya dose nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga amo an mga patriyarka.

en: “Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him into slavery in Egypt. God was with him, however,
war: “Naawa kan Jose an mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Jacob ngan iginbaligya nira hiya nga oripon didto ha Ehipto. Kundi nag-upod ha iya an Dyos,

en: and rescued him from all his troubles. The grace and wisdom he gave Joseph were recognized by Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and over his whole palace.
war: ngan nagtalwas ha iya han ngatanan nga kakurian niya. Han pag-atubang ni Jose kan Paraon nga hadi han Ehipto, gintagan hiya han Dyos hin maupay nga ginawian ug kinaadman. Ginhimo ni Paraon hi Jose nga gobernador han nasod ngan han hadianon nga panimalay.

en: A famine came upon all Egypt and Canaan, and great hardship came with it. Our ancestors had nothing to eat.
war: Niyan nagkamay-ada kagutom ha bug-os nga Ehipto ngan ha Canaan, nga nakahatag hin dako nga kakurian, ngan waray sadang makaon an aton mga kaapoy-apoyan.

en: When Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
war: Sanglit han pakabati ni Jacob nga may trigo didto ha Ehipto, ginsugo niya ngadto an iya mga anak nga aton kaapoy-apoyan. Amo adto an ira syahan nga pagduaw.

en: During their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.
war: Han ikaduha nira nga pagkadto, nagpakilala hi Jose han iya kabugtoan, ngan nakilala ni Paraon an panimalay ni Jose.

en: Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives—seventy-five in all—and invited them to live with him.
war: Sanglit nagpatugon hi Jose kan Jacob nga amay niya, nga pakadtoon ha Ehipto hiya ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay; 75 ka tawo hira ngatanan.

en: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.
war: Ngan kinmadto hi Jacob ha Ehipto diin namatay hiya ngan an iya mga anak.

en: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had purchased for a certain sum of money from Hamor’s children, who lived in Shechem.
war: Gindara an ira mga lawas ngadto ha Siquem ngan iginlubong hira didto han lubnganan nga ginpalit ni Abraham tikang han panimalay ni Hamor.

en: “When it was time for God to keep the promise he made to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly expanded.
war: “Han tikahirani na an panahon hin pagtuman han Dyos han iginsaad niya kan Abraham, nagdamo na hin duro an aton mga tawo didto ha Ehipto.

en: But then “ another king rose to power over Egypt who didn’t know anything about Joseph. ”
war: Niyan may sinmaliwan hin paghadi ha Ehipto nga diri nakilala kan Jose.

en: He exploited our people and abused our ancestors. He even forced them to abandon their newly born babies so they would die.
war: Ginlimbongan niya an aton kaapoy-apoyan ngan iya ginraogdaog hira, ngan ginpirit hira hin pagbutang ha gawas han ira mga balay han ira mga minasus-an basi ini hira magkamatay.

en: That’s when Moses was born. He was highly favored by God, and for three months his parents cared for him in their home.
war: Hini manta nga panahon natawo hi Moises, usa nga bata nga makalilipay gud pagkit-on. Sulod hin tulo ka bulan ginmangnoan hiya han iya mga kag-anak didto han ira balay.

en: After he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter adopted and cared for him as though he were her own son.
war: Ngan han pagbutangan na ha iya ha gawas han balay, gin-angkon ngan ginmangnoan hiya han anak nga babaye ni Paraon sugad hin iya kalugaringon nga anak.

en: Moses learned everything Egyptian wisdom had to offer, and he was a man of powerful words and deeds.
war: Gintutdoan hi Moises han ngatanan nga kinaadman han mga taga-Ehipto, ngan nagin bantogan hiya ha pulong ug ha buhat.

en: “When Moses was 40 years old, he decided to visit his family, the Israelites.
war: “Han 40 na ka tuig an edad ni Moises naghunahuna hiya hin pagduaw han iya mga igkasi-Israelita.

en: He saw one of them being wronged so he came to his rescue and evened the score by killing the Egyptian.
war: Hinkit-an niya in usa ha ira nga ginkakastigo hin Ehiptohanon; sanglit inugopan ini niya ngan ginpatay niya an Ehiptohanon. (

en: He expected his own kin to understand that God was using him to rescue them, but they didn’t.
war: Naghunahuna hiya nga makakasabot an iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga gagamiton hiya han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha ira; kundi waray hira makasabot.)

en: The next day he came upon some Israelites who were caught up in an argument. He tried to make peace between them by saying, ‘You are brothers! Why are you harming each other?’
war: Han pagkabuwas, hinkit-an niya in duha nga Israelita nga nag-aaway ngan gintinguha niya hin pagtuhay ha ira. Nagsiring hiya, ‘Mga sangkay ko, pamatii daw ako niyo! Magbugto la kamo; kay ano nga nag-aaway man kamo?’

en: The one who started the fight against his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, “ ‘Who appointed you as our leader and judge? ”
war: Kundi an nagkakastigo han iya kaaway nagtikwang la kan Moises ngan nagpakiana, ‘Hin-o an naghimo ha imo nga punoan ngan maghurukom ha amon?

en: “ Are you planning to kill me like you killed that Egyptian yesterday?’ ”
war: Buot mo ba patayon ako sugad han pagpatay mo han Ehiptohanon kakulop?’

en: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he lived as an immigrant and had two sons.
war: Han pakabati hini ni Moises, pinmalagiw hiya ha Ehipto ngan nag-ukoy didto ha tuna han Madian. Didto magkamay-ada hiya duha nga anak nga lalake.

en: “Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses in the flame of a burning bush in the wilderness near Mount Sinai.
war: “Pag-agi hin 40 ka tuig, nagpakita kan Moises in usa nga anghel dida hin naglalaga nga tanom, didto ha kamingawan hirani han Bukid Sinai.

en: Enthralled by the sight, Moses approached to get a closer look and he heard the Lord’s voice:
war: Nahipausa hi Moises han iya hinkit-an, ngan hinmarani hiya han tanom hin pag-usisa. Kundi hinbatian niya an tingog han Ginoo nga nasiring,

en: ‘“ I am the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. ”’ Trembling with fear, Moses didn’t dare to investigate any further.
war: ‘Amo ako an Dyos han imo kaapoy-apoyan, an Dyos ni Abraham, ni Isaac, ug ni Jacob.’ Kinmurog hi Moises hin kahadlok ngan waray na mangahas hin pagkita.

en: The Lord continued, ‘“ Remove the sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy ground. ”
war: Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, ‘Hukasa an imo mga sandalyas kay baraan nga tuna an imo tinitindogan.

en: “ I have clearly seen the oppression my people have experienced in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning. I have come down to rescue them. Come! I am sending you to Egypt ”.’
war: Hinkit-an ko an mapait nga pag-antos han akon mga tawo didto ha Ehipto, ngan hinbatian ko an ira mga araba, sanglit linmusad ako hin pagtalwas ha ira. Hala na, ipapadara ko ikaw ngadto ha Ehipto.’

en: “This is the same Moses whom they rejected when they asked, ‘Who appointed you as our leader and judge?’ This is the Moses whom God sent as leader and deliverer. God did this with the help of the angel who appeared before him in the bush.
war: “Amo ini nga Moises an iginsalikway han mga tawo han Israel ngan ginpakianhan, ‘Hin-o an naghimo ha imo nga punoan ngan maghurukom ha amon?’ Amo hiya an ginsugo han Dyos nga punoan ngan magtaralwas han mga tawo nga binuligan han anghel nga nagpakita ha iya dida han naglalaga nga tanom.

en: This man led them out after he performed wonders and signs in Egypt at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.
war: Nangulo hiya han mga tawo hin paggawas ha Ehipto ngan nagbuhat hiya hin mga milagro ngan mga urosahon didto ha Ehipto ngan ha Dagat nga Pula, ngan didto ha kamingawan sulod hin 40 ka tuig.

en: This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘“ God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people. ”’
war: Amo ini nga Moises an nagsiring ha mga tawo han Israel, ‘Magpapadara ha iyo an Dyos hin manaragna sugad han pagpadara niya ha akon, ngan magigin usa hiya han iyo kalugaringon nga mga tawo.’

en: This is the one who was in the assembly in the wilderness with our ancestors and with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai. He is the one who received life-giving words to give to us.
war: Amo ini hiya an kaupod han mga tawo han Israel nga nagkatirok didto ha kamingawan; didto hiya kaupod han aton kaapoy-apoyan ngan han anghel nga nagyakan ha iya didto ha Bukid Sinai. Kinarawat niya an buhi nga mga mensahe han Dyos basi ihatag ha aton.

en: He’s also the one whom our ancestors refused to obey. Instead, they pushed him aside and, in their thoughts and desires, returned to Egypt.
war: “Kundi nagdumiri hin pagsugot ha iya an aton kaapoy-apoyan. Ginsalikway nira hiya ngan karuyag nira makabalik unta ngadto ha Ehipto.

en: They told Aaron, ‘“ Make us gods that will lead us. As for this Moses who led us out of Egypt, we don’t know what’s happened to him! ”’
war: Sanglit ginsiring nira hi Aaron, ‘Ighimo kami hin mga diyosdiyos nga mag-uuna ha amon. Diri kami maaram kon ano an nahinabo hadto nga Moises nga nagpagawas ha amon tikang ha Ehipto.’

en: That’s when they made an idol in the shape of a calf, offered a sacrifice to it, and began to celebrate what they had made with their own hands.
war: Ngan naghimo hira hin diyosdiyos nga hitsora hin lalaki nga baka; ginhalaran nira ini, ngan nagrayhak hira hin pagsaurog han ira ngahaw ginhimo.

en: So God turned away from them and handed them over to worship the stars in the sky, just as it is written in the scroll of the Prophets:
war: Sanglit tinalikdan hira han Dyos ngan ginpasagdan nga magsingba han mga kabiton-an ha kalangitan, sumala han iginsurat ha basahan han mga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: “ Did you bring sacrifices and offerings to me ”
war: ‘Katawhan han Israel! Diri adto para ha akon

en: “ for forty years in the wilderness, house of Israel? ”
war: nga nag-ihaw ngan naghalad kamo hin kahayopan

en: “ No! Instead, you took the tent of Moloch with you, ”
war: sulod hin 40 ka tuig didto ha kamingawan.

en: “ and the star of your god Rephan, ”
war: Tulda adto han diyosdiyos nga hi Molok nga iyo gindara,

en: “ the images that you made in order to worship them. ”
war: ngan an ladawan han iyo bitoon nga diyosdiyos nga hi Refan;

en: “ Therefore, I will send you far away, farther than Babylon. ”
war: mga ladawan hira nga ginhimo niyo basi pagsingbahon.

en: “The tent of testimony was with our ancestors in the wilderness. Moses built it just as he had been instructed by the one who spoke to him and according to the pattern he had seen.
war: Sanglit ipabibihag ko kamo ngadto ha unhan pa han Babilonia.’

en: In time, when they had received the tent, our ancestors carried it with them when, under Joshua’s leadership, they took possession of the land from the nations whom God expelled. This tent remained in the land until the time of David.
war: “An aton kaapoy-apoyan may-ada didto ha kamingawan Tulda diin nagpapakita an Dyos. Ginhimo adto ni Moises sugad han iginsiring han Dyos ha iya, sumala han surubdan nga iginpakita ha iya han Dyos.

en: God approved of David, who asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
war: Niyan gindara han aton kaapoy-apoyan ini nga Tulda nga ira kinarawat tikang han ira mga ginikanan ha ira pag-upod-upod kan Josue ngan pagtag-iya han tuna nga ira naagaw tikang han mga nasod nga gintabog han Dyos dida han ira pagsulong. Ngan nagpabilin didto an Tulda tubtob han panahon ni David.

en: But it was Solomon who actually built a house for God.
war: Nakalipay han Dyos hi David, ngan naghangyo hiya han Dyos nga tugotan hiya hin pagtindog hin urokyan han Dyos ni Jacob.

en: However, the Most High doesn’t live in houses built by human hands. As the prophet says,
war: Kundi hi Solomon na an nagtindog hini nga balay.

en: “ Heaven is my throne, ”
war: “Kundi diri nag-uokoy an Labi ka Harangdon nga Dyos ha mga balay nga gintindog hin mga tawo; sumala han siring han manaragna:

en: “ and the earth is my footstool. ”
war: ‘An langit amo an akon trono, nasiring an Ginoo,

en: “ ‘What kind of house will you build for me,’ says the Lord, ”
war: ngan an tuna amo an taramakan han akon mga tiil.

en: “ ‘or where is my resting place? ”
war: Ano nga balay an iyo hihimoon para ha akon?

en: “ Didn’t I make all these things with my own hand?’ ”
war: Hain man an dapit nga akon pag-uokyan?

en: “You stubborn people! In your thoughts and hearing, you are like those who have had no part in God’s covenant! You continuously set yourself against the Holy Spirit, just like your ancestors did.
war: Diri ba ako ngahaw an naghimo hini ngatanan nga mga butang?’

en: Was there a single prophet your ancestors didn’t harass? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the righteous one, and you’ve betrayed and murdered him!
war: “Pagkamatig-a han iyo mga ulo! Pagkadiri matinuohon han iyo mga kasingkasing! Pagkabungol niyo han mensahe han Dyos! Pareho gud kamo han iyo mga ginikanan: dayuday sinusupak niyo an Espiritu Santo!

en: You received the Law given by angels, but you haven’t kept it.”
war: May-ada ha manaragna nga waray pagpakurii han iyo mga ginikanan? Ginpatay nira an mga surugoon han Dyos nga hadto pa nagpahibaro mahitungod han pag-abot han iya matadong nga Surugoon. Ngan yana iyo ginlingo ngan ginpatay hiya.

en: Once the council members heard these words, they were enraged and began to grind their teeth at Stephen.
war: Hi kamo an kinmarawat han Balaod han Dyos nga iginhatag pinaagi hin mga anghel, kundi waray ini niyo pagtumana!”

en: But Stephen, enabled by the Holy Spirit, stared into heaven and saw God’s majesty and Jesus standing at God’s right side.
war: Han namamati kan Esteban an mga sakop han Labaw nga Hukmanan, duro gud an ira kasina ngan nanligot an ira mga ngipon tungod hin kapungot ha iya.

en: He exclaimed, “Look! I can see heaven on display and the Human One standing at God’s right side!”
war: Kundi hinmangad ha langit hi Esteban nga puno han Espiritu, ngan nakita niya an himaya han Dyos ngan hi Jesus nga natindog ha tuo han Dyos.

en: At this, they shrieked and covered their ears. Together, they charged at him,
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, nakita ako nga nabuksan an langit ngan an Anak han Tawo nga natindog ha tuo han Dyos!”

en: threw him out of the city, and began to stone him. The witnesses placed their coats in the care of a young man named Saul.
war: Sinagpo han ira mga kamot an ira mga talinga upod in paggoliat, ngan nagdurungan hira ngatanan hin pagdasmag ha iya.

en: As they battered him with stones, Stephen prayed, “Lord Jesus, accept my life!”
war: Ginlabog hiya nira ngadto ha gawas han syudad, ngan didto ginbato hiya. Iginbutang han mga saksi an ira mga kurugpos ha tiilan hin usa nga batan-on nga Saulo an ngaran.

en: Falling to his knees, he shouted, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” Then he died.
war: Ginbinato nira hi Esteban samtang nag-aampo hiya han Ginoo nga nasiring, “Ginoo nga Jesus, karawata an akon espiritu!”

en: Saul was in full agreement with Stephen’s murder.
war: Hito manta nga adlaw nagtikang hin pag-antos hin mabangis nga pagpakurii an singbahan ha Jerusalem. Nagkaburublag an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon, labot han mga apostoles, ngadto han mga lalawigan ha Judea ug ha Samaria.

en: At that time, the church in Jerusalem began to be subjected to vicious harassment. Everyone except the apostles was scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria.
war: Ginlubong hi Esteban hin pira nga mga tawo nga mag-inampoon, ngan nagmasulub-on gud hira tungod hin dako nga pagkabido nira ha iya.

en: Some pious men buried Stephen and deeply grieved over him.
war: Kundi gintinguha ni Saulo hin pagpukan han singbahan; ginbalaybalay niya hin pagsiksik han mga magtinuohon nga lalake ug babaye, ngan iya ini hira gindanas ngan ginsulod ha prisohan.

en: Saul began to wreak havoc against the church. Entering one house after another, he would drag off both men and women and throw them into prison.
war: An nagkaburublag nga mga magtinuohon napakadto ha magkalainlain nga dapit ngan nagpasangyaw han mensahe.

en: Those who had been scattered moved on, preaching the good news along the way.
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe ha syudad ha Samaria ngan didto iginwali niya ha mga tawo an Mesiyas.

en: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and began to preach Christ to them.
war: Namati hin maupay an mga tawo han iginsiring ni Felipe. Namati hira ha iya, ngan nakakita hira han mga milagro nga iya ginbuhat.

en: The crowds were united by what they heard Philip say and the signs they saw him perform, and they gave him their undivided attention.
war: Nagkagawas nga naggogoliat an magraot nga mga espiritu tikang hin damo nga mga tawo. Damo nga mga paralitiko ngan mga piay in nagkauupay.

en: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many people, and many who were paralyzed or crippled were healed.
war: Sanglit nagkamay-ada dako nga kalipay ha bug-os nga Samaria.

en: There was great rejoicing in that city.
war: Nag-ukoy didto hadto nga syudad in usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan nga Simon. Nakapahiburong hiya han mga Samaritano sulod hin pira ka panahon tungod han iya salamangka. Nagpatoo hiya nga gamhanan hiya,

en: Before Philip’s arrival, a certain man named Simon had practiced sorcery in that city and baffled the people of Samaria. He claimed to be a great person.
war: ngan pinamatian gud hiya han ngatanan nga mga tawo han katilingban. Nagsiring hira, “Amo hiya an gahom han Dyos nga ginngangaranan, ‘An Dako nga Gahom’.”

en: Everyone, from the least to the greatest, gave him their undivided attention and referred to him as “the power of God called Great.”
war: Sulod hin maiha nga panahon nakapahiburong hiya ha ira tungod han iya salamangka, sanglit pinamatian gud hiya nira.

en: He had their attention because he had baffled them with sorcery for a long time.
war: Kundi han pagtoo na nira han iginsangyaw ni Felipe mahitungod han Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian han Dyos ngan han ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo, ginbunyagan hira, kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an.

en: After they came to believe Philip, who preached the good news about God’s kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.
war: Tinmoo man liwat hi Simon, ngan kahuman pagbunyagi ha iya, nag-upodupod hiya kan Felipe. Ngan nahipausa hiya han pakakita niya han mga urosahon ngan mga milagro nga ginbuhat.

en: Even Simon himself came to believe and was baptized. Afterward, he became one of Philip’s supporters. As he saw firsthand the signs and great miracles that were happening, he was astonished.
war: Han pakabati han mga apostoles ha Jerusalem nga kinmarawat han pulong han Dyos an mga tawo ha Samaria, iginpadara nira hi Pedro ug Juan ngadto ha ira.

en: When word reached the apostles in Jerusalem that Samaria had accepted God’s word, they commissioned Peter and John to go to Samaria.
war: Han pag-abot nira, nag-ampo hira para han mga magtinuohon basi makarawat nira han Espiritu Santo.

en: Peter and John went down to Samaria where they prayed that the new believers would receive the Holy Spirit. (
war: Kay waray pa man kumunsad an Espiritu Santo ha bisan usa ha ira; ginbunyagan la hira ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Jesus.

en: This was because the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen on any of them; they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
war: Niyan iginpandong nira Pedro ug Juan an ira mga kamot ha ira, ngan kinarawat nira an Espiritu Santo.

en: So Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
war: Hinkit-an ni Simon nga iginhatag ha mga tawo an Espiritu Santo dida han pagpandongi ha ira han mga kamot han mga apostoles. Sanglit ginhugay niya hin salapi hira Pedro ug Juan,

en: When Simon perceived that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
war: ngan ginsiring, “Tagi man ako niyo hini nga gahom, basi bisan hin-o an akon pagpandongan, makarawat liwat han Espiritu Santo.”

en: He said, “Give me this authority too so that anyone on whom I lay my hands will receive the Holy Spirit.”
war: Kundi ginbaton hiya ni Pedro, “Maghikaraot unta ikaw upod an imo kwarta tungod han imo paghunahuna nga mapapalit mo hin kwarta an hatag han Dyos!

en: Peter responded, “May your money be condemned to hell along with you because you believed you could buy God’s gift with money!
war: Waray ka bahin o labot han amon buruhaton kay diri matadong an imo kasingkasing ha atubangan han Dyos.

en: You can have no part or share in God’s word because your heart isn’t right with God.
war: Sanglit pagbasoli ini nga maraot mo nga panuyo, ngan pag-ampo ha Ginoo nga pasayloon ka tungod han imo pakahunahuna hin sugad hini.

en: Therefore, change your heart and life! Turn from your wickedness! Plead with the Lord in the hope that your wicked intent can be forgiven,
war: Kay kinikita ko nga duro gud an imo kaawa ngan napripriso ka han sala.”

en: for I see that your bitterness has poisoned you and evil has you in chains.”
war: Nagsiring hi Simon kanda Pedro ug Juan, “Alayon hin pag-ampo ha akon ngadto ha Ginoo basi an mga butang nga ginyakan niyo diri nahinabo ha akon!”

en: Simon replied, “All of you, please, plead to the Lord for me so that nothing of what you have said will happen to me!”
war: Katapos nira pagpamatuod ngan pagsangyaw han mensahe han Ginoo, binmalik ha Jerusalem hira Pedro ug Juan. Iginwali liwat nira an Maupay nga Sumat ha damo nga mga baryo han Samaria nga ira inagian.

en: After the apostles had testified and proclaimed the Lord’s word, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the good news to many Samaritan villages along the way.
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, “Pag-andam ngan kadto ha timogan, ha dalan nga tikang ha Jerusalem tipakadto ha Gaza.” (Diri na ginagamit ini nga dalan.)

en: An angel from the Lord spoke to Philip, “At noon, take the road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.” (This is a desert road.)
war: 27-28 Sanglit nag-andam hi Felipe ngan kinmadto. Niyan may usa nga yunuko nga taga-Etiopia nga tipauli na. Usa hiya nga importante nga opisyal ug tisurero ni Candace o Rayna han Etiopia. Kinmadto hiya ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba han Dyos, ngan nagtitipauli na nga sakay han iya karuwahe. Samtang nagsasakay hiya, nagbibinasa hiya han basahan nga sinurat ni Isaias nga manaragna.

en: So he did. Meanwhile, an Ethiopian man was on his way home from Jerusalem, where he had come to worship. He was a eunuch and an official responsible for the entire treasury of Candace. (Candace is the title given to the Ethiopian queen.)
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe an Espiritu Santo, “Kadtoa ngan duoka ito nga karuwahe.”

en: He was reading the prophet Isaiah while sitting in his carriage.
war: Dinmalagan hin paghirani hi Felipe ngan hinbatian niya nga nagbabasa an yunuko han basahan ni manaragna Isaias. Niyan nagpakiana hi Felipe ha iya, “Nakakasabot ka ba han imo ginbabasa?”

en: The Spirit told Philip, “Approach this carriage and stay with it.”
war: Nagbaton an opisyal, “Uunanhon ko hin pakasabot kon waray magtutdo hini ha akon?” Ngan ginhangyo niya hi Felipe nga sumakay han karuwahe sapit ha iya.

en: Running up to the carriage, Philip heard the man reading the prophet Isaiah. He asked, “Do you really understand what you are reading?”
war: Amo ini an bahin han Kasuratan nga iya ginbabasa:

en: The man replied, “Without someone to guide me, how could I?” Then he invited Philip to climb up and sit with him.
war: “Sugad hiya hin karnero nga gindara basi pag-ihawon.

en: This was the passage of scripture he was reading:
war: Sugad hiya hin nati nga karnero nga waray aringasa kon gin-aarotan.

en: “ Like a sheep he was led to the slaughter ”
war: Ginpakaalohan hiya ngan waray tagi hin katadongan.

en: “ and like a lamb before its shearer is silent ”
war: Waray makakagsumat mahitungod han iya katulinan,

en: “ so he didn’t open his mouth. ”
war: kay natapos na man an iya kinabuhi dinhe ha tuna.”

en: “ In his humiliation justice was taken away from him. ”
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe an opisyal, “Sumati ako kon hin-o an hinnanabihan hini han manaragna. Hiya ba, o lain ba nga tawo?”

en: “ Who can tell the story of his descendants ”
war: Sanglit gin-asoyan hiya ni Felipe han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesus tikang gud dinhe hini nga bahin han Kasuratan.

en: “ because his life was taken from the earth? ”
war: Samtang nagpapadayon hira ha dalan, inmabot hira hin dapit nga may-ada tubig, ngan nagsiring an opisyal, “Iini na in tubig; ano pa man in nakakaulang hin pagbunyag ha akon?”

en: The eunuch asked Philip, “Tell me, about whom does the prophet say this? Is he talking about himself or someone else?”
Starting with that passage, Philip proclaimed the good news about Jesus to him.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Mabubunyagan ka kon kinasingkasing gud an imo pagtoo.”

en: As they went down the road, they came to some water.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Oo, natoo ako nga hi Jesu-Cristo amo an Anak han Dyos.”)

en: The eunuch said, “Look! Water! What would keep me from being baptized?”
war: Ginpaukoy han opisyal an karuwahe, linmugsong hira Felipe ngan an opisyal ngadto han tubig, ngan ginbunyagan hiya ni Felipe.

en: He ordered that the carriage halt. Both Philip and the eunuch went down to the water, where Philip baptized him.
war: Han paghaw-as nira han tubig, gindara hi Felipe han Espiritu han Ginoo ngan waray na hiya hikit-i han opisyal. Kundi nagpadayon hin pagsakay nga malipayon an opisyal.

en: Meanwhile, Saul was still spewing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest,
war: Hini nga panahon nagpadayon hi Saulo han iya mapintas nga mga panarhog hin pagpatay han mga tinun-an han Ginoo. Kinmadto hiya han Labaw nga Padi,

en: seeking letters to the synagogues in Damascus. If he found persons who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, these letters would authorize him to take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
war: ngan nangaro hin mga surat nga magpapakilala ha iya didto ha mga sinagoga han mga Judiyo ha Damasco, basi kon hiagian niya didto in bisan hin-o nga lalake o babaye nga mga sakop han Dalan han Ginoo, makakahimo hiya hin pagdakop ngan ibabalik niya ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: During the journey, as he approached Damascus, suddenly a light from heaven encircled him.
war: Han nagtitikahirani na hi Saulo han syudad han Damasco, tigda la nga nalukop hiya hin kapawa nga tikang ha langit.

en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice asking him, “Saul, Saul, why are you harassing me?”
war: Natumba hiya ngan hinbatian niya in tingog nga nasiring ha iya, “Saulo, Saulo, kay ano nga ginpapakurian mo ako?”

en: Saul asked, “Who are you, Lord?”
war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Hin-o ka ba, Ginoo?”

en: “I am Jesus, whom you are harassing,” came the reply.
war: Binmaton an tingog, “Amo ako hi Jesus nga imo ginpapakurian.

en: “Now get up and enter the city. You will be told what you must do.”
war: Buhat ngan pakadto ha syudad, ngan didto pagsusumatan ka kon ano an imo pagbubuhaton.”

en: Those traveling with him stood there speechless; they heard the voice but saw no one.
war: An mga tawo nga kaupod ni Saulo waray makagkiwa ug makagtingog; hinbatian nira an tingog kundi waray nira hinkit-an nga tawo.

en: After they picked Saul up from the ground, he opened his eyes but he couldn’t see. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
war: Binmuhat hi Saulo ngan ginpukrat niya an iya mga mata, kundi waray na hiya makakita, sanglit gintugwayan hiya ngan gindara hiya nira ngadto ha Damasco.

en: For three days he was blind and neither ate nor drank anything.
war: Sulod hin tulo ka adlaw waray hiya pakakita, ngan hito nga panahon waray hiya kumaon o uminom.

en: In Damascus there was a certain disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!”
war: May-ada didto ha Damasco usa nga tinun-an nga Ananias an ngaran. Pinaagi hin panan-awon nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Ananias!”

en: He answered, “Yes, Lord.”
war: Ngan binmaton hiya, “Iini ako, Ginoo.”

en: The Lord instructed him, “Go to Judas’ house on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul. He is praying.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Pag-andam ngan pakadto ha Matadong nga Dalan ngadto han balay ni Judas ngan pagpakiana mahitungod hin usa ka tawo nga taga-Tarsos, nga Saulo an ngaran. Nag-aampo hiya.

en: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias enter and put his hands on him to restore his sight.”
war: Samtang nag-aampo hiya, hinkit-an niya ha usa nga panan-awon in usa ka tawo nga Ananias an ngaran nga sinmulod ngan iginpandong an iya mga kamot ha iya, basi makakita na liwat hiya.”

en: Ananias countered, “Lord, I have heard many reports about this man. People say he has done horrible things to your holy people in Jerusalem.
war: Binmaton hi Ananias, “Ginoo, damo na in nagsumat ha akon mahitungod hini nga tawo, mahitungod han ngatanan nga magpakaharadlok nga ginbuhat niya ha imo mga tawo didto ha Jerusalem.

en: He’s here with authority from the chief priests to arrest everyone who calls on your name.”
war: Ngan kinmanhi hiya ha Damasco dara in gahom tikang han mga puno han kapadian, hin pagdakop han ngatanan nga natawag han imo ngaran.”

en: The Lord replied, “Go! This man is the agent I have chosen to carry my name before Gentiles, kings, and Israelites.
war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Kadto na, kay ginpili ko hiya hin pagsirbe ha akon, ha pagpakilala han akon ngaran ha mga Hentil ngan mga hadi, ngan sugad man ha mga tawo han Israel.

en: I will show him how much he must suffer for the sake of my name.”
war: Ngan ako ngahaw an magpapakita ha iya han ngatanan nga iya pag-aantoson tungod ha akon.”

en: Ananias went to the house. He placed his hands on Saul and said, “Brother Saul, the Lord sent me—Jesus, who appeared to you on the way as you were coming here. He sent me so that you could see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
war: Sanglit kinmadto hi Ananias han balay ngan iginpandong kan Saulo an iya mga kamot. Nagsiring hiya, “Bugto Saulo, ginsugo ako han Ginoo—ni Jesus ngahaw nga pinmakita ha imo dida ha dalan han imo pagtipakanhi. Ginsugo ako niya basi makakita ka na liwat ngan mapuno ka han Espiritu Santo.”

en: Instantly, flakes fell from Saul’s eyes and he could see again. He got up and was baptized.
war: Nagkataktak dayon in sugad hin mga hingbis hin isda tikang han mga mata ni Saulo, ngan nakakita na liwat hiya. Binmuhat hiya ngan ginbunyagan;

en: After eating, he regained his strength.
war: ngan kahuman han iya pagkaon, nagmakusog hiya.

en: He stayed with the disciples in Damascus for several days.
war: Nagpabilin hi Saulo upod han mga magtinuohon didto ha Damasco sulod hin pira ka adlaw.

en: Right away, he began to preach about Jesus in the synagogues. “He is God’s Son,” he declared.
war: Kinmadto dayon hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagwali nga hi Jesus amo an Anak han Dyos.

en: Everyone who heard him was baffled. They questioned each other, “Isn’t he the one who was wreaking havoc among those in Jerusalem who called on this name? Hadn’t he come here to take those same people as prisoners to the chief priests?”
war: Nanhipausa an ngatanan nga nakabati ha iya ngan nagpakiana, “Diri ba amo ini an tawo didto ha Jerusalem nga nagpinamatay han ngatanan nga nagtatawag han ngaran ni Jesus? Ngan diri ba kinmanhi hiya para hini gud nga tuyo: hin pagdakop ngan pagdara ha ira ngadto han mga puno han kapadian?”

en: But Saul grew stronger and stronger. He confused the Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
war: Kundi nagdugang pa gud hin kamadasigon an pagwali ni Saulo, ngan marig-on kaupay an iya mga pagmatuod nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas. Sanglit waray gud nakabaton ha iya an mga Judiyo nga nag-ukoy didto ha Damasco.

en: After this had gone on for some time, the Jews hatched a plot to kill Saul.
war: Paglabay hin damo nga mga adlaw, nagkatirok an mga Judiyo ngan naglarang hira hin pagpatay kan Saulo;

en: However, he found out about their scheme. They were keeping watch at the city gates around the clock so they could assassinate him.
war: kundi hinbaroan ini niya. Ginbantayan nira adlaw gab-i an mga portahan han syudad basi patayon hiya.

en: But his disciples took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the city wall.
war: Kundi usa ka gab-i ginkuha hi Saulo han iya mga sakop ngan gintunton hiya, sulod hin alat, ngan ginpalusot hiya ha buho han pader.

en: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him. They didn’t believe he was really a disciple.
war: Kinmadto hi Saulo ha Jerusalem ngan nagtinguha hiya hin pagtampo han mga magtinuohon. Kundi waray hira tuod nga tinun-an na hiya, sanglit nagkahadlok hira ngatanan ha iya.

en: Then Barnabas brought Saul to the apostles and told them the story about how Saul saw the Lord on the way and that the Lord had spoken to Saul. He also told them about the confidence with which Saul had preached in the name of Jesus in Damascus.
war: Niyan ginbuligan hiya ni Bernabe ngan gindara hiya ngadto han nga apostoles. Iginsaysay ha ira ni Bernabe mahitungod han pakakita ni Saulo han Ginoo didto ha dalan ngan han pakighimangraw ha iya han Ginoo. Ginsumatan liwat niya hira han kaisog ni Saulo hin pagwali ha ngaran ni Jesus didto ha Damasco.

en: After this, Saul moved freely among the disciples in Jerusalem and was speaking with confidence in the name of the Lord.
war: Sanglit nagpabilin hi Saulo upod ha ira, ngan nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Jerusalem diin nagwali hiya nga madasigon han ngaran han Ginoo.

en: He got into debates with the Greek-speaking Jews as well, but they tried to kill him.
war: Nakigkarokayakan ngan nakiglantugi liwat hiya han mga Judiyo nga Griego an pinulongan, kundi gin-iparatay lugod hiya nira.

en: When the family of believers learned about this, they escorted him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
war: Han paghibaro han mga magtinuohon mahitungod hini, gindara nira hi Saulo ngadto ha Cesarea, ngan ginpakadto hiya ha Tarso.

en: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace. God strengthened the church, and its life was marked by reverence for the Lord. Encouraged by the Holy Spirit, the church continued to grow in numbers.
war: Tungod hini nagkamay-ada kalinaw an singbahan ha bug-os nga Judea, Galilea, ug Samaria. Pinaagi han bulig han Espiritu Santo nagmadig-on an singbahan ngan nagdamo, samtang nagpapadayon hira hin pag-ukoy dida hin kamatinahoron han Ginoo.

en: As Peter toured the whole region, he went to visit God’s holy people in Lydda.
war: Nagsudoy hi Pedro ha ngatanan nga dapit, ngan usa ka panahon kinmadto hiya hin pagduaw han mga tawo han Dyos nga nag-uokoy didto ha Lida.

en: There he found a man named Aeneas who was paralyzed and had been confined to his bed for eight years.
war: Iginkita hiya didto hin tawo nga paralitiko nga Eneas an ngaran. Waray na ini hiya makabuhat sulod hin walo ka tuig.

en: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and make your bed.” At once he got up.
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Pedro, “Eneas, gin-uupay ka ni Jesu-Cristo. Buhat ngan lukota an imo higdaan.” Binmuhat dayon hi Eneas.

en: Everyone who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
war: Nakakita ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga nag-uokoy ha Lida ngan ha Saron, ngan tinmoo hira han Ginoo.

en: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas). Her life overflowed with good works and compassionate acts on behalf of those in need.
war: Didto ha Jope may-ada usa nga matinuohon nga babaye nga ginngangaranan nga Tabita. (Dorcas an iya ngaran ha Griego, nga bugsok an kahulogan.) Ginamit niya an iya bug-os nga panahon hin pagpakaupay ngan pagbulig han mga kablas.

en: About that time, though, she became so ill that she died. After they washed her body, they laid her in an upstairs room.
war: Hito nga panahon nasakit hiya ngan namatay. Ginpunasan an iya lawas ngan ginhayad didto han kwarto ha igbaw.

en: Since Lydda was near Joppa, when the disciples heard that Peter was there, they sent two people to Peter. They urged, “Please come right away!”
war: Diri gud hirayo an Jope tikang ha Lida. Han pakabati han mga magtinuohon ha Jope nga nakadto hi Pedro ha Lida, ginsugo nira in duha ka tawo ngadto ha iya upod in tugon nga magdagmit gud hiya hin pagkadto ha Jope.

en: Peter went with them. Upon his arrival, he was taken to the upstairs room. All the widows stood beside him, crying as they showed the tunics and other clothing Dorcas made when she was alive.
war: Sanglit nag-andam hi Pedro ngan inmupod ha ira. Han pag-abot niya, gindara hiya nira ngadto han kwarto ha igbaw. Gin-alirongan hi Pedro han ngatanan nga mga balo nga kababayen-an nga nagtitinangis, ngan iginpapakita ha iya an mga bado ngan mga kurugpos nga ginhimo ni Dorcas han buhi pa hiya.

en: Peter sent everyone out of the room, then knelt and prayed. He turned to the body and said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.
war: Ginpaguwa hira ngatanan ni Pedro. Linmuhod ngan nag-ampo hiya. Kahuman, inatubang niya an minatay ngan sidngon, “Tabita, buhat!” Pinmukrat ini hiya, ngan han pakakita niya kan Pedro, linmingkod hiya.

en: There was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion in the Italian Company.
war: May usa ka tawo ha Cesarea nga ginngangaranan kan Cornelio, usa nga kapitan han kasondalohan nga Italyano.

en: He and his whole household were pious, Gentile God-worshippers. He gave generously to those in need among the Jewish people and prayed to God constantly.
war: Mainampoon hiya nga tawo, ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay nagsisingba han Dyos. Dako an iya bulig ha mga kablas nga Judiyo ngan dayuday hiya nga nag-aampo sa Dyos.

en: One day at nearly three o’clock in the afternoon, he clearly saw an angel from God in a vision. The angel came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
war: Mga alas tres adto ha kulop nga nagkamay-ada hiya panan-awon diin hinkit-an niya in usa nga anghel nga sinmakob ha balay ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Cornelio!”

en: Startled, he stared at the angel and replied, “What is it, Lord?”
war: Tinmutok hiya han anghel upod in kahadlok ngan nagsiring hiya, “Ano an imo tuyo?”

en: The angel said, “Your prayers and your compassionate acts are like a memorial offering to God.
war: Binmaton an anghel, “Nakalipay han Dyos an imo mga pag-ampo ngan mga buhat hin kalooy ngan nahinumdom hiya ha imo.

en: Send messengers to Joppa at once and summon a certain Simon, the one known as Peter.
war: Ngan yana pagsugo hin mga tawo ngadto ha Jope hin pakigkita hin usa ka tawo, hi Simon, nga ginngangaranan kan Pedro.

en: He is a guest of Simon the tanner, whose house is near the seacoast.”
war: Aadto nalungon hiya kan Simon nga paratina hin anit, nga an balay aada ha ligid han dagat.”

en: When the angel who was speaking to him had gone, Cornelius summoned two of his household servants along with a pious soldier from his personal staff.
war: Niyan han pagbaya na han anghel, gintawag ni Cornelio in duha han iya mga surugoon ngan hin usa nga sondalo nga mainampoon, nga usa han iya mga tinaporan.

en: He explained everything to them, then sent them to Joppa.
war: Ginsumatan niya hira han nahinabo ngan ginpakadto hira ha Jope.

en: At noon on the following day, as their journey brought them close to the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
war: Han pagkabuwas, samtang hirani na ha Jope an mga ginsugo, hi Pedro na man sinmaka ha atop han balay han tikaurudto hin pag-ampo.

en: He became hungry and wanted to eat. While others were preparing the meal, he had a visionary experience.
war: Ginutom hiya ngan karuyag kumaon. Samtang gin-aandam an pagkaon, nakakita hiya hin panan-awon.

en: He saw heaven opened up and something like a large linen sheet being lowered to the earth by its four corners.
war: Hinkit-an niya nga nabuksan an langit ngan may nagtitiubos nga pareho hin halapad nga taklap nga hinigtan ha upat nga mga kanto, nga igintutunton ha tuna.

en: Inside the sheet were all kinds of four-legged animals, reptiles, and wild birds.
war: Nakada sulod hini an ngatanan nga mga mananap nga naglalakat ngan nagkakamang, ngan ihalas nga katamsihan.

en: A voice told him, “Get up, Peter! Kill and eat!”
war: May tingog nga nagsiring ha iya, “Tindog, Pedro; pag-ihaw ngan kaon!”

en: Peter exclaimed, “Absolutely not, Lord! I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gad ako, Ginoo! Kay waray pa gud ako kumaon hin bisan ano nga kinikilala nga mahugaw o diri malinis sugad han amon gintutuohan.”

en: The voice spoke a second time, “Never consider unclean what God has made pure.”
war: Nagyakan liwat an tingog ha iya, “Ayaw paghunahunaa nga mahugaw an bisan ano nga ginsiring na han Dyos nga malinis.”

en: This happened three times, then the object was suddenly pulled back into heaven.
war: Nahinabo ini makatulo, ngan kahuman, iginbalik an iya hinkit-an ngadto ha langit.

en: Peter was bewildered about the meaning of the vision. Just then, the messengers sent by Cornelius discovered the whereabouts of Simon’s house and arrived at the gate.
war: Samtang nagpapainoino hi Pedro mahitungod han kahulogan hini nga panan-awon nga iya hinkit-an, inmabot an mga tawo nga ginsugo ni Cornelio. Nakatultol hira han balay ni Simon, ngan yana nakada na hira ha atubangan han portahan.

en: Calling out, they inquired whether the Simon known as Peter was a guest there.
war: Nagsangpit hira ngan nagpakiana, “May sumasaka ba dinhe nga ginngangaranan kan Simon Pedro?”

en: While Peter was brooding over the vision, the Spirit interrupted him, “Look! Three people are looking for you.
war: Ginpapainoino pa ni Pedro an karuyag sidngon han panan-awon han pagsiring ha iya han Espiritu, “Hahani in tulo ka tawo nga nagbibiling ha imo.

en: Go downstairs. Don’t ask questions; just go with them because I have sent them.”
war: Sanglit lusad ngan ayaw pag-alang hin pag-upod ha ira kay akon hira ginsugo.”

en: So Peter went downstairs and told them, “I’m the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
war: Sanglit linmusad hi Pedro ngan ginsiring an mga tawo, “Ako an iyo ginbibiling. Kay ano nga kinmanhi kamo?”

en: They replied, “We’ve come on behalf of Cornelius, a centurion and righteous man, a God-worshipper who is well-respected by all Jewish people. A holy angel directed him to summon you to his house and to hear what you have to say.”
war: “Ginsugo kami ni Kapitan Cornelio,” nagbaton hira. “Maupay hiya nga tawo nga nagsisingba han Dyos, ngan tinahod kaupay han ngatanan nga mga Judiyo. Ginsiring hiya han anghel han Ginoo nga dapiton ka ngadto ha iya balay, basi makabati hiya han imo karuyag igsumat.”

en: Peter invited them into the house as his guests.
war: Ginpauswag ni Pedro an mga tawo, ngan didto hira pakaturoga hito nga gab-i.

en: The next day he got up and went with them, together with some of the believers from Joppa.
war: Han pagkabuwas nag-andam hiya ngan inmupod ha ira. Binmunyog liwat ha iya in pira nga mga magtinuohon ha Jope.

en: They arrived in Caesarea the following day. Anticipating their arrival, Cornelius had gathered his relatives and close friends.
war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw inmabot hiya ha Cesarea diin naghulat ha iya hi Cornelio upod in mga kaurupdan ngan suok nga kasangkayan nga iya gindapit.

en: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in order to honor him.
war: Han tisakob na hi Pedro, gintapo hiya ni Cornelio nga linmuhod ngan yimukbo ha iya atubangan.
