war: Nagbaton hira, “Mga tulin kami ni Abraham, ngan waray pa gud kami maoripon hin bisan hin-o, sanglit ano an karuyag mo sidngon han imo pagsiring, ‘Matatalwas kamo’?”

en: Jesus answered, “ I assure you that everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: oripon han sala an ngatanan nga nakakasala.

en: A slave isn’t a permanent member of the household, but a son is.
war: Diri dayuday sakop han panimalay an oripon, kundi sakop ha kadayonan an anak.

en: Therefore, if the Son makes you free, you really will be free.
war: Sanglit matatalwas gud kamo hin tinuod kon an Anak an magtalwas ha iyo.

en: I know that you are Abraham’s children, yet you want to kill me because you don’t welcome my teaching.
war: Maaram ako nga mga tulin kamo ni Abraham, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo, kay diri man kamo nakarawat han akon pagturon-an.

en: I’m telling you what I’ve seen when I am with the Father, but you are doing what you’ve heard from your father. ”
war: Naghihimangraw ako mahitungod han iginpakita ha akon han akon Amay, kundi binubuhat niyo an iginsumat ha iyo han iyo amay.”

en: They replied, “Our father is Abraham.”
war: Nagbaton hira ha iya, “Hi Abraham an amon amay.”

en: Jesus responded, “ If you were Abraham’s children, you would do Abraham’s works.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon tinuod nga mga anak kamo ni Abraham, bubuhaton unta niyo an mga buruhaton nga ginbuhat niya.

en: Instead, you want to kill me, though I am the one who has spoken the truth I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
war: An akon nabuhat amo la an pagsumat ha iyo han kamatuoran nga akon hinbatian tikang han Dyos, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo. Waray magbuhat hi Abraham hin sugad hini!

en: You are doing your father’s works. ”
war: Ginbubuhat niyo an ginbuhat han amay niyo.”

en: They said, “Our ancestry isn’t in question! The only Father we have is God!”
war: Nagbaton hira, “An Dyos la an amon Amay; kami an tinuod nga iya mga anak.”

en: Jesus replied, “ If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God. Here I am. I haven’t come on my own. God sent me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kon matuod nga an Dyos an Amay niyo, mahigugma unta kamo ha akon, kay tinmikang ako sa Dyos ngan yana aanhi ako. Waray ako kumanhi ha akon la kalugaringon nga pagbuot, kundi ginsugo ako niya.

en: Why don’t you understand what I’m saying? It’s because you can’t really hear my words.
war: Kay ano nga diri kamo nasabot han akon iginyayakan? Tungod kay diri kamo nailob hin pamati han akon mga mensahe.

en: Your father is the devil. You are his children, and you want to do what your father wants. He was a murderer from the beginning. He has never stood for the truth, because there’s no truth in him. Whenever that liar speaks, he speaks according to his own nature, because he’s a liar and the father of liars.
war: Mga anak kamo han amay niyo, an Yawa, ngan naruruyag kamo pagsunod han ungara han amay niyo. Parapamatay hiya tikang pa ha tinikangan. Waray hiya dumapig han kamatuoran, kay waray man kamatuoran dida ha iya. Kon nagbubuwa hiya, nagbuhat la hiya sugad han iya kinaiya, kay buwaon man hiya, ngan amo hiya an amay han ngatanan nga buwa.

en: Because I speak the truth, you don’t believe me.
war: Nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, sanglit diri kamo natuod ha akon.

en: Who among you can show I’m guilty of sin? Since I speak the truth, why don’t you believe me?
war: Hin-o ha iyo in makakapamatuod nga salaan ako? Kon nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, kay ano man nga diri kamo natuod ha akon?

en: God’s children listen to God’s words. You don’t listen to me because you aren’t God’s children. ”
war: Namamati han mga pulong han Dyos an tawo nga tikang ha Dyos. Kundi diri kamo tikang ha Dyos, sanglit diri kamo namamati ha akon.”

en: The Jewish opposition answered, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and have a demon, weren’t we?”
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo kan Jesus, “Diri ba tama an amon pagsiring nga Samaritano ka ngan sinasangkayan ka hin yawa?”

en: “ I don’t have a demon, ” Jesus replied. “ But I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri gad ako sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ginpapasidunggan ko la an akon Amay, kundi ginpapakaalohan ako niyo.

en: I’m not trying to bring glory to myself. There’s one who is seeking to glorify me, and he’s the judge.
war: Diri ako nagtitingoha hin dungog ha akon kalugaringon. May-ada hito nagtitinguha ngan naghuhukom ugop ha akon.

en: I assure you that whoever keeps my word will never die. ”
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.”

en: The Jewish opposition said to Jesus, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham and the prophets died, yet you say, ‘Whoever keeps my word will never die.’
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Judiyo, “Yana hinsabtan na namon nga sinasangkayan ka hin yawa! Namatay ngani hi Abraham ngan an mga manaragna, kundi nasiring ka, ‘Diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.’

en: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died and the prophets died, so who do you make yourself out to be?”
war: Labaw ka pa ba kan Abraham nga amon amay? Namatay ngani hiya sugad man an mga manaragna, baga hin-o ka gud, ha imo paghunahuna?”

en: Jesus answered, “ If I glorify myself, my glory is meaningless. My Father, who you say is your God, is the one who glorifies me.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon pasidunggan ko an akon kalugaringon, waray hinungdan an akon dungog. Nagpapasidungog ha akon an akon Amay—an ginsisiring niyo nga iyo Dyos.

en: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who was blind from birth.
war: Han naglalakat hi Jesus, nakakita hiya hin tawo nga daan buta tikang han iya katawo.

en: Jesus’ disciples asked, “Rabbi, who sinned so that he was born blind, this man or his parents?”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, kanay man sala nga natawo hiya nga daan buta? Iya ba kalugaringon o kanan iya mga kag-anak?”

en: Jesus answered, “ Neither he nor his parents. This happened so that God’s mighty works might be displayed in him.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Waray labot han iya pagkabuta an iya mga sala o an mga sala han iya mga kag-anak. Natawo hiya nga daan buta basi hikit-an an gahom han Dyos dida ha iya.

en: While it’s daytime, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming when no one can work.
war: Kinahanglan tumanon ta an mga buruhaton han nagsugo ha akon, samtang nga adlaw pa; maabot an gab-i ngan waray na makakagtrabaho.

en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world. ”
war: Ako an kapawa han kalibutan samtang aanhi pa ako ha kalibutan.”

en: After he said this, he spit on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and smeared the mud on the man’s eyes.
war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, linmura hi Jesus ha tuna, naghimo hin lapok pinaagi han iya laway, ngan gindihogan niya an mga mata han buta,

en: Jesus said to him, “ Go, wash in the pool of Siloam ” (this word means sent ). So the man went away and washed. When he returned, he could see.
war: ngan iya sidngon, “Kadto na, ngan paghiram-os didto ha linaw han Siloe.” (“Ginsugo” an kahulogan hini nga ngaran.) Sanglit kinmadto an tawo, naghiram-os hiya, ngan binmalik nga nakita na.

en: The man’s neighbors and those who used to see him when he was a beggar said, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
war: Sanglit nagpakiana an iya mga amyaw ngan an mga tawo nga nakakita ha iya hadto, nga nakikilimos, “Diri ba amo ini an tawo nga hadto nalingkod didto ngan agsob makilimos?”

en: Some said, “It is,” and others said, “No, it’s someone who looks like him.”
war: May nagsiring, “Amo ini hiya,” kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri hiya amo, kundi alid-agid la ha iya.”

en: But the man said, “Yes, it’s me!”
war: Sanglit nagsiring an tawo ngahaw, “Amo ako an tawo.”

en: So they asked him, “How are you now able to see?”
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Naunan-o man nga nakita ka na?”

en: He answered, “The man they call Jesus made mud, smeared it on my eyes, and said, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went and washed, and then I could see.”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Naghimo hin lapok an tawo nga Jesus an ngaran, ngan igindihog niya ha akon mata. Ngan ginpakadto ako niya ha Siloe hin paghiram-os. Sanglit napakadto ako, ngan han pakahiram-os ko la, nakakita ako.”

en: They asked, “Where is this man?”
war: “Hain naman hiya?” nagpakiana hira.

en: He replied, “I don’t know.”
war: “Ambot,” nagbaton hiya.

en: Then they led the man who had been born blind to the Pharisees.
war: Ngan gindara nira ngadto han mga Parisiyo an tawo nga hadto anay buta.

en: Now Jesus made the mud and smeared it on the man’s eyes on a Sabbath day.
war: Adlaw adto nga Iparahuway han paghimo ni Jesus hin lapok ngan pagtambal niya han kanan tawo mga mata.

en: So Pharisees also asked him how he was able to see.
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan liwat han mga Parisiyo an tawo kon naunan-o hin pakakita niya. Nagsumat hiya ha ira, “Gindihugan niya hin lapok an akon mga mata, naghiram-os ako, ngan yana nakita na ako.”

en: The man told them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I see.”
war: Nagsiring an pira han mga Parisiyo, “Diri mahihimo nga tikang sa Dyos an tawo nga nagbuhat hini, kay diri niya gintutuman an Balaod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: Some Pharisees said, “This man isn’t from God, because he breaks the Sabbath law.” Others said, “How can a sinner do miraculous signs like these?” So they were divided.
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Uunanhon hin tawo nga makasasala pakahimo hin mga orosahon nga sugad hini?” Ngan nagkabahinbahin hira.

en: Some of the Pharisees questioned the man who had been born blind again: “What do you have to say about him, since he healed your eyes?”
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan na liwat hiya han mga Parisiyo, “Nasiring ka man nga hiya an nagtambal han imo mga mata—niyan, ano man an imo isisiring mahitungod ha iya?”

en: He replied, “He’s a prophet.”
war: “Manaragna hiya,” nagbaton hiya.

en: The Jewish leaders didn’t believe the man had been blind and received his sight until they called for his parents.
war: Kundi diri karuyag tumuod an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga buta hiya anay ngan yana nakita na. Sanglit gintawag nira an iya mga kag-anak,

en: The Jewish leaders asked them, “Is this your son? Are you saying he was born blind? How can he now see?”
war: ngan ginpakianhan nira, “Iyo ba ini anak? Nasiring kamo nga natawo hiya nga daan buta, niyan ano man in kasugad nga nakita na man hiya yana?”

en: His parents answered, “We know he is our son. We know he was born blind.
war: Nagbaton an iya mga kag-anak, “Maaram kami nga amon hiya anak, ngan natawo hiya nga daan buta.

en: But we don’t know how he now sees, and we don’t know who healed his eyes. Ask him. He’s old enough to speak for himself.”
war: Kundi diri kami maaram kon naunan-o nga nakita na man hiya yana, ngan diri kami maaram kon hin-o an nagtambal han iya mata. Hiya na la in pakianhi kay may buot na man hiya, ngan makakabaton na man hiya para han iya kalugaringon!”

en: His parents said this because they feared the Jewish authorities. This is because the Jewish authorities had already decided that whoever confessed Jesus to be the Christ would be expelled from the synagogue.
war: Ginyakan ini han mga kag-anak kay nahadlok hira han mga punoan nga Judiyo nga nagkasarabot na nga daan hin pagpagawas ha sinagoga hin bisan hin-o nga magtug-an nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas.

en: That’s why his parents said, “He’s old enough. Ask him.”
war: Sanglit nagsiring an iya mga kag-anak, “May buot na man hiya; hiya na la an pakianhi.”

en: Therefore, they called a second time for the man who had been born blind and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know this man is a sinner.”
war: Iginpatawag na liwat nira an tawo nga natawo nga daan buta ngan ginsiring, “Pagsaad ha atubangan han Dyos nga magsusumat ka hin kamatuoran! Maaram kami nga makasasala ini nga tawo nga nagtambal.”

en: The man answered, “I don’t know whether he’s a sinner. Here’s what I do know: I was blind and now I see.”
war: “Diri ako maaram kon makasasala ba hiya o diri,” nagbaton an tawo. “An hinsabtan ko la amo ini: nakita na ako yana, kundi hadto buta ako.”

en: They questioned him: “What did he do to you? How did he heal your eyes?”
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Ano an ginbuhat niya ha imo? Gin-unan-o niya hin pagtambal han imo mga mata?”

en: He replied, “I already told you, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod. Kay ano nga iyo ini gin-uolit-okit? Bangin la naruruyag liwat kamo nga magin tinun-an niya?”

en: They insulted him: “You are his disciple, but we are Moses’ disciples.
war: Ginpakaraot hiya nira ngan ginsiring, “Ikaw an iya tinun-an, kundi mga tinun-an kami ni Moises.

en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we don’t know where this man is from.”
war: Maaram kami nga nakighimangraw an Dyos kan Moises; mahitungod hito nga tawo, diri ngani kami maaram kon diin hiya tikang!”

en: The man answered, “This is incredible! You don’t know where he is from, yet he healed my eyes!
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Pagkaorosahon hini! Diri kamo maaram kon diin hiya tikang, kundi ginpakita niya an akon mga mata!

en: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners. God listens to anyone who is devout and does God’s will.
war: Maaram kita nga diri namamati an Dyos han mga makasasala; namamati hiya han mga tawo nga natahod ha iya ngan nagtutuman han karuyag niya ipabuhat ha ira.

en: No one has ever heard of a healing of the eyes of someone born blind.
war: Tikang pa han tinikangan han kalibutan, waray pa gud hinbatian nga may nakatambal han mga mata nga daan buta.

en: If this man wasn’t from God, he couldn’t do this.”
war: Waray gud mahihimo hito nga tawo kon diri hiya tikang ha Dyos.”

en: They responded, “You were born completely in sin! How is it that you dare to teach us?” Then they expelled him.
war: Binmaton hira, “Natawo ngan nagtubo ka ha sala—ngan karuyag mo magtutdo ha amon?” Ngan ginpagawas hiya nira ha sinagoga.

en: Jesus heard they had expelled the man born blind. Finding him, Jesus said, “ Do you believe in the Human One? ”
war: Hinbatian ni Jesus nga ginpagawas nira ha sinagoga an tawo. Hin-agian hiya ni Jesus ngan ginpakianhan, “Natoo ka ba han Anak han Tawo?”

en: He answered, “Who is he, sir? I want to believe in him.”
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Sumati gad ako kon hin-o hiya, basi makatoo ako ha iya!”

en: Jesus said, “ You have seen him. In fact, he is the one speaking with you. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hinkit-an mo na hiya, ngan amo hiya nga nakikighimangraw yana ha imo.”

en: I assure you that whoever doesn’t enter into the sheep pen through the gate but climbs over the wall is a thief and an outlaw.
war: “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: kawatan ngan tikasan an tawo nga diri naagi ha porta hin pagsulod han turil, kundi nagsasaka hin iba nga agian.

en: The one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
war: Magmarangno han mga karnero an tawo nga naagi ha porta.

en: The guard at the gate opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
war: Pinaaagi hiya han magbarantay han portahan; namamati an mga karnero han iya tingog kon gintatawag niya hira hin ira tagsatagsa nga ngaran, ngan pinagagawas niya hira han turil.

en: Whenever he has gathered all of his sheep, he goes before them and they follow him, because they know his voice.
war: Paghihigawas na nira, nag-uuna hiya ha ira, ngan nasunod an mga karnero ha iya kay nakilala han iya tingog.

en: They won’t follow a stranger but will run away because they don’t know the stranger’s voice. ”
war: Diri hira masunod hin iba; lugod makalagiw hira, kay diri nira kinikilala an iya tingog.”

en: Those who heard Jesus use this analogy didn’t understand what he was saying.
war: Iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan, kundi waray hira makasabot han karuyag sidngon han pananglitan.

en: So Jesus spoke again, “I assure you that I am the gate of the sheep.
war: Sanglit nagsiring liwat hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: amo ako an porta para han mga karnero.

en: All who came before me were thieves and outlaws, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
war: Mga kawatan ngan mga tikasan an ngatanan nga kinmanhi una ha akon; kundi waray mamati ha ira an mga karnero.

en: I am the gate. Whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out and find pasture.
war: Amo ako an porta. Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga masulod pinaaagi ha akon, masulod-guwa hiya ngan makakaagi hin panibsiban.

en: The thief enters only to steal, kill, and destroy. I came so that they could have life—indeed, so that they could live life to the fullest.
war: Nasulod la an kawatan hin pangawat, panmatay, ngan panmungkag. Kinmanhi ako basi makaangkon hira han kinabuhi, an hura nga kinabuhi.

en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
war: “Amo ako an maupay nga magmarangno han mga karnero. An maupay nga magmarangno andam pag-unong han iya kinabuhi tungod han mga karnero.

en: When the hired hand sees the wolf coming, he leaves the sheep and runs away. That’s because he isn’t the shepherd; the sheep aren’t really his. So the wolf attacks the sheep and scatters them.
war: An sinuholan la, kay diri magmarangno ngan diri tag-iya han mga karnero, nabaya ha ira ngan nakalagiw kon nakita hiya hin lubo; sanglit tinatabag han lubo an mga karnero ngan nagsasarang hira.

en: He’s only a hired hand and the sheep don’t matter to him.
war: Nakalagiw an sinuholan, kay sinuholan man la hiya ngan diri napaid han mga karnero.

en: “I am the good shepherd. I know my own sheep and they know me,
war: 14-15 Amo ako an maupay nga magmarangno. Sugad nga nakilala an Amay ha akon ngan nakilala ako han Amay, ha amo man nga paagi, nakilala ako han akon karnero ngan nakilala man hira ha akon. Ngan andam ako hin pag-unong han akon kinabuhi tungod ha ira.

en: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father. I give up my life for the sheep.
war: May-ada iba nakon nga mga karnero nga diri sakop hini nga panon. Kinahanglan sakopon ko liwat hira; mamamati hira han akon tingog, ngan mauusa na la hira nga panon ha ubos hin usa nga magmarangno.

en: I have other sheep that don’t belong to this sheep pen. I must lead them too. They will listen to my voice and there will be one flock, with one shepherd.
war: “Nahigugma an Amay ha akon kay andam man ako hin paghatag han akon kinabuhi basi mahibalik liwat ini ha akon.

en: “ This is why the Father loves me: I give up my life so that I can take it up again.
war: Waray makakaagaw han akon kinabuhi; ihinahatag ko ini ha akon kalugaringon nga pagbuot. May-ada ko gahom hin pagtubyan han akon kinabuhi ngan may-ada ko liwat gahom hin pagbawi hini. Amo ini an ipinapagbuhat ha akon han akon Amay.”

en: No one takes it from me, but I give it up because I want to. I have the right to give it up, and I have the right to take it up again. I received this commandment from my Father. ”
war: Nagkabahin na liwat an mga Judiyo tungod hini nga mga pulong.

en: There was another division among the Jews because of Jesus’ words.
war: Nagsiring in kadam-an ha ira, “Sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa ngan nakulangan ha hiya hin buot! Kay ano nga namamati pa kamo ha iya?”

en: Many of them said, “He has a demon and has lost his mind. Why listen to him?”
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri makakaghimangraw hin sugad hini in tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa! Uunanhon man hin yawa pagpakita han mga buta?”

en: Others said, “These aren’t the words of someone who has a demon. Can a demon heal the eyes of people who are blind?”
war: Inmabot an panahon han pagsaurog han Pyesta han Paghalad didto ha Jerusalem ngan panahon adto hin kathagkot,

en: The time came for the Festival of Dedication in Jerusalem. It was winter,
war: ngan didto ha Templo naglalakat hi Jesus didto han Balkon ni Solomon.

en: and Jesus was in the temple, walking in the covered porch named for Solomon.
war: Gin-alirongan hiya han mga Judiyo nga nagsiring, “Tubtob san-o an imo pagpinakulbai ha amon? Sumati kami hin tinuod kon amo ka an Mesiyas.”

en: The Jewish opposition circled around him and asked, “How long will you test our patience? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod ha akon. Saksi ha akon an gintuman ko nga mga buhat nga sugo han akon Amay;

en: Jesus answered, “ I have told you, but you don’t believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,
war: kundi diri kamo matuod kay diri man kamo akon mga karnero.

en: but you don’t believe because you don’t belong to my sheep.
war: Namamati han akon tingog an akon mga karnero; nakilala ako ha ira, ngan nasunod hira ha akon;

en: My sheep listen to my voice. I know them and they follow me.
war: Nahatag ako ha ira han dayon nga kinabuhi, ngan diri nagud hira mamamatay; ngan waray makakaagaw ha ira tikang ha akon.

en: I give them eternal life. They will never die, and no one will snatch them from my hand.
war: Labaw han ngatanan an akon Amay nga amo an naghatag ha ira ha akon, ngan waray gud makakaagaw ha ira tikang han kamot han Amay.

en: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch them from my Father’s hand.
war: Mag-usa la an Amay ug ako.”

en: I and the Father are one. ”
war: Nanmurot na liwat an mga Judiyo hin mga bato paglabay ha iya.

en: Again the Jewish opposition picked up stones in order to stone him.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Damo nga mga mag-upay an akon nabuhat ha iyo atubangan nga sugo han akon Amay; hain man hini nga mga buhat in pinasisikaran niyo hin pagbato ha akon?”

en: Jesus responded, “ I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of those works do you stone me? ”
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Ginbabato ka namon diri tungod hin ano man nga mag-upay nga mga buhat, kundi tungod han imo pagpasipara han Dyos! Nagpapaka-Dyos ka, nga tawo ka man la!”

en: The Jewish opposition answered, “We don’t stone you for a good work but for insulting God. You are human, yet you make yourself out to be God.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Di ba nahisurat ha iyo kalugaringon nga Balaod nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Mga dyos kamo’?

en: Jesus replied, “ Isn’t it written in your Law, I have said, you are gods?
war: Maaram kita nga matuod ha kadayonan an iginsisiring han kasuratan, ngan gintawag han Dyos nga mga dyos adton mga tawo nga gintaporan han iya mga pulong.

en: Scripture calls those to whom God’s word came gods , and scripture can’t be abolished.
war: Mahitungod ha akon, ginpili ako han Amay ngan ginsugo nganhi ha kalibutan. Sanglit uunanhon pakasiring niyo nga nagpapasipara ako han Dyos tungod han pagsiring ko nga amo ako an Anak han Dyos?

en: So how can you say that the one whom the Father has made holy and sent into the world insults God because he said, ‘I am God’s Son’?
war: Sanglit angay diri kamo tumoo ha akon kon diri ako nagbubuhat han mga buhat han akon Amay.

en: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
war: Kundi kon nagbubuhat man ako, bisan kon diri kamo natoo ha akon, kinahanglan tumoo kamo bisan na man la han akon mga buhat, basi hibaroan ngan masayoran niyo nga aadi ha akon an Amay, ngan aada ako ha iya.”

en: But if I do them, and you don’t believe me, believe the works so that you can know and recognize that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.”
war: Gin-idarakop na liwat hiya nira, kundi nakapudlos hiya tikang ha ira mga kamot.

en: Again, they wanted to arrest him, but he escaped from them.
war: Binmalik na liwat hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Salog han Jordan, ngadto han dapit diin nanmunyag hi Juan, ngan nagpabilin hiya didto.

en: Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had baptized at first, and he stayed there.
war: Pinmakadto ha iya in damo nga mga tawo. Nagsiring hira, “Waray magbuhat hi Juan hin mga orosahon, kundi puros matuod an iginsiring niya mahitungod hini nga tawo.”

en: Many people came to him. “John didn’t do any miraculous signs,” they said, “but everything John said about this man was true.”
war: Ngan damo nga mga tawo didto in tinmoo kan Jesus.

en: A certain man, Lazarus, was ill. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha. (
war: May usa nga tawo nga hi Lazaro an ngaran. Nag-ukoy hiya ha Betania upod an iya kabugtoan nga kababayen-an, hira Maria ug Marta. (

en: This was the Mary who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped his feet with her hair. Her brother Lazarus was ill.)
war: Amo ini nga Maria an nagbubo hin pahamot ha mga tiil han Ginoo ngan ginpahiran han iya buhok. Nasakit hi Lazaro nga iya bugto.)

en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, saying, “Lord, the one whom you love is ill.”
war: Nagpatugon ini nga magbugto nga kababayen-an ngadto kan Jesus nga sidngon hiya, “Ginoo, masakit an imo suok nga sangkay.”

en: When he heard this, Jesus said, “ This illness isn’t fatal. It’s for the glory of God so that God’s Son can be glorified through it. ”
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus hini, nagsiring hiya, “Diri ikamamatay ni Lazaro ini nga sakit. Nahinabo ini basi pasidunggan an Dyos, ngan pinaagi hito, pasidunggan man liwat an Anak han Dyos.”

en: Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.
war: Hinigugma ni Jesus hira Marta, Maria, ug Lazaro.

en: When he heard that Lazarus was ill, he stayed where he was. After two days,
war: Han pakabati niya nga masakit hi Lazaro, duha anay ka adlaw an iya ginpalabay san-o hiya kumadto.

en: he said to his disciples, “ Let’s return to Judea again. ”
war: Katapos, nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, balik kita ha Judea.”

en: The disciples replied, “Rabbi, the Jewish opposition wants to stone you, but you want to go back?”
war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, diri pa la maiha nga gin-iibarato ka didto han mga Judiyo, ngan karuyag mo na liwat hin pagkadto?”

en: Jesus answered, “ Aren’t there twelve hours in the day? Whoever walks in the day doesn’t stumble because they see the light of the world.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Di ba may dose ka oras an usa ka adlaw? Sanglit diri mahipapakdol an tawo nga maglalakat ha kapaw-an, kay nakita hiya han kapawa hini nga kalibutan.

en: But whoever walks in the night does stumble because the light isn’t in them. ”
war: Kundi mahipapakdol hiya kon maglakat hiya ha gab-i, kay masirom man.”

en: He continued, “ Our friend Lazarus is sleeping, but I am going in order to wake him up. ”
war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus ngan sinumpayan pa niya pagsiring, “Nakaturog hi Lazaro nga aton sangkay, kundi makadto ako hin pagpukaw ha iya.”

en: The disciples said, “Lord, if he’s sleeping, he will get well.”
war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Ginoo, mag-uupay hiya kon nakaturog la hiya.”

en: They thought Jesus meant that Lazarus was in a deep sleep, but Jesus had spoken about Lazarus’ death.
war: Karuyag sidngon ni Jesus nga patay na hi Lazaro; kundi naghunahuna an mga tinun-an nga nagsiring hi Jesus nga nakaturog la hiya.

en: Jesus told them plainly, “ Lazarus has died.
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hin waray lipodlipod, “Patay na hi Lazaro;

en: For your sakes, I’m glad I wasn’t there so that you can believe. Let’s go to him. ”
war: kundi tungod ha iyo nalilipay ako nga waray ako didto upod ha iya, basi tumoo kamo. Kadtoa ta hiya.”

en: Then Thomas (the one called Didymus) said to the other disciples, “Let us go too so that we may die with Jesus.”
war: Nagsiring ngadto han iya mga igkasi tinun-an hi Tomas, an ginngangaranan nga Karuha, “Tana, bunyog kita ngatanan han Magturutdo, basi mamatay kita upod ha iya!”

en: When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
war: Pag-abot ni Jesus, nasayran niya nga upat na ka adlaw nga iginlubong hi Lazaro.

en: Bethany was a little less than two miles from Jerusalem.
war: Mga tulo la ka kilometro an Betania tikang ha Jerusalem,

en: Many Jews had come to comfort Martha and Mary after their brother’s death.
war: ngan damo nga mga Judiyo an kinmadto hin pagliaw kanda Marta ug Maria mahitungod han kamatay han ira bugto.

en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him, while Mary remained in the house.
war: Han pakabati ni Marta nga tiarabot hi Jesus, kinmadto hiya hin pagtapo, samtang hi Maria nagpabilin ha balay.

en: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
war: Nagsiring hi Marta kan Jesus, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!

en: Even now I know that whatever you ask God, God will give you.”
war: Kundi maaram ako nga bisan yana, ihahatag ha imo han Dyos an bisan ano nga imo pangaroon ha iya.”

en: Jesus told her, “ Your brother will rise again. ”
war: Ginsumatan hiya ni Jesus, “Mababanhaw an imo bugto.”

en: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day.”
war: Nagbaton hi Marta, “Maaram ako nga mababanhaw hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.”

en: Jesus said to her, “ I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live, even though they die.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hi ako an pagkabanhaw ngan an kinabuhi. Mabubuhi an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon, bisan kon mamatay hiya;

en: Everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this? ”
war: ngan diri na gud mamamatay an bisan hin-o nga buhi nga natoo ha akon. Natuod ka ba hini?”

en: She replied, “Yes, Lord, I believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, the one who is coming into the world.”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Oo, Ginoo, natoo ako nga amo ka an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos, nga makanhi ha kalibutan.”

en: After she said this, she went and spoke privately to her sister Mary, “The teacher is here and he’s calling for you.”
war: 28-30 Katapos pagsiring hini ni Marta, binmalik hiya ngan gintawag hi Maria nga iya bugto. (Waray pa abot hi Jesus ha baryo, kundi nakadto pa han dapit nga ginkatapoan niya ngan hi Marta.) Ginhuringan niya hi Maria, “Hahani an Magturutdo ngan nagpipinakiana ha imo.” Pakabati ni Maria hini, binmuhat hiya ngan nagdagmit hin paggawas pagtapo kan Jesus.

en: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Jesus.
war: Hinkit-an ngan ginsunod hiya han mga Judiyo nga nakadto ha ira balay hin pagliaw ha iya. Naghunahuna hira nga tikadto hiya ha lubnganan hin pagtangis didto.

en: He hadn’t entered the village but was still in the place where Martha had met him.
war: Inmabot hi Maria ha dapit diin nakadto hi Jesus. Pakakita niya kan Jesus, hinmapa hiya ha atubangan niya ngan nagsiring, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!”

en: When the Jews who were comforting Mary in the house saw her get up quickly and leave, they followed her. They assumed she was going to mourn at the tomb.
war: Hinkit-an hiya ni Jesus nga nagtatangis, sugad man an mga Judiyo nga upod niya; nabantad an iya kasingkasing ngan inalpan hiya hin kalooy.

en: When Mary arrived where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
war: Nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Diin niyo iglubong hiya?”

en: When Jesus saw her crying and the Jews who had come with her crying also, he was deeply disturbed and troubled.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Kadi, Ginoo, ngan kitaa.”

en: He asked, “ Where have you laid him? ”
war: Nagtangis hi Jesus.

en: They replied, “Lord, come and see.”
war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga Judiyo, “Kitaa, pagkadako han iya paghigugma kan Lazaro!”

en: Jesus began to cry.
war: Kundi an iba ha ira nagsiring, “Hiya nga nakapakita han mga mata han buta, diri ba hiya takos makapugong han kamatayon ni Lazaro?”

en: The Jews said, “See how much he loved him!”
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha lubnganan kay inalpan na liwat hiya hin kabido. Usa adto nga lungib nga sinadhan hin bato.

en: But some of them said, “He healed the eyes of the man born blind. Couldn’t he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
war: Nagsugo hi Jesus, “Kuhaa niyo an bato!”

en: Jesus was deeply disturbed again when he came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone covered the entrance.
war: Nagbaton hi Marta nga bugto han minatay, “Naninimaho na hiya yana, Ginoo, kay upat na ka adlaw tikang hiya iginlubong.”

en: Jesus said, “ Remove the stone. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ba nagsiring ako ha imo nga hikikit-an mo an gahom han Dyos kon tumoo ka?”

en: Martha, the sister of the dead man, said, “Lord, the smell will be awful! He’s been dead four days.”
war: Ginkuha nira an bato. Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, Amay ko, nga pinamamatian mo ako.

en: Jesus replied, “ Didn’t I tell you that if you believe, you will see God’s glory? ”
war: Maaram ako nga dayuday ka namamati ha akon, kundi iginyakan ko ini tungod hini nga mga tawo nga aanhi yana, basi tumoo hira nga ginsugo mo ako.”

en: So they removed the stone. Jesus looked up and said, “ Father, thank you for hearing me.
war: Katapos niya magsiring hini, ginmoliat hiya, “Lazaro! Gawas ngadi!”

en: I know you always hear me. I say this for the benefit of the crowd standing here so that they will believe that you sent me. ”
war: Ginmawas an minatay nga inalikosan pa an iya mga tiil han mga dugnit hin paglubong, pati an iya nawong. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hubari niyo ngan palakta hiya.”

en: Having said this, Jesus shouted with a loud voice, “ Lazarus, come out! ”
war: Nakakita han ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo han mga Judiyo nga nagduaw kan Maria, ngan tinmoo hira ha iya.

en: The dead man came out, his feet bound and his hands tied, and his face covered with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “ Untie him and let him go. ”
war: Kundi kinmadto han mga Parisiyo an iba ha ira hin pagsumat ha ira han ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: Therefore, many of the Jews who came with Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
war: Sanglit nakigkita han Labaw nga Hukmanan an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo ngan nagsiring, “Ano an aton bubuhaton? Nagbubuhat ini nga tawo hin damo nga mga orosahon!

en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
war: Kon pabay-an ta la hiya, matoo an ngatanan ha iya, ngan maabot an mga punoan nga Romano ngan bubungkagon an Templo ngan an aton bug-os nga nasod!”

en: Then the chief priests and Pharisees called together the council and said, “What are we going to do? This man is doing many miraculous signs!
war: Nagsiring an usa ha ira, nga Caifas an ngaran, nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, “Waray gud kamo makasabot!

en: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him. Then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our people.”
war: Diri ba kamo maaram nga mas maupay para ha iyo nga gabay usa la ka tawo an mamatay tungod han bungto, kay nga mabungkag an bug-os nga nasod?”

en: One of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, told them, “You don’t know anything!
war: Ginsiring ini niya diri ha iya kalugaringon nga pagbuot. Kundi tungod nga hiya an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, ginpanagna niya nga kinahanglan mamatay hi Jesus para han mga Judiyo,

en: You don’t see that it is better for you that one man die for the people rather than the whole nation be destroyed.”
war: ngan diri la para ha ira, kundi pagtirok liwat ngan pag-urosa han ngatanan nga nagkakaburublag nga mga anak han Dyos.

en: He didn’t say this on his own. As high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would soon die for the nation—
war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw, nagkasarabot an mga punoan nga Judiyo hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: and not only for the nation. Jesus would also die so that God’s children scattered everywhere would be gathered together as one.
war: Sanglit waray na hiya magsudoy hin dayag ha Judea, kundi binmaya hiya ngan napakadto hin dapit nga hirani han kamingawan, ngadto hin bungto nga ginngangaranan nga Efraim. Nagpabilin hiya didto upod an iya mga tinun-an.

en: From that day on they plotted to kill him.
war: Hiraniay na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo. Napakadto ha Jerusalem, san-o magpyesta, in damo nga mga tawo nga tikang ha kahuronan, pagtuman han seremonyas han paglinis sumala han Balaod.

en: Therefore, Jesus was no longer active in public ministry among the Jewish leaders. Instead, he left Jerusalem and went to a place near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.
war: Nagpinamiling kan Jesus an mga tawo. Han katirok na nira didto han Templo, naggiparupakiana hira, “Ano an iyo hunahuna? Diri ba hiya mapakanhi ha Pyesta?”

en: It was almost time for the Jewish Passover, and many people went from the countryside up to Jerusalem to purify themselves through ritual washing before the Passover.
war: Nagsugo na an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo nga adton maaram kon hain hi Jesus, kinahanglan magpahibaro dayon ha ira basi dakpon nira.

en: Six days before Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, home of Lazarus, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
war: Unom pa ka adlaw san-o umabot an Pyesta han Paglabay, napakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, an bungto ni Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.

en: Lazarus and his sisters hosted a dinner for him. Martha served and Lazarus was among those who joined him at the table.
war: Nag-andam hira didto hin panihapon para ha iya, ngan nagdurot hi Marta, samtang nakigsaro hi Lazaro kan Jesus.

en: Then Mary took an extraordinary amount, almost three-quarters of a pound, of very expensive perfume made of pure nard. She anointed Jesus’ feet with it, then wiped his feet dry with her hair. The house was filled with the aroma of the perfume.
war: Ngan kinmuha hi Maria hin mga tunga hin kilo han gimamahali nga pahamot, nga hinimo tikang hin puro nga nardo. Ginbubo ini niya ha mga tiil ni Jesus, ngan ginpahiran niya han iya buhok. Nalukop an bug-os nga balay han alimyon hini nga pahamot.

en: Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples (the one who was about to betray him), complained,
war: Nagsiring an usa han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, hi Judas Iscariote—an maglilingo ha iya,

en: “This perfume was worth a year’s wages! Why wasn’t it sold and the money given to the poor?” (
war: “Kay ano nga waray lugod ibaligya ini nga pahamot hin sais syintos pesos ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas?”

en: He said this not because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief. He carried the money bag and would take what was in it.)
war: Ginsiring ini niya diri tungod nga napaid hiya han mga kablas, kundi tungod nga kawatan hiya. Hiya an tinaporan han supot han kwarta ngan naara hiya hin pagpasipara hin pagkuha hin kwarta.

en: Then Jesus said, “ Leave her alone. This perfume was to be used in preparation for my burial, and this is how she has used it.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pasagdi la niyo hiya! Tugoti hiya pagbuhat hini kay gin-aandam niya ini para han adlaw han paglubong ha akon.

en: You will always have the poor among you, but you won’t always have me. ”
war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.”

en: Many Jews learned that he was there. They came not only because of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
war: Nakabati in kadam-an nga mga Judiyo nga nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, sanglit napakadto hira, diri la tungod kan Jesus, kundi pagkita liwat kan Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.

en: The chief priests decided that they would kill Lazarus too.
war: Sanglit nagkasarabot an mga puno han kapadian hin pagpatay kan Lazaro;

en: It was because of Lazarus that many of the Jews had deserted them and come to believe in Jesus.
war: kay tungod ha iya damo nga mga Judiyo in nahibulag ha ira ngan tinmoo na kan Jesus.

en: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
war: Pagkabuwas, hinbatian han kadam-an nga mga tawo nga kinmadto han Pyesta han Paglabay, nga maabot hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: They took palm branches and went out to meet him. They shouted,
war: Sanglit nanguha hira hin mga palwa ngan tinmapo hira kan Jesus; ngan naggogoliat hira, “Dayawon an Dyos! Dayawon hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Dayawon an Hadi han Israel!”

en: “Hosanna!
war: Nakaagi hi Jesus hin asno ngan iya ginsakyan, sugad han nahisurat:

en: Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
war: “Ayaw kahadlok, syudad han Sion!

en: Blessings on the king of Israel!”
war: Aanhi naabot an imo Hadi

en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, just as it is written,
war: nga nasakay hin nati nga asno.”

en: Don’t be afraid, Daughter Zion.
war: Waray makasabot hini an iya mga tinun-an hadto nga takna; kundi han kabanhaw na ni Jesus, nahinumdom hira nga nahisurat ini mahitungod ha iya, ngan ginbuhat ini nira para ha iya.

en: Look! Your king is coming ,
war: Nagsumat han nahinabo an mga tawo nga kaupod ni Jesus han pagtawaga niya kan Lazaro tikang ha lubnganan ngan pagbanhawa ha iya.

en: sitting on a donkey’s colt .
war: Sanglit gintapo hiya han kadam-an, kay hinbatian nira nga ginbuhat niya ini nga urosahon.

en: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first. After he was glorified, they remembered that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.
war: Ngan may hinsiring an mga Parisiyo, “Kitaa daw! Waray gud naton mahihimo! Kitaa, nagsusunod na ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo!”

en: The crowd who had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead were testifying about him.
war: May mga Griego nga kaupod han mga kinmadto ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba ha panahon han pyesta.

en: That’s why the crowd came to meet him, because they had heard about this miraculous sign that he had done.
war: Hinmarani hira kan Felipe nga taga-Betsaida, ha Galilea ngan nagsiring, “Karuyag namon makigkita kan Jesus.”

en: Therefore, the Pharisees said to each other, “See! You’ve accomplished nothing! Look! The whole world is following him!”
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe pagsumat kan Andres, ngan kinmadto hira nga duha pagsumat kan Jesus.

en: Some Greeks were among those who had come up to worship at the festival.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Inmabot na yana an takna nga pagpapasidunggan an Anak han Tawo.

en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and made a request: “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an usa ka lugas nga trigo nagpapabilin hin ka usa la ka lugas nga trigo labot kon mahulog ha tuna ngan katak-opan. Kon katak-opan na, mabunga hin damo nga mga lugas.

en: Philip told Andrew, and Andrew and Philip told Jesus.
war: Mawawad-an han iya kalugaringon an nahigugma han iya kinabuhi; kundi makakaangkon lugod han kinabuhi nga dayon adton nagdudumot han iya kinabuhi dinhe hini nga kalibutan.

en: Jesus replied, “The time has come for the Human One to be glorified.
war: Kinahanglan magsunod ha akon an karuyag magsirbe ha akon, basi kon hain ako, aadto man an akon surugoon. Pagpapasidunggan han akon Amay an magsirbe ha akon.”

en: I assure you that unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it can only be a single seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
war: “Mabidoon gud ako yana, ngan ano an akon isisiring? Masiring ba ako, ‘Amay ko, palabya anay ha akon ini nga takna’? Diri, kay amo ini an hinungdan nga kinmanhi ako, basi karawaton ko ini nga takna hin pag-antos.

en: Those who love their lives will lose them, and those who hate their lives in this world will keep them forever.
war: Amay ko, paghimayaa an imo ngaran!”

en: Whoever serves me must follow me. Wherever I am, there my servant will also be. My Father will honor whoever serves me.
war: Ngan nagyakan in tingog tikang ha langit, “Ginhimaya ko na ini, ngan paghihimayaon ko na liwat.”

en: “ Now I am deeply troubled. What should I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? No, for this is the reason I have come to this time.
war: Nakabati han tingog an kadam-an nga nagkakatukdaw didto, ngan nagsiring, “Nagdalugdog!” An iba nagsiring, “Nagyakan ha iya in usa nga anghel!”

en: Father, glorify your name! ”
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri tungod ha akon nga nagyakan ini nga tingog, kundi tungod ha iyo.

en: Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
war: Ginhuhukman na yana an kalibutan; pupukanon na yana an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: The crowd standing there heard and said, “It’s thunder.” Others said, “An angel spoke to him.”
war: Kakabigon ko ngadi ha akon an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kon isahon na ako tikang ha tuna.” (

en: Jesus replied, “ This voice wasn’t for my benefit but for yours.
war: Ha pagsiring niya hini, iginpasabot niya an paagi han kamatayon nga iya pag-aantoson.)

en: Now is the time for judgment of this world. Now this world’s ruler will be thrown out.
war: Nagbaton an kadam-an, “Nagsusumat an aton Balaod nga mabubuhi ha kadayonan an Mesiyas. Niyan naunan-o man nga nasiring ka nga kinahanglan isahon an Anak han Tawo? Hin-o man ini nga Anak han Tawo?”

en: When I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to me. ” (
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Halipotay na la nga panahon an pag-upod ha iyo han kapawa. Pagpadayon ha iyo dalan samtang aada pa ha iyo an kapawa, basi diri kamo abotan han kasisidman; kay an naglalakat ha kasisidman diri maaram kon tipakain hiya.

en: He said this to show how he was going to die.)
war: Sanglit too kamo han kapawa, samtang aada pa ha iyo ini, basi mahimo kamo nga mga anak han kapawa.”

en: The crowd responded, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ remains forever. How can you say that the Human One must be lifted up? Who is this Human One?”
war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, linmakat hiya ngan tinmago.

en: Jesus replied, “ The light is with you for only a little while. Walk while you have the light so that darkness doesn’t overtake you. Those who walk in the darkness don’t know where they are going.
war: Bisan kon ginbuhat niya ini ngatanan nga mga urosahon ha atubangan nira, waray gihapon hira tumoo ha iya,

en: As long as you have the light, believe in the light so that you might become people whose lives are determined by the light. ” After Jesus said these things, he went away and hid from them.
war: basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna:

en: Jesus had done many miraculous signs before the people, but they didn’t believe in him.
war: “Ginoo, hin-o in tinmuod

en: This was to fulfill the word of the prophet Isaiah:
war: han iginsumat namon nga mensahe?

en: Lord, who has believed through our message?
war: Hin-o an ginpakita han Ginoo han iya gahom?”

en: To whom is the arm of the Lord fully revealed?
war: Tungod hini waray hira makatoo, kay nagsiring liwat hi Isaias:

en: Isaiah explains why they couldn’t believe:
war: “Ginbuta han Dyos an ira mga mata,

en: He made their eyes blind
war: ngan ginsadhan an ira mga hunahuna,

en: and closed their minds
war: basi diri kumita an ira mga mata,

en: so that they might not see with their eyes,
war: ngan diri makasantop an ira mga hunahuna,

en: understand with their minds,
war: ngan diri hira dumanggop ha akon,

en: and turn their lives around—
war: nasiring an Dyos,

en: and I would heal them.
war: basi tambalon ko hira.”

en: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory; he spoke about Jesus.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Isaias kay hinkit-an niya an gahom ni Jesus, ngan nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha iya.

en: Even so, many leaders believed in him, but they wouldn’t acknowledge their faith because they feared that the Pharisees would expel them from the synagogue.
war: Bisan pa ngani, damo gihapon nga mga punoan nga Judiyo in tinmoo kan Jesus; kundi tungod han mga Parisiyo, waray hira magpadayag hin paghimangraw ha kadam-an, basi diri hira pagawason ha sinagoga.

en: They believed, but they loved human praise more than God’s glory.
war: Ginpalabi nira an pagdayaw ha ira han mga tawo kay han pagdayaw ha ira han Dyos.

en: Before the Festival of Passover, Jesus knew that his time had come to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them fully.
war: Bisperas na adto han Pyesta han Paglabay. Maaram na hi Jesus nga inmabot na an iya takna hin pagbaya hini nga kalibutan ngan hin pagkadto han Amay. Dayuday ginhigugma niya an iya mga sakop dinhe ha kalibutan, ngan ginhigugma niya hira tubtob gud ha kataposan.

en: Jesus and his disciples were sharing the evening meal. The devil had already provoked Judas, Simon Iscariot’s son, to betray Jesus.
war: Tarangka ha panihapon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Ginlarang na han Yawa nga maglilingo kan Jesus hi Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: Jesus knew the Father had given everything into his hands and that he had come from God and was returning to God.
war: Maaram hi Jesus nga itinubyan ha iya han Amay an bug-os nga gahom, ngan maaram hiya nga tikang hiya ha Dyos, ngan tikadto na hiya sa Dyos.

en: So he got up from the table and took off his robes. Picking up a linen towel, he tied it around his waist.
war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jesus ngan maglubas han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan magbagkos hin twalya.

en: Then he poured water into a washbasin and began to wash the disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel he was wearing.
war: Inmipis hiya hin tubig ngada ha palanggana ngan nagtikang hin panmusa han mga tiil han mga tinun-an, ngan ginpahiran han twalya nga iya iginbagkos.

en: When Jesus came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
war: Hinmarani kan Simon Pedro nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ginoo, mamumusa ka ba han akon mga tiil?”

en: Jesus replied, “ You don’t understand what I’m doing now, but you will understand later. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ka pa maaram yana kon ano an akon ginbubuhat, kundi hibabaroan mo ini onina.”

en: “No!” Peter said. “You will never wash my feet!”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako matugot nga mamusa ka han akon mga tiil!”

en: Jesus replied, “ Unless I wash you, you won’t have a place with me. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon diri ako mamusa han imo mga tiil, diri ka na magigin tinun-an ko.”

en: Simon Peter said, “Lord, not only my feet but also my hands and my head!”
war: Nagbaton hi Simon Pedro, “Kon amo man ini, Ginoo, diri la an akon mga tiil, kundi ilakip liwat hin paghugas an akon mga kamot ngan ulo!”

en: Jesus responded, “ Those who have bathed need only to have their feet washed, because they are completely clean. You disciples are clean, but not every one of you. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “An human na kumarigos, malinis na an iya bug-os nga lawas, sanglit diri na kinahanglan maghugas pa ha iya ngahaw, kundi an iya mga tiil na la. Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.” (

en: He knew who would betray him. That’s why he said, “ Not every one of you is clean. ”
war: Maaram na hi Jesus kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.”)

en: After he washed the disciples’ feet, he put on his robes and returned to his place at the table. He said to them, “Do you know what I’ve done for you?
war: Katapos niya pamusa han ira mga tiil, nagsul-ot na liwat hi Jesus han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan binmalik ha iya lingkoran ha lamesa. Nagpakiana hiya, “Nasayod ba kamo han ginbuhat ko ha iyo?

en: You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and you speak correctly, because I am.
war: Natawag kamo ha akon nga magturutdo ngan Ginoo, ngan may kamatuoran, kay amo gud ito ako.

en: If I, your Lord and teacher, have washed your feet, you too must wash each other’s feet.
war: Sanglit kon ako nga iyo Ginoo ngan Magturutdo namusa han iyo mga tiil, angay man liwat kamo maggiparupamusa han iyo mga tiil.

en: I have given you an example: Just as I have done, you also must do.
war: Gintagan ko kamo hin susbaranan, basi sugaron niyo hin pagbuhat han ginbuhat ko ha iyo.

en: I assure you, servants aren’t greater than their master, nor are those who are sent greater than the one who sent them.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron; waray sinugo nga labaw han nagsugo ha iya.

en: Since you know these things, you will be happy if you do them.
war: Yana maaram na kamo hini nga kamatuoran; palaran kamo kon buhaton ini niyo!

en: I’m not speaking about all of you. I know those whom I’ve chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture, The one who eats my bread has turned against me.
war: “Diri ako naghihimangraw mahitungod ha iyo ngatanan; nakilala ako han akon mga ginpili. Kundi kinahanglan matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, ‘Kinmontra ha akon an tawo nga sinmaro ha akon.’

en: “ I’m telling you this now, before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I Am.
war: Ginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo nga hi ‘Ako Amo Ako.’

en: I assure you that whoever receives someone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me. ”
war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han akon sinusugo, nakarawat man ha akon; ngan an nakarawat ha akon, nakarawat man han nagsugo ha akon.”

en: After he said these things, Jesus was deeply disturbed and testified, “ I assure you, one of you will betray me. ”
war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, inalpan hiya hin dako nga kabido, ngan nagsiring hin dayag, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo.”

en: His disciples looked at each other, confused about which of them he was talking about.
war: Naggipasirosiplat hira nga nanhiburong kon hin-o gud an iya karuyag sidngon.

en: One of the disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was at Jesus’ side.
war: Nalingkod sapit ni Jesus an hinigugma niya nga tinun-an.

en: Simon Peter nodded at him to get him to ask Jesus who he was talking about.
war: Nagsenyas hi Simon Pedro ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Pakianhi daw hiya kon hin-o an iya hinnanabihan.”

en: Leaning back toward Jesus, this disciple asked, “Lord, who is it?”
war: Sanglit sinmiring kan Jesus adto nga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man hiya, Ginoo?”

en: Jesus answered, “ It’s the one to whom I will give this piece of bread once I have dipped into the bowl. ” Then he dipped the piece of bread and gave it to Judas, Simon Iscariot’s son.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Itutunlob ko an tinapay ngan ihahatag ko ini ha iya; amo hiya an tawo.” Sanglit kinmuha hiya hin pinit nga tinapay, iya ini gintunlob, ngan iginhatag kan Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: After Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus told him, “ What you are about to do, do quickly. ”
war: Han pakakarawat gud la ni Judas han tinapay, sinmulod dayon ha iya hi Satanas. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Dagmit ngan tumana an kinahanglan mo buhaton!”

en: No one sitting at the table understood why Jesus said this to him.
war: Waray nakasabot han mga nakada ha lamesa kay ano nga ginsiring ini ni Jesus ha iya.

en: Some thought that, since Judas kept the money bag, Jesus told him, “Go, buy what we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
war: Tungod nga hi Judas man an tinaporan han supot han kwarta, nakahunahuna an iba nga mga tinun-an nga ginsugo hiya ni Jesus hin pagpalit han ira kinahanglanon para han pyesta, o bangin ginsugo hiya paghatag ngadto han mga kablas.

en: So when Judas took the bread, he left immediately. And it was night.
war: Ginkarawat ni Judas an tinapay ngan ginmawas hiya dayon. Gab-i adto.

en: When Judas was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Human One has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
war: Han paggawas na ni Judas, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Iginpapakita na yana an himaya han Anak han Tawo, ngan pinaagi ha iya, ginpapakita liwat an himaya han Dyos.

en: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify the Human One in himself and will glorify him immediately.
war: Kon iginpapakita an himaya han Dyos pinaagi ha iya, magpapakita man an Dyos han himaya han Anak han Tawo ha iya ngahaw, ngan bubuhaton ito niya dayon.

en: Little children, I’m with you for a little while longer. You will look for me—but, just as I told the Jewish leaders, I also tell you now—‘Where I’m going, you can’t come.’
war: Mga anak ko, gutiay na la nga panahon an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo. Mamimiling kamo ha akon; kundi susumatan ko kamo yana han akon iginsiring ngadto han mga Judiyo, ‘Diri kamo makakadto han akon kakadtoan.’

en: “ I give you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, so you also must love each other.
war: Ihinahatag ko ha iyo in bag-o nga sugo: magsihigugmaay kamo. Kinahanglan magsihigugmaay kamo sugad han akon paghigugma ha iyo.

en: This is how everyone will know that you are my disciples, when you love each other. ”
war: Kon magsihigugmaay kamo, mahibabaro an ngatanan nga akon kamo mga tinun-an.”

en: Simon Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, where are you going?”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain ka man kakadto, Ginoo ?”

en: Jesus answered, “ Where I am going, you can’t follow me now, but you will follow later. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri ka pa yana makakasunod ngadto han akon kakadtoan, kundi masunod ka ha akon onina.”

en: “ Don’t be troubled. Trust in God. Trust also in me.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kagupong. Too kamo han Dyos ngan too man kamo ha akon.

en: My Father’s house has room to spare. If that weren’t the case, would I have told you that I’m going to prepare a place for you?
war: Damo in mga kwarto didto han balay han akon Amay, ngan makadto ako hin pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo. Diri ako magsusumat hini ha iyo kon diri pa ini tinuod.

en: When I go to prepare a place for you, I will return and take you to be with me so that where I am you will be too.
war: Ngan katapos ko kadto ngan pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo, mabalik ako ngan pauupdon ko kamo ha akon, basi kon hain ako aadto man liwat kamo.

en: You know the way to the place I’m going. ”
war: Maaram na kamo kon uunanhon niyo pagsangpot ngadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: Thomas asked, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Tomas, “Ginoo, diri kami maaram kon tikain ka; uunanhon man namon paghibaro han dalan nga tipakadto?”

en: Jesus answered, “ I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Amo ako an dalan, an kamatuoran, ngan an kinabuhi; waray makakadto han Amay kon diri pinaagi ha akon.”

en: If you have really known me, you will also know the Father. From now on you know him and have seen him. ”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Yana nga nakakilala na kamo ha akon, makilala man kamo han akon Amay; ngan tikang yana nakilala na kamo ha iya, ngan hinkit-an na hiya niyo.”

en: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father; that will be enough for us.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Ginoo, ipakita ha amon an Amay ngan igo na ito para ha amon.”

en: Jesus replied, “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been with you all this time? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kamaiha na nga kaupod-upod ako niyo ngatanan; diri ka pa gihapon nakilala ha akon, Felipe? Nakakita na han Amay an bisan hin-o nga nakakita ha akon. Sanglit kay ano nga nasiring ka, ‘Ipakita ha amon an Amay’?

en: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I have spoken to you I don’t speak on my own. The Father who dwells in me does his works.
war: Diri ka ba natoo, Felipe, nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon?” Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Diri natikang ha akon an mga pulong nga iginhimangraw ko ha iyo. Nagbubuhat an Amay nga aadi ha akon han iya kalugaringon nga mga buruhaton.

en: Trust me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me, or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
war: Tuohi niyo nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon; kon diri man, tuohi ako niyo tungod hini nga mga buhat.

en: I assure you that whoever believes in me will do the works that I do. They will do even greater works than these because I am going to the Father.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: magbubuhat man han mga buruhaton nga akon ginbubuhat an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon—tinuod, magbubuhat hiya hin larolabaw pa, kay makadto ako han Amay.

en: I will do whatever you ask for in my name, so that the Father can be glorified in the Son.
war: Ngan bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha akon ngaran, basi pagdayawon an Amay pinaagi han Anak.

en: When you ask me for anything in my name, I will do it.
war: Bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo ha akon ngaran.

en: “If you love me, you will keep my commandments.
war: “Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, magtutuman kamo han akon mga sugo.

en: I will ask the Father, and he will send another Companion, who will be with you forever.
war: Pangangaroon ko han Amay, ngan tatagan kamo niya hin lain nga Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga magpapabilin ha iyo ha kadayonan.

en: This Companion is the Spirit of Truth, whom the world can’t receive because it neither sees him nor recognizes him. You know him, because he lives with you and will be with you.
war: Diri makarawat ha iya an kalibutan, kay diri nakita o nakilala an kalibutan ha iya. Kundi nakilala kamo ha iya, kay nagpapabilin nga nag-uokoy hiya dida ha iyo.

en: “ I won’t leave you as orphans. I will come to you.
war: “Diri ko kamo babayaan nga mag-uusaan; mabalik ako ngada ha iyo.

en: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Because I live, you will live too.
war: Ha diri maiha diri na makita ha akon an kalibutan, kundi makita kamo ha akon; ngan mabubuhi kamo kay buhi man ako.

en: On that day you will know that I am in my Father, you are in me, and I am in you.
war: Kon umabot na ito nga adlaw, hibabaroan niyo nga aada ako han akon Amay, ngan aadi kamo ha akon, sugad nga aada ako ha iyo.

en: Whoever has my commandments and keeps them loves me. Whoever loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love them and reveal myself to them. ”
war: “Nahigugma ha akon an bisan hin-o nga makarawat ngan magtuman han akon mga sugo. Hihigugmaon han akon Amay adton nahigugma ha akon; hihigugmaon ko man hiya ngan magpapakilala ako ha iya.”

en: Judas (not Judas Iscariot) asked, “Lord, why are you about to reveal yourself to us and not to the world?”
war: Nagpakiana hi Judas (diri hi Judas Iscariote), “Ginoo, uunanhon hin pagpakilala mo han imo kalugaringon ha amon, ngan diri ngadto ha kalibutan?”

en: Jesus answered, “Whoever loves me will keep my word. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Magtutuman han akon mensahe an bisan hin-o nga nahigugma ha akon. Hihigugmaon hiya han akon Amay, ngan makada kami ha iya, ngan mag-uokoy kami dida ha iya.

en: Whoever doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word that you hear isn’t mine. It is the word of the Father who sent me.
war: Diri nagtutuman han akon mga pulong an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma ha akon. Diri akon an mensahe nga hinbatian niyo, kundi natikang han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: “I have spoken these things to you while I am with you.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo samtang upod pa ako niyo.

en: The Companion, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I told you.
war: Kundi an Parabulig, an Espiritu Santo, nga susugoon han Amay ha akon ngaran, amo an magtututdo ha iyo han ngatanan nga mga butang, ngan magpapahinumdom ha iyo han ngatanan nga akon iginsumat ha iyo.

en: “Peace I leave with you. My peace I give you. I give to you not as the world gives. Don’t be troubled or afraid.
war: “Ibibilin ko ha iyo an kalinaw; ihahatag ko ha iyo an akon kalinaw. Ihahatag ko ini ha iyo diri sugad han paghatag han kalibutan. Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kalisang; ayaw kamo kahadlok.

en: You have heard me tell you, ‘I’m going away and returning to you.’ If you loved me, you would be happy that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than me.
war: Hinbatian ako niyo nga nasiring ha iyo, ‘Mabaya ako, kundi mabalik ako ha iyo.’ Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, maglilipay unta kamo nga makadto ako han Amay, kay larolabaw hiya ha akon.

en: I have told you before it happens so that when it happens you will believe.
war: Iginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo.

en: I won’t say much more to you because this world’s ruler is coming. He has nothing on me.
war: Diri na ako maghihimangraw ha iyo hin maiha, kay maabot na an punoan hini nga kalibutan. Waray hiya gahom ha akon,

en: Rather, he comes so that the world will know that I love the Father and do just as the Father has commanded me. Get up. We’re leaving this place.
war: kundi kinahanglan mahibaro an kalibutan nga nahigugma ako han Amay; sanglit ginbubuhat ko an ngatanan nga iginsugo niya ha akon.

en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the vineyard keeper.
war: “Amo ako an tinuod nga balagon, ngan an akon Amay an magmarangno.

en: He removes any of my branches that don’t produce fruit, and he trims any branch that produces fruit so that it will produce even more fruit.
war: Binabanggi niya an ngatanan nga sanga nga diri nabunga. Tinatag-an niya hin paghawan an kada sanga nga nabunga, basi mamunga hin darodamo.

en: You are already trimmed because of the word I have spoken to you.
war: Nalinisan na kamo pinaagi han mensahe nga akon iginhimangraw ha iyo.

en: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. A branch can’t produce fruit by itself, but must remain in the vine. Likewise, you can’t produce fruit unless you remain in me.
war: Pabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpapabilin man ako dida ha iyo. Diri makakabunga in sanga ha iya la kalugaringon; mahihimo la ini kon sumpay han puno an sanga. Ha sugad nga kaagi, diri kamo makakabunga, labot kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon.

en: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, then you will produce much fruit. Without me, you can’t do anything.
war: “Ako an balagon ngan kamo an mga sanga. Mabunga hin damo an bisan hin-o nga magpabilin didi ha akon, ngan ako dida ha iya, kay waray niyo mahihimo kon bulag kamo ha akon.

en: If you don’t remain in me, you will be like a branch that is thrown out and dries up. Those branches are gathered up, thrown into a fire, and burned.
war: Ilinalabog ha gawas an bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapabilin ha akon, ngan nauuga sugad hin sanga; gintitirok in sugad nga mga sanga, ngan ilinalabog ha kalayo, ngan sunogon.

en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask for whatever you want and it will be done for you.
war: Kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpabilin an akon mga pulong dida ha iyo, mangangaro kamo hin bisan ano nga inuungara niyo, ngan katutumanan kamo.

en: My Father is glorified when you produce much fruit and in this way prove that you are my disciples.
war: Ginhihimaya an akon Amay tungod han iyo pamunga hin damo; ngan pinaagi hini, nagigin mga tinun-an ko kamo.

en: “As the Father loved me, I too have loved you. Remain in my love.
war: Hinihigugma ko kamo sugad gud han paghigugma ha akon han Amay; pagpabilin kamo didi han akon gugma.

en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, just as I kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
war: Kon tumanon niyo an akon mga sugo, magpapabilin kamo ha akon gugma, sugad gud han pagtuman ko han mga sugo han akon Amay ngan nagpapabilin ako dida han iya gugma.

en: I have said these things to you so that my joy will be in you and your joy will be complete.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mahingada ha iyo an akon kalipay, ngan basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: This is my commandment: love each other just as I have loved you.
war: Amo ini an akon sugo: pagsihigugmaay kamo, sugad han paghigugma ko ha iyo.

en: No one has greater love than to give up one’s life for one’s friends.
war: An gidadakoi nga gugma nga maaangkon hin usa ka tawo tungod han iya kasangkayan, amo an pagtubyan han iya kinabuhi para ha ira.

en: You are my friends if you do what I command you.
war: Ngan kasangkayan ko kamo, kon buhaton niyo an akon iginsusugo ha iyo.

en: I don’t call you servants any longer, because servants don’t know what their master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because everything I heard from my Father I have made known to you.
war: Diri ko na kamo tatawgon nga mga surugoon, kay diri maaram an surugoon han ginbubuhat han iya agaron. Lugod, tatawagon ko kamo nga mga sangkay, kay iginsumat ko ha iyo an ngatanan nga hinbatian ko tikang han akon Amay.

en: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you could go and produce fruit and so that your fruit could last. As a result, whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.
war: Waray kamo magpili ha akon; ako an nagpili ha iyo, ngan nagtudlok ha iyo nga magkalakat kamo ngan mamunga hin damo, mga bunga nga nagpapadayon. Sanglit ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya, ha akon ngaran.

en: I give you these commandments so that you can love each other.
war: Sanglit amo ini an igsusugo ko ha iyo: paggihigugmaay kamo.”

en: “If the world hates you, know that it hated me first.
war: “Kon magdumot ha iyo an kalibutan, kinahanglan hisabotan niyo nga una ako pagdumtan han kalibutan.

en: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. However, I have chosen you out of the world, and you don’t belong to the world. This is why the world hates you.
war: Kon kanan kalibutan pa kamo, mahigugma unta ha iyo an kalibutan sugad nga iya kalugaringon. Kundi ginpili ko kamo tikang hini nga kalibutan, ngan diri na kamo sakop han kalibutan; sanglit magdudumot ha iyo an kalibutan.

en: Remember what I told you, ‘Servants aren’t greater than their master.’ If the world harassed me, it will harass you too. If it kept my word, it will also keep yours.
war: Hinumdomi an iginsiring ko ha iyo: ‘Waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron.’ Kon ginpakurian ako nira, pagpapakurian man liwat kamo nira; kon gintuman nira an akon mensahe, pagtutumanon man liwat nira an iyo mensahe.

en: The world will do all these things to you on account of my name, because it doesn’t know the one who sent me.
war: Kundi bubuhaton nira ini ngatanan ha iyo, kay akon man kamo sakop; kay diri hira nakilala han nagsugo ha akon.

en: “If I hadn’t come and spoken to the people of this world, they wouldn’t be sinners. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray pa ako kumanhi ngan maghimangraw ha ira; kundi yana, waray na hira baribad han ira sala.

en: Whoever hates me also hates the Father.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot ha akon, nagdudumot man han akon Amay.

en: If I hadn’t done works among them that no one else had done, they wouldn’t be sinners. But now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray ko pa buhata ha butnga nira an mga buhat nga waray pagbuhata hin bisan hin-o; kundi yana, hinkit-an na nira an akon ginbuhat, ngan gindudumtan nira ako ngan an akon Amay.

en: This fulfills the word written in their Law, They hated me without a reason.
war: Kundi kinahanglan mahinabo ini, basi matuman an iginsurat dida han ira Balaod: ‘Gindumtan ako nira hin waray la hinungdan.’

en: “When the Companion comes, whom I will send from the Father—the Spirit of Truth who proceeds from the Father—he will testify about me.
war: “Maabot an Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga natikang han Amay. Susugoon ko hiya nganhi ha iyo tikang han Amay, ngan magpapamatuod hiya mahitungod ha akon.

en: You will testify too, because you have been with me from the beginning.
war: Ngan magpapamatuod liwat kamo mahitungod ha akon, kay nagin kaupod ko man kamo tikang pa gud ha tinikangan.

en: I have said these things to you so that you won’t fall away.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi diri lumuya an iyo pagtoo ha akon.

en: They will expel you from the synagogue. The time is coming when those who kill you will think that they are doing a service to God.
war: Paiiwason kamo nira ha ira mga sinagoga. Maabot an panahon nga an magpapatay ha iyo makakahunahuna nga nag-aalagad hiya han Dyos.

en: They will do these things because they don’t know the Father or me.
war: Bubuhaton nira ha iyo ini nga mga butang, kay waray hira makakilala han Amay o ha akon.

en: But I have said these things to you so that when their time comes, you will remember that I told you about them.
war: Kundi iginsumat ko ini ha iyo, basi kon buhaton na nira ini, mahinunumdom kamo nga iginsumat ko ini ha iyo.

en: “I didn’t say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.
war: “Waray ko igsumat ha iyo ini nga mga butang ha tinikangan, kay kaupod pa man ako niyo.

en: But now I go away to the one who sent me. None of you ask me, ‘Where are you going?’
war: Kundi yana, makadto na ako han nagsugo ha akon; kundi waray ha iyo napakiana ha akon, ‘Tikain ka?’

en: Yet because I have said these things to you, you are filled with sorrow.
war: Ngan yana nga ginsumatan ko na kamo, nagmamabidoon kamo.

en: I assure you that it is better for you that I go away. If I don’t go away, the Companion won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
war: Kundi susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: mauruupay para ha iyo nga malakat ako, kay kon diri ako lumakat, diri makanhi ha iyo an Parabulig. Kundi kon lumakat ako, ipadadara ko hiya nganhi ha iyo.

en: When he comes, he will show the world it was wrong about sin, righteousness, and judgment.
war: Ngan kon umabot na hiya, magpapamatuod hiya ha mga tawo han kalibutan nga mga sayop hira mahitungod han sala, mahitungod han pagkamatadong, ngan mahitungod han paghukom han Dyos.

en: He will show the world it was wrong about sin because they don’t believe in me.
war: Sayop hira mahitungod han sala, kay diri hira natoo ha akon;

en: He will show the world it was wrong about righteousness because I’m going to the Father and you won’t see me anymore.
war: mahitungod han pagkamatadong, kay makadto ako han Amay ngan diri na kamo makita ha akon;

en: He will show the world it was wrong about judgment because this world’s ruler stands condemned.
war: mahitungod han paghukom, kay ginhukman na an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: “ I have much more to say to you, but you can’t handle it now.
war: “Damo pa gad an akon igsurumat ha iyo, kundi diri pa ini niyo maaakos yana.

en: However, when the Spirit of Truth comes, he will guide you in all truth. He won’t speak on his own, but will say whatever he hears and will proclaim to you what is to come.
war: Kundi kon umabot na an Espiritu han kamatuoran, igtututdo kamo niya ngadto han ngatanan nga kamatuoran. Diri hiya maghihimangraw ha iya la kalugaringon, kundi maghihimangraw hiya han hinbabatian, ngan magsusumat han mga butang nga tiarabot.

en: He will glorify me, because he will take what is mine and proclaim it to you.
war: Paghihimayaon ako niya, kay natikang ha akon an igsusumat niya ha iyo.

en: Everything that the Father has is mine. That’s why I said that the Spirit takes what is mine and will proclaim it to you.
war: Akon an ngatanan nga kanan Amay; sanglit nagsiring ako nga natikang ha akon an igsusumat ha iyo han Espiritu.

en: Soon you won’t be able to see me; soon after that, you will see me. ”
war: “Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon; ngan ha diri liwat maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.”

en: Some of Jesus’ disciples said to each other, “What does he mean: ‘Soon you won’t see me, and soon after that you will see me’ and ‘Because I’m going to the Father’?
war: Nagsiring ngadto han iba an pira han iya mga tinun-an: “Ano ba an kahulogan hini nga iya siring, ‘Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon’; ngan nasiring liwat hiya, ‘Kay makadto ako han Amay.’”

en: What does he mean by ‘soon’? We don’t understand what he’s talking about.”
war: Nagpakiana pa hira, “Ano an buot niya sidngon han ‘diri maiha’? Diri kita nasabot han iya ginyiyinakan!”

en: Jesus knew they wanted to ask him, so he said, “Are you trying to find out from each other what I meant when I said, ‘Soon you won’t see me, and soon after that you will see me’?
war: Nahibaro hi Jesus nga karuyag hira pumakiana ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nagsiring ako, ‘Ha diri maiha diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.’ Amo ba ini an iyo ginpaparopakiana?

en: I assure you that you will cry and lament, and the world will be happy. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: magtatangis ngan magngunguyngoy kamo, kundi maglilipay an kalibutan; magmamabidoon kamo, kundi magigin kalipayan an iyo kabidoan.

en: When a woman gives birth, she has pain because her time has come. But when the child is born, she no longer remembers her distress because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
war: Mabidoon in babaye kon tipagaranak pa la hiya, kay inmabot na an takna han iya pag-antos; kundi kon natatawo na an bata, hinngangalimtan niya an iya gin-antos, kay malipayon na hiya nga may natawo nga bata nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: In the same way, you have sorrow now; but I will see you again, and you will be overjoyed. No one takes away your joy.
war: Amo man ini dida ha iyo: mabidoon kamo yana, kundi makikigkita liwat ako ha iyo, ngan magmamalipayon gud kamo hin kalipay nga waray makakaagaw ha iyo.

en: In that day, you won’t ask me anything. I assure you that the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
war: “Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw diri na kamo mangangaro ha akon hin bisan ano. Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya ha akon ngaran.

en: Up to now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask and you will receive so that your joy will be complete.
war: Ngada yana waray pa kamo mangaro hin bisan ano ha akon ngaran; pangaro ngan makarawat kamo, basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: “ I’ve been using figures of speech with you. The time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in such analogies. Instead, I will tell you plainly about the Father.
war: “Iginsumat ko ha iyo ini nga mga butang pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Kundi maabot in panahon nga diri na ako magamit hin mga pananglitan, kundi magyayakan ako ha iyo hin yano nga mga pulong mahitungod han Amay.

en: In that day you will ask in my name. I’m not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
war: Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw mangangaro kamo ha iya ha akon ngaran; ngan diri ako nasiring nga mangangaro ako ha iya para ha iyo,

en: The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and believed that I came from God.
war: kay nahigugma ha iyo an Amay ngahaw. Nahigugma hiya ha iyo kay nahigugma man kamo ha akon ngan tinmoo kamo nga tinmikang ako han Dyos.

en: I left the Father and came into the world. I tell you again: I am leaving the world and returning to the Father. ”
war: Tikang gud ako han Amay ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan; ngan yana mabaya na ako han kalibutan ngan mabalik ako ngadto han Amay.”

en: His disciples said, “See! Now you speak plainly; you aren’t using figures of speech.
war: Ngan nagsiring an iya mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, dayag na kaupay an imo pagyakan, ngan diri ka na nagamit hin mga pananglitan.

en: Now we know that you know everything and you don’t need anyone to ask you. Because of this we believe you have come from God.”
war: Maaram na kami yana nga sayod ka han ngatanan; diri ka nagkikinahanglan nga may magpinakiana pa ha imo. Nakakapatoo ini ha amon nga tikang ka han Dyos.”

en: Jesus replied, “ Now you believe?
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Natoo na ba kamo yana?
