en: Look! A time is coming—and is here!—when each of you will be scattered to your own homes and you will leave me alone. I’m not really alone, for the Father is with me.
war: Maabot an panahon, ngan aanhi na, nga magkakaburublag kamo ngatanan, kada usa, ha iya kalugaringon nga urukyan, ngan babayaan ako nga mag-uusaan. Kundi diri tinuod nga nag-uusaan la ako, kay kaupod ko an Amay.

en: When Jesus finished saying these things, he looked up to heaven and said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son can glorify you.
war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini, hinmangad hiya ha langit ngan nagsiring, “Amay ko, inmabot na an takna. Paghimayaa an imo Anak, basi paghimayaon ka man han imo Anak.

en: You gave him authority over everyone so that he could give eternal life to everyone you gave him.
war: Kay gintagan mo man hiya hin gahom hin pagmando han ngatanan nga mga tawo basi humatag hiya han dayon nga kinabuhi ngadto han ngatanan nga igintubyan mo ha iya.

en: This is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent.
war: Ngan amo ini an dayon nga kinabuhi; nga kumilala ha imo an mga tawo, nga ikaw la an matuod nga Dyos, ngan kumilala kan Jesu-Cristo nga imo ginsugo.

en: I have glorified you on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
war: Iginpakita ko ha tuna an imo himaya; ginhuman ko na an iginpabuhat mo ha akon.

en: Now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I shared with you before the world was created.
war: Amay ko, himayaa ako yana ha imo atubangan sugad han himaya nga akon hadto han kaupod pa ako nimo, han waray pa himoa an kalibutan.

en: “I have revealed your name to the people you gave me from this world. They were yours and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
war: “Iginpakilala ko ikaw han mga tawo nga imo ginkuha ha kalibutan. Imo hira, ngan gintubyan mo hira ha akon. Gintuman nira an imo pulong,

en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
war: ngan yana maaram hira nga tikang ha imo an ngatanan nga iginhatag mo ha akon.

en: This is because I gave them the words that you gave me, and they received them. They truly understood that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
war: Igintutdo ko ha ira an mensahe nga iginhatag mo ha akon, ngan ginkarawat ini hira. Maaram hira nga tikang ako ha imo, ngan natoo hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: “I’m praying for them. I’m not praying for the world but for those you gave me, because they are yours.
war: “Nag-aampo ako para ha ira. Diri ako nag-aampo para han kalibutan, kundi para han mga tawo nga igintubyan mo ha akon, kay imo man hira.

en: Everything that is mine is yours and everything that is yours is mine; I have been glorified in them.
war: Imo an ngatanan nga akon, ngan akon man an ngatanan nga imo; ngan napapasidunggan ako tungod ha ira.

en: I’m no longer in the world, but they are in the world, even as I’m coming to you. Holy Father, watch over them in your name, the name you gave me, that they will be one just as we are one.
war: Yana makada na ako ha imo; mabaya na ako han kalibutan, kundi hahani pa hira ha kalibutan. Baraan nga Amay, panalipdi hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran, an ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita.

en: When I was with them, I watched over them in your name, the name you gave to me, and I kept them safe. None of them were lost, except the one who was destined for destruction, so that scripture would be fulfilled.
war: Ginpanalipdan ko hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, samtang kaupod pa ako nira. Ginbantayan ko hira, ngan waray usa ha ira nga nawara, labot han tawo nga kinahanglan mawara, basi matuman an kasuratan.

en: Now I’m coming to you and I say these things while I’m in the world so that they can share completely in my joy.
war: Kundi yana makada na ako ha imo, ngan ginhihimangraw ko ini nga mga butang dinhe ha kalibutan, basi matugob gud hira han akon kalipayan.

en: I gave your word to them and the world hated them, because they don’t belong to this world, just as I don’t belong to this world.
war: Iginhatag ko ha ira an imo mensahe ngan nagdumot ha ira an kalibutan, kay diri man hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: I’m not asking that you take them out of this world but that you keep them safe from the evil one.
war: Diri ako nahangyo nga kuhaon mo hira ha kalibutan, kundi nga panalipdan mo hira han Yawa.

en: They don’t belong to this world, just as I don’t belong to this world.
war: Diri hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: Make them holy in the truth; your word is truth.
war: Ihalad hira ngada ha imo pinaagi han kamatuoran; an imo pulong amo an kamatuoran.

en: As you sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
war: Ginpadara ko hira nganhi ha kalibutan sugad han pagsugoa mo ha akon nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: I made myself holy on their behalf so that they also would be made holy in the truth.
war: Ngan tungod ha ira ihinahalad ko ha imo an akon kalugaringon, basi hira liwat magin tinuod man nga iginhalad ha imo.

en: “I’m not praying only for them but also for those who believe in me because of their word.
war: “Nag-aampo ako diri para la ha ira, kundi para liwat hadton mga matoo ha akon tungod han ira mensahe.

en: I pray they will be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. I pray that they also will be in us, so that the world will believe that you sent me.
war: Nag-aampo ako nga magkaurosa unta hira ngatanan. Amay, mahiusa unta hira ha aton, sugad gud nga aadi ka ha akon ngan aada ako ha imo, basi tumoo an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: I’ve given them the glory that you gave me so that they can be one just as we are one.
war: Gintagan ko hira han amo nga himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita;

en: I’m in them and you are in me so that they will be made perfectly one. Then the world will know that you sent me and that you have loved them just as you loved me.
war: ako dida ha ira ngan ikaw dadi ha akon, basi magkaurosa unta hira hin hingpit, basi makasabot unta an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon, ngan nahigugma ka ha ira sugad han imo paghigugma ha akon.

en: “Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am. Then they can see my glory, which you gave me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
war: “Amay, igintubyan mo hira ha akon, ngan karuyag ko nga hira mahiusa ha akon bisan kon hain ako, basi hikit-an nira an akon himaya, an himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon; kay ginhigugma mo ako han waray pa hihimoa an kalibutan.

en: “ Righteous Father, even the world didn’t know you, but I’ve known you, and these believers know that you sent me.
war: Matadong nga Amay, diri nakilala ha imo an kalibutan, kundi nakilala ako ha imo, ngan maaram ini hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: I’ve made your name known to them and will continue to make it known so that your love for me will be in them, and I myself will be in them. ”
war: Iginpakilala ko ikaw ha ira, ngan ipadadayon ko hin pagpakilala ha imo, basi maangkon man nira an gugma mo para ha akon, ngan mag-ukoy man ako dida ha ira.”

en: After he said these things, Jesus went out with his disciples and crossed over to the other side of the Kidron Valley. He and his disciples entered a garden there.
war: Katapos ni Jesus mag-ampo hini, linmakat hiya upod an iya mga tinun-an ngan tinmabok han sapa nga Kidron an ngaran. May tanaman didto hadto nga dapit, ngan sinmulod ngadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Judas, his betrayer, also knew the place because Jesus often gathered there with his disciples.
war: Agsob hi Jesus makig-urosa han iya mga tinun-an didto, sanglit maaram hini nga dapit an malingo nga Judas.

en: Judas brought a company of soldiers and some guards from the chief priests and Pharisees. They came there carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hi Judas hini nga tanaman upod in mga sondalo ngan mga gwardya han Templo nga ginsugo han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo. Dara nira in mga hinganiban, mga parol, ngan mga sulo.

en: Jesus knew everything that was to happen to him, so he went out and asked, “ Who are you looking for? ”
war: Maaram hi Jesus han ngatanan nga mahinanabo ha iya, sanglit gintapo niya ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Hin-o an iyo ginbibiling?”

en: They answered, “Jesus the Nazarene.”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: He said to them, “ I Am. ” (Judas, his betrayer, was standing with them.)
war: “Amo ako,” nagsiring hiya.

en: When he said, “I Am,” they shrank back and fell to the ground.
war: Natindog didto upod ha ira an malingo nga Judas.

en: He asked them again, “ Who are you looking for? ”
war: Han pagsiring la ni Jesus, “Amo ako,” inmisol hira ngan nagkatutumba ha tuna.

en: They said, “Jesus the Nazarene.”
war: Ginpakianhan na liwat hira ni Jesus, “Hin-o gud an iyo ginbibiling?”

en: Jesus answered, “ I told you, ‘I Am.’ If you are looking for me, then let these people go. ”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: This was so that the word he had spoken might be fulfilled: “ I didn’t lose anyone of those whom you gave me. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo nga amo ako, sanglit kon ako an iyo tuyo, palakta niyo inin iba.” (

en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)
war: Ginsiring niya ini basi matuman an iya iginyakan, “Amay, waray ako kawad-i bisan usa han imo iginhatag ha akon.”)

en: Jesus told Peter, “ Put your sword away! Am I not to drink the cup the Father has given me? ”
war: May espada hi Simon Pedro; hinulbot ini niya ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an tuo nga talinga han oripon. Malco an ngaran han oripon.

en: Then the company of soldiers, the commander, and the guards from the Jewish leaders took Jesus into custody. They bound him
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada! Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga diri ko iimnon an kupa hin pag-antos nga iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay?”

en: and led him first to Annas. He was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year. (
war: Gindakop ngan gingapos hi Jesus han mga sondalo nga upod han ira kapitan, ngan han mga gwardya nga Judiyo.

en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it was better for one person to die for the people.)
war: Gindara hiya nira, syahan ngadto kan Anas nga ugangan ni Caifas nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig.

en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. Because this other disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard.
war: Hi Caifas an nagsagdon han mga Judiyo nga maoruopay pa nga usa la nga tawo an mamatay para han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: However, Peter stood outside near the gate. Then the other disciple (the one known to the high priest) came out and spoke to the woman stationed at the gate, and she brought Peter in.
war: Sinmunod kan Jesus hi Simon Pedro ngan hin usa nga tinun-an. Kilala kaupay han Labaw nga Padi adto nga usa nga tinun-an, sanglit binmunyog hiya kan Jesus ngadto ha bungsaran han balay han Labaw nga Padi.

en: The servant woman stationed at the gate asked Peter, “Aren’t you one of this man’s disciples?”
war: Nagpabilin hi Pedro ha gawas, ha may portahan. Ginmawas an tinun-an nga kilala han Labaw nga Padi, nakighimangraw han daragita nga nakada han portahan ngan ginpasulod hi Pedro.

en: “I’m not,” he replied.
war: Nagpakiana kan Pedro ini nga daragita nga bantay han portahan, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?”

en: The servants and the guards had made a fire because it was cold. They were standing around it, warming themselves. Peter joined them there, standing by the fire and warming himself.
war: “Diri,” nagbaton hi Pedro.

en: Meanwhile, the chief priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
war: Tungod han kahagkot nagtap-ong an mga surugoon ngan mga gwardya nga nagkatukdaw hira palibot han tap-ong nga nagdadangdang ha ira ngahaw. Tinmig-ob hi Pedro ha ira basi kapasuan hiya.

en: Jesus answered, “ I’ve spoken openly to the world. I’ve always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all the Jews gather. I’ve said nothing in private.
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi mahitungod han iya mga tinun-an ngan mahitungod han iya pagturon-an.

en: Why ask me? Ask those who heard what I told them. They know what I said. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Dayuday dayag an akon pagyakan ha ngatanan. Ginbuhat ko an ngatanan nga pagtutdo didto ha mga sinagoga ngan ha Templo, diin napakadto didto an ngatanan nga mga Judiyo. Waray gud ako magyakan hin bisan ano nga diri dayag ha iyo.

en: After Jesus spoke, one of the guards standing there slapped Jesus in the face. “Is that how you would answer the high priest?” he asked.
war: Kay ano nga ako an iyo ginpapakianhan? Asay niyo pakianhi an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha akon. Pakianhi hira kon ano an akon iginsumat ha ira, sayod hira han akon iginyakan.”

en: Jesus replied, “ If I speak wrongly, testify about what was wrong. But if I speak correctly, why do you strike me? ”
war: Han pagsiring hini ni Jesus, gintampalo hiya hin usa han mga gwardya nga nakadto ngan sidngon, “Kamailob mo hin pagyakan hin sugad ngadto han Labaw nga Padi!”

en: Then Annas sent him, bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon may iginyakan ko nga sayop, sumati an ngatanan nga hahani kon ano an akon ginyakan. Kundi kon matadong man an akon ginyakan, kay ano nga gintampalo mo ako?”

en: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing with the guards, warming himself. They asked, “Aren’t you one of his disciples?”
war: Ngan iginpadara ni Anas hi Jesus nga ginapos pa, ngadto kan Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: Peter denied it, saying, “I’m not.”
war: Han natindog pa hi Pedro nga nagdadangdang harani han tap-ong, nagpakiana ha iya an iba, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?”

en: A servant of the high priest, a relative of the one whose ear Peter had cut off, said to him, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
war: Naglirong hiya ngan nagsiring, “Diri!”

en: Peter denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.
war: Sinmagbang hin pagpakiana in usa han mga oripon han Labaw nga Padi, nga urupod han ginpalongan ni Pedro, “Diri ba ikaw an hinkit-an ko nga kaupod niya didto han tanaman?”

en: The Jewish leaders led Jesus from Caiaphas to the Roman governor’s palace. It was early in the morning. So that they could eat the Passover, the Jewish leaders wouldn’t enter the palace; entering the palace would have made them ritually impure.
war: Ngan nagsiring na liwat hi Pedro, “Diri,” ngan hito ngahaw nga takna tinmugaok in manok.

en: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What charge do you bring against this man?”
war: Han agaaga pa, gindara nira hi Jesus tikang han balay ni Caifas ngadto han palasyo han gobernador. Waray sumulod han palasyo an mga Judiyo kay diri nira karuyag magtalapas han balaod han ira tuluohan hiunong han paglinis, basi makakaon hira han panihapon han Paglabay.

en: They answered, “If he had done nothing wrong, we wouldn’t have handed him over to you.”
war: Sanglit ginmawas na la hi Pilato ngadto ha ira ngan nagpakiana, “Ano in iyo sumbong kontra hini nga tawo?”

en: Pilate responded, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your Law.”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Diri unta namon hiya gindadara nganhi ha imo kon waray pa hiya makagtalapas.”

en: The Jewish leaders replied, “The Law doesn’t allow us to kill anyone.” (
war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Dad-a hiya ngan usisaha niyo sumala han iyo kalugaringon nga balaod.”

en: This was so that Jesus’ word might be fulfilled when he indicated how he was going to die.)
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Diri itinutugot ha amon hin pagpatay bisan kan kanay.” (

en: Pilate went back into the palace. He summoned Jesus and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginyakan ni Jesus han paghimangraw niya kon ano nga paagi mamamatay hiya.)

en: Jesus answered, “ Do you say this on your own or have others spoken to you about me? ”
war: Sinmulod liwat ha palasyo hi Pilato ngan gintawag hi Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya kan Jesus, “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: Pilate responded, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your nation and its chief priests handed you over to me. What have you done?”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kalugaringon mo ba ini nga pakiana, o ginsumatan ka ba hin iba mahitungod ha akon?”

en: Jesus replied, “ My kingdom doesn’t originate from this world. If it did, my guards would fight so that I wouldn’t have been arrested by the Jewish leaders. My kingdom isn’t from here. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “Kay ano, Judiyo ba ako? An imo kalugaringon nga mga tawo ngan an ira mga puno han kapadian an nagtubyan ha imo nganhi ha akon. Ano ba in nabuhat mo?”

en: Then Pilate had Jesus taken and whipped.
war: Ngan ipinakuha ni Pilato hi Jesus ngan iginpalatob hiya ha ira.

en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple robe.
war: Naghimo an mga sondalo hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga ngan iginsul-ot ha iya ulo. Ginbadoan hiya nira hin panapton nga pula,

en: Over and over they went up to him and said, “Greetings, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.
war: gindaop hiya, ngan ginsiring, “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!” Ngan gintampalo hiya nira.

en: Pilate came out of the palace again and said to the Jewish leaders, “Look! I’m bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no grounds for a charge against him.”
war: Ginmawas na liwat hi Pilato ngan sidngon an mga tawo, “Tan-awa, dadad-on ko hiya nganhi ha iyo basi niyo hibaroan nga waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: When Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here’s the man.”
war: Ngan ginmawas hi Jesus nga nakakasul-ot han tunokon nga korona ngan han panapton nga pula. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga tawo, “Kitaa, iini an tawo!”

en: When the chief priests and their deputies saw him, they shouted out, “Crucify, crucify!”
war: Han pakakita la ha iya han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga gwardya, naggoliat hira, “Igraysang hiya ha kros! Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: Pilate told them, “You take him and crucify him. I don’t find any grounds for a charge against him.”
war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuhaa hiya niyo ngan igraysang hiya ha kros. Waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: The Jewish leaders replied, “We have a Law, and according to this Law he ought to die because he made himself out to be God’s Son.”
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “May-ada kami balaod nga nagsusumat nga kinahanglan hiya mamatay, kay nagpaka-Anak han Dyos hiya.”

en: When Pilate heard this word, he was even more afraid.
war: Labi na nga nahadlok hi Pilato han pakabati niya hini.

en: He went back into the residence and spoke to Jesus, “Where are you from?” Jesus didn’t answer.
war: Binmalik hiya pagsulod ngadto han palasyo ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Tikang ka ba diin?”

en: So Pilate said, “You won’t speak to me? Don’t you know that I have authority to release you and also to crucify you?”
war: Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus.

en: Jesus replied, “ You would have no authority over me if it had not been given to you from above. That’s why the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin. ”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Pilato, “Diri ka ba nabaton ha akon? Tigamni nga may-ada ko gahom hin pagtalwas ha imo ngan hin pagraysang ha imo ha kros.”

en: From that moment on, Pilate wanted to release Jesus.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “May-ada ka gahom ha akon tungod la nga iginhatag ini han Dyos ha imo; sanglit darudako nga salaan an nagtubyan ha akon ngada ha imo.”

en: However, the Jewish leaders cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t a friend of the emperor! Anyone who makes himself out to be a king opposes the emperor!”
war: Han pakabati hini ni Pilato, nagtalingoha hiya pagbiling hin paagi hin pagbuhi kan Jesus. Kundi naggoliat an mga Judiyo, “Kon buhian mo hiya, diri ka ngay-an sangkay han Emperador! Kaaway han Emperador an bisan hin-o nga napakahadi!”

en: When Pilate heard these words, he led Jesus out and seated him on the judge’s bench at the place called Stone Pavement (in Aramaic, Gabbatha ).
war: Han pakabati ni Pilato hini nga mga pulong, iginawas niya hi Jesus, ngan linmingkod ha lingkoran han maghurukom dida han dapit han ginngangaranan “An Plataporma nga bato.” (“Gabata” an ngaran hini ha Hebreo.)

en: It was about noon on the Preparation Day for the Passover. Pilate said to the Jewish leaders, “Here’s your king.”
war: Tikaurudto na adto han bisperas han Paglabay. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Iini an iyo hadi!”

en: The Jewish leaders cried out, “Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!”
war: Naggoliat hira, “Pataya hiya! Pataya hiya! Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: Pilate responded, “What? Do you want me to crucify your king?”
war: Nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Karuyag ba niyo nga igraysang ko ha kros an iyo hadi?”

en: “We have no king except the emperor,” the chief priests answered.
war: Nagbaton an mga puno han kapadian, “An Emperador la an amon hadi!”

en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified.
war: Sanglit igintubyan ha ira ni Pilato hi Jesus, basi igraysang ha kros.

en: The soldiers took Jesus prisoner.
war: Sanglit gindara nira hi Jesus.

en: Carrying his cross by himself, he went out to a place called Skull Place (in Aramaic, Golgotha ).
war: Ginmuwa hiya nga nagpapas-an han iya kros, ngan inmabot ha dapit nga gintatawag “An Dapit han Klabera.” (“Golgota” an tawag hini ha Hebreo.)

en: That’s where they crucified him—and two others with him, one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
war: Didto iginraysang nira ha kros hi Jesus. Iginraysang liwat nira ha mga kros in duha pa ka tawo ha magkasi ligid niya, nga nabubutnga nira hi Jesus.

en: Pilate had a public notice written and posted on the cross. It read “Jesus the Nazarene, the king of the Jews.”
war: Iginsurat ni Pilato in usa nga pahibaro ngan iginpataod ini ha kros. Amo ini an ginsurat: “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, an Hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city and it was written in Aramaic, Latin, and Greek.
war: Nakabasa hini in damo nga mga Judiyo kay diri man hirayo tikang han syudad an dapit nga ginraysangan kan Jesus. Iginsurat an pahibaro ha pinulongan nga Hebreo, Latin, ngan Griego.

en: Therefore, the Jewish chief priests complained to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The king of the Jews’ but ‘This man said, “I am the king of the Jews.”’”
war: Nagsiring kan Pilato an mga puno han kapadian han mga Judiyo, “Ayaw isurat ‘An Hadi han mga Judiyo,’ kundi ‘Nagsiring ini nga tawo, Ako an Hadi han mga Judiyo.’”

en: Pilate answered, “What I’ve written, I’ve written.”
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “An nahisurat, nahisurat na.”

en: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and his sandals, and divided them into four shares, one for each soldier. His shirt was seamless, woven as one piece from the top to the bottom.
war: Katapos pagraysangan kan Jesus han mga sondalo, ginkuha nira an iya mga panapton ngan ginbahinbahin hin upat ka bahin, usa ka bahin ha kada sondalo. Ginkuha liwat nira an iya halawig nga panapton nga hinimo hin usa la nga dugnit nga hinablon, ngan waray tinahian.

en: They said to each other, “Let’s not tear it. Let’s cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the scripture,
war: May hinsiring han mga sondalo, “Ayaw ta paggisia ini; kundi pagripa kita kon hin-o in makakadara.” Nahinabo ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring:

en: They divided my clothes among themselves,
war: “Ginbahinbahin nira an akon mga panapton,

en: and they cast lots for my clothing.
war: ngan ginripahan an akon hilawig nga bado.”

en: That’s what the soldiers did.
war: Sanglit ginbuhat ini han mga sondalo.

en: Jesus’ mother and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene stood near the cross.
war: Natukdaw hirani han kros ni Jesus hira iya nanay, an bugto nga babaye ni iya nanay, hi Maria nga asawa ni Cleopas, ngan hi Maria Magdalena.

en: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, “ Woman, here is your son. ”
war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus hi iya nanay ngan an tinun-an nga iya hinigugma nga natukdaw harani han kros; sanglit nagsiring hiya kan iya nanay, “Babaye, iini an imo anak.”

en: Then he said to the disciple, “ Here is your mother. ” And from that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ngadto han tinun-an, “Iini an imo nanay.” Ngan tikang hadto gindara hiya han tinun-an hin pag-ukoy tampo han iya panimalay.

en: After this, knowing that everything was already completed, in order to fulfill the scripture, Jesus said, “ I am thirsty. ”
war: Maaram hi Jesus nga natuman na an ngatanan, ngan basi matuman an kasuratan, nagsiring hiya, “Inuuhaw ako.”

en: A jar full of sour wine was nearby, so the soldiers soaked a sponge in it, placed it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.
war: May surudlan didto nga puno hin maaslom nga bino. Ginhumog nira an espongha hin bino, igintaod ha kataposan hin sanga hin isopo, ngan iginhungit ha iya.

en: When he had received the sour wine, Jesus said, “ It is completed. ” Bowing his head, he gave up his life.
war: Dinmimdim hi Jesus han bino ngan nagsiring hiya, “Natuman na!”

en: It was the Preparation Day and the Jewish leaders didn’t want the bodies to remain on the cross on the Sabbath, especially since that Sabbath was an important day. So they asked Pilate to have the legs of those crucified broken and the bodies taken down.
war: Ngan dinmuko hiya ngan nabunoson hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: Therefore, the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men who were crucified with Jesus.
war: Ngan naghangyo kan Pilato an mga Judiyo nga barion na la an mga bitiis han mga tawo nga iginraysang, ngan tanggalon na hira ha kros. Ginbuhat ini nira, kay Viernes na adto ngan nadiri hira nga magpabilin ha kros an lawas ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kay baraan kaupay an tiarabot nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: When they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead so they didn’t break his legs.
war: Sanglit kinmadto an mga sondalo ngan ginbari an mga bitiis han syahan nga tawo ngan han usa pa nga tawo nga iginraysang upod kan Jesus.

en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
war: Kundi han pag-abot na nira kan Jesus, hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya, sanglit waray na la nira baria an iya mga bitiis.

en: The one who saw this has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he speaks the truth, and he has testified so that you also can believe.
war: Kundi ginbangkaw an iya kagiliran hin usa han mga sondalo, ngan inmawas dayon in dugo ug tubig. (

en: These things happened to fulfill the scripture, They won’t break any of his bones .
war: Nagpamatuod mahitungod hini an nakakita hini nga hinabo, basi tumoo man kamo. Matuod an iya iginsiring, ngan maaram hiya nga naghihimangraw hiya han kamatuoran.)

en: And another scripture says, They will look at him whom they have pierced.
war: Ginbuhat ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, “Waray usa han iya mga tul-an nga mababari.”

en: Early in the morning of the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
war: Temprano pa han aga han Domingo, samtang masirom pa, kinmadto hi Maria Magdalena ha lubnganan, ngan hinkit-an niya nga kinuha na an bato nga ginsada han lubnganan.

en: She ran to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb, and we don’t know where they’ve put him.”
war: Nagdalagan hiya ngadto kanda Simon Pedro ngan han tinun-an nga hinigugma ni Jesus, ngan ginsumatan hira, “Ginkuha nira ha lubnganan an Ginoo, ngan diri kita maaram kon diin nira ibutang hiya!”

en: Peter and the other disciple left to go to the tomb.
war: Ngan napakadto dayon ha lubnganan hi Pedro ngan an usa nga tinun-an.

en: They were running together, but the other disciple ran faster than Peter and was the first to arrive at the tomb.
war: Nagdalagan hira nga duha, kundi nahiuna pag-abot ha lubnganan an usa nga tinun-an kay malurolaksi hiya dumalagan kan Pedro.

en: Bending down to take a look, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he didn’t go in.
war: Inmubo hiya hin paghiling ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit, kundi waray hiya sumulod.

en: Following him, Simon Peter entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
war: Inmabot hi Simon Pedro nga sinmunod ha iya, ngan sinmulod dayon han lubnganan. Hinkit-an niya didto an lino nga mga dugnit.

en: He also saw the face cloth that had been on Jesus’ head. It wasn’t with the other clothes but was folded up in its own place.
war: Diri na tampo han lino nga mga dugnit an panyo nga iginputos han ulo ni Jesus, kundi bulag nga nalulukot ha piliw.

en: Then the other disciple, the one who arrived at the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
war: Ngan sinmulod liwat an tinun-an nga una makaabot han lubnganan; nakakita hiya ngan tinmoo. (

en: They didn’t yet understand the scripture that Jesus must rise from the dead.
war: Waray pa gihapon hira makasabot han kasuratan nga nagsiring nga kinahanglan mabanhaw hiya.)

en: Then the disciples returned to the place where they were staying.
war: Ngan nanngoli an mga tinun-an.

en: Mary stood outside near the tomb, crying. As she cried, she bent down to look into the tomb.
war: Nagtitinangis hi Maria nga natukdaw ha gawas han lubnganan. Nagtitinangis pa hiya han pag-ubo niya hin paghiling han lubnganan,

en: She saw two angels dressed in white, seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and one at the foot.
war: ngan hinkit-an niya didto in duha nga mga anghel nga nakakabado hin busag, ngan nagkakalingkod ha dapit nga ginpahigdaan kan Jesus, usa ha ulohan, ngan an usa ha tiilan.

en: The angels asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?”
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Babaye, kay ano nga nagtitinangis ka?”

en: She replied, “They have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they’ve put him.”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Ginkuha nira an akon Ginoo ngan diri ako maaram kon diin nira igbutang hiya.”

en: As soon as she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she didn’t know it was Jesus.
war: Han pakayakan niya hini, tinmalikod hiya ngan hinkit-an niya hi Jesus nga natukdaw didto, kundi waray hiya makakilala nga hi Jesus adto.

en: Jesus said to her, “ Woman, why are you crying? Who are you looking for? ”
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya, “Babaye, kay ano nga nagtitinangis ka? Hin-o an imo ginbibiling?”

en: Thinking he was the gardener, she replied, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him and I will get him.”
war: Naghunahuna hiya nga an magmarangno adto han tanaman, sanglit ginsiring niya, “Mano, kon ikaw man lugaring an nagkuha ha iya, sumati ako kon diin mo igbutang hiya, ngan kukuhaon ko hiya.”

en: Jesus said to her, “ Mary. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Maria!”

en: She turned and said to him in Aramaic, “Rabbouni” (which means Teacher ).
war: Inmatubang hi Maria ngan nagsiring ha iya ha Hebreo, “Raboni!” (“Magturutdo” an kahulogan hini.)

en: Jesus said to her, “ Don’t hold on to me, for I haven’t yet gone up to my Father. Go to my brothers and sisters and tell them, ‘I’m going up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Ayaw ako pagkapti, kay waray pa ako saka ngadto han Amay. Kadtoa lugod an akon kabugtoan ngan sumati hira nga masaka ako ngadto han akon Amay ngan iyo Amay, han akon Dyos ngan iyo Dyos.”

en: Mary Magdalene left and announced to the disciples, “I’ve seen the Lord.” Then she told them what he said to her.
war: Sanglit linmakat hi Maria Magdalena ngan ginsumatan niya an mga tinun-an nga hinkit-an niya an Ginoo ngan amo ini an iginsiring han Ginoo ha iya.

en: It was still the first day of the week. That evening, while the disciples were behind closed doors because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities, Jesus came and stood among them. He said, “ Peace be with you. ”
war: Han pagkagab-i na hadto ngahaw nga Domingo, nagtirok an mga tinun-an ha sulod hin balay nga trinangkahan an mga porta, kay nahadlok hira han mga punoan nga Judiyo. Ngan inmabot hi Jesus ngan tinmukdaw ha butnga nira ngan nagsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they were filled with joy.
war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan an iya kagiliran. Nalipay an mga tinun-an han pakakita nira han Ginoo.

en: Jesus said to them again, “ Peace be with you. As the Father sent me, so I am sending you. ”
war: Ngan nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo. Sugad nga ginsugo ako han Amay, sinusugo ko man kamo.”

en: Then he breathed on them and said, “ Receive the Holy Spirit.
war: Ginhuypan hira niya nga sidngon, “Karawata niyo an Espiritu Santo.

en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they are forgiven; if you don’t forgive them, they aren’t forgiven. ”
war: Kon pasayloon niyo an mga sala han mga tawo, pasasayloon hira; ngan kon diri niyo pasayloon hira, diri man hira pasasayloon.”

en: Thomas, the one called Didymus, one of the Twelve, wasn’t with the disciples when Jesus came.
war: Diri kaupod nira hi Tomas, (an gintatawag nga karuha) nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, han pagpakita ni Jesus ha ira.

en: The other disciples told him, “We’ve seen the Lord!”
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hiya han iba nga mga tinun-an, “Hinkit-an namon an Ginoo!”

en: But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in his hands, put my finger in the wounds left by the nails, and put my hand into his side, I won’t believe.”
war: Nagsiring hi Tomas ha ira, “Diri ako matuod kon diri ko hikit-an an mga ulat han ginlahosan han mga raysang dida han iya mga kamot ngan mahibutang ko an akon tudlo dida hini nga mga ulat ngan mahiram han akon kamot an iya kagiliran.”

en: After eight days his disciples were again in a house and Thomas was with them. Even though the doors were locked, Jesus entered and stood among them. He said, “ Peace be with you. ”
war: Paglabay hin usa ka semana, nagkaurosa na liwat an mga tinun-an ha sulod hin balay, ngan upod na nira hi Tomas. Trangkado an mga porta, kundi inmabot hi Jesus ngan tinmukdaw ha butnga nira ngan nagsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: Then he said to Thomas, “ Put your finger here. Look at my hands. Put your hand into my side. No more disbelief. Believe! ”
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Tomas, “Ibutang didi an imo tudlo, ngan kitaa an akon mga kamot; ngan ikadi an imo kamot ngan hirama an akon kagiliran. Ayaw na pagruhaduha, tuo na!”

en: Later, Jesus himself appeared again to his disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. This is how it happened:
war: Katapos hini, nagpakita liwat hi Jesus ngadto han iya mga tinun-an didto ha Lanaw han Tiberias. Sugad hini an iya pagpakita.

en: Simon Peter, Thomas (called Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, Zebedee’s sons, and two other disciples were together.
war: Urosa hira Simon Pedro, hi Tomas (an tinatawag nga Karuha), hi Natanael (an taga-Cana, ha Galilea), an mga anak ni Sebedeo, nga duha pa nga mga tinun-an ni Jesus.

en: Simon Peter told them, “I’m going fishing.”
war: Nagsiring hi Simon Pedro ha ira, “Mangingisda ako.”

en: They said, “We’ll go with you.” They set out in a boat, but throughout the night they caught nothing.
war: “Maupod kami,” nagsiring hira. Sanglit kinmadto hira ngan kinmalawod hira; kundi waray gud nira nadakop hadto nga bug-os nga gab-i.

en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples didn’t realize it was Jesus.
war: Han tisirang na an adlaw, tinmindog hi Jesus ha baybayon, kundi waray makakilala an mga tinun-an nga hi Jesus ngay-an adto.

en: Jesus called to them, “ Children, have you caught anything to eat? ”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakadakop ba kamo?”

en: They answered him, “No.”
war: “Waray!” binmaton hira.

en: He said, “ Cast your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some. ”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Huloga an iyo pukot ha tuo han sakayan, ngan makakadakop kamo.” Sanglit ginhulog nira an pukot, ngan waray na hira pakakaakos hin pag-alsa tungod han kadamo han isda.

en: So they did, and there were so many fish that they couldn’t haul in the net.
war: Nagsiring kan Pedro an tinun-an nga hinigugma ni Jesus, “Amo hiya an Ginoo!” Han pakabati ni Simon Pedro nga amo hiya an Ginoo, iginbagkos niya an iya bado (kay lubas man hiya) ngan linmukso ngadto ha tubig.

en: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” When Simon Peter heard it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked) and jumped into the water.
war: Dinmuong ha baybayon an iba nga mga tinun-an, nga nagbubutong han pukot nga puno hin isda, kay diri man hira hirayo ha tabi, may mga 60 la ka dupa.

en: The other disciples followed in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they weren’t far from shore, only about one hundred yards.
war: Paghaw-as na nira, hinkit-an nira in mga baga nga may ginsusugba nga isda ngan mga tinapay.

en: When they landed, they saw a fire there, with fish on it, and some bread.
war: Ngan nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Pagdara ngadi hin mga isda nga iyo pa la nadakop.”

en: Jesus said to them, “ Bring some of the fish that you’ve just caught. ”
war: Sanglit sinmakay hi Pedro ngan ginguyod niya ngadto ha baybayon an pukot nga puno hin dagko nga mga isda, 153 ngatanan; waray magisi an pukot, bisan kon damo hin duro an mga isda.

en: Simon Peter got up and pulled the net to shore. It was full of large fish, one hundred fifty-three of them. Yet the net hadn’t torn, even with so many fish.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kadi, ngan pamahaw kita.” Waray gud han mga tinun-an nangahas hin pagpakiana ha iya, “Hin-o ka?” kay nasayod man hira nga amo hiya an Ginoo.

en: Jesus said to them, “ Come and have breakfast. ” None of the disciples could bring themselves to ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
war: Sanglit dinmaop hi Jesus, ginkuha an tinapay, ngan iginhatag ha ira, ngan sugad man an mga isda.

en: Jesus came, took the bread, and gave it to them. He did the same with the fish.
war: Amo ini an ikatulo nga pagpakita ni Jesus han iya mga tinun-an katapos niya mabanhaw.

en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
war: Katapos nira pamahaw, nagsiring hi Jesus kan Simon Pedro, “Simon Pedro, anak ni Juan, nahigugma ka ba ha akon labaw han ira paghigugma ha akon?”

en: When they finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “ Simon son of John, do you love me more than these? ”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Oo, Ginoo, sayod ka nga nahigugma ako ha imo.”

en: Simon replied, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Jesus, “Mangnoi an akon nati nga mga karnero.”

en: Jesus said to him, “ Feed my lambs. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya hin ikaduha, “Simon, anak ni Juan, nahigugma ka ba ha akon?”

en: Jesus asked a second time, “ Simon son of John, do you love me? ”
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Oo, Ginoo, sayod ka nga nahigugma ako ha imo.”

en: Simon replied, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Jesus, “Mangnoi an akon mga karnero.”

en: Jesus said to him, “ Take care of my sheep. ”
war: Nagsiring gihapon hi Jesus hin ikatulo, “Simon, anak ni Juan, nahigugma ka ba ha akon?”

en: He asked a third time, “ Simon son of John, do you love me? ”
war: Nabido hi Pedro kay ikatulo na ini nga iya pakianhi, “Nahigugma ka ba ha akon!” Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Ginoo, sayod ka han ngatanan nga mga butang. Sayod ka nga nahigugma ako ha imo!”

en: Peter was sad that Jesus asked him a third time, “Do you love me?” He replied, “Lord, you know everything; you know I love you.”
war: Nagsiring na liwat hi Jesus ha iya, “Mangnoi an akon mga karnero.

en: After Moses the LORD ’s servant died, the LORD spoke to Joshua, Nun’s son. He had been Moses’ helper.
war: Han kamatay na han surugoon han Ginoo , hi Moises, naghimangraw an Ginoo han kabulig ni Moises, hi Josue nga anak ni Nun.

en: “My servant Moses is dead. Now get ready to cross over the Jordan with this entire people to the land that I am going to give to the Israelites.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Patay na hi Moises, an akon surugoon. Pag-andam kamo, ikaw ug an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel, ngan tabok kamo han Salog Jordan ngadto han tuna nga ighahatag ko ha ira.

en: I am giving you every place where you set foot, exactly as I promised Moses.
war: Sugad han akon siring kan Moises, iginhatag ko ha imo ug han ngatanan nga akon mga tawo an bug-os nga tuna nga iyo pag-aagian.

en: Your territory will stretch from the desert and the Lebanon as far as the great Euphrates River, including all Hittite land, up to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
war: An mga pag-ultan han iyo mga tuna matikang ha kamingawan didto ha timogan nga dapit ngadto han mga kabukiran han Libano ha amihanan nga dapit; tikang han Dako nga Salog Eufrates didto ha sinirangan nga dapit ngan matalabok han mga katunaan han mga Hiteohanon, ngadto han Dagat Mediteraneo ha katundan nga dapit.

en: No one will be able to stand up against you during your lifetime. I will be with you in the same way I was with Moses. I won’t desert you or leave you.
war: Josue, samtang nga buhi ka pa, waray gud makakadaog ha imo. Maupod ako ha imo sugad han akon pag-upod kan Moises. Dayuday maupod ako ha imo; diri gud ako mabaya ha imo.

en: Be brave and strong, because you are the one who will help this people take possession of the land, which I pledged to give to their ancestors.
war: Dig-ona an imo kalugaringon ngan ipakita an imo pagtapod kay magigin pangulo ka hini nga mga tawo ha ira pagtag-iya hini nga tuna nga iginsaad ko han ira mga ginikanan.

en: “Be very brave and strong as you carefully obey all of the Instruction that Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t deviate even a bit from it, either to the right or left. Then you will have success wherever you go.
war: Dig-ona la an imo kasingkasing, ipakita an imo pagtapod; ayaw hingalimot hin pagsugot han bug-os nga Balaod nga ginhatag ha iyo han akon surugoon, hi Moises. Ayaw pagpasibay-i in bisan ano nga bahin hini ngan magmamainuswagon ka bisan ka pumakain.

en: Never stop speaking about this Instruction scroll. Recite it day and night so you can carefully obey everything written in it. Then you will accomplish your objectives and you will succeed.
war: Dayuday basahon gud an Balaod dida han imo pagsingba. Pag-admi ini adlaw gab-i ngan tumana gud an ngatanan nga nahisurat dida han Balaod. Ngan magmamainuswagon ug magmamabinungahon an imo kinabuhi.

en: I’ve commanded you to be brave and strong, haven’t I? Don’t be alarmed or terrified, because the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
war: Panumdom han akon sugo, “Dig-ona an imo kalugaringon ngan ipakita an imo pagtapod. Ayaw kahadlok ngan ayaw pagturaw, kay ako, an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos, dayuday kaupod nimo bisan kon pumakain ka.”

en: Then Joshua gave orders to the people’s officers:
war: Ug ginsugo ni Josue an mga pangulo

en: “Go through the camp and give orders to the people. Say, ‘Get supplies ready for yourselves because in three days you will be crossing over the Jordan to enter the land and take it over. The LORD your God is going to give it to you as your possession.’”
war: hin pagsudoy han kampo ngan paghimangraw han mga tawo, “Andama niyo in pagkaon, kay pag-ikatolo ka adlaw matabok kamo han Salog Jordan hin pagtag-iya han tuna nga ighahatag ha iyo han Ginoo nga iyo Dyos.”

en: Then Joshua addressed the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh:
war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga banay nira Ruben ug Gad ngan an katunga han banay ni Manases,

en: “Remember the command that Moses the LORD ’s servant gave you: ‘The LORD your God will give you rest and give you this land.’
war: “Panumdom han tugon ha iyo ni Moises, an surugoon han Ginoo , nga ihahatag han Ginoo nga iyo Dyos ini nga tuna ha may sinirangan han Jordan nga iyo puroy-anan.

en: Your wives, children, and cattle may remain in the land that Moses has given you on the east side of the Jordan. But all you brave fighters, organized for war, must cross over in front of your fellow Israelites. You must help them
war: Mapabilin dinhe an iyo mga asawa, mga anak, ug an iyo kahayopan, kundi an iyo mga sondalo nga andam hin pakig-away, mag-uuna han iyo mga igkasi Israelita hin pagtabok basi makabulig ha ira hin pakig-away

en: until the LORD gives a rest like yours to your fellow Israelites and they too take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return and take over the land that belongs to you, which Moses the LORD ’s servant has given you on the east side of the Jordan.”
war: ngada han pakatag-iya nira han tuna didto ha katundan han Jordan nga iginhatag ha ira han Ginoo nga ira Dyos. Kon murayaw na an pag-ukoy han ngatanan nga mga banay han Israel, amo na an iyo pagbalik ngan mag-uokoy na kamo dinhe hinin iyo kalugaringon nga tuna ha may sinirangan han Jordan nga ihinatag ha iyo ni Moises, an surugoon han Ginoo .”

en: They answered Joshua, “We will obey everything you have commanded us and go anywhere you send us.
war: Nagbaton hira kan Josue, “Tutumanon namon an ngatanan nga imo ginhimangraw ha amon ngan mapakadto kami ha bisan diin nga dapit kami pakadtoa.

en: We will obey you in the same way that we obeyed Moses. Just let the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses!
war: Masugot kami ha imo sugad nga dayuday sinmugot kami kan Moises. Updan ka unta han Ginoo nga imo Dyos sugad nga kaupod hiya ni Moises!

en: Anybody who stubbornly opposes what you declare and doesn’t obey any of your commands will be put to death. Be brave and strong!”
war: Adton mariwa han imo gahom ug masupak han imo sugo, kinahanglan nga patayon. Rig-ona an imo kasingkasing ug ipakita an imo pagtapod.”

en: Joshua, Nun’s son, secretly sent two men as spies from Shittim. He said, “Go. Look over the land, especially Jericho.” They set out and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab. They bedded down there.
war: Niyan nagpadara hi Josue hin duha nga mag-irinaw tikang han kampo ha Acacia ug ginsugo hira hin pagkadto ngan pag-usisa hin hilom han tuna han Canaan, labi na an syudad han Jerico. Han pag-abot nira ha Jerico, didto hira pahuway han gab-i ha balay ni Rahab, usa nga babaye nga maraot an dungog.

en: Someone told the king of Jericho, “Men from the Israelites have come here tonight to spy on the land.”
war: Nakabati an hadi han Jerico nga may-ada mga Israelita nga sinmulod han syudad hadto nga gab-i hin pag-inaw han nasod,

en: So the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab: “Send out the men who came to you, the ones who came to your house, because they have come to spy on the entire land.”
war: sanglit nagpatugon hiya kan Rahab: “An mga tawo nga sinmaka ha imo balay nakanhi hin pagtiktik han bug-os nga nasod! Pagawsa hira!”

en: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. Then she said, “Of course the men came to me. But I didn’t know where they were from.
war: 4-6 Binmaton hi Rahab, “Tinuod nga may-ada mga tawo nga sinmaka han akon balay, kundi diri ako maaram kon tikang hira diin. Linmakat hira ha pagkakulop nga waray pa kasasadhi an ganghaan han syudad. Waray ako mag-usisa kon tikain hira, kundi kon iyo hira lanaton dayon, hiaabotan pa niyo hira.” (Kundi gindara ni Rahab an duha nga mga mag-irinaw ngadto ha atop ngan gintago niya hira didto han mga uhot han lino nga iya didto gintambak.)

en: The men left when it was time to close the gate at dark, but I don’t know where the men went. Hurry! Chase after them! You might catch up with them.”
war: Binmaya han syudad an mga ginsugo han hadi ngan ginsadhan an ganghaan. Nagpinamiling hira han mga mag-irinaw nga Israelita tubtob han dapit diin an dalan natabok han Jordan.

en: But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the flax stalks that she had laid out on the roof.
war: Han waray pa magkakahigda an mga mag-irinaw, sinmaka hi Rahab ngadto ha atop

en: The men from Jericho chased after them in the direction of the Jordan up to the fords. As soon as those chasing them went out, the gate was shut behind them.
war: ngan ginsiring niya hira, “Maaram ako nga iginhatag ha iyo han Ginoo ini nga tuna. An ngatanan dinhe nahahadlok ha iyo.

en: Before the spies bedded down, Rahab went up to them on the roof.
war: Nasumatan kami kon gin-unan-o han Ginoo hin pagpamara han Dagat nga Pula ha atubangan niyo han pagkalag-iw niyo ha Ehipto. Nakabati liwat kami han pagpataya niyo kanda Sihon ug Og, an duha nga mga Amoreohanon nga hadi ha sinirangan nga dapit han Jordan.

en: She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land. Terror over you has overwhelmed us. The entire population of the land has melted down in fear because of you.
war: Nahadlok kami han amon pakabati hini; tinmalaw na kami tungod ha iyo. An Ginoo nga iyo Dyos amo an Dyos han langit ha kahitas-an ug dinhe ha tuna.

en: We have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Reed Sea in front of you when you left Egypt. We have also heard what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites on the other side of the Jordan. You utterly wiped them out.
war: Igsumpa yana ha Ginoo nga uupayon niyo hin pagdumara han akon panimalay sugad han akon pagdumara ha iyo, ngan ipakita ha akon in mga tigaman nga makakatapod ako ha iyo.

en: We heard this and our hearts turned to water. Because of you, people can no longer work up their courage. This is because the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.
war: Pagsaad kamo ha akon nga tatalwason niyo an akon amay ug iroy, an akon mga kabugtoan ug an ira mga panimalay! Ayaw itugot nga pamatayon kami!”

en: Now, I have been loyal to you. So pledge to me by the LORD that you in turn will deal loyally with my family. Give me a sign of good faith.
war: Sinmiring ha iya an mga tawo, “Kuhaon unta han Dyos an amon kinabuhi kon diri namon tumanon an amon mga ginyakan. Kon diri ka magsumat bisan kan kanay han amon ginbuhat, nagsasaad kami ha imo nga kon ihatag na ha amon han Ginoo ini nga tuna, uupayon namon an amon pagdumara ha imo.”

en: Spare the lives of my father, mother, brothers, and sisters, along with everything they own. Rescue us from death.”
war: Nag-ukoy hi Rahab dida hin balay nga dukot han pader han syudad, sanglit ginpalusad niya an mga tawo ha bintana pinaagi hin pisi.

en: The men said to her, “We swear by our own lives to secure yours. If you don’t reveal our mission, we will deal loyally and faithfully with you when the LORD gives us the land.”
war: “Pakadto kamo ha sagkahon nga tuna,” nasiring hiya, “kay bangin kamo hiagian han mga tawo han hadi. Tago kamo didto hin tulo ka adlaw ngada han ira pagbalik. Kahuman hini, makakagpadayon na kamo han iyo kalakat.”

en: So she lowered the spies on a rope through the window. Her house was on the outer side of the city wall, and she lived inside the wall.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga tawo, “Tutumanon namon ini nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.

en: Then she said to them, “Go toward the highlands so that those chasing you don’t run into you. Hide there for three days until those chasing you return. Then you may go on your way.”
war: Amo ini an kinahanglan nimo buhaton. Kon sulongon na namon an iyo tuna, ihigot ini nga pula nga lubid ngadto han bintana nga gintontunan ha amon. Tiroka dinhe ha imo balay an imo amay ug iroy, an imo mga kabugtoan ngan an ngatanan nga sakop han panimalay ni imo tatay.

en: The men said to her, “We won’t be responsible for this pledge you made us swear
war: Kon may-ada ha iyo gumawas han balay, iya na ito kasaypanan kon mamatay hiya, diri kami mabaton; kundi kon may-ada paghukaan ha sakob han imo balay, hi kami an mabaton hini.

en: unless, when we come into the land, you tie this red woven cord in the window through which you lowered us. Gather your father, your mother, your brothers, and your whole family into the house with you.
war: Kundi kon igsumat niyo an amon ginbuhat dinhe, diri kami kinahanglan magtuman han amon saad nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.”

en: Those who go outside the doors of your house into the street will have only themselves to blame for their own deaths. We won’t be responsible. If anyone lays a hand on those who are with you in the house, we will take the blame for their death.
war: Tinmangdo hiya ngan ginpalakat hira. Han paghilakat na nira, ginhigot niya an pula nga lubid ngadto han bintana.

en: But if you reveal our mission, we won’t be responsible for this pledge you made us swear.”
war: An mga mag-irinaw pinmakadto han sagkahon nga tuna ngan tinmago hira didto. Ginpinamiling hira han mga tawo han hadi ha bug-os nga kaumhan hin tulo ka adlaw, kundi waray hira hiagii, sanglit binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerico.

en: She said, “These things will happen just like you said.” She sent them away and they went off. Then she tied the red cord in the window.
war: Ug an duha nga mag-irinaw linmusad tikang han sagkahon nga tuna, tinmalabok hira han salog, ngan inmoli hira ngadto kan Josue. Ginsumatan nira hi Josue han ngatanan nga nahitabo, ngan

en: The spies went out and entered the highlands. They stayed there for three days until those chasing them came back. Those chasing them had searched all along the road but never found them.
war: sinmiring hira, “Waray ruhaduha nga iginhatag ha aton han Ginoo an bug-os nga katunaan. Nagkakahadlok ha aton an ngatanan nga mga tawo didto.”

en: Joshua took down the camp early in the morning. He and all the Israelites marched out of Shittim and came to the Jordan, where they stayed overnight before crossing.
war: Han pagkabuwas han aga binmuhat hin temprano hira Josue ug an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel, binmaya hira han kampo ha Acacia ngan pinmakadto hira ha Jordan diin nagkampo hira samtang naghuhulat hira hin pagtabok.

en: At the end of three days the officers went through the middle of the camp.
war: Kahuman han ikatolo ka adlaw, an mga pangulo nagsudoy han kampo

en: They commanded the people, “As soon as you see the LORD your God’s chest containing the covenant and the levitical priests carrying it, you are to march out from your places and follow it.
war: ug ginsiring nira an mga tawo, “Kon kumita kamo han mga padi nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo nga iyo Dyos, pamutos kamo ngan sunod ha ira.

en: But let there be some distance between you and it, about three thousand feet. Don’t come near it! You will know the way you should go, even though you’ve never traveled this way before.”
war: Syahan pa la ini niyo nga paghinganhi, sanglit ipapakita nira ha iyo an dalan nga iyo pag-aagian. Kundi ayaw kamo paghirani han Kahon han Ginsaaran; paorhe kamo hin mga usa ka kilometro.”

en: Joshua said to the people, “Make yourselves holy! Tomorrow the LORD will do wonderful things among you.”
war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga tawo, “Paglinis kamo ha iyo kalugaringon kay buwas an Ginoo magbubuhat hin mga milagro dida ha iyo.”

en: Then Joshua said to the priests, “Lift up the covenant chest. Go along in front of the people.” So they lifted up the covenant chest and went in front of the people.
war: Ngan ginsiring niya an mga kapadian nga dad-on nira an Kahon han Ginsaaran ug mag-una hira han mga tawo. Gintuman ini nira sugad han siring niya ha ira.

en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to make you great in the opinion of all Israel. Then they will know that I will be with you in the same way that I was with Moses.
war: Nagsiring kan Josue an Ginoo , “An akon bubuhaton yana nga adlaw makakaaghat han ngatanan nga mga tawo hin pagpasidungog ha imo nga usa nga dako nga pagkatawo ngan makakasabot hira nga kaupod ako nimo sugad nga hadto kaupod ako ni Moises.

en: You are to command the priests who carry the covenant chest, ‘As soon as you come to the bank of the Jordan, stand still in the Jordan.’”
war: Sumati an mga kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran nga ha pag-abot nira ha salog, kinahanglan lumugsong hira ha tubig ngan umukoy hira nga natukdaw hirani han pangpang.”

en: Joshua said to the Israelites, “Come close. Listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Josue han mga tawo, “Pakadi kamo ngan pamati kamo kon ano an ighihimangraw ha iyo han Ginoo nga iyo Dyos.

en: Then Joshua said, “This is how you will know that the living God is among you and will completely remove the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites before you.
war: Ha iyo pagsulong, bubukoron gud niya an mga Canaanhon, mga Hiteohanon, mga Hibeohanon, mga Pereseohanon, mga Girgaseohanon, mga Amoreohanon, ngan an mga Jebuseohanon. Hibabaroan niyo nga aada ha iyo an buhi nga Dyos

en: Look! The covenant chest of the ruler of the entire earth is going to cross over in front of you in the Jordan.
war: kon an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo han ngatanan nga tuna tumalabok han Jordan una ha iyo.

en: Now pick twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one per tribe.
war: Yana pagpili kamo hin dose nga mga kalalaken-an, usa ha kada tribo han Israel.

en: The soles of the priests’ feet, who are carrying the chest of the LORD , ruler of the whole earth, will come to rest in the water of the Jordan. At that moment, the water of the Jordan will be cut off. The water flowing downstream will stand still in a single heap.”

en: But at that moment the water of the Jordan coming downstream stood still. It rose up as a single heap very far off, just below Adam, which is the city next to Zarethan. The water going down to the desert sea (that is, the Dead Sea) was cut off completely. The people crossed opposite Jericho.

en: So the priests carrying the LORD ’s covenant chest stood firmly on dry land in the middle of the Jordan. Meanwhile, all Israel crossed over on dry land, until the entire nation finished crossing over the Jordan.
war: Samtang an mga tawo natalabok dida hin mamara nga tuna, tinmukdaw an kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran dida hin mamara nga tuna ha butnga han Jordan tubtob han pakatabok han ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: The Israelites did exactly what Joshua ordered. They lifted twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, matching the number of the tribes of the Israelites, exactly as the LORD had said to Joshua. They brought them over to the camp and put them down there.

en: Meanwhile, the priests carrying the chest were standing in the middle of the Jordan. They stood there until every command that the LORD had ordered Joshua to tell the people had been carried out. This was exactly what Moses had commanded Joshua. The people crossed over quickly.

en: All the Amorite kings on the west side of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings near the sea heard that the LORD had dried up the water of the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over. Then their hearts melted. They lost all courage because of the Israelites.
war: Hinbatian han ngatanan nga kahadian nga Amoreohanon ha katundan han Jordan ug han ngatanan nga kahadian nga Canaanhon ha ligid han Dagat Mediteraneo nga ginpahubas han Ginoo an salog han Jordan tubtob nga an mga tawo han Israel nakatabok ngatanan. Nagkahadlok ini hira ngan nagmatalaw na hira tungod han mga Israelita.

en: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make yourself flint knives. Circumcise the Israelites for a second time.”
war: Ginsiring han Ginoo hi Josue, “Paghimo hin mga kutsilyo tikang hin bato bantilis ngan toria an mga Israelita.”

en: So Joshua made flint knives for himself. He circumcised the Israelites at Foreskins Hill.
war: Gintuman ini ni Josue sugad han sugo ha iya han Ginoo , ngan iya gintori an mga Israelita didto hin dapit nga ginngaranan Torian nga Pungtod.

en: This is the reason Joshua did so: All the people who went out of Egypt, that is, all the men who were soldiers, had died in the desert on the way after they left Egypt.
war: 4-6 Han pagbaya han Ehipto han mga tawo han Israel tinori na an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an. Kundi ha sakob hin 40 ka tuig nga pag-ukoy nira ha kamingawan, waray gintori bisan ma usa han kalalaken-an nga puya. Labot pa, katapos hini nga panahon an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an nga igo na magsondalo han paggawas nira han Ehipto ubos na pagkamatay kay waray hira magsugot han Ginoo . Sugad han iya ginpanaad, waray hira tugoti nga kumita hira han hura ngan maglangbo nga tuna nga iginsaad niya han ira mga ginikanan.

en: All the people who went out were circumcised. But none of the people born in the desert on the way after they had left Egypt had been circumcised.
war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an hini nga mga tawo waray gud may natori ug amo ini nga bag-o nga tulin an ginpanori ni Josue.

en: This was because the Israelites journeyed forty years in the desert until the whole nation died off. These were the men old enough to fight who went out from Egypt and who hadn’t obeyed the LORD . The LORD had pledged to them never to show them the land that the LORD had pledged to their ancestors to give us. It is a land full of milk and honey.
war: Kahuman han pagtoria han kalalaken-an, pinmabilin ini hira ha kampo tubtob han kaupay han katorian.

en: Joshua circumcised their children, the ones the LORD had set in their place. They were uncircumcised because they hadn’t been circumcised on the way.
war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Josue, “Yana ginkuha ko ha iyo an makaarawod nga kahimtang hin pagkaoripon didto ha Ehipto.” Sanglit ginngaranan hin Gilgal an dapit ngada yana.

en: After the whole nation had undergone circumcision, they remained in the camp until they got well again.
war: Samtang an mga Israelita nagkampo didto ha Gilgal dida han kapatagan harani han Jerico, nagsaurog hira han Paglabay dida han gab-i han ika-14 nga adlaw han bulan.

en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away from you the disgrace of Egypt.” So the place was called Gilgal, as it is today.
war: An pagkabuwas nga adlaw amo an ira syahan nga pagkaon hin mga abot ha Canaan: sinanlag nga trigo ug tinapay nga waray patubo.

en: The Israelites camped in Gilgal. They celebrated Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month on the plains of Jericho.
war: Inmukoy na an mana hin kahulog tikang ha kahitas-an ug nawarayan na hini an mga Israelita. Tikang hadto an ira mga pagkaon tikang na han mga abot ha Canaan.

en: On the very next day after Passover, they ate food produced in the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.
war: Han haraniay na hi Josue ha Jerico, nakakita hiya hin tawo nga tinmukdaw ha iya atubangan nga nakakadara hin espada. Gindaop ini ni Josue ngan pinmakiana hiya, “Usa ka ba han amon mga sondalo kon kaaway ka ba namon?”

en: The manna stopped on that next day, when they ate food produced in the land. There was no longer any manna for the Israelites. So that year they ate the crops of the land of Canaan.
war: “Waray hito nga duha,” binmaton an tawo. “Aanhi ako sugad nga kapitan han mga kasondalohan han Ginoo .”

en: When Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up. He caught sight of a man standing in front of him with his sword drawn. Joshua went up and said to him, “Are you on our side or that of our enemies?”
war: Hinmapa hi Josue ha tuna hin pagsingba ha iya ngan sinmiring hiya, “Ako an imo surugoon. Ano an imo karuyag nga akon pagbuhaton?”

en: He said, “Neither! I’m the commander of the LORD ’s heavenly force. Now I have arrived!”
war: Ug an kapitan han kasondalohan han Ginoo nagsiring ha iya, “Hukasa an imo mga sandalyas, kay natukdaw ka dida hin baraan nga tuna.” Ngan gintuman ini ni Josue sugad han siring ha iya.

en: Now Jericho was closed up tightly because of the Israelites. No one went out or came in.
war: An mga aragian han Jerico ginsadhan ug ginbantayan hin maupay basi diri makasulod an mga Israelita. Waray nakakasulod kon nakakagawas han syudad.

en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Look. I have given Jericho and its king into your power, along with its mighty warriors.
war: Nagsiring kan Josue an Ginoo , “Itinutubyan ko ha imo an Jerico upod an iya mga kahadian ngan an ngatanan nga mga mag-isog nga sondalo.

en: Circle the city with all the soldiers, going around the city one time. Do this for six days.
war: Ikaw ug an imo mga sondalo magmamartsa palibot han syudad makausa kada adlaw sulod hin unom ka adlaw.

en: Have seven priests carry seven trumpets made from rams’ horns in front of the chest. On the seventh day, circle the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.
war: Pipito nga mga padi an mag-uuna han Kahon han Ginsaaran ug an tagsa ha ira may-ada dara nga budyong nga hinimo hin sungay hin lalaki nga karnero. Ha ikapito ka adlaw ikaw ug an imo mga sondalo magmamartsa palibot han syudad makapito upod an mga padi nga magpapatunog han ira mga budyong nga sungay.

en: “Have them blow a long blast on the ram’s horn. As soon as you hear that trumpet blast, have all the people shout out a loud war cry. Then the city wall will collapse, and the people will rise up, attacking straight ahead.”
war: Ngan patutunggon nira hin maiha an mga budyong nga sungay. Pakabati gud niyo hini, an ngatanan nga mga tawo magdudurungan hin paggoliat hin dako nga tingog ngan marurumpag an mga pader han syudad. Ngan an ngatanan nga mga sondalo masulod dayon han syudad.”

en: So Joshua, Nun’s son, called the priests. He said to them, “Lift up the covenant chest. Let seven priests carry seven trumpets made from rams’ horns in front of the LORD ’s chest.”
war: Gintawag ni Josue an kapadian ngan ginsiring hira, “Dad-a niyo an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngan pito ha iyo mag-uuna nga may-ada dara nga mga budyong nga sungay.”

en: He said to the people, “Go forward. Circle the city. Let the armed soldiers go in front of the LORD ’s chest.”
war: Niyan ginsugo niya an iya mga tawo hin pagtikang hin pagmartsa palibot han syudad upod in mga armado nga gwardya nga nag-uuna han Kahon han Ginsaaran.

en: As soon as Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying seven ram’s horn trumpets moved forward in front of the LORD . They blew the trumpets. The LORD ’s covenant chest followed.
war: 8-9 Sanglit, sumala han sugo ni Josue, an mga armado nga gwardya nag-una han mga kapadian nga nagpapatunog han ira mga budyong nga sungay; sunod ha ira an kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran ngan ha orhe, may-ada gihapon mga gwardya. Waray hunong an pagpatunog han mga budyong.

en: The initial group of soldiers was going in front of the priests who were blowing the trumpets. The rear guard was coming behind the chest, with trumpets blowing continuously.
war: Kundi gintugon ni Josue an iya mga tawo nga diri hira gumoliat nga diri hira magyakan, gawas kon sugoon hira niya.

en: Joshua ordered the people, “Don’t shout. Don’t let your voice be heard. Don’t let a word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you, ‘Shout!’ Then shout!”
war: Ginsugo niya an iya mga tawo nga ilibot nira han syudad an Kahon han Ginsaaran makausa. Kahuman binmalik hira ngadto ha kampo ngan didto hira pahuway.

en: He made the LORD ’s chest circle the city, going around one time. They went back to the camp and stayed there overnight.
war: 12-13 Nagmata hin temprano hi Josue han pagkabuwas han aga ug naglibot na liwat hira han syudad sugad hadton syahan nira nga paglibot: syahan, an mag-uruna nga mga gwardya; sunod, an pito nga kapadian nga nagpapatunog han mga budyong; sunod, an kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo ; ug ha kataposan, an mga gwardya ha orhe. Waray hunong an pagpatunog han mga budyong.

en: Joshua got up early in the morning. The priests lifted up the LORD ’s chest.
war: Dida hini nga ikaduha ka adlaw, nakausa hira paglibot han syudad ngan kahuman, inmoli hira ngadto ha kampo. Ginbuhat nira ini sakob hin unom ka adlaw.

en: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets made from rams’ horns were going in front of the LORD ’s chest, blowing trumpets continuously. The armed soldiers were going in front of them. The rear guard was coming after the LORD ’s chest, blowing trumpets continuously.
war: Han pag-ikapito ka adlaw, ha pagpunias han adlaw binmuhat hira ngan nagmartsa makapito palibot han syudad hin sugad nga paagi—amo la ini nga adlaw nga makapito hira pagmartsa palibot han syudad.

en: They circled the city one time on the second day. Then they went back to the camp. They did this for six days.
war: Dida han ira ikapito nga paglibot, han tipagturunog na an mga kapadian han ira mga budyong, ginsugo ni Josue hin paggoliat an iya mga tawo. Nagsiring hiya, “Itinubyan na ha iyo han Ginoo an syudad!

war: Kundi ayaw gud kamo pagdara hin bisan ano nga naruba; kon buhaton niyo ini, igkakasaramok kamo ngan mabubungkag an kampo han mga Israelita.

war: Pinamatay nira an ngatanan nga mga tawo dida han syudad pinaagi han ira espada—lalake ug babaye, lagas ug bata. Ira liwat pinamatay an mga baka, karnero ug mga kamelyo.

en: Then the people shouted. They blew the trumpets. As soon as the people heard the trumpet blast, they shouted a loud war cry. Then the wall collapsed. The people went up against the city, attacking straight ahead. They captured the city.

en: Without mercy, they wiped out everything in the city as something reserved for God—man and woman, young and old, cattle, sheep, and donkeys.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hira ngan ira gindara hi Rahab, upod an iya amay ug iroy, an iya kabugtoan, ug an iba han iya panimalay. Gindara hira ngatanan, an panimalay ug an mga oripon ngan igingawas hira ha kataragman ngadto hin dapit nga harani han kampo han mga Israelita.

en: Joshua spoke to the two men who had scouted out the land. “Go to the prostitute’s house. Bring out the woman from there, along with everyone related to her, exactly as you pledged to her.”
war: Kahuman ginsunog nira an syudad ngan naugtang an ngatanan labot hadton mga hinimo hin bulawan, salapi, bronse, ug puthaw nga ira ginkuha ngan ibinutang didto han hiriposan han mga manggad han Ginoo .

en: So the young men who had been spies went and brought Rahab out, along with her father, her mother, her brothers, and everyone related to her. They brought her whole clan out and let them stay outside Israel’s camp.
war: Kundi gintalwas ni Josue an kinabuhi hi Rahab, an babaye nga maraot an dungog, ug an ngatanan niya nga kauropdan tungod kay gintago niya an duha nga mga mag-irinaw nga iya ginpadara ngadto ha Jerico. (An mga tulin ni Rahab nag-ukoy ha Israel ngada yana.)

en: They burned the city and everything in it. But they put the silver and gold, along with the bronze and iron equipment, into the treasury of the LORD ’s house.
war: Hito manta nga takna nagpagawas hi Josue hin pahimatngon, “Higagabaan han Ginoo adton magtalinguha hin pagtindog liwat han syudad han Jerico.

war: Waray pagtumana an sugo han Ginoo ha mga Israelita nga diri hira magkuha hin bisan ano nga naguba didto ha Jerico. (Anak hi Acan ni Carmi ug apo ni Sabdi ngan sakop han banay ni Sera, usa han tribo ni Juda.)

en: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel. He said to them, “Go up. Scout out the land.”
war: Nagpadara hi Josue hin mga tawo tikang ha Jerico ngadto ha Ai, usa nga syudad ha sinirangan han Betel, harani han Betaben. Ginpakadto hira basi mag-usisa hira han tuna. Pakahuman nira,

en: So the men went up and scouted out Ai.

en: They came back to Joshua and said to him, “There is no need for all of the people to go up. Two or three thousand men could go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all of the people bother going there. There are just a few of them.”
war: Sanglit mga tulo la ka yukot nga mga Israelita an sinmulong, kundi napirit hira hin pag-isol.

en: So about three thousand men from the people went up in that direction. But they fled from the men of Ai.
war: Ginbukod hira han mga tawo han Ai tikang ha ganghaan han syudad tubtob ngadto han mga kababtoan ug kapin hin 36 an ginpatay nira samtang nalugsong hira han pungtod. Tinmalaw an mga Israelita ngan nahadlok hira.

en: The men of Ai struck down approximately thirty-six of them. They chased them from outside the gate as far as Shebarim. They struck them down on the slope. Then the hearts of the people melted and turned to water.
war: Tungod han ira kabido gingisi an ira bado ngan hinmapa ha tuna ha atubangan han Kahon han Ginsaaran hi Josue ug an mga pangulo han Israel tubtob han pagkagab-i. Nagbutang hira hin agbon ha ira ulo, ha pagpakita han ira kabidoan.

en: Joshua ripped open his clothes. He, along with the elders of Israel, lay flat on their faces before the LORD ’s chest until evening. They put dust on their heads.
war: Ngan nag-ampo hi Josue, “Ginoo nga DYOS kay ano nga ginpatabok pa man kami nimo han Jordan? Basi itubyan kami nimo ngadto han mga Amoreohanon? Basi mapuo kami? Kay ano nga waray na man la kami magpabilin didto ha tabok han Jordan?

en: Then Joshua said, “Oh no, LORD God! Why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan? Was it to hand us over to the power of the Amorites, to destroy us? If only we had been prepared to live on the other side of the Jordan!
war: Ano man an akon masisiring yana, Ginoo nga an mga Israelita inmisol ha iya mga kaaway?

en: Please forgive me, LORD . What can I say now that Israel has retreated before its enemies?
war: Makakabati hini an mga Canaanhon ug an iba pa dinhe hini nga tuna. Maglilibot hira ha amon ngan pamamatayon kami ngatanan. Ug ano man an imo bubuhaton ha pagpanalipod han imo dungog?”

en: The Canaanites and the whole population of the land will hear of it. They will surround us and make our name disappear from the earth. What will you do about your great name then?”
war: Nagsiring kan Josue an Ginoo , “Buhat! Kay ano nga nahapa ka man ha tuna?

en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Get up! Why do you lie flat on your face like this?
war: Nakasala an Israel! Waray nira tumana an Ginsaaran nga ginsugo ko ha ira hin papagtuman. Ira ginkuha in mga butang nga ginlain na basi pagbungkagon. Ira ini pinangawat, nagbinuwa hira ngan gintampo nira han ira mga kalugaringon nga butang.

en: Israel has sinned. They have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the things reserved for me and put them with their own things. They have stolen and kept it a secret.
war: Sanglit an mga Israelita waray makaato han ira mga kaaway. Inmisol hira han ira kaaway tungod kay hira ngahaw ginhukman na nga mapuo. Diri na ako magpapabilin dinhe ha iyo labot kon iyo pagbungkagon an mga butang nga waray itugot ha iyo hin pagkuha!

en: The Israelites can’t stand up to their enemies. They retreat before their enemies because they themselves have become a doomed thing reserved for me. I will no longer be with you unless you destroy the things reserved for me that are present among you.
war: Hala, buhat! Linisi an mga tawo sumala han mga seremonyas ngan andama hira hin pagkadi ha akon atubangan. Sumati hira nga maandam na hira buwas, kay ako, an Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, may-ada ko igsisiring mahitungod hini: ‘Israel, may-ada dida ha imo mga butang nga akon ginsugo ha imo hin pagpabungkag! Diri ka makakaato han imo mga kaaway kon diri ini nga mga butang bayaan nimo!’

en: Go and make the people holy. Say, ‘Get ready for tomorrow by making yourselves holy. This is what the LORD , the God of Israel, says: “Israel! Things reserved for me are present among you. You won’t be able to stand up to your enemies until you remove from your presence the things reserved for me.”’
war: Sanglit sumati hira nga ha pagkaaga paaatubangon ko hira ha akon an tagsa nga tribo. An tribo nga akon pilion, maatubangan ha akon an tagsa nga iya banay. An banay nga akon pilion, maatubang ha akon an tagsa nga iya panimalay. An panimalay nga akon pilion, maatubangan ha akon an tagsa nga tawo hito nga panimalay.

en: In the morning, come forward tribe by tribe. Whichever tribe the LORD selects must come forward clan by clan. Whichever clan the LORD selects must come forward family by family. Whichever family the LORD selects will come forward by individual soldiers.
war: An tawo nga akon pilion ngan hiagian dida ha iya an mga butang nga puroohon, ini hiya pagsusunugon, upod an iya panimalay ug an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi, kay nakahatag hiya hin makalilisang nga kaalo ha Israel ngan ginpasipad-an niya hin pagsupak an ginsaaran nga akon ginhimo ha mga tawo.”

en: The person selected, who has the things reserved for God, must be put to death by burning. Burn everything that belongs to him too. This is because he has violated the LORD ’s covenant and has committed an outrage in Israel.”
war: Temprano pa han pagkaaga gindara ni Josue an bug-os nga Israel, an tagsa nga tribo, ngadto ha atubangan ngan napili an tribo ni Juda.

en: Joshua got up early in the morning. He made Israel come forward tribe by tribe. The tribe of Judah was selected.
war: Gindara an tagsa nga banay han tribo ni Juda ug an napili amo an banay ni Zera. Gindara an tagsa nga panimalay han banay ni Zera, ngan napili an panimalay ni Zabdi.

en: He made the clans of Judah come forward. He selected the clan of Zerah. He made the clan of Zerah come forward as individual soldiers. Zabdi was selected.
war: Gindara an tagsa nga tawo han panimalay ni Zabdi ug an napili amo hi Acan, an anak ni Carmi ug apo ni Zabdi.

en: He made each soldier of his family come forward. Achan was selected. He was a son of Carmi, grandson of Zabdi, great-grandson of Zerah, and of the tribe of Judah.
war: Nagsiring hi Josue kan Acan, “Anak ko, pagsumat han kamatuoran dinhe ha atubangan han Ginoo , an Dyos han Israel ngan igtug-an. Sumati ako yana han iyo ginbuhat. Ayaw ini pagtagoa ha akon.”

en: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD the God of Israel. Tell me what you have done. Don’t hide anything from me.”
war: “Tinuod,” binmaton hi Acan, “nga nakasala ako han Ginoo , an Dyos han Israel ug amo ini an akon ginbuhat.

en: Achan answered Joshua, “It’s true. I’ve sinned against the LORD , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:
war: Usa han mga butang nga aton naagaw, akon hinkit-an in usa nga matahum nga kurugpos nga hinimo ha Babilonia, salapi nga kapin hin duha ka kilo, ngan hin usa ka bareta nga bulawan nga natimbang kapin hin tunga hin kilo. Kinaruyag ko gud ini nga mga butang ngan akon ginkuha. Hiaagian ini linubong didto han akon tulda upod an salapi nga aadto ha ilarom.”

en: Among the booty I saw a single beautiful robe in the Babylonian style, two hundred shekels of silver, and a single gold bar weighing fifty shekels. I desired them and took them. Now they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver on the bottom.”
war: Nagpasugo hi Josue hin mga tawo nga nagdalagan ngadto han tulda ug ira hin-agian an mga butang nga iginlubong didto upod an salapi nga nakadto ha ilarom.

en: Then Joshua sent messengers. They ran to the tent. There it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver on the bottom.
war: Ira ini ginbukad ngan igingawas han tulda, ira gindara ngadto kan Josue ug han mga Israelita ngan ibinutang nira ha atubangan han Ginoo .

en: They took the things from inside the tent. They brought them to Joshua and to all the Israelites and emptied them out before the LORD .
