war: “Palaran adton nagbubuhat para hin kamurayaw ha mga tawo,

en: In the same way, let your light shine before people, so they can see the good things you do and praise your Father who is in heaven.
war: kay tatawgon hira nga mga anak han Dyos!

en: “Don’t even begin to think that I have come to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I haven’t come to do away with them but to fulfill them.
war: “Palaran adton ginpapakurian tungod nga nagtutuman hira han kaburut-on han Dyos,

en: I say to you very seriously that as long as heaven and earth exist, neither the smallest letter nor even the smallest stroke of a pen will be erased from the Law until everything there becomes a reality.
war: kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!

en: Therefore, whoever ignores one of the least of these commands and teaches others to do the same will be called the lowest in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever keeps these commands and teaches people to keep them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
war: “Palaran kamo kon pagbiaybiayon, ngan pagpakurian kamo han mga tawo, ngan pagbutangbutangan kamo tungod la nga akon kamo mga sakop.

en: I say to you that unless your righteousness is greater than the righteousness of the legal experts and the Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
war: Pagrayhak ngan paglipay kamo, kay dako an balos nga andam didto ha langit para ha iyo. Amo ini an ginbuhat han mga tawo han pagpakurii nira han mga manaragna nga una pa ha iyo.

en: “You have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago, Don’t commit murder, and all who commit murder will be in danger of judgment.
war: “Kamo amo an asin para han ngatanan nga katawhan ha tuna. Kundi kon tumab-ang an asin, waray na iba nga paagi hin pagpabalik han iya kapag-ad. Waray na ito gamit, sanglit ilalabog nala basi pagtamaktamakan han mga tawo.

en: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with their brother or sister will be in danger of judgment. If they say to their brother or sister, ‘You idiot,’ they will be in danger of being condemned by the governing council. And if they say, ‘You fool,’ they will be in danger of fiery hell.
war: “Kamo amo an kapawa han bug-os nga kalibutan. Diri matatago in bungto nga gintindog ha bawbaw hin bukid.

en: Therefore, if you bring your gift to the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,
war: Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan takloban. Lugod, ibinubutang ha burutangan hin suga basi makalamrag han ngatanan nga aada ha balay.

en: leave your gift at the altar and go. First make things right with your brother or sister and then come back and offer your gift.
war: Ha sugad nga paagi, kinahanglan an iyo suga magmapawa ha atubangan han mga tawo, basi hikit-an nira an iyo maupay nga buhat, ngan pagdayawon nira an Amay niyo ha langit.

en: Be sure to make friends quickly with your opponents while you are with them on the way to court. Otherwise, they will haul you before the judge, the judge will turn you over to the officer of the court, and you will be thrown into prison.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga kinmanhi ako pagpara han Balaod ni Moises ngan han mga igintutdo han mga manaragna. Waray ako kumanhi hin pagpara hini, kundi hin pagtuman.

en: I say to you in all seriousness that you won’t get out of there until you’ve paid the very last penny.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: samtang aada pa an langit ngan an tuna waray bisan usa nga tulbok ug usa nga bagis in paparaon dida han Balaod, ngada han katuman han ngatanan.

en: “You have heard that it was said, Don’t commit adultery.
war: Sanglit, an magpasibaya bisan han gigugutiayi han mga sugo, ngan magtutdo han iba hin diri pagtuman, giuubosi hiya paghunahunaon didto ha langit. Kundi an nasugot han Balaod ngan magtutdo han iba hin pagtuman hini, magigin dako hiya didto han Ginhadian han langit.

en: But I say to you that every man who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery in his heart.
war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: kon diri lumabaw an iyo pagkamatadong han kanan mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, diri gud kamo makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit.

en: And if your right eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out and throw it away. It’s better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body be thrown into hell.
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga gintutdoan hini an mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Diri ka magpatay; dadad-on ha hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga makamatay.’

en: And if your right hand causes you to fall into sin, chop it off and throw it away. It’s better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body go into hell.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: dadad-on ha hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga masina han iya bugto; dadad-on ha Labaw nga Hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga magbiaybiay han iya bugto; ngan an matawag han iya bugto, ‘Tuyawtuyaw ka;’ mahingangadto ha kalayo han impyerno!

en: “It was said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a divorce certificate.’
war: Sanglit kon maghalad ka sa Dyos ngan manumdom ka nga may kasina an imo bugto ha imo,

en: But I say to you that whoever divorces his wife except for sexual unfaithfulness forces her to commit adultery. And whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
war: bayai anay an imo halad didto ha altar ngan kadto dayon pakighioli han imo bugto. Kahuman, balik ngan paghalad sa Dyos.

en: “Again you have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago: Don’t make a false solemn pledge, but you should follow through on what you have pledged to the Lord.
war: “Kon may tawo nga magsumbong kontra ha imo ngan dad-on ka ha hukmanan, pakigsaboti hiya samtang may panahon pa, nga diri ka pa naatubang han hukmanan. Kay kon mahingadto ka na, itutubyan ka niya ngadto ha hukom, nga matubyan ha imo ngadto ha polis, ngan mabibilanggo ka.

en: But I say to you that you must not pledge at all. You must not pledge by heaven, because it’s God’s throne.
war: Nasiring ako ha imo: diri ka makakagawas didto tubtob nga kabaydan mo an ngatanan nga multa ha imo.

en: You must not pledge by the earth, because it’s God’s footstool. You must not pledge by Jerusalem, because it’s the city of the great king.
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring ini, ‘Diri ka manlibog.’

en: And you must not pledge by your head, because you can’t turn one hair white or black.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: nakapanlibog na ha iya kasingkasing an bisan hin-o nga nasiplat hin babaye ngan nakahunahuna hin pakighilawas ha iya.

en: Let your yes mean yes, and your no mean no. Anything more than this comes from the evil one.
war: Sanglit kon an imo tuo nga mata amo an tinikangan han imo pakasala, lukata ngan ilabog. Gabay ka nala kawad-an hin usa nga bahin han imo lawas, kay hin mahingadto ha impyerno an imo bug-os nga lawas.

en: “You have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth .
war: Kon an imo tuo nga kamot amo an tinikangan han imo pakasala, utda ngan ilabog! Gabay ka nala kawad-an hin usa nga bahin han imo lawas, kay hin mahingadto ha impyerno an bug-os mo nga lawas.

en: But I say to you that you must not oppose those who want to hurt you. If people slap you on your right cheek, you must turn the left cheek to them as well.
war: “Iginsiring liwat ini, ‘Adton makig-bulag han iya asawa, kinahanglan nga maghatag hin sinurat nga karig-onan hin pagpahibaro han iya asawa mahitungod han iya pakigbulag.’

en: When they wish to haul you to court and take your shirt, let them have your coat too.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako: kon in lalake makigbulag han iya asawa hin bisan ano nga pasangil—labot kono naglalake hiya—nakasala hiya, kay hiya man an tinikangan nga nakasala hin panlibog an iya asawa, kon pumaasawa hin iba nga lalake an iya asawa. Makakasala liwat hin panlibog an mangasawa han babaye nga binulagan.

en: When they force you to go one mile, go with them two.
war: “Hinbatian liwat niyo nga igintutdo ha mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Tumana an imo iginsaad ngan buhata an imo iginsumpa ha Ginoo.’

en: Give to those who ask, and don’t refuse those who wish to borrow from you.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagsumpa kon nagsasaad ka. Ayaw gamita an langit hin pagsumpa, kay trono ito han Dyos;

en: “You have heard that it was said, You must love your neighbor and hate your enemy.
war: ayaw man an tuna, kay tungtungan ito han iya mga tiil. Ayaw liwat an Jerusalem, kay syudad ito han harangdon nga Hadi.

en: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who harass you
war: Ayaw gamita bisan pa an imo ulo, kay diri ka makakapabusag o makakapaitom hin usa han imo buhok.

en: so that you will be acting as children of your Father who is in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both the evil and the good and sends rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.
war: Igo na nga masiring ka, ‘Oo’ kon matangdo ka; ‘Diri’ kon mariwa ka; natikang na han Yawa an sobra pa hini nga igyayakan mo.

en: If you love only those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘An mata bayaran hin mata ngan an ngipon bayaran hin ngipon.’

en: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing? Don’t even the Gentiles do the same?
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagbulos han nagpapakaraot ha imo. Kon may magtampalo han imo tuo nga bayhon, ipatampalo liwat ha iya an imo wala nga bayhon.

en: Therefore, just as your heavenly Father is complete in showing love to everyone, so also you must be complete.
war: Ngan kon may magsumbong ha imo basi makuha niya an imo kamiseta, ihatag pa ha iya pati an imo kamisadentro.

en: “Be careful that you don’t practice your religion in front of people to draw their attention. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
war: “Paghirot kamo nga diri mahimo nga parayaw la ha mga tawo an pagbuhat niyo hin maupay. Kay kon amo ito an pagbuhaton niyo, diri kamo makarawat hin balos tikang han Amay niyo ha langit.

en: “Whenever you give to the poor, don’t blow your trumpet as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets so that they may get praise from people. I assure you, that’s the only reward they’ll get.
war: “Sanglit kon mahatag kamo ngadto hin nagkikinahanglan, ayaw paghimoa ini nga dako nga kiritaon sugad han ginbubuhat han mga maglabyaw didto han mga sinagoga ngan ha kadalanan. Ginbubuhat nira ini basi pagdayawon hira han mga tawo. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: But when you give to the poor, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand is doing
war: Kundi kon mabulig kamo han nagkikinahanglan, buhata ini hin hilom, kon mahimo, diri mahibaroan han wala niyo nga kamot an ginbubuhat han iyo tuo,

en: so that you may give to the poor in secret. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.
war: basi mahilom an iyo paghatag, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.

en: “When you pray, don’t be like hypocrites. They love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners so that people will see them. I assure you, that’s the only reward they’ll get.
war: “Kon mag-aampo kamo, ayaw subad han mga maglabyaw! Karuyag nira mag-ampo nga natukdaw ha mga sinagoga ngan ha kanto han kadalanan, basi hikit-an hira han ngatanan. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: But when you pray, go to your room, shut the door, and pray to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.
war: Kundi kon mag-aampo kamo, sakob ha iyo sulod ngan sadhi an porta, ngan pag-ampo han Amay niyo nga diri kinikita, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.

en: “When you pray, don’t pour out a flood of empty words, as the Gentiles do. They think that by saying many words they’ll be heard.
war: “Ha iyo mga pag-ampo, ayaw paggamit hin damo nga waray kahulogan nga mga pulong sugad han ginbubuhat han mga Hentil. An pagsabot nira nga pamamatian hira han Dyos tungod han ira higlaba nga mga pag-ampo.

en: Don’t be like them, because your Father knows what you need before you ask.
war: Ayaw kamo pagsubad ha ira, kay maaram na nga daan an Amay niyo han iyo ginkikinahanglan samtang nga diri pa kamo naaro ha iya.

en: Pray like this:
war: Sanglit sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo:

en: Our Father who is in heaven,
war: ‘Amay namon ha langit:

en: uphold the holiness of your name.
war: Pagdayawon an imo baraan nga ngaran,

en: Bring in your kingdom
war: Maghadi ka unta ha amon,

en: so that your will is done on earth as it’s done in heaven.
war: matuman dinhe ha tuna an imo kaburut-on sugad han didto ha langit.

en: Give us the bread we need for today.
war: Tagi kami yana nga adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.

en: Forgive us for the ways we have wronged you,
war: Pasayloa kami han amon mga sala

en: just as we also forgive those who have wronged us.
war: sugad han pagpasaylo namon han mga nakasala ha amon.

en: And don’t lead us into temptation,
war: Ayaw itugot nga mahingadto kami hin makuri nga kataragman,

en: but rescue us from the evil one.
war: kundi bawia kami ha Karat-an.’

en: “If you forgive others their sins, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
war: [Kay imo an ginhadian, an gahom ngan an himaya ha kadayonan! Amen.]

en: But if you don’t forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your sins.
war: “Kon pasayloon niyo an nakakasala ha iyo, pasasayloon man kamo han Amay niyo ha langit.

en: “And when you fast, don’t put on a sad face like the hypocrites. They distort their faces so people will know they are fasting. I assure you that they have their reward.
war: Kundi kon diri niyo pasayloon an mga nakakasala ha iyo, diri man mapasaylo ha iyo an Amay niyo ha langit.

en: When you fast, brush your hair and wash your face.
war: “Ngan kon magpupuasa kamo, ayaw pagpakita hin bayhon nga masulob-on sugad han mga maglabyaw. Ginraraksot nira an ira nawong basi hikit-an hira han mga tawo nga nagpupuasa hira. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: Then you won’t look like you are fasting to people, but only to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
war: Kon magpupuasa kamo, paghiram-os ngan pagsudlay,

en: “Stop collecting treasures for your own benefit on earth, where moth and rust eat them and where thieves break in and steal them.
war: basi diri mahibaroan han mga tawo nga nagpupuasa kamo. An Amay niyo nga diri kinikita amo la an mahibabaro, ngan babaloson kamo han maupay nga iyo ginbubuhat hin hilom.

en: Instead, collect treasures for yourselves in heaven, where moth and rust don’t eat them and where thieves don’t break in and steal them.
war: “Ayaw kamo pagtirok hin mga bahandi dinhe ha tuna nga pagkukutkuton hin mga tangkob ug taoy, ngan may-ada makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.

en: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
war: Lugod, pagtirok kamo para han iyo kalugaringon hin mga manggad didto ha langit diin waray tangkob ug taoy nga nakakakutkot, ngan waray makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.

en: “The eye is the lamp of the body. Therefore, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light.
war: Kay kon hain an iyo mga manggad, dayuday aadto man an iyo kasingkasing.

en: But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how terrible that darkness will be!
war: “An mga mata amo an suga para han lawas. Kon maupay an iyo mga mata, malulukop hin kapawa an bug-os niyo nga lawas.

en: No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be loyal to the one and have contempt for the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.
war: Kundi kon diri maupay an iyo mata, mapuputos hin kamasirom an bug-os niyo nga lawas. Sanglit kon an kapawa dida ha iyo, kasisidman ngay-an, kamakalilisang hito nga kasisidman!

en: “Therefore, I say to you, don’t worry about your life, what you’ll eat or what you’ll drink, or about your body, what you’ll wear. Isn’t life more than food and the body more than clothes?
war: “Waray tawo nga makakahimo hin pag-alagad hin duha nga agaron, kay mahinanabo nga pagdudumtan niya an usa ngan paghihigugmaon niya an ikaduha. Uunongan niya an usa ngan pagtatamayon niya an ikaduha. Diri ka makakag-alagad han Dyos ngan han manggad.

en: Look at the birds in the sky. They don’t sow seed or harvest grain or gather crops into barns. Yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you worth much more than they are?
war: “Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw kamo kabaraka mahitungod han pagkaon ngan pag-inom nga kinahanglanon niyo basi mabuhi kamo, o tungod han panapton para han iyo lawas. Diri ba an kinabuhi labaw pa han pagkaon, ngan an lawas labaw pa han panapton?

en: Who among you by worrying can add a single moment to your life?
war: Tan-awa daw niyo an katamsihan: diri hira nagpupugas, o nagbabari, o nagsisibog ngadto ha kamalig, kundi ginmamangnoan hira han Amay niyo ha langit. Diri ba kamo labaw pa han katamsihan?

en: And why do you worry about clothes? Notice how the lilies in the field grow. They don’t wear themselves out with work, and they don’t spin cloth.
war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakapahilaba han iya kinabuhi hin bisan pira la ka tuig pinaagi han iyo pagkinabaraka?

en: But I say to you that even Solomon in all of his splendor wasn’t dressed like one of these.
war: “Ngan kay ano nga nababaraka kamo mahitungod hin panapton? Paghunahunaa daw niyo an pagtubo han mga bukad ha kapatagan; diri hira nagbubuhat o naghahablon.

en: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghukom han iba basi diri kamo paghukman han Dyos.

en: You’ll receive the same judgment you give. Whatever you deal out will be dealt out to you.
war: Kay paghuhukman kamo han Dyos sumala han paghukom niyo han iba, ngan an iyo igsusukol han iba amo man an gagamiton ha iyo.

en: Why do you see the splinter that’s in your brother’s or sister’s eye, but don’t notice the log in your own eye?
war: Kay ano nga nakita man kamo han poling ha mata han iyo bugto, kundi diri kamo nanginginano han nabalabag han iyo kalugaringon nga mata?

en: How can you say to your brother or sister, ‘Let me take the splinter out of your eye,’ when there’s a log in your eye?
war: Uunanhon niyo hin pagsiring ha imo bugto, ‘Kadi, kukuhaon ta an poling ha imo mata,’ kon aada pa in nabalabag ha iyo kalugaringon nga mata?

en: You deceive yourself! First take the log out of your eye, and then you’ll see clearly to take the splinter out of your brother’s or sister’s eye.
war: Kamalabyaw niyo! Kuhaa anay an nabalabag ha iyo mata, ngan unina, makakakita kamo hin maupay, ngan makakakuha kamo han poling han iyo bugto.

en: Don’t give holy things to dogs, and don’t throw your pearls in front of pigs. They will stomp on the pearls, then turn around and attack you.
war: “Ayaw ihatag ha mga ayam an baraan nga butang, kay bangin kamo banhagon ngan kumagat ha iyo. Ayaw ilabog an iyo mga perlas ngadto han mga baboy, kay pagtatamaktamakan la ito nira.

en: “Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened to you.
war: “Pangaro ngan tatagan kamo; pamiling ngan makakaagi kamo; pagtuktok ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iyo.

en: For everyone who asks, receives. Whoever seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door is opened.
war: Kay makarawat an tagsa nga nangangaro, makakaagi an namimiling, ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iya nga nagtutuktok.

en: Who among you will give your children a stone when they ask for bread?
war: Kamo nga mga amay, tatagan ba niyo hin bato kon mangaro an iyo anak hin tinapay?

en: Or give them a snake when they ask for fish?
war: Tatagan ba niyo hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?

en: If you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give good things to those who ask him.
war: Kon kamo nga magraot, maaram humatag hin mag-upay nga mga butang ha iyo mga anak, asay pa ba an Amay niyo ha langit in diri humatag han mag-upay nga mga butang hadton mga nangangaro ha iya!

en: Therefore, you should treat people in the same way that you want people to treat you; this is the Law and the Prophets.
war: “Buhata niyo ha iba an karuyag niyo nga buhaton nira ha iyo. Amo ini an kahulogan han Balaod ni Moises ngan han igintutdo han mga manaragna.

en: “Go in through the narrow gate. The gate that leads to destruction is broad and the road wide, so many people enter through it.
war: “Sulod kamo han haligot nga aragian; kay haluag an aragian ngan masayon an dalan tipakadto ha impyerno, ngan damo an naagi hini nga dalan.

en: But the gate that leads to life is narrow and the road difficult, so few people find it.
war: Kundi haligot an aragian ngan makuri an dalan tipakadto ha kinabuhi nga dayon, ngan diri damo an nakakatoltol hini nga dalan.

en: “Watch out for false prophets. They come to you dressed like sheep, but inside they are vicious wolves.
war: “Pag-ikmat kamo han buwaon nga mga manaragna; napahirani hira ha iyo sugad hin mga karnero pagkit-on, kundi balitaw, ha sulod, sugad gud hira hin magbangis nga mga lubo.

en: You will know them by their fruit. Do people get bunches of grapes from thorny weeds, or do they get figs from thistles?
war: Makikilala niyo hira pinaagi han ira mga panggawi. Binuburo ba in ubas tikang hin kasapinitan, o in igos tikang hin niyutiyo?

en: In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, and every rotten tree produces bad fruit.
war: Nabunga hin maupay an maupay nga kahoy, kundi nabunga hin maraot an maraot man nga kahoy.

en: A good tree can’t produce bad fruit. And a rotten tree can’t produce good fruit.
war: Diri makakabunga hin maraot an maupay nga kahoy, diri man liwat makakabunga hin maupay an maraot nga kahoy.

en: Every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is chopped down and thrown into the fire.
war: Pupudlon ngan susunogon an kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.

en: Therefore, you will know them by their fruit.
war: Sanglit, makikilala niyo an buwaon nga mga manaragna pinaagi han ira mga panggawi.

en: “Not everybody who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only those who do the will of my Father who is in heaven will enter.
war: “Diri ngatanan nga natawag ha akon, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo,’ makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit, kundi adton nagtutuman la han kaburut-on han akon Amay ha langit.

en: On the Judgment Day, many people will say to me, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name and expel demons in your name and do lots of miracles in your name?’
war: Pag-abot han Adlaw han Paghukom, damo in masiring ha akon, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo! ha imo ngaran nagpasangyaw kami han mensahe han Dyos, nagpaiwas kami hin mga yawa, ngan nagbuhat kami hin mga milagro!’

en: Then I’ll tell them, ‘I’ve never known you. Get away from me, you people who do wrong.’
war: Niyan masiring ako ha ira, ‘Waray gud ako kumilala ha iyo. Pahirayo kamo, mga banyaga nga mga tawo!’

en: “ Everybody who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise builder who built a house on bedrock.
war: “Sanglit, an tagsa nga mamati ngan magtuman hini nga akon mga pulong masusugad hin tawo nga may-ada hibaro nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han bato.

en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It didn’t fall because it was firmly set on bedrock.
war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay; kundi waray mapukan, kay maupay an katindog ha bawbaw han bato.

en: But everybody who hears these words of mine and doesn’t put them into practice will be like a fool who built a house on sand.
war: “An tagsa nga mamati hini nga akon mga pulong, ngan diri magtuman masusugad hin tawo nga buangbuang nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han baras.

en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It fell and was completely destroyed. ”
war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay, ngan napukan. Kamakalilisang an pagkapukan hadto nga balay!”

en: When Jesus finished these words, the crowds were amazed at his teaching
war: Katapos ni Jesus pagyakan hini nga mga butang, nahipausa an mga tawo han paagi han iya pagtutdo,

en: because he was teaching them like someone with authority and not like their legal experts.
war: kay nagtutdo hiya nga may gahom ngan diri sugad han ira mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: Now when Jesus had come down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.
war: Linmugsong hi Jesus tikang hin pungtod ngan nagsunod ha iya in damo kaupay nga mga tawo.

en: A man with a skin disease came, kneeled before him, and said, “Lord, if you want, you can make me clean.”
war: Hinmarani ha iya in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha atubangan niya ngan sinmiring, “Kon imo karuyag, makakalinis ka ha akon.”

en: Jesus reached out his hand and touched him, saying, “ I do want to. Become clean. ” Instantly his skin disease was cleansed.
war: Kinamkam hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Karuyag ko, magmalinis ka!” Dida dayon nalinisan an tawo han iya sanla.

en: Jesus said to him, “ Don’t say anything to anyone. Instead, go and show yourself to the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded. This will be a testimony to them. ”
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Pamati! Ayaw pagsumat bisan kan kanay, kundi kadto dayon ha padi ngan pakita ha iya. Kahuman, paghalad sugad han iginsugo ni Moises, pagpakita han mga tawo nga malinis ka na.”

en: When Jesus went to Capernaum, a centurion approached,
war: Han pagsulod ni Jesus ha Capernaum gintapo hiya hin kapitan nga Romano nga nakimalooy ha iya,

en: pleading with him, “Lord, my servant is flat on his back at home, paralyzed, and his suffering is awful.”
war: “Sir, masakit an akon surugoon, nahigda, diri nakakakiwa, ngan nagkukuri hin duro.”

en: Jesus responded, “ I’ll come and heal him. ”
war: “Makadto ako ngan uupayon ko hiya,” nagsiring hi Jesus.

en: But the centurion replied, “Lord, I don’t deserve to have you come under my roof. Just say the word and my servant will be healed.
war: Kundi binmaton an kapitan, “Sir, diri ako takos nga sumulod ka ha akon balay. Sugoa la ako ngan mauupay dayon an akon surugoon.

en: I’m a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and the servant does it.”
war: Usa liwat ako ka tawo nga ubos hin labaw nga mga opisyal, ngan may-ada ko liwat mga sakop nga mga sondalo. Kon nasugo ako ha usa, ‘Kadto na!’ napakadto hiya; ngan ha iba, ‘Kadi na!’ nadaop hiya. Kon nasugo ako han akon oripon, ‘Buhata ini!’ ginbubuhat niya dayon.”

en: When Jesus heard this, he was impressed and said to the people following him, “ I say to you with all seriousness that even in Israel I haven’t found faith like this.
war: Nahipausa hi Jesus han pakabati niya hini, ngan ginsiring an mga tawo nga nagsusunod ha iya, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, waray pa gud ako makakita ha Israel hin pagtoo nga sugad kadako hini.

en: I say to you that there are many who will come from east and west and sit down to eat with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: damo in maabot tikang ha sinirangan ngan ha katundan, ngan makikigsaro kanda Abraham, Isaac, ug Jacob didto han Ginhadian han langit,

en: But the children of the kingdom will be thrown outside into the darkness. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth. ”
war: samtang an mga anak han Ginhadian ilalabog lugod ha kasisidman ha gawas; didto mananangis hira ngan manliligot an ira mga ngipon.”

en: Jesus said to the centurion, “ Go; it will be done for you just as you have believed. ” And his servant was healed that very moment.
war: Ngan ginsiring ni Jesus an kapitan, “Hala, oli na la, ngan matumanan ka sumala han imo pagtoo.” Ngan hito ngahaw nga takna naupay an surugoon han kapitan.

en: Jesus went home with Peter and saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha balay ni Pedro ngan hinkit-an niya an babaye nga ugangan ni Pedro nga nahigda kay hinihirantan.

en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served them.
war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an iya kamot ngan nalungasan hiya han hiranat. Binmuhat hiya ngan nagsirbe kan Jesus.

en: That evening people brought to Jesus many who were demon-possessed. He threw the spirits out with just a word. He healed everyone who was sick.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, gindara ngadto kan Jesus in damo nga mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ha usa la ka pulong ginpagawas ni Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, ngan gintambal an ngatanan nga mga magsakit.

en: This happened so that what Isaiah the prophet said would be fulfilled: He is the one who took our illnesses and carried away our diseases.
war: Ginbuhat niya ini basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna,

en: Now when Jesus saw the crowd, he ordered his disciples to go over to the other side of the lake.
war: “Hiya ngahaw an nagkuha han

en: A legal expert came and said to him, “Teacher, I’ll follow you wherever you go.”
war: ngatanan naton nga mga sakit.”

en: Jesus replied, “ Foxes have dens, and the birds in the sky have nests, but the Human One has no place to lay his head. ”
war: Han pagkita ni Jesus han kadam-an nga nag-aalirong ha iya, nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga mapakadto ha tabok han lanaw.

en: Another man, one of his disciples, said to him, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
war: Dinimaop ha iya in usa nga magturutdo han Balaod ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo, andam ako hin pag-upod ha imo bisan ngain.”

en: But Jesus said to him, “ Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead. ”
war: Ginbaton hiya ni Jesus, “May mga buho an mga miro, ngan may mga salag an katamsihan, kundi waray ngani hinihigdaan hin pagpahuway an Anak han Tawo.”

en: When Jesus got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
war: Nagsiring liwat in lain nga tinun-an, “Tugoti gad ako hin pag-oli anay hin paglubong han akon amay.”

en: A huge storm arose on the lake so that waves were sloshing over the boat. But Jesus was asleep.
war: Kundi ginbaton hiya ni Jesus, “Sunod ha akon, ngan pabay-i an mga patay nga asay maglubong han ira minatay.”

en: They came and woke him, saying, “Lord, rescue us! We’re going to drown!”
war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.

en: He said to them, “ Why are you afraid, you people of weak faith? ” Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the lake, and there was a great calm.
war: Han nakaturog hi Jesus, tigda la nga inmabot in makusog nga alipuros ha lanaw, sanglit ginsasakayan na hira han mga balod, ngan haros na malunod an sakayan, kundi nakaturog hi Jesus.

en: The people were amazed and said, “What kind of person is this? Even the winds and the lake obey him!”
war: Gindaop hiya han mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hin pagpukaw ha iya, “Talwasa kami, Ginoo! Malulunod kita!”

en: When Jesus arrived on the other side of the lake in the country of the Gadarenes, two men who were demon-possessed came from among the tombs to meet him. They were so violent that nobody could travel on that road.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Kay ano nga nahadlok man kamo? Kagutiay han iyo pagtoo!” Niyan binmuhat hiya ngan ginsaway an hangin ngan an balod, ngan nagmalinaw an dagat.

en: They cried out, “What are you going to do with us, Son of God? Have you come to torture us before the time of judgment?”
war: Nahipausa hira ngatanan ngan may hinsiring, “Hin-o ini nga tawo? Nasugot ha iya bisan an hangin ug balod!”

en: Far off in the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ha tabok han lanaw, ha tuna han mga taga-Gadara, gintapo hiya hin duha ka tawo nga tikang han mga lubnganan. Sinasangkayan hira hin yawa, ngan mga magisog, sanglit waray nagpapasipara hin pag-agi hadto nga dalan.

en: The demons pleaded with him, “If you throw us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
war: Sinminggit hira dayon, “Ano an imo karuyag ha amon, Anak han Dyos? Kinmanhi ka ba hin pagkastigo ha amon nga diri pa man igo nga panahon?”

en: Then he said to the demons, “ Go away, ” and they came out and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.
war: May dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon hirani hini nga dapit.

en: Those who tended the pigs ran into the city and told everything that had happened to the demon-possessed men.
war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa, “Kon pagagawson mo man kami, pasudla kami ngadto hito nga panon hin kababoyan.”

en: Then the whole city came out and met Jesus. When they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Kadto na kamo.” Sanglit ginmawas hira ngan sinmulod han kababoyan. Tigda nga nagdadlagan an bug-os nga panon han kababoyan ngadto ha ligid han umpas, nagkahuglog ngadto ha lanaw, ngan nagkalulumos.

en: Boarding a boat, Jesus crossed to the other side of the lake and went to his own city.
war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan, binmalik pagtabok han lanaw, ngan kinmadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto.

en: People brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a cot. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man who was paralyzed, “ Be encouraged, my child, your sins are forgiven. ”
war: Gindara ngada ha iya hin pira ka tawo in usa nga lulid nga nahigda. Hinkit-an ni Jesus an kadako han ira pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Tapod na la, anak ko! Ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: Some legal experts said among themselves, “This man is insulting God.”
war: Ngan may hinsiring hin pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Nagpanamastamas ini nga tawo!”

en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “ Why do you fill your minds with evil things?
war: Nakasantop hi Jesus han ira nahunahunaan, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Kay ano nga nakahunahuna kamo hin sugad kamaraot nga mga butang?

en: Which is easier—to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
war: Hain in masarusayon, an pagsiring, ‘An imo mga sala ginpasaylo,’ o an pagsiring, ‘Buhat ngan lakat’?

en: But so you will know that the Human One has authority on the earth to forgive sins ”—he said to the man who was paralyzed—“ Get up, take your cot, and go home. ”
war: Ipakikita ko ha iyo nga may gahom an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala dinhe ha tuna.” Ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan oli ngadto ha imo balay.”

en: The man got up and went home.
war: Binmuhat an tawo ngan inmoli.

en: When the crowds saw what had happened, they were afraid and praised God, who had given such authority to human beings.
war: Pakakita hini han mga tawo kinulba hira ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos nga naghatag hin sugad nga gahom ngadto han mga tawo.

en: As Jesus continued on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. He said to him, “ Follow me, ” and he got up and followed him.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit. Han naglalakat hiya ha dalan, hinkit-an niya in tawo nga parasukot hin buhis nga ginngaranan kan Mateo nga nalingkod didto han iya buhatan. Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Sunod ha akon.”

en: As Jesus sat down to eat in Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners joined Jesus and his disciples at the table.
war: Ngan binmuhat hi Mateo ngan sinmunod ha iya.

en: But when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
war: Han nangangaon na hira Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an didto han balay ni Mateo, inmabot in damo nga mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay, ngan tinmangka upod ha ira.

en: When Jesus heard it, he said, “ Healthy people don’t need a doctor, but sick people do.
war: Hinkit-an ini hin mga Parisiyo ngan nagpakiana hira han iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nakikigsaro an iyo magturutdo han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay?”

en: Go and learn what this means: I want mercy and not sacrifice . I didn’t come to call righteous people, but sinners. ”
war: Hinbatian hira ni Jesus ngan ginbaton hira, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an waray sakit nga mga tawo, kundi an mga magsakit la.

en: At that time John’s disciples came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees frequently fast, but your disciples never fast?”
war: Lakat ngan panginanoa kon ano an kahulogan hini nga kasuratan nga nasiring, ‘Naungara ako hin kalooy, diri hin halad nga mga hayop.’ Kay kinmanhi ako pagtawag han mga makasasala, diri han mga magtadong.”

en: Jesus responded, “The wedding guests can’t mourn while the groom is still with them, can they? But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they’ll fast.
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus an mga sakop ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan nagpakiana, “Kay ano nga agsob magpuasa kami ngan an mga Parisiyo, kundi diri man nagpupuasa an imo mga tinun-an?”

en: “ No one sews a piece of new, unshrunk cloth on old clothes because the patch tears away the cloth and makes a worse tear.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Magmamasulob-on ba an mga dinapit ngadto hin pakasal samtang upod pa nira an lalake nga kinasal? Diri gud! Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal nga lalake, ngan amo na an pagpuasa nira.

en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. If they did, the wineskins would burst, the wine would spill, and the wineskins would be ruined. Instead, people pour new wine into new wineskins so that both are kept safe. ”
war: “Waray nagamit hin bag-o nga dugnit para hin pagtangkop hin daan nga panapton; kay nakakagisi han daan nga panapton in sugad nga tangkop, ngan mahiluag lugod an tarangkopan.

en: While Jesus was speaking to them, a ruler came and knelt in front of him, saying, “My daughter has just died. But come and place your hand on her, and she’ll live.”
war: Waray liwat naipis hin bag-o nga bino ngadto hin daan na nga anit nga surudlan. Kon buhaton ini, mabuburit an surudlan, kay magigisi man an anit, ngan makakarag an bino. Lugod, isinusulod an bag-o nga bino ngadto hin bag-o nga anit nga surudlan ngan waray may nakakarag.”

en: So Jesus and his disciples got up and went with him.
war: Han nagyayakan pa hi Jesus hini, hinmarani ha iya in usa nga Judiyo, linmuhod ha iya atubangan, ngan naghangyo: “Kamamatay pa la yana han akon anak nga babayehay, kundi upod gad ha akon ngan ipadapat an imo kamot ha iya, ngan mabubuhi hiya.”

en: Then a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and touched the hem of his clothes.
war: Sanglit, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan sinmunod ha iya ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.

en: She thought, If I only touch his robe I’ll be healed.
war: May usa nga babaye nga gindidinogoan sulod hin dose na ka tuig, ngan pinmaluyo hiya kan Jesus. Kinamkam niya an sidsid han bado ni Jesus.

en: When Jesus turned and saw her, he said, “ Be encouraged, daughter. Your faith has healed you. ” And the woman was healed from that time on.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya kalugaringon, “Kon makakamkam la ako han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

en: When Jesus went into the ruler’s house, he saw the flute players and the distressed crowd.
war: Linmingi hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya an babaye, ngan ginsiring niya, “Ayaw kahadlok, anak! Nakaupay ha imo an imo pagtoo.” Ngan dida dayon naupay an babaye.

en: He said, “ Go away, because the little girl isn’t dead but is asleep ”; but they laughed at him.
war: Sanglit, kinmadto hi Jesus ha balay han opisyal. Han pakakita niya han mga magtotokar para han paglubong ngan han nagkarigumok nga mga tawo,

en: After he had sent the crowd away, Jesus went in and touched her hand, and the little girl rose up.
war: nagsiring hiya, “Kagawas kamo ngatanan! Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya!”

en: News about this spread throughout that whole region.
war: Ngan gintinawaan hiya nira.

en: As Jesus departed, two blind men followed him, crying out, “Show us mercy, Son of David.”
war: Han pagkagawas la han mga tawo, sinmulod hi Jesus han kwarto han babayehay, kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata, ngan binmuhat an bata.

en: When he came into the house, the blind men approached him. Jesus said to them, “ Do you believe I can do this? ”
war: Ngan nahisangyaw ini nga nahinabo ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.

en: “Yes, Lord,” they replied.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit ngan han naglalakat hiya, ginsunod hiya hin duha nga lalake nga buta. Ginmuliat hira, “Kaluoyi intawon kami, Anak ni David!”

en: Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, “ It will happen for you just as you have believed. ”
war: Han pagsulod na ni Jesus hin balay, dinmaop ha iya an duha nga buta, ngan nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Natoo ba kamo nga mahihimo ko ini?”

en: Their eyes were opened. Then Jesus sternly warned them, “ Make sure nobody knows about this. ”
war: Binmaton hira, “Oo, Ginoo.”

en: But they went out and spread the word about him throughout that whole region.
war: Niyan kinamkam ni Jesus an ira mga mata ngan nagsiring, “Mahimo unta sumala gud han iyo pagtoo!”—

en: As they were leaving, people brought to him a man who was demon-possessed and unable to speak.
war: ngan nakakita na hira. Gintugon hira ni Jesus, “Ayaw gud kamo pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay!”

en: When Jesus had thrown out the demon, the man who couldn’t speak began to talk. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel.”
war: Kundi linmakat hira ngan iginsumat lugod nira ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hadto nga tuna an ginbuhat ha ira ni Jesus.

en: But the Pharisees said, “He throws out demons with the authority of the ruler of demons.”
war: Han pagkalakat na han mga tawo, may pira ka tawo nga nagdara ngadto kan Jesus hin tawo nga waray makakayakan kay sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa.

en: Jesus traveled among all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, announcing the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.
war: Han paghigawas na han yawa, nakayakan dayon an tawo, ngan nahipausa an ngatanan. Nagsiring hira, “Waray pa kita kumita hin sugad hini dinhe ha Israel!”

en: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he had compassion for them because they were troubled and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
war: Kundi nagsiring an mga Parisiyo, “An punoan han mga yawa an naghatag ha iya hin gahom hin pagpagawas han mga yawa.”

en: Then he said to his disciples, “ The size of the harvest is bigger than you can imagine, but there are few workers.
war: Ngan ginduaw ni Jesus an ngatanan nga kabungtohan ngan kabaryohan. Nagtutdo hiya didto han ira mga sinagoga, nagwali han Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian, ngan gintambal niya an mga tawo han ngatanan nga mga sakit.

en: He called his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits to throw them out and to heal every disease and every sickness.
war: Gintirok ni Jesus an iya dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan gintagan hira hin gahom hin pagpaiwas han magraot nga mga espiritu ngan pagtambal han ngatanan nga sakit.

en: Here are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, who is called Peter; and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee; and John his brother;
war: Amo ini an mga ngaran han dose nga mga apostoles: an syahan, hi Simon (nga ginngangaranan kan Pedro) ngan an iya bugto, hi Andres; hi Santiago ngan an iya bugto, hi Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo;

en: Philip; and Bartholomew; Thomas; and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; and Thaddaeus;
war: hi Felipe ngan hi Bartolome; hi Tomas ngan hi Mateo nga parasukot hin buhis; hi Santiago, nga anak ni Alfeo, ngan hi Tadeo;

en: Simon the Cananaean; and Judas, who betrayed Jesus.
war: hi Simon nga bayani, ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.

en: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, “Don’t go among the Gentiles or into a Samaritan city.
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus ini nga dose upod ini nga mga tugon: “Ayaw kamo pagkadto han bisan ano nga tuna han mga Hentil o han bisan ano nga bungto han Samaria.

en: Go instead to the lost sheep, the people of Israel.
war: Lugod, kadtoa niyo an nagkawawara nga mga karnero han katawhan han Israel.

en: As you go, make this announcement: ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near.’
war: Lakat kamo ngan ipasangyaw nga hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.

en: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those with skin diseases, and throw out demons. You received without having to pay. Therefore, give without demanding payment.
war: Tambala an mga magsakit, banhawa an mga minatay, linisi an mga sanlahon, ngan pagawsa an mga yawa. Kinmarawat kamo nga waray pabaydi ha iyo, sanglit hatag man kamo nga diri kamo magpapabayad.

en: Workers deserve to be fed, so don’t gather gold or silver or copper coins for your money belts to take on your trips.
war: Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bulawan, salapi, o bronse nga kwarta ha iyo mga bulsa;

en: Don’t take a backpack for the road or two shirts or sandals or a walking stick.
war: ayaw liwat kamo pagdara hin kanan makililimos supot ha iyo paglalaktan, o iba nga liliwanan o sandalyas labot han iyo sinusulot o tungkod. Angay tagan an nagkakabudlay han iya mga kinahanglanon.

en: Whatever city or village you go into, find somebody in it who is worthy and stay there until you go on your way.
war: “Pag-abot niyo hin bungto o baryo, pamiling kamo hin mapasaka ha iyo, ngan pabilin kamo dida ha iya ngada han pagbaya niyo hito nga dapit.

en: When you go into a house, say, ‘Peace!’
war: Pagsaka niyo hin balay siring kamo, ‘Maada unta ha iyo an kamurayaw.’

en: If the house is worthy, give it your blessing of peace. But if the house isn’t worthy, take back your blessing.
war: Kon karawaton kamo han tagbalay mapabilin an kamurayaw dida hito nga balay; kundi kon diri, bawia an igpapabilin nga kamurayaw.

en: If anyone refuses to welcome you or listen to your words, shake the dust off your feet as you leave that house or city.
war: Ngan kon may-ada balay kon bungto nga diri kumarawat o diri mamati ha iyo, padpara an tapotapo han iyo mga tiil ngan bayai ito nga dapit.

en: I assure you that it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on Judgment Day than it will be for that city.
war: Tigamni ini! Ha Adlaw han Paghukom malolooy pa an Dyos han mga tawo han Sodoma ug Gomora kay han mga tawo hito nga bungto!

en: “Look, I’m sending you as sheep among wolves. Therefore, be wise as snakes and innocent as doves.
war: “Pamati kamo! Sinusugo ko kamo sugad hin mga karnero ngadto ha panon hin mga lubo. Sanglit kinahanglan mag-ikmat kamo sugad hin mga halas ngan magmalumo kamo sugad hin sarapati.

en: Watch out for people—because they will hand you over to councils and they will beat you in their synagogues.
war: Pagbantay kamo kay may mga tawo nga magdadakop ngan magdadara ha iyo ngadto ha hukmanan, ngan paglalatobon kamo nira didto ha ira mga sinagoga.

en: They will haul you in front of governors and even kings because of me so that you may give your testimony to them and to the Gentiles.
war: Pagdadad-on kamo ha atubangan han mga punoan ngan mga hadi tungod ha akon, hin pagsangyaw han Maupay nga Sumat ha ira ngan ha mga Hentil.

en: Whenever they hand you over, don’t worry about how to speak or what you will say, because what you can say will be given to you at that moment.
war: Kon pagdad-on kamo ha hukmanan, ayaw kabaraka mahitungod han iyo igyayakan o kon uunanhon niyo hin pagyakan; kay pag-abot han panahon, tututdoan kamo han iyo igyayakan.

en: You aren’t doing the talking, but the Spirit of my Father is doing the talking through you.
war: Kay diri iyo an mga pulong nga igyayakan niyo, kundi tikang han Espiritu han Amay niyo nga magyayakan ha iyo.

en: Brothers and sisters will hand each other over to be executed. A father will turn his child in. Children will defy their parents and have them executed.
war: “Igtutubyan han mga tawo an ira kalugaringon nga kabugtoan basi patayon hira, ngan amo ngahaw an bubuhaton han mga amay ha ira mga anak; maato an mga anak han ira mga kag-anak ngan ipapapatay hira.

en: Everyone will hate you on account of my name. But whoever stands firm until the end will be saved.
war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon, kundi matatalwas an magpailob tubtob ha kataposan.

en: Whenever they harass you in one city, escape to the next, because I assure that you will not go through all the cities of Israel before the Human One comes.
war: Kon pagpakurian kamo ha usa nga bungto, palagiw ngadto hin lain nga bungto. Nasiring ako ha iyo nga diri pa mahuhuman an iyo buruhaton ha ngatanan nga kabungtohan han Israel, maabot na an Anak han Tawo.

en: “Disciples aren’t greater than their teacher, and slaves aren’t greater than their master.
war: “Waray tinun-an nga labaw han iya magturutdo; waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron.

en: It’s enough for disciples to be like their teacher and slaves like their master. If they have called the head of the house Beelzebul, it’s certain that they will call the members of his household by even worse names.
war: Sanglit angay malipay an tinun-an kon makatupong hiya han iya magturutdo, ngan an oripon kon makatupong hiya han iya agaron. Kon tawgon nga Beelsebul an pangulo han panimalay, pagngangaranan hin labaw pa gud kamangil-ad an iya mga sakop!

en: “Therefore, don’t be afraid of those people because nothing is hidden that won’t be revealed, and nothing secret that won’t be brought out into the open.
war: “Sanglit ayaw kamo kahadlok han mga tawo. Bubuksan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ngan igpapahayag an tagsa nga tinago.

en: What I say to you in the darkness, tell in the light; and what you hear whispered, announce from the rooftops.
war: Kinahanglan igyakan niyo liwat ha kapaw-an an igsusumat ko ha iyo ha kasisidman, ngan kinahanglan igpasangyaw niyo tikang ha mga atop an nabatian niyo hin hilom.

en: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body but can’t kill the soul. Instead, be afraid of the one who can destroy both body and soul in hell.
war: Ayaw kamo kahadlok han makakamatay han lawas, kundi diri makakamatay han kalag; asay lugod kahadloki niyo an Dyos nga makakamatay han kalag ngan han lawas didto ha impyerno.

en: Aren’t two sparrows sold for a small coin? But not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father knowing about it already.
war: Usa ka sentabo an igpapalit niyo hin duha nga balinsasayaw kundi waray usa nga balinsasayaw nga nahuhulog ha tuna kon diri pagbuot han Amay niyo.

en: Even the hairs of your head are all counted.
war: An ha iyo nga bahin, gin-ihap na bisan ngani an ngatanan nga mga buhok han iyo ulo.

en: Don’t be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.
war: Sanglit ayaw kamo kahadlok; mahal pa kamo kaupay kay hin damo nga mga balinsasayaw!

en: “Therefore, everyone who acknowledges me before people, I also will acknowledge before my Father who is in heaven.
war: “Aangkonon ko man ha atubangan han akon Amay ha langit an bisan hin-o nga magpadayag ha kadam-an nga akon hiya.

en: But everyone who denies me before people, I also will deny before my Father who is in heaven.
war: Kundi iglilirong ko man ha atubangan han akon Amay ha langit an bisan hin-o nga maglirong ha kadam-an nga akon hiya.

en: “Don’t think that I’ve come to bring peace to the earth. I haven’t come to bring peace but a sword.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga kinmanhi ako pagdara hin kalinaw ha kalibutan; diri kalinaw an gindara ko, kundi espada.

en: I’ve come to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law .
war: Kinmanhi ako pagtugpo han mga anak nga kalalaken-an kontra han mga amay nira, han mga anak nga kababayen-an kontra han mga iroy nira, han mga umagad nga kababayen-an kontra han mga ugangan nira nga kababayen-an.

en: People’s enemies are members of their own households .
war: An makaharadlok gud nga mga kaaway han tawo amo an mga sakop ngahaw han iya kalugaringon nga panimalay.

en: “Those who love father or mother more than me aren’t worthy of me. Those who love son or daughter more than me aren’t worthy of me.
war: “Diri takos ha akon an nahigugma han amay o iroy niya labaw ha akon; diri takos ha akon an nahigugma han iya mga anak labaw ha akon.

en: Those who don’t pick up their crosses and follow me aren’t worthy of me.
war: Diri takos ha akon an diri magpas-an han iya kros ngan diri magsunod ha akon.

en: Those who find their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives because of me will find them.
war: An karuyag magtipig han iya kinabuhi ini mawawara ha iya; kundi an kawad-an han iya kinabuhi tungod ha akon mabubuhi lugod.

en: “ Those who receive you are also receiving me, and those who receive me are receiving the one who sent me.
war: “An bisan hin-o nga nakarawat ha iyo nakarawat ha akon; ngan an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat ha akon nakarawat liwat han nagsugo ha akon.

en: Those who receive a prophet as a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. Those who receive a righteous person as a righteous person will receive a righteous person’s reward.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han sinugo han Dyos, tungod kay sinugo hiya han Dyos maangbit han balos nga kakarawaton han sinugo; ngan an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat hin tawo nga maupay, tungod kay maupay hiya maangbit man han balos nga kakarawaton hin maupay nga tawo.

en: I assure you that everybody who gives even a cup of cold water to these little ones because they are my disciples will certainly be rewarded. ”
war: Ngan tigamni ini: an bisan hin-o nga magpainom hin tubig nga mahagkot han giuubosi hini nga akon mga sakop, tungod nga akon hiya sakop makarawat manta han iya balos.”

en: When Jesus finished teaching his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
war: Katapos pagtugona ni Jesus an iya dose nga mga tinun-an, binmaya hiya hadto nga dapit ngan kinmadto hin pagtutdo ngan pagwali ha mga higrani nga bungto.

en: Now when John heard in prison about the things the Christ was doing, he sent word by his disciples to Jesus, asking,
war: Han pakabati ni Juan nga parabunyag didto ha bilanggoan mahitungod han mga buhat ni Cristo, ginpakadto niya kan Jesus in pira han iya mga tinun-an.

en: “Are you the one who is to come, or should we look for another?”
war: Nagpakiana hira kan Jesus, “Sumati daw kami, ikaw ba an ginpapaabot nga ginsiring ni Juan, o maghuhulat pa ba kami hin lain?”

en: Jesus responded, “ Go, report to John what you hear and see.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Balik kamo ngan sumati hi Juan han iyo hinbabatian ngan hinkikit-an:

en: Those who were blind are able to see . Those who were crippled are walking. People with skin diseases are cleansed. Those who were deaf now hear. Those who were dead are raised up. The poor have good news proclaimed to them .
war: nakakakita na an mga buta, nakakalakat na an mga lulid, malinis na an mga sanlahon, nakakabati na an mga bungol, nabanhaw na an mga minatay, ngan iginpasangyaw na an Maupay nga Sumat ngadto han mga kablas.

en: Happy are those who don’t stumble and fall because of me. ”
war: Hin kapalaran hadton waray pagruhaduha ha akon!”

en: When John’s disciples had gone, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: “What did you go out to the wilderness to see? A stalk blowing in the wind?
war: Samtang naoli na an mga tinun-an ni Juan, naghimangraw hi Jesus ha mga tawo mahitungod kan Juan: “Han pagkadto niyo kan Juan didto ha kamingawan, ano man an karuyag niyo hikit-an? Usa ba nga dahon nga ginpapalidpalid han hangin?

en: What did you go out to see? A man dressed up in refined clothes? Look, those who wear refined clothes are in royal palaces.
war: Ano gud an iyo ginkadto hin pagkita? Usa ba ka tawo nga nakakasul-ot hin mahal nga panapton? Aadto pag-uokoy ha mga palasyo an mga nagpapanapton hin sugad hito!

en: What did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
war: “Sumati ako, ano gud an iyo ginkadto hin pagkita? Usa ba nga manaragna? Tinuod, nasiring ako ha iyo, hinkit-an niyo in labaw pa hin manaragna.

en: He is the one of whom it is written: Look, I’m sending my messenger before you, who will prepare your way before you .
war: Kay amo hi Juan an hinnabihan han kasuratan: ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nasiring an Dyos; ipadadara ko hiya una ha imo basi mag-andam han imo aagian.’

en: “I assure you that no one who has ever been born is greater than John the Baptist. Yet whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
war: Tigamni niyo ini! Labaw pa hi Juan nga Parabunyag hin bisan hin-o nga iginanak hin babaye, kundi labaw pa ha iya an gigugutiayi ha Ginhadian han langit.

en: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven is violently attacked as violent people seize it.
war: Tikang han pagwali ni Juan ngada yana, nahiagom na an Ginhadian han langit hin makusog nga mga pagsulong, ngan an mag-isog nga mga tawo naniniguro nga maagaw ini nira.

en: All the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John came.
war: Ngada han panahon ni Juan, naghimangraw mahitungod han Ginhadian an ngatanan nga mga manaragna ngan an Balaod ni Moises;

en: If you are willing to accept it, he is Elijah who is to come.
war: ngan kon karuyag niyo hin pagtoo han ira sumat, hi Juan amo hi Elias kanay pag-abot daan na igintagna.

en: Let the person who has ears, hear.
war: Sanglit, pamati kamo kon may niyo mga durunggan!

en: “ To what will I compare this generation? It is like a child sitting in the marketplaces calling out to others,
war: “Niyan, ano man an akon itatanding han mga tawo yana nga panahon? Sugad hira hin kabataan nga nagkakalingkod didto ha taboan. Nagoliat an usa nga hugpo ngadto han lain nga hugpo,

en: ‘We played the flute for you and you didn’t dance. We sang a funeral song and you didn’t mourn.’
war: ‘Nagtokar kami para ha iyo hin maribhong nga tokar, kundi waray may nasayaw! Nagkanta kami hin mga masulob-on nga mga awit, kundi waray kamo magtangis!’

en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
war: Han pagkanhi ni Juan, nagpuasa hiya, ngan waray uminom hin bino, ngan nagsiring an ngatanan, ‘May-ada yawa dida ha iya!’

en: Yet the Human One came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look, a glutton and a drunk, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’ But wisdom is proved to be right by her works. ”
war: Kinmanhi an Anak han Tawo ngan kinmaon ngan inminom hiya, ngan nagsiring an ngatanan, ‘Kitaa daw niyo ini nga tawo! Malamon ngan parahubog hiya, sangkay han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay!’ Kundi ginpapakita nga matuod an kinaadman han Dyos pinaagi han mga bunga hito nga mga buhat.”

en: Then he began to scold the cities where he had done his greatest miracles because they didn’t change their hearts and lives.
war: Niyan gintunglo ni Jesus an mga bungto diin ginbuhat niya an kaurog han iya mga milagro, kay waray man bumaya an mga tawo han ira mga sala.

en: “ How terrible it will be for you, Chorazin! How terrible it will be for you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles done among you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have changed their hearts and lives and put on funeral clothes and ashes a long time ago.
war: “Kairo nimo, Corasin! Kairo man liwat nimo, Betsaida! Kon an mga milagro nga ginbuhat dida ha iyo didto pa pagbuhata ha Tiro ngan ha Sidon, maiha na unta an mga tawo didto nga nagsusul-ot hin sako ngan nagsaribo hin agbon ha ira mga ulo, hin pagpakita nga binmaya na hira han ira mga sala.

en: But I say to you that Tyre and Sidon will be better off on Judgment Day than you.
war: Sanglit, hinumdomi nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, labaw pa nga malolooy an Dyos han mga tawo han Tiro ug Sidon kay ha iyo!

en: And you, Capernaum, will you be honored by being raised up to heaven? No, you will be thrown down to the place of the dead. After all, if the miracles that were done among you had been done in Sodom, it would still be here today.
war: Ngan ikaw Capernaum, karuyag mo ba nga bayawon ka ngadto ha langit? Ilalabog ka ha impyerno! Kay kon didto pa pagbuhata ha Sodoma an mga milagro nga ginbuhat dida ha imo, matindog pa unta ini nga bungto yana.

en: But I say to you that it will be better for the land of Sodom on the Judgment Day than it will be for you. ”
war: Sanglit, hinumdomi nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, labaw pa nga malolooy an Dyos han Sodoma kay ha imo!”

en: At that time Jesus said, “I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you’ve hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and have shown them to babies.
war: Hito nga panahon nagsiring hi Jesus, “O Amay, Ginoo han langit ngan han tuna! Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, kay imo iginpahayag hadton mga tapang an imo gintago ha mga mag-aram ug may-ada hibaro.

en: Indeed, Father, this brings you happiness.
war: Tinuod, Amay ko, nahimo ini tungod han imo kalugaringon nga pagbuot ug karuyag.

en: “My Father has handed all things over to me. No one knows the Son except the Father. And nobody knows the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son wants to reveal him.
war: “Iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay an ngatanan nga mga butang. Waray makilala han Anak labot han Amay, ngan waray makilala han Amay labot han Anak, ngan hadton karuyag han Anak nga magpadayag han Amay.

en: “ Come to me, all you who are struggling hard and carrying heavy loads, and I will give you rest.
war: “Kadi kamo ha akon, ngatanan kamo nga ginugul-an hin pagdara han iyo mabug-at nga mga paras-anon, ngan tatagan ta kamo hin pahuway.

en: Put on my yoke, and learn from me. I’m gentle and humble. And you will find rest for yourselves.
war: Kuhaa an akon yugo ngan ibutang dida ha iyo, ngan pagtuon kamo ha akon kay malumo ako ngan mapinaubsanon ha kasingkasing; ngan hiaagian niyo an pagpahuway.

en: My yoke is easy to bear, and my burden is light. ”
war: Kay masayon an yugo nga ihinahatag ko ha iyo, ngan magaanay an darad-on nga ipapapas-an ko ha iyo.”

en: At that time Jesus went through the wheat fields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry so they were picking heads of wheat and eating them.
war: Waray pag-iha, naglatas hi Jesus han kaumhan hin trigo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Ginutom an iya mga tinun-an, sanglit nagtikang hira pangutos han mga uhay han trigo ngan pangaon han mga tipasi.

en: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, “Look, your disciples are breaking the Sabbath law.”
war: Han pakakita hini han mga Parisiyo, nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Kitaa daw, supak ha aton Balaod an ginbubuhat han imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway!”

en: But he said to them, “ Haven’t you read what David did when he and those with him were hungry?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Waray ba kamo makabasa han ginbuhat ni David dida nga ginutom hiya ngan an iya mga kaupod?

en: He went into God’s house and broke the law by eating the bread of the presence, which only the priests were allowed to eat.
war: Sinmulod hiya han balay han Dyos ngan kinmaon hiya ngan an iya mga kaupod han tinapay nga iginhalad sa Dyos, bisan kon supak han Balaod nga mangaon hira hadto nga tinapay kay an mga padi la an tinutugotan hin pagkaon hini nga halad.

en: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple treat the Sabbath as any other day and are still innocent?
war: Waray ba niyo mabasa ha Balaod ni Moises nga ha kada iparahuway nga adlaw nagtatalapas an mga padi han Templo han balaod mahitungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kundi diri man hira nakakasala?

en: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga may-ada dinhe labaw pa han Templo.

en: If you had known what this means, I want mercy and not sacrifice , you wouldn’t have condemned the innocent.
war: Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Diri ko karuyag in mga mananap nga halad, kundi an pagkalooy.’ Kon nakasabot la kamo han karuyag sidngon hini, diri konta niyo ginhuhukman an mga tawo nga waray sala.

en: The Human One is Lord of the Sabbath. ”
war: Kay Ginoo han Adlaw nga Iparahuway an Anak han Tawo.”

en: Jesus left that place and went into their synagogue.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit ngan kinmadto hin usa nga sinagoga.

en: A man with a withered hand was there. Wanting to bring charges against Jesus, they asked, “Does the Law allow a person to heal on the Sabbath?”
war: May-ada didto tawo nga patay an usa nga kamot. May pira ka tawo didto nga karuyag nga isumbong hi Jesus nga nagbuhat hin maraot; sanglit nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Supak ba ha aton Balaod an pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”

en: Jesus replied, “ Who among you has a sheep that falls into a pit on the Sabbath and will not take hold of it and pull it out?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ano man an iyo bubuhaton kon pananglitan usa han iyo mga karnero mahulog ngadto hin hilarom nga luong ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway? Diri ba niyo kukuhaon dayon?

en: How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! So the Law allows a person to do what is good on the Sabbath. ”
war: Labaw pa ka mahal an tawo kay hin karnero! Sanglit, natugot ha aton an aton Balaod hin pagbulig bisan hin-o ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: Then Jesus said to the man, “ Stretch out your hand. ” So he did and it was made healthy, just like the other one.
war: Niyan ginsiring niya an tawo, “Unata an imo kamot.”

en: The Pharisees went out and met in order to find a way to destroy Jesus.
war: Gin-unat niya ngan naupay ito sugad han iya usa nga kamot.

en: Jesus knew what they intended to do, so he went away from there. Large crowds followed him, and he healed them all.
war: Nagkalakat an mga Parisiyo ngan nagsarabot hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: But he ordered them not to spread the word about him,
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus mahitungod hini nga maraot nga hunahuna kontra ha iya, binmaya hiya hadto nga dapit ngan sinmunod ha iya in damo nga mga tawo. Gintambal niya an ngatanan nga magsakit,

en: so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled:
war: ngan gindid-an hira hin pagsumat han iba mahitungod ha iya,

en: Look, my Servant whom I chose,
war: basi matuman an ginsiring han Dyos pinaagi kan Isaias nga manaragna:

en: the one I love, in whom I find great pleasure .
war: “Iini an akon surugoon nga akon ginpili,

en: I’ll put my Spirit upon him,
war: an akon hinigugma nga akon nalilipayan.

en: and he’ll announce judgment to the Gentiles.
war: Ibubutang ko ha iya an akon Espiritu,

en: He won’t argue or shout,
war: ngan ipapasangyaw niya an akon paghukom

en: and nobody will hear his voice in the streets.
war: ngadto han ngatanan nga mga nasod.

en: He won’t break a bent stalk,
war: Kundi diri hiya makikiglantugi o magoliat,

en: and he won’t snuff out a smoldering wick,
war: diri ngani mamumulong hin dako nga tingog

en: until he makes justice win.
war: dida ha kadalanan.

en: And the Gentiles will put their hope in his name.
war: Diri hiya magbabari hin malubay nga tangbo,

en: They brought to Jesus a demon-possessed man who was blind and unable to speak. Jesus healed him so that he could both speak and see.
war: o maghuhuyop hin tikapaparong nga lampara.

en: All the crowds were amazed and said, “This man couldn’t be the Son of David, could he?”
war: Magpapadayon hiya

en: When the Pharisees heard, they said, “This man throws out demons only by the authority of Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.”
war: tubtob nga makapadaog hiya han katadongan;

en: Because Jesus knew what they were thinking, he replied, “Every kingdom involved in civil war becomes a wasteland. Every city or house torn apart by divisions will collapse.
war: ngan paglalaoman hiya han ngatanan nga mga katawhan.”

en: If Satan throws out Satan, he is at war with himself. How then can his kingdom endure?
war: Gindara ngadto kan Jesus in usa ka tawo nga buta ngan ngula, kay sinasangkayan ini hiya hin yawa. Gintambal ni Jesus an tawo, sanglit nakayakan ngan nakakita hiya.

en: And if I throw out demons by the authority of Beelzebul, then by whose authority do your followers throw them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.
war: Nahipausa an ngatanan nga mga tawo ngan nagpakiana hira, “Amo na ba ini hiya an Anak ni David?”

en: But if I throw out demons by the power of God’s Spirit, then God’s kingdom has already overtaken you.
war: Han pakabati hini han mga Parisiyo, nagsiring hira, “Nagpapagawas hiya hin mga yawa tungod kay gintagan hiya hin gahom ni Beelsebul, an ira puno.”

en: Can people go into a house that belongs to a strong man and steal his possessions, unless they first tie up the strong man? Then they can rob his house.
war: Nahibaroan ni Jesus an ira ginhuhunahuna, ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Diri mag-iiha in nasod nga nagkakabahinbahin ngan nag-aaruaraway. Ngan mabubungkag an bungto o panimalay nga nagkakabahinbahin ngan nag-aaruaraway.

en: Whoever isn’t with me is against me, and whoever doesn’t gather with me scatters.
war: Sanglit, kon in usa nga hugpo han ginhadian ni Satanas makikig-away ha lain nga hugpo ni Satanas, tigaman ini nga nagkabahinbahin na ito, ngan diri mag-iiha, mabubungkag ito nga ginhadian.

en: “Therefore, I tell you that people will be forgiven for every sin and insult to God. But insulting the Holy Spirit won’t be forgiven.
war: Nasiring kamo nga nagpapagawas ako hin mga yawa, kay gintatagan man ako hin gahom ni Beelsebul. Kon amo ito, hin-o man an nahatag han iyo mga sakop hin gahom pagpaguwa ha ira? An iyo mga sakop an nagpapamatuod nga mga sayop kamo!

en: And whoever speaks a word against the Human One will be forgiven. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit won’t be forgiven, not in this age or in the age that is coming.
war: Diri hi Satanas, kundi an Espiritu han Dyos an nahatag ha akon hin gahom pagpaguwa han mga yawa. Tigaman ini nga inmabot na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: “ Either consider the tree good and its fruit good, or consider the tree rotten and its fruit rotten. A tree is known by its fruit.
war: “Waray makakasulod ngadto ha balay hin kusgan nga tawo hin pagkuha han iya mga butang, kon diri gaposon anay niya an tawo nga kusgan; ngan amo na an pakapanikas niya han balay.

en: Children of snakes! How can you speak good things while you are evil? What fills the heart comes out of the mouth.
war: “An diri nauyon ha akon, nasupak ha akon; ngan nagpapasarang adton diri nabulig ha akon hin pagtirok.

en: Good people bring out good things from their good treasure. But evil people bring out evil things from their evil treasure.

en: When Jesus heard about John, he withdrew in a boat to a deserted place by himself. When the crowds learned this, they followed him on foot from the cities.
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga ginpatay hi Juan, binmaya hiya ngadto nga dapit, ngan nagsakay hiya. Kinmadto hiya nga waray niya upod, hin dapit nga mamingaw. Hinbaroan ini han mga tawo. Binayaan nira an ira mga bungto, ngan nagbaktas hira hin pagsunod ha iya.

en: When Jesus arrived and saw a large crowd, he had compassion for them and healed those who were sick.
war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus han sakayan hinkit-an niya an kadam-an nga mga tawo, ngan inalpan hiya hin dako nga kalooy ha ira, ngan gintambal niya an ira mga magsakit.

en: That evening his disciples came and said to him, “This is an isolated place and it’s getting late. Send the crowds away so they can go into the villages and buy food for themselves.”
war: Hadto ngahaw nga kulop, dinmaop ha iya an mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Tikasirom na, ngan tay-aw ini nga dapit. Palakta na an mga tawo ngan pakadtoa hira ha mga kabaryohan, basi makapalit hira hin pagkaon.”

en: But Jesus said to them, “ There’s no need to send them away. You give them something to eat. ”
war: “Diri kinahanglan nga magkalakat hira,” binmaton hi Jesus. “Hi kamo ngahaw in pagpakaon ha ira.”

en: They replied, “We have nothing here except five loaves of bread and two fish.”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Lilima la ka bug-os an aton tinapay ngan duduha an isda.”

en: He said, “ Bring them here to me. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Dad-a niyo ngadi.”

en: He ordered the crowds to sit down on the grass. He took the five loaves of bread and the two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them and broke the loaves apart and gave them to his disciples. Then the disciples gave them to the crowds.
war: Pinapanlingkod niya an mga tawo ha kabanwaan; kinuha niya an lima nga tinapay ngan duha nga isda, ngan hinmanggad hiya ha langit pagpasalamat han Dyos. Ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha mga tinun-an, ngan igindorot ini ngadto han mga tawo.

en: Everyone ate until they were full, and they filled twelve baskets with the leftovers.
war: Nangaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog. Katapos, gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga salin nga nakapuno hin dose ka alat.

en: About five thousand men plus women and children had eaten.
war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon, labot han kababayen-an ngan han kabataan.

en: Right then, Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side of the lake while he dismissed the crowds.
war: Niyan ginpasakay hin sakayan ni Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan ginpauna niya ngadto ha tabok han lanaw, samtang ginpalakat niya an mga tawo.

en: When he sent them away, he went up onto a mountain by himself to pray. Evening came and he was alone.
war: Kahuman niya palakta an mga tawo, sinmagka hiya hin bukid nga usa la hiya, basi hiya mag-ampo. Han pagkagab-i na nag-usaan la didto hi Jesus.

en: Meanwhile, the boat, fighting a strong headwind, was being battered by the waves and was already far away from land.
war: Hini nga takna nakadto na an sakayan ha lawod, gindadasmagan han mga balod kay sungsong adto han hangin.

en: Very early in the morning he came to his disciples, walking on the lake.
war: Ha may mga alas tres ngadto ha alas seis na han kaagahon kinmadto ha ira hi Jesus nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig.

en: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified and said, “It’s a ghost!” They were so frightened they screamed.
war: Han pakakita han mga tinun-an ha iya nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig, duro an ira kahadlok. “Iini in murto,” nagsiring hira, ngan ginmoliat hira tungod hin kahadlok.

en: Just then Jesus spoke to them, “ Be encouraged! It’s me. Don’t be afraid. ”
war: Nagyakan dayon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Ako gad ini!”

en: Peter replied, “Lord, if it’s you, order me to come to you on the water.”
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kon tinuod nga ikaw, palakata man ako ha bawbaw han tubig ngada ha imo.”

en: And Jesus said, “ Come. ”
war: “Pakadi!” binmaton hi Jesus. Sanglit hinmaw-as hi Pedro han sakayan ngan nagtikang hin paglakat ha bawbaw han tubig ngadto kan Jesus.

en: Then Peter got out of the boat and was walking on the water toward Jesus.
war: Kundi han pakasabot niya nga makusog an hangin, nahadlok hiya ngan nagtikang hiya hin paglunod. “Tabagi ako, Ginoo!” ginmoliat hiya.

en: But when Peter saw the strong wind, he became frightened. As he began to sink, he shouted, “Lord, rescue me!”
war: Kinaptan ngan binutong hiya dayon ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Pagkagutiay han imo pagtoo! Kay ano nga nagruhaduha ka?”

en: Jesus immediately reached out and grabbed him, saying, “ You man of weak faith! Why did you begin to have doubts? ”
war: Sinmakay hira han sakayan ngan hinmugpoy an hangin.

en: When they got into the boat, the wind settled down.
war: Nagsingba kan Jesus an mga tinun-an nga nakada han sakayan ngan nagsiring hira, “Matuod gud nga ikaw amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: Then those in the boat worshipped Jesus and said, “You must be God’s Son!”
war: Tinmabok hira han lanaw ngan inmabot ha Genesaret,

en: When they had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret.
war: diin kinmilala kan Jesus an mga tawo. Sanglit iginpakuha nira an mga magsakit didto hito nga katunaan ngan gindara nira ngadto kan Jesus.

en: When the people who lived in that place recognized him, they sent word throughout that whole region, and they brought to him everyone who was sick.
war: Nakimalooy hira ha iya nga tugotan niya an mga magsakit hin pagkapot bisan na manla han sidsid han iya bado; ngan nagkauupay an ngatanan nga nakakapot.

en: Then Pharisees and legal experts came to Jesus from Jerusalem and said,
war: Niyan dinmaop kan Jesus in mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tikang ha Jerusalem, ngan nagpakiana ha iya:

en: “Why are your disciples breaking the elders’ rules handed down to us? They don’t ritually purify their hands by washing before they eat.”
war: “Kay ano nga diri nagtutuman an imo mga tinun-an han pagturon-an nga igintutdo han aton mga kaapoy-apoyan? Diri anay hira nanhuhunaw han angay nga paagi nga diri pa hira nakaon!”

en: Jesus replied, “ Why do you break the command of God by keeping the rules handed down to you?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kay ano man liwat nga diri niyo ginsusugot an sugo han Dyos, kundi asay lugod niyo ginsusunod an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an?

en: For God said, Honor your father and your mother, and The person who speaks against father or mother will certainly be put to death .
war: Kay nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Tahora an amay ngan an iroy niyo,’ ngan ‘Kinahanglan patayon adton nagpapakaraot han amay o iroy niya.’

en: But you say, ‘If you tell your father or mother, “ Everything I’m expected to contribute to you I’m giving to God as a gift, ” then you don’t have to honor your father.’
war: Kundi nagtututdo kamo nga kon in tawo may-ada niya sadang magamit hin pagbulig han amay o iroy niya, kundi kon sumiring ha ira, ‘Kanan Dyos na ini,’

en: So you do away with God’s Law for the sake of the rules that have been handed down to you.
war: diri na kinahanglan tumahod pa hiya han iya kag-anak. Amo ini an paagi han pagsalikway niyo han pulong han Dyos basi la niyo pagsundon an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an.

en: Hypocrites! Isaiah really knew what he was talking about when he prophesied about you,
war: Mga salingkapaw kamo! Waray gud pagsayop an igintagna ni Isaias mahitungod ha iyo!

en: This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far away from me.
war: ‘Gintatahod ako hini nga katawhan

en: Their worship of me is empty since they teach instructions that are human rules . ”
war: pinaagi han ira la mga pulong, nasiring an Dyos,

en: Jesus called the crowd near and said to them, “ Listen and understand.
war: kundi hirayo ha akon an ira kasingkasing.

en: It’s not what goes into the mouth that contaminates a person in God’s sight. It’s what comes out of the mouth that contaminates the person. ”
war: Kawang la an pagsingba nira ha akon,

en: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended by what you just said?”
war: kay nagtututdo hira

en: Jesus replied, “ Every plant that my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be pulled up.
war: hin mga hinimo la hin tawo

en: Leave the Pharisees alone. They are blind people who are guides to blind people. But if a blind person leads another blind person, they will both fall into a ditch. ”
war: nga mga turumanon sugad nga akon mga sugo!’”

en: Then Peter spoke up, “Explain this riddle to us.”
war: Niyan gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo ngan ginsiring hira: “Pamati, ngan sabota niyo!

en: Jesus said, “ Don’t you understand yet?
war: Diri an nasulod ha baba han tawo an nakakahugaw ha iya; an nagawas lugod ha baba an nakakahugaw ha iya.”

en: Don’t you know that everything that goes into the mouth enters the stomach and goes out into the sewer?
war: Niyan hinmarani ha iya an mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Maaram ka ba nga napungot an mga Parisiyo han imo iginyakan?”

en: But what goes out of the mouth comes from the heart. And that’s what contaminates a person in God’s sight.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Gagaboton an tagsa nga tanom nga waray igtanom han akon Amay ha langit.

en: Out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adultery, sexual sins, thefts, false testimonies, and insults.
