en: This is the duty of the Merarite clans for all their work in the meeting tent under the supervision of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
war: Amo ini an mga katungdanan han banay ni Merari ha ira pag-alagad didto han Tulda; bubuhaton ini nira ha ubos han pagmando ni Itamar nga anak ni Aaron nga Padi.

en: So Moses, Aaron, and the chiefs of the community enrolled the Kohathites by their clans and their households,
war: 34-48 Ha pagsunod han sugo han Ginoo , gin-ihap nira Moises, Aaron, ngan mga pangulo han bungto, an tulo nga mga banay nga Levita nira Coat, Gerson, ug Merari. Ginbuhat nira ini pinaagi hin gurugudti nga mga banay ngan pinaagi hin mga panimalay, ngan iginlista nira an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an nga 30 ngadto ha 50 an panuigon nga angay magtrabaho didto han Tulda han Ginoo , sumala han masunod:

en: those from 30 to 50 years old who were eligible for work in the meeting tent.
war: Hugpo hin mga Panimalay

en: Their enrollment by their clans was 2,750.
war: Kadamo

en: These are the enrolled of the Kohathite clans, all who worked in the meeting tent and whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORD ’s command through Moses.
war: Coat

en: The enrollment of the Gershonites by their clans and their households,
those 30 to 50 years old who were eligible for work in the meeting tent:
war: Gerson

en: their enrollment by their clans and their households was 2,630.
These are the enrolled of the Gershonite clans, all who worked in the meeting tent, and whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORD ’s command.
war: Merari

en: The enrollment of the Merarite clans by their clans and their households,
those 30 to 50 years old who were eligible for work in the meeting tent:
war: Total:

en: their enrollment by their clans was 3,200.
These are the enrolled of the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORD ’s command through Moses.
war: Iginlista an kada tawo sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises; ngan ha pagsugo han Ginoo pinaagi kan Moises, gintagan an kada tawo han iya buruhaton hin pag-alagad o pagdara.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Command the Israelites to send out from the camp anyone with a skin disease, an oozing discharge, or who has become unclean from contact with a corpse.
war: “Sugoa an mga tawo han Israel nga pagawson nira ha kampo an ngatanan nga may sakit nga sanla o may nagaawas ha lawas, ngan an ngatanan nga maghugaw pinaagi hin pakakapot hin minatay.

en: You must send out both male and female. You must send them outside the camp so that they will not make their camp, where I live among them, unclean.
war: Igawas ini ngatanan nga mga tawo nga maghugaw sumala han seremonyas basi diri hira makahugaw han kampo diin nag-uokoy ako tampo han akon mga tawo.”

en: The Israelites did so and sent them outside the camp. The Israelites did just what the LORD said to Moses.
war: Nagsugot an mga Israelita ngan ginpaiwas ha kampo hira ngatanan nga mahugaw.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Iginhatag han Ginoo kan Moises

en: Tell the Israelites: When a man or a woman commits any sin against anyone else, thus breaking faith with the LORD , that person becomes guilty.
war: an masunod nga mga tugon para han mga tawo han Israel. Kon may-ada diri matinumanon han Ginoo ngan makasayop hiya kontra hin iba nga tawo,

en: Such persons will confess the sin they have done. Each will make payment for his guilt, add one-fifth more, and give it to the injured party.
war: kinahanglan igkompisal niya an iya sala ngan pagbaydan han ngatanan an tawo nga iya nasal-an upod in dugang nga 20 por syento.

en: If the person has no close relative to whom the payment can be made, then the compensation payment will go to the LORD for the priest. This is in addition to the ram of reconciliation by which the guilty party himself is reconciled.
war: Kundi kon namatay na adto nga tawo ngan waray niya suok nga urupod nga sadang pagbaydan, ihahatag ini ngadto han Ginoo para han padi. Dugang ini nga bayad han karnero nga lalaki nga ginagamit han seremonyas hin paglinis para han tawo nga salaan.

en: Any gift offering from all the sacred donations that the Israelites offer will be the property of the priest.
war: An tagsa liwat nga linain nga amot nga iginhahalad han mga Israelita ngadto han Ginoo kanan padi na nga ira tinatagan hini nga halad.

en: The sacred donations belong to each person alone; whatever anyone gives to the priest will be his.
war: Hihiposon han tagsa nga padi an mga halad nga ihinahatag ha iya.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Ginsugo han Ginoo hi Moises

en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: A man may suspect that his wife has had an affair and has broken faith with him,
war: 12-14 hin paghatag han mga Israelita han masunod nga mga tugon. Mahinanabo nga in usa nga bana magtahap han iya asawa nga naglilingo ha iya ngan naghugaw ha iya ngahaw ini nga babaye pinaagi hin pakighilawas hin iba nga lalake. Kundi diri nakakasiguro an bana kay bangin gintago ini han iya asawa—waray man testigo ngan waray man hiya hidakpi nga nagbubuhat hini. O mahinanabo nga in usa nga bana magtahap han iya asawa bisan kon waray maglingo ha iya an iya asawa.

en: that a man has had intercourse with her unknown to her husband and that she has defiled herself in secret—even though there are no witnesses and she isn’t caught.
war: Bisan hain hini nga duha nga kaso, dadad-on han bana an iya asawa ngadto han padi. Dadad-on liwat niya an kinahanglan nga halad nga usa ka kilo nga harina nga sebada, kundi diri niya iipisan ini hin lana hin olibo o bubutangan hin insyenso, kay halad ini hin usa nga nagtatahap nga bana, nga ginhihimo basi mahisabotan an kamatuoran.

en: If jealousy overcomes him and he is jealous of his wife who has defiled herself, or if jealousy overcomes him and he is jealous of his wife who hasn’t defiled herself,
war: Pakakadaon han padi ha iya atubangan an babaye ngan patitindogon hiya ha atubangan han altar.

en: then the man will bring his wife to the priest. He will bring the offering required for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He will not pour oil on it, nor offer frankincense with it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a grain offering for recognition in order to recognize guilt.
war: Maipis an padi hin baraan nga tubig ngadto hin kalot nga surudlan ngan makuha hin gutiay nga tuna nga aada han salog han Tulda han Ginoo , ngan ibubutang ini dida han tubig.

en: The priest will bring her close and make her stand before the LORD .
war: Niyan babadbaron niya an tinalanay nga buhok han babaye ngan igbubutang ha kamot han babaye an harina nga halad. Kakaptan han padi an surudlan nga may mapait nga tubig nga nagdadara hin maldesyon.

en: The priest will take holy water in a clay jar, and taking dust from the floor of the dwelling, the priest will place it in the water.
war: Niyan papapagsumpaon han padi an babaye hini nga sumpa nga ginyayakan han padi: “Kon waray lalake nga nakighilawas ha imo o waray ka maghugaw han imo kalugaringon, diri ka unta dudultan han gahom nga nagdadara hin maldesyon.

en: The priest will make the woman stand before the LORD , let the hair of the woman hang down, and place the grain offering for recognition, that is, the grain offering for jealousy, in her hands. The water of bitterness that brings the curse will be in the hands of the priest.
war: Kundi kon naglingo ka han imo bana o naghugaw pinaagi hin pakighilawas hin iba nga lalake,

en: Then the priest will make her swear a solemn pledge, saying to the woman, “If no man has slept with you and if you haven’t had an affair, becoming defiled while married to your husband, then be immune from the water of bitterness that brings these curses.
war: maldesyonon ka unta han Ginoo ha butnga han imo mga tawo. Kumopos unta an imo ikinatawo ngan dumako an imo tiyan.

en: But if you have had an affair while married to your husband, if you have defiled yourself, and a man other than your husband has had intercourse with you”—
war: Sumulod unta ha imo tiyan ini nga tubig ngan padakoon hini an imo tiyan ngan pakupson an imo ikinatawo.”

en: then the priest must make the woman utter the curse and say to the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and a harmful pledge among your people, when the LORD induces a miscarriage and your womb discharges.
war: Mabaton an babaye, “Nauyon ako; matuman unta an siring han Ginoo .”

en: And may the water that brings these curses enter your stomach and make your womb discharge and make you miscarry.”
war: Niyan igsusurat han padi ini nga maldesyon ngan paparaon an sinurat pinaagi hin paghulos hini han tubig nga mapait.

en: And the woman will say, “I agree, I agree.”
war: Ha diri pa niya paiimnon han tubig an babaye, nga bangin makapasakit hin duro ha iya,

en: The priest will write these curses in the scroll and wipe them off into the water of bitterness.
war: kukuhaon han padi an halad nga harina tikang han mga kamot han babaye, aalsahon ini ha paghalad ngadto han Ginoo , ngan ighahalad ini dida han altar.

en: Then he will make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings the curse. And the water that brings the curse will enter her, causing bitterness.
war: Niyan makuha hiya hin usa ka harop hini sugad nga usa nga halad nga hinumdoman ngan susunogon ini dida han altar. Ha kataposan, paiimnon niya han tubig an babaye.

en: The priest will take the grain offering for jealousy from the woman’s hands, elevate the grain offering before the LORD , and bring it to the altar.
war: Kon tinuod nga nakapanlibog hiya, mahatag hin duro nga kasakit an tubig; madako an iya tiyan ngan makupos an iya ikinatawo. Mahihimo nga maldesyon an iya ngaran dida han iya mga tawo.

en: The priest will take a handful of the grain offering as a token part of it and turn it into smoke on the altar. And afterward he will make the woman drink the water.
war: Kundi kon diri hiya salaan, diri hiya madadaot ngan mag-aanak pa hiya.

en: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and has broken faith with her husband, then the water that brings the curse will enter her, causing bitterness, and her womb will discharge and she will miscarry. The woman will be a curse among her people.
war: 29-30 Amo ini an balaod kon nangangabugho in usa nga lalake ngan magtahap hiya nga nakapanlibog an iya asawa. Patitindogon an babaye ha atubangan han altar, ngan bubuhaton han padi ini nga seremonyas.

en: But if the woman hasn’t defiled herself and she is pure, then she will be immune and able to conceive.
war: Matatalwas hin sala an bana, kundi kon salaan an babaye kinahanglan mag-antos hiya han mga bunga han iya pagtalapas.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Ginsugo han Ginoo hi Moises,

en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: If a man or a woman makes a binding promise to be a nazirite in order to be dedicated to the LORD ,
war: hin paghatag han masunod nga mga tugon ngadto han mga tawo han Israel. Bisan hin-o nga lalake o babaye nga maghimo hin usa nga linain nga sumpa hin pagka Nazarita ngan maghalad han iya kinabuhi ngadto han Ginoo ,

en: that person must refrain from wine and brandy. He or she may not drink wine vinegar or brandy vinegar, nor drink any grape juice or eat grapes, whether fresh or dried.
war: kinahanglan diri hiya uminom hin bino o makahurubog nga irimnon. Diri hiya uminom hin bisan ano nga irimnon nga hinimo hin ubas o kumaon hin mga ubas o mga pasas.

en: While a nazirite, the person may not eat anything produced from the grapevine, not even its seeds or skin.
war: Samtang nga Nazarita pa hiya, diri hiya makaon hin bisan ano nga natikang hin ubas, diri ngani hin mga liso o mga parot hin mga ubas.

en: For the term of the nazirite promise, no razor may be used on the head until the period of dedication to the LORD is fulfilled. The person is to be holy, letting his or her hair grow untrimmed.
war: Samtang aada pa hiya ha ilarom han sumpa han pagka Nazarita, kinahanglan diri hiya magpaarot o magbarbas. Hinihigtan hiya han sumpa sulod han bug-os nga panahon nga iginhalad hiya ngadto han Ginoo , ngan patutuboon niya an iya buhok ug bungot.

en: The period of dedication to the LORD also requires that the person not go near a corpse,
war: 6-7 An iya buhok amo an tigaman han iya paghalad ngadto sa Dyos, sanglit kinahanglan diri hiya maghuhugaw ha iya ngahaw pinaagi hin paghirani hin patay nga lawas, bisan pa ito kanan iya amay, iroy, bugto nga lalake, o bugto nga babaye.

en: whether father, mother, brother, or sister. Nazirites should not defile themselves because of the death of these people, because they bear the sign of their dedication to God on their heads.
war: Samtang Nazarita pa hiya, iginhalad hiya ngadto han Ginoo .

en: While a nazirite, the person is holy to the LORD .
war: Kon mahugawan an iginhalad nga buhok hin Nazarita kay nakasapit hiya hin tawo nga tigda la nga namatay, kinahanglan humulat hiya hin pito ka adlaw ngan onina magkiskis hiya han iya buhok ngan magtosan han iya bungot; ngan magmamalinis na hiya sumala han seremonyas.

en: If someone suddenly dies nearby, defiling the head of the nazirite, he or she will shave the head on the day of cleansing; they will shave it on the seventh day.
war: Dida han ikawalo ka adlaw dadad-on niya in duha nga sarapati o duha nga tukmo ngadto han padi dida han agian han Tulda han Ginoo .

en: On the eighth day the person will bring two turtledoves or two young doves to the priest at the entrance of the meeting tent.
war: Ighahalad han padi an usa nga usa nga halad tungod hin sala ngan an ikaduha, nga usa nga halad nga tutuboron, hin pagbuhat han seremonyas han paglinis para ha iya tungod han iya pakahirani hin patay nga lawas. Dida han amo manta nga adlaw ootrohon hin paghalad han tawo an iya buhok,

en: The priest will offer one for a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering. He will seek reconciliation for the person on account of the guilt acquired from the corpse, and he will make the head holy again on that same day.
war: ngan magtutuman na liwat hiya han iya panaad hin ka Nazarita ngadto han Ginoo . Waray gamit an una nga panaad kay nahugawan man an iya buhok nga iginhalad. Sugad nga usa nga bayad nga halad hin paglukat, magdadara hiya hin usa nga nati nga karnero nga usa ka tuig an panuigon.

en: The person will be rededicated to the LORD as a nazirite and bring a one-year-old male lamb for a compensation offering. The previous period will be invalid, because the nazirite promise was defiled.
war: Kon nakatuman na han iya saad in usa nga Nazarita, bubuhaton niya an seremonyas. Makadto hiya ha agian han Tulda,

en: This is the Instruction for the nazirite. When the term as a nazirite is completed, the person will be brought to the entrance of the meeting tent
war: ngan ighahalad niya ngadto han Ginoo in tulo nga mga hayop nga waray mga dum-it: usa nga nati nga karnero nga lalaki nga usa ka tuig an panuigon para hin usa nga halad nga tutuboron; usa nga nati nga karnero nga babayi nga usa ka tuig an panuigon para hin usa nga halad tungod hin sala, ngan hin usa nga karnero nga lalaki para hin usa nga halad hin pagkaurosa.

en: and offer a gift to the LORD , consisting of a flawless one-year-old male lamb as an entirely burned offering, a flawless one-year-old female lamb as a purification offering, one flawless ram as a well-being sacrifice,
war: Ighahalad liwat niya in usa ka basket nga tinapay nga waray patubo: magdakmol nga mga tinapay nga hinimo hin harina nga sinaktan hin lana hin olibo, ngan dugang hini an ginkikinahanglan nga mga halad nga pagkaon ug bino.

en: and a basket of loaves of unleavened bread made with fine flour and mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, along with their grain offering and their drink offering.
war: Pagdadad-on han padi ini ngatanan ngadto han Ginoo ngan ighahalad niya an halad tungod hin sala ngan an halad nga tutuboron.

en: The priest will come close to the LORD and offer the purification and entirely burned offerings.
war: Ighahalad niya ngadto han Ginoo an karnero nga lalaki nga usa nga halad hin pagkaurosa ngan ighahalad ini upod an basket hin tinapay; ighahalad liwat niya an mga halad nga pagkaon ug bino.

en: The ram he will offer as a well-being sacrifice to the LORD with the basket of unleavened bread; then the priest will offer the grain offering and the drink offering.
war: Dida han agian han Tulda pagkikiskisan han Nazarita an iya ulo ngan pagsusunogon an buhok didto han dapit nga ginsusunogan han halad hin pagkaurosa.

en: The nazirite will shave his ordained head at the meeting tent’s entrance, take the hair from his ordained head, and put it in the fire under the well-being sacrifice.
war: Niyan, kon laga na an sugbong han karnero nga lalaki, kukuhaon ini han padi ngan igbubutang ini dida han mga kamot han Nazarita upod in usa nga madakmol nga tinapay ngan usa nga manipis nga torta nga kinuha dida han basket.

en: The priest will take the shoulder from the ram after it is boiled, one piece of unleavened bread from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and place them in the hands of the nazirite after the ordained head is shaved.
war: Sunod, ighahalad ini han padi nga usa nga linain nga regalo ngadto han Ginoo ; usa ini nga baraan nga halad para han padi, nga dugang han dughan ngan han paa han karnero nga lalaki nga kanan padi na sumala han balaod. Katapos hini nga seremonyas, makakainom na hin bino an Nazarita.

en: Then the priest will raise them as an uplifted offering before the LORD ; they are holy to the priest, with the breast of the uplifted offering and the thigh of the gift offering. After this the nazirite may drink wine.
war: Amo ini an mga turumanon para hin mga Nazarita; kundi kon magsaad in usa nga Nazarita hin halad nga lapos na han ginkikinahanglan han panaad nga iya ighahatag, kinahanglan pagtumanon gud niya an iya iginsaad.

en: This is the instruction for the nazirite who takes the solemn promise. That person’s offering to the LORD will be in accordance with the nazirite promise, in addition to whatever else the person may have offered. The person must do just as they have promised, in adherence with the nazirite promise.
war: Ginsugo han Ginoo hi Moises

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: hin pagsumat kan Aaron ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga gamiton an masunod nga mga pulong ha pagbendisyon han mga tawo han Israel:

en: Tell Aaron and his sons: You will bless the Israelites as follows. Say to them:
war: Bendisyonan ngan mangnoan unta kamo han Ginoo ;

en: The LORD bless you and protect you.
war: Magmaloloy-on ngan magmahigugmaon unta ha iyo an Ginoo ;

en: The LORD make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.
war: Magmaloloy-on unta ha iyo an Ginoo ngan ihatag unta ha iyo an kamurayaw.

en: The LORD lift up his face to you and grant you peace.
war: Ngan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Kon gamiton nira an akon ngaran nga usa nga bendisyon para han mga tawo han Israel, bebendisyonan ko hira.”

en: On the day when Moses finished setting up the dwelling, he anointed and made it holy. All its equipment, as well as the altar and all its equipment, he also anointed and made holy.
war: Dida han adlaw han kahuman ni Moises pagtindog han Tulda han Ginoo , gindihogan ngan iginhalad niya an Tulda ngan an ngatanan nga mga kasangkapan hini, ngan an altar ngan an ngatanan nga mga kasangkapan han altar.

en: The chiefs of Israel, the leaders of their households, made their presentations. They were the tribal chiefs and those who were in charge of the enlistment.
war: 2-3 Niyan gindara han mga puno han mga banay, nga mga pangulo han mga tribo han Israel, nga amo ngahaw an mga tawo nga tinaporan han pag-ihap, an ira mga halad ngadto han Ginoo : unom nga mga karomata ngan dose nga mga baka, usa nga karomata para han kada duha nga pangulo, ngan usa nga baka para han kada usa nga pangulo. Katapos nira ighalad ini,

en: They brought their offerings before the LORD : six covered wagons and twelve oxen—a wagon for every two chiefs, and an ox for every chief. They brought them near before the dwelling.
war: nagsiring an Ginoo kan Moises,

en: The LORD said to Moses:
war: “Karawata ini nga mga regalo basi gamiton para han buruhaton dida han Tulda; ighatag ini ngadto han mga Levita, sumala han buruhaton nga ira pagtutumanon.”

en: Take these from them and use them for service in the meeting tent. Give them to the Levites according to their duties.
war: Sanglit iginhatag ni Moises an mga karomata ngan an mga baka ngadto han mga Levita.

en: So Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and he gave them to the Levites.
war: Iginhatag niya in duha nga karomata ngan upat nga mga baka ngadto han mga anak ni Gerson,

en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the Gershonites for their duty.
war: ngan upat nga mga karomata ngan walo nga mga baka ngadto han mga anak ni Merari. Pagtutumanon an ngatanan nira nga buruhaton ha ubos han pagmando ni Itamar nga anak ni Aaron.

en: Four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the Merarites for their duty under the supervision of Ithamar, Aaron the priest’s son.
war: Kundi waray tagi ni Moises hin mga karomata o mga baka an mga anak ni Coat, kay hira man an magdadara han baraan nga mga butang nga ira ginmamangnoan.

en: But to the Kohathites he gave nothing because their duty concerned the holy things that had to be carried on the shoulders.
war: Nagdara liwat an mga pangulo hin mga regalo para hin pagsaurog han paghalad han altar. Han andam na hira hin paghalad han ira mga regalo dida ha altar,

en: The chiefs made their presentations for the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed. The chiefs presented their offerings before the altar.
war: nagsiring an Ginoo kan Moises, “Sumati an tagsa ha ira nga ha kada adlaw, sulod hin dose ka adlaw, magdadara han iya mga regalo in usa han mga pangulo para han paghalad han altar.”

en: The LORD said to Moses: One chief per day will present their offering for the dedication of the altar.
war: 12-83 Iginhalad nira an mga halad dida hini nga pagkasunodsunod:

en: The one presenting his offering on the first day was Nahshon, Amminadab’s son, from the tribe of Judah.
war: Adlaw

en: His offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
war: Tribo

en: one gold bowl weighing ten shekels full of incense;
war: Pangulo

en: one bull from the herd, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering;
war: Syahan

en: one male goat for a purification offering;
war: Juda

en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon, Amminadab’s son.
war: Hi Naason nga anak ni Aminadab

en: On the second day Nethanel, Zuar’s son, the chief of Issachar, presented his offering.
war: Ikaduha

en: He presented as his offering one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
war: Isacar

en: one gold bowl weighing ten shekels full of incense;
war: Hi Natanael nga anak ni Zuar

en: one bull from the herd, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering;
war: Ikatulo

en: one male goat for a purification offering;
war: Zabulon

en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel, Zuar’s son.
war: Hi Eliab nga anak ni Helon

en: On the third day Zebulun’s Chief Eliab, Helon’s son:
war: Ikaupat

en: his offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
war: Ruben

en: one gold bowl weighing ten shekels full of incense;
war: Hi Elizur nga anak ni Sedeur

en: one bull from the herd, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering;
war: Ikalima

en: one male goat for a purification offering;
war: Simeon

en: and for the well-being sacrifice, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab, Helon’s son.
war: Hi Selumiel nga anak ni Zurisadai

en: On the fourth day Reuben’s Chief Elizur, Shedeur’s son:
war: Ikaunom

en: his offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
war: Gad

war: Han pagsulod ni Moises han Tulda hin pakighimangraw han Ginoo , hinbatian niya in tingog nga nagyayakan ha iya tikang ha igbaw han takop han Kahon han Ginsaaran, ha butnga han duha nga mga kerubin.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you set them up, the seven lamps will give light in front of the lampstand.
war: “Sidnga hi Aaron nga kon magbutang hiya han pito nga mga lampara dida han kandilero, kinahanglan nga an pito nga mga lampara makalamrag han atubangan han kandilero.”

en: Aaron did so. He set up its lamps in front of the lampstand as the LORD commanded Moses.
war: Gintuman hi Aaron ngan iginbutang an mga lampara nga makalamrag han atubangan han kandilero.

en: This is how the lampstand was made: it was hammered gold; from its base to its flower it was hammered. Moses made the lampstand according to the vision that the LORD had shown Moses.
war: Hinimo an kandilero hin pinilpig nga bulawan tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos, sumala han surubdan nga iginpakita han Ginoo kan Moises.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Separate the Levites from the Israelites and cleanse them.
war: “Laina an mga Levita tikang han iba nga mga tawo han Israel ngan linisi hira

en: This is what you will do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purification on them, have them shave their bodies, wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
war: dida hinin masunod nga paagi: warikwiki hira han tubig hin paglinis ngan patosari ha ira an ira bug-os nga lawas ngan palabhi ha ira an ira mga panapton. Ngan magmamalinis hira sumala han seremonyas.

en: They will take a bull from the herd, with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil. You will take a second bull from the herd for a purification offering.
war: Niyan magdadara hira hin nati nga baka nga lalaki ngan hin harina nga sinaktan hin lana hin olibo nga ginkikinahanglan nga halad nga pagkaon; ngan makuha ka hin lain nga baka nga lalaki para han halad tungod hin sala.

en: You will bring the Levites before the meeting tent and gather the entire Israelite community.
war: Niyan pagtiroka an bug-os nga bungto han Israel ngan patindoga an mga Levita ha atubangan han akon Tulda.

en: Then you will bring the Levites into the LORD ’s presence, and the Israelites will lay their hands on the Levites.
war: Igpapandong han mga tawo han Israel an ira mga kamot dida han mga ulo han mga Levita,

en: Aaron will present the Levites as an uplifted offering in the LORD ’s presence from the Israelites so that they may do the LORD ’s service.
war: ngan onina ighahalad ha akon ni Aaron an mga Levita nga usa nga linain nga regalo tikang han mga Israelita, basi magtuman hira han akon buruhaton.

en: Then the Levites will lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and Aaron will offer one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering to the LORD in order to seek reconciliation for the Levites.
war: Niyan igpapandong han mga Levita an ira mga kamot dida han mga ulo han duha nga mga todo nga baka; ighahalad an usa nga halad tungod hin sala ngan an ikaduha, nga usa nga halad nga tutuboron, basi pagbuhaton an seremonyas hin paglinis para han mga Levita.

en: You will have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and you will present them as an uplifted offering to the LORD .
war: “Ighalad an mga Levita nga usa nga linain nga regalo ha akon, ngan igbutang hira Aaron ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga tinaporan ha ira.

en: You will separate the Levites from the Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.
war: Laina an mga Levita hin sugad hini nga paagi tikang han iba nga mga Israelita, basi maakon na hira.

en: The Levites will enter to serve the meeting tent, after you have cleansed them and presented them as an uplifted offering.
war: Katapos mo paglinisi ngan ighalad an mga Levita, makakagtrabaho na hira didto han Tulda.

en: They are given over to me from the Israelites in place of all the newborn, the oldest of all the Israelites. I take them for myself.
war: Gin-angkon ko na hira nga liwan han ngatanan nga suhag nga kalalaken-an han mga Israelita, ngan ako la an tag-iya ha ira.

en: Every oldest male among the Israelites is mine, whether human or animal. When I killed all the oldest males in the land of Egypt, I dedicated them to myself.
war: Han pamataya ko han ngatanan nga suhag didto ha Ehipto, iginhalad ko nga akon kalugaringon an suhag nga lalake han kada panimalay nga Israelita ngan an suhag han tagsa nga mananap.

en: I have taken the Levites in place of all the oldest among the Israelites.
war: Kinukuha ko na yana an mga Levita nga liwan han ngatanan nga mga suhag han mga Israelita,

en: I have selected the Levites from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons to perform the service of the Israelites in the meeting tent and to seek reconciliation for the Israelites so that there will not be a plague when the Israelites approach the sanctuary.
war: ngan akon itinutubyan an mga Levita ngadto kan Aaron ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an, nga usa nga regalo tikang han mga Israelita, hin pag-alagad dida han Tulda para han mga tawo han Israel ngan hin pagpanalipod han mga Israelita tikang han karat-an nga mahampak ha ira kon dumuok hira han Baraan nga Dapit.”

en: Moses, Aaron, and the entire Israelite community carried out for the Levites everything the LORD had commanded Moses. That is what the Israelites did for the Levites.
war: Sanglit iginhalad an mga Levita nira Moises, Aaron ngan han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel, sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises.

en: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Aaron presented them as an uplifted offering in the LORD ’s presence, and he sought reconciliation for them in order to cleanse them.
war: Naglinis ha ira ngahaw an mga Levita ngan naglaba han ira mga panapton, ngan iginhalad hira ni Aaron nga usa nga linain nga regalo ngadto han Ginoo . Ginbuhat liwat niya para ha ira an seremonyas hin paglinis.

en: After this the Levites went in to perform their service in the meeting tent before Aaron and his sons. They did for the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning them.
war: Ginbuhat han mga tawo an ngatanan nga iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises hiunong han mga Levita. Sanglit nakag-alagad na an mga Levita didto ha sakob han Tulda ha ubos ni Aaron ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: This rule applies to the Levites: Everyone 25 years old and above will enter into service, performing the duties for the meeting tent.
war: “Tikang ha panuigon nga 25 magbubuhat an tagsa nga Levita han iya mga katungdanan didto han akon Tulda,

en: At 50 years old each will retire from service. They will perform their duties no longer.
war: ngan ha panuigon nga 50 maukoy na hiya hin pag-alagad didto han Tulda.

en: Each may assist his fellow Levites in the meeting tent with some responsibilities, but he may not perform service. This is how you should assign responsibilities to the Levites.
war: Katapos, makakahimo hiya hin pagbulig han iya igkasi mga Levita ha pagbuhat han ira mga katungdanan didto han Tulda, kundi kinahanglan diri hiya maglugaring hin pagtuman hin bisan ano nga buruhaton. Amo ini an paagi nga imo pagsusundon kon magbahinbahin ka han mga katungdanan han mga Levita.”

en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Sinai desert in the first month of the second year after they had left the land of Egypt:
war: Naghimangraw kan Moises an Ginoo didto han Kamingawan han Sinai, dida han syahan nga bulan han ikaduha ka tuig katapos bumaya han Ehipto an mga tawo han Israel. Nagsiring hiya,

en: Let the Israelites keep the Passover at its appointed time.
war: 2-3 “Dida han ika-14 nga adlaw hini nga bulan, nga matikang dida han pagkatunod han adlaw, pagsasaurogon han mga tawo han Israel an Paglabay, sumala han ngatanan nga mga turumanon ngan mga lagda para hini.”

en: On the fourteenth day of this month at twilight you will keep it at its appointed time. Keep it according to all its regulations and its customary practices.
war: Sanglit ginsiring ni Moises an mga tawo nga pagsaurogon an Paglabay,

en: Moses instructed the Israelites to keep the Passover.
war: ngan ginbuhat nira ini dida han gab-i han ika-14 nga adlaw han syahan nga bulan didto han Kamingawan han Sinai. Ginbuhat han mga tawo an ngatanan sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises.

en: At twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month they kept the Passover in the Sinai desert. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
war: Kundi may pipira ka tawo nga maghugaw sumala han seremonyas kay kinmapot hira hin minatay, ngan waray hira pakagsaurog han Paglabay dida hito nga adlaw. Kinmadto hira kanda Moises ug Aaron

en: But there were persons who were unclean from contact with a human corpse, and they were unable to keep the Passover on that day. They approached Moses and Aaron that day.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Mahugaw kami kay kinmapot kami hin minatay, kundi kay ano nga diri kamo ig-uupod han iba nga mga Israelita hin pagdara han halad ngadto han Ginoo ?”

en: These persons said to him, “Although we are unclean from contact with a human corpse, why must we be prohibited from presenting the LORD ’s offering at its appointed time with the rest of the Israelites?”
war: Binmaton hi Moises, “Hulat kamo tubtob han pakakarawat ko hin mga tugon tikang han Ginoo .”

en: Moses said to them, “Wait while I listen for what the LORD will command concerning you.”
war: Ginsiring han Ginoo hi Moises

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: nga sidngon an mga tawo han Israel, “Kon mahugaw in bisan hin-o ha iyo o han iyo mga tulin tungod hin pagkapot hin minatay o kon hirayo hiya didto ha paglalaktan, kundi karuyag gihapon magsaurog han Paglabay,

en: Tell the Israelites: When any of you or your descendants are unclean from contact with a corpse or are on a long trip, they may still keep the Passover to the LORD .
war: tinutugotan kamo hin pagsaurog hini dida han sunod nga bulan, dida han gab-i han ika-14 nga adlaw han ikaduha nga bulan. Pagsauroga ini pinaagi hin tinapay nga waray patubo ngan hin magpait nga mga dahon nga utanon.

en: They will keep it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They will eat the Passover lamb with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
war: Ayaw pagsalin hin bisan ano han pagkaon tubtob han pagkaaga ngan ayaw pagbaria in bisan ano han mga tul-an han hayop. Pagsauroga an Paglabay sumala han ngatanan nga mga turumanon.

en: They must not leave any of it until morning, nor break any of its bones. They will keep the Passover according to all its regulations.
war: Kundi an bisan hin-o nga malinis sumala han seremonyas ngan diri aadto hin paglalaktan ngan diri nagsasaurog han Paglabay, diri na hiya pag-iisipon nga kausa han akon mga tawo, kay waray niya maghalad ha akon dida han igintalaan nga panahon. Kinahanglan mag-antos hiya han mga bunga han iya sala.

en: But any persons who are clean and not on a trip, yet don’t keep the Passover, those persons will be cut off from their people, because they didn’t present the LORD ’s offering at its appointed time. Those persons will bear their sin.
war: “Kon karuyag magsaurog han Paglabay in usa nga lumalangyaw nga nag-uokoy dida ha iyo, kinahanglan pagsaurogon niya ini sumala han ngatanan nga mga turumanon ngan mga lagda. Amo la gihapon an balaod an pagsusundon han ngatanan, ma tuminungnong o lumalangyaw.”

en: If an immigrant resides among you and wishes to keep the Passover to the LORD , that one also will keep it according to its regulations and its customary practices. There will be one set of regulations for both of you, for the immigrant and for the native of the land.
war: 15-16 Dida han adlaw han katindog han Tulda han Ginoo , inmabot in usa nga dampog ngan natahuban an Tulda. Ha gab-i kalayo pagkit-on an dampog.

en: On the day the dwelling was erected, the cloud covered the dwelling, the covenant tent. At night until morning, the cloud appeared with lightning over the dwelling.
war: Kada pagtitipaigbaw han dampog, nabalhin hin kampo an mga tawo han Israel, ngan nagkakampo liwat hira didto han dapit nga hinuhugdonan han dampog.

en: It was always there. The cloud covered it by day, appearing with lightning at night.
war: Nabalhin hin kampo an mga tawo ngan nagkakampo liwat hira sumala han sugo han Ginoo . Samtang nagpapabilin an dampog ha igbaw han Tulda, nagpapabilin man hira dida han ira ginkampohan.

en: Whenever the cloud ascended from the tent, the Israelites would march. And the Israelites would camp wherever the cloud settled.
war: Kon nagpapabilin an dampog ha igbaw han Tulda sulod hin maiha nga panahon, nagsusugot hira han Ginoo ngan diri hira nabalhin.

en: At the LORD ’s command, the Israelites would march, and at the LORD ’s command they would camp. As long as the cloud settled on the dwelling, they would camp.
war: Usahay nagpapabilin an dampog ha igbaw han Tulda sulod hin pira la ka adlaw; ha bisan ano nga kaiha, nagpapabilin o nabalhin hira hin kampo sumala han sugo han Ginoo .

en: When the cloud lingered on the meeting tent for many days, the Israelites would observe the LORD ’s direction and they wouldn’t march.
war: Usahay nagpapabilin an dampog tikang la ha gab-i ngada han pagkaaga, ngan nabalhin hira dayon kon napaigbaw na an dampog. Nabalhin hira ha kada pagtitipaigbaw han dampog.

en: Sometimes the cloud would be over the dwelling for a number of days, so they would camp at the LORD ’s command, marching again only at the LORD ’s command.
war: Bisan duha la ini ka adlaw, usa ka bulan, usa ka tuig, o mairoiha, samtang nagpapabilin an dampog ha igbaw han Tulda, diri hira nabalhin; kundi kon napaigbaw na ini, nabalhin hira.

en: Sometimes the cloud would settle only overnight, and they would march when the cloud ascended in the morning. Whether it was day or night, they would march when the cloud ascended.
war: Nagkakampo hira ngan nabalhin hin kampo ha pagsugot han mga sugo nga iginhatag han Ginoo pinaagi kan Moises.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Make two silver trumpets and make them from hammered metalwork. Use them for summoning the community and for breaking camp.
war: “Paghimo hin duha nga mga trompeta nga salapi nga gagamiton hin pagtirok han mga tawo ngan hin pagbalhin han kampo.

en: When both are blown, the entire community will meet you at the entrance of the meeting tent.
war: Kon malanoy an pagpatunog han duha nga mga trompeta, mag-aalirong ha imo an bug-os nga bungto dida han agian han akon Tulda.

en: When one is blown, the chiefs, the leaders of Israel’s divisions, will meet you.
war: Kundi kon usa la nga trompeta an patunggon, mag-aalirong ha imo an mga pangulo la han mga banay.

en: When you blow a series of short blasts, the camp on the east side will march.
war: Kon haliputay la an tunog an hibatian malakat hin pagbalhin an mga tribo nga nagkampo ha sinirangan.

en: And when you blow a second series of short blasts, the camp on the south side will march. You will blow a series of short blasts to announce their march.
war: Kon makaduha ini nga haliputay nga mga tunog, malakat hin pagbalhin an mga tribo nga nagkampo ha timogan. Sanglit an haliputay nga mga tunog para hin pagbalhin hin kampo,

en: To gather the assembly, blow a long blast, not a series of short blasts.
war: ngan an hilawig nga mga tunog para hin pagtirok han bungto.

en: Aaron’s sons the priests will blow the trumpets. This will be a permanent regulation for you throughout time.
war: An kapadian nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Aaron amo an parahuyop han mga trompeta.

en: When you go to war in your land against an enemy who is attacking you, you will blow short blasts with the trumpets so that you may be remembered by the LORD your God and be saved from your enemies.
war: “Pagtutumanon an masunod nga lagda para han ngatanan nga panahon nga tiarabot.

en: On your festival days, your appointed feasts, and at the beginning of your months, you will blow the trumpets over your entirely burned offerings and your well-being sacrifices. They will serve as a reminder of you to your God. I am the LORD your God.
war: Kon makig-away kamo didto han iyo tuna, hin pagpanalipod ha iyo ngahaw kontra hin kaaway nga masulong ha iyo, patungga an mga trompeta para hin pakig-away. Ako nga Ginoo nga iyo Dyos an mabulig ha iyo ngan tatalwason ko kamo ha iyo mga kaaway.

en: On the twentieth day of the second month in the second year, the cloud ascended from the covenant dwelling.
war: Dida liwat hin malipayon nga mga katirok—ha iyo mga Pyesta hin Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan ngan ha iba niyo nga siringbahon nga mga pyesta—patungga niyo an mga trompeta kon dadad-on niyo an iyo mga halad nga tutuboron ngan an iyo mga halad hin pagkaurosa. Niyan bubuligan ko kamo. Hi ako an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos.”

en: The Israelites set out on their march from the Sinai desert, and the cloud settled in the Paran desert.
war: Dida han ika-20 nga adlaw han ikaduha nga bulan han ikaduha ka tuig katapos gumawas ha Ehipto an mga tawo, pinmaigbaw an dampog nga nakada ha bawbaw han Tulda han Ginoo ,

en: They marched for the first time at the LORD ’s command through Moses.
war: ngan nagtikang an mga Israelita han ira paglakat tikang han Kamingawan han Sinai. Hinmugdon an dampog didto han Kamingawan han Paran.

en: The banner of Judah’s camp marched first with its military units. Nahshon, Amminadab’s son, commanded its military.
war: Nagtikang hira hin pagkalakat sumala han sugo han Ginoo , pinaagi kan Moises,

en: Nethanel, Zuar’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Issachar.
war: ngan ha kada pagbalhin nira, amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han ira kalakat: nag-uuna paggawas pinaagi hin mga hugpo hin kasondalohan amo an mga tawo ha ubos han bandera han tribo ni Juda, nga pinangulohan ni Naason nga anak ni Aminadab.

en: Eliab, Helon’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Zebulun.
war: Pinangulohan ni Natanael nga anak ni Zuar an tribo ni Isacar,

en: The dwelling was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites, who carried the dwelling, marched.
war: ngan pinangulohan ni Eliab nga anak ni Helon an tribo ni Zabulon.

en: The banner of Reuben’s camp marched with its military units. Elizur, Shedeur’s son, commanded its military.
war: Niyan ginbubulkas nira an Tulda ngan nasunod an mga banay nira Gerson ug Merari nga nagdadara han Tulda ngan han mga kasangkapan hini.

en: Shelumiel, Zurishaddai’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Simeon.
war: Nasunod hini an mga hugpo hin kasondalohan hadton mga tawo ha ubos han bandera han tribo ni Ruben nga pinangulohan ni Elizur nga anak ni Sedeur.

en: Eliasaph, Deuel’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Gad.
war: Pinangulohan ni Selumiel nga anak ni Zurisadai an tribo ni Simeon,

en: The Kohathites, who carried the holy things, marched. The dwelling would be set up before their arrival.
war: ngan pinangulohan ni Eliasaf nga anak ni Deuel an tribo ni Gad.

en: The banner of Ephraim’s camp marched with its military units. Elishama, Ammihud’s son, commanded its military.
war: Nasunod liwat an Levita nga banay ni Coat, nga nagdadara han baraan nga mga butang. Ha pag-abot nira didto han sunod nga kampo, gintitindog na liwat an Tulda.

en: Gamaliel, Pedahzur’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Manasseh.
war: Nasunod hini an mga hugpo hin kasondalohan hadton mga tawo ha ubos han bandera han tribo ni Efraim, nga pinangulohan ni Elisama nga anak ni Amiud.

en: Abidan, Gideoni’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Benjamin.
war: Pinangulohan ni Gamaliel nga anak ni Pedasur an tribo ni Manases,

en: The banner of Dan’s camp, at the rear of the whole camp, marched with its military units. Ahiezer, Ammishaddai’s son, commanded its military.
war: ngan pinangulohan ni Abidan nga anak ni Gideoni an tribo ni Benjamin.

en: Pagiel, Ochran’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Asher.
war: Ha kataposan amo an hugpo hin kasondalohan hadton mga tawo ha ubos han bandera han tribo ni Dan, nga nag-aalagad sugad nga bantay ha talikoran han ngatanan nga mga hugpo hin kasondalohan, ngan pinangulohan ini ni Ahiezer nga anak ni Amisadai.

en: Ahira, Enan’s son, commanded the military of the tribe of Naphtali.
war: Pinangulohan ni Pagiel nga anak ni Ocran an tribo ni Aser,

en: This was the order of departure of the Israelites with their military units when they set out.
war: ngan hi Ahira, anak ni Enan, amo an nangungulo han banay ni Neftali.

en: Moses said to Hobab the Midianite, Reuel’s son and Moses’ father-in-law, “We’re marching to the place about which the LORD has said, ‘I’ll give it to you.’ Come with us and we’ll treat you well, for the LORD has promised to treat Israel well.”
war: Amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han pagkalakat han kada hugpo hin kasondalohan ha kada pagbabalhin hin kampo ngan pagkakalakat han mga Israelita.

en: Hobab said to him, “I won’t go; I’d rather go to my land and to my folk.”
war: Nagsiring hi Moises kan Hobab nga iya bayaw, nga anak ni Jetro nga taga-Midian, “Tikadto na kami han dapit nga ginsiring han Ginoo nga iya ighahatag ha amon. Nagsaad ha amon an Ginoo nga pauuswagon niya an Israel, sanglit upod ha amon kay babahinan ka namon.”

en: Moses said, “Please don’t abandon us, for you know where we can camp in the desert, and you can be our eyes.
war: Binmaton hi Hobab, “Diri ako. Mabalik ako ngadto han akon tuna nga natawhan.”

en: If you go with us, whatever good the LORD does for us, we’ll do for you.”
war: “Ayaw gad kami pagbayai,” nagsiring hi Moises. “Ikaw an maaram kon diin kami makakagkampo didto han kamingawan ngan ikaw an magpapangulo ha amon.

en: They marched from the LORD ’s mountain for three days. The LORD ’s chest containing the covenant marched ahead of them for three days to look for a resting place for them.
war: Kon umupod ka ha amon, pagbabahinan ka namon han ngatanan nga mga kaupayan nga ihinahatag ha amon han Ginoo .”

en: Now the LORD ’s cloud was over them by day when they marched from the camp.
war: Han pagbaya han mga tawo han Sinai nga baraan nga bukid, nagkalakat hira hin tulo ka adlaw. Dayuday nag-una ha ira an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo hin pagbiling hin dapit nga pagkakampohan nira.

en: When the chest set out, Moses would say, “Arise, LORD , let your enemies scatter, and those who hate you flee.”
war: Ha pagbabalhin nira han tagsa nira nga kampo, napaigbaw ha ira kon adlaw an dampog han Ginoo .

en: When it rested, he would say, “Return, LORD of the ten thousand thousands of Israel.”
war: Ha kada paglalakat han Kahon han Ginsaaran, nasiring hi Moises, “Bangon, O Ginoo , pagburublaga an imo mga kaaway ngan taboga adton mga napupungot ha imo!”

en: When the people complained intensely in the LORD ’s hearing, the LORD heard and became angry. Then the LORD ’s fire burned them and consumed the edges of the camp.
war: Nagtikang an mga tawo hin pagngurutob han Ginoo hiunong han ira mga kakurian. Han paghibatii ha ira han Ginoo , nasina hiya ngan ginpadad-an hin kalayo an mga tawo. Naglarab ini dida ha ira ngan nakasunog hin usa nga kataposan nga dapit han kampo.

en: When the people cried out to Moses, Moses prayed to the LORD , and the fire subsided.
war: Nagtawag an mga tawo kan Moises hin pakibulig; nag-ampo hi Moises ngadto han Ginoo ngan naparong an kalayo.

en: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD ’s fire burned against them.
war: Sanglit ginngaranan nga Tabera an dapit kay didto naglarab dida ha ira an kalayo han Ginoo .

en: The riffraff among them had a strong craving. Even the Israelites cried again and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
war: May mga lumalangyaw nga binmunyog han mga Israelita. Nahidlaw na gud hira hin pagkaon hin karne, ngan bisan an mga Israelita ngahaw nagtikang na hin pagngurutob: “Kon may-ada la unta naton karne!

en: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt for free, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.
war: Didto ha Ehipto hura kita han ngatanan nga isda ngan diri naton pinalit. Nahinunumdom ba kamo han mga pipino, mga sandiya, mga ahos, mga sibuyas, ngan mga lasona?

en: Now our lives are wasting away. There is nothing but manna in front of us.”
war: Kundi yana maluya na kita. Waray na sadang makaon—waray na gud, labot hini nga mana nga masumo na!”

en: The manna was like coriander seed and its color was like resin.
The people would roam around and collect it and grind it with millstones or pound it in a mortar. Then they would boil it in pots and make it into cakes. It tasted like cakes baked in olive oil.
war: An mana sugad hin gudtiay nga mga liso nga baga labsag an kamadulaw.

en: When the dew fell on the camp during the night, the manna would fall with it.
war: 8-9 Nagkakataktak ini ngada han kampo kon gab-i upod han tun-og. Ha pagkakaaga nagsusudoy ngan gintitirok ini han mga tawo, ginigiling o binabayo ini nga mahimo nga harina, ngan ginluluto ini ngan ginhihimo ini nga mga magnipis nga torta. An rasa hini sugad hin tinapay nga ginhudno nga sinaktan hin lana hin olibo.)

en: Moses heard the people crying throughout their clans, each at his tent’s entrance. The LORD was outraged, and Moses was upset.
war: Hinbatian ni Moises an ngurutob han ngatanan nga mga tawo samtang nagpupurupundok hira dida han mga agian han ira mga tulda. Nabido hi Moises kay nasina ha ira an Ginoo ,

en: Moses said to the LORD , “Why have you treated your servant so badly? And why haven’t I found favor in your eyes, for you have placed the burden of all these people on me?
war: ngan nagsiring hiya han Ginoo , “Kay ano nga ginpakurian mo ako? Kay ano nga nabubudlay ka ha akon? Kay ano nga iginhatag mo ha akon an katungdanan hin pag-alagad hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?

en: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give birth to them, that you would say to me, ‘Carry them at the breast, as a nurse carries an unweaned child,’ to the fertile land that you promised their ancestors?
war: Waray ako magtuha o mag-anak ha ira! Kay ano nga pinapagmangnoan mo hira ha akon nga sugad ako hin yaya nga nagkukugos ha ira sugad hin mga minasus-an ngadto han tuna nga imo iginsaad ha ira kaapoy-apoyan?

en: Where am I to get meat for all these people? They are crying before me and saying, ‘Give us meat, so we can eat.’
war: Hain ko man kukuhaa in igo nga karne para hini ngatanan nga mga tawo? Nagnginginurutob ngan nag-iinaro hira hin karne.

en: I can’t bear this people on my own. They’re too heavy for me.
war: Diri ako makakabaton ha akon kalugaringon hini ngatanan nga mga tawo; mabug-at ini hin duro para ha akon!

en: If you’re going to treat me like this, please kill me. If I’ve found favor in your eyes, then don’t let me endure this wretched situation.”
war: Kon susugaron mo na manla ako hini, kalooyi ako ngan pataya na la ako, basi diri na ako mag-inantos hin maiha han imo pagkamaisog.”

en: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather before me seventy men from Israel’s elders, whom you know as elders and officers of the people. Take them to the meeting tent, and let them stand there with you.
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo , “Tiroka in 70 nga tinahod nga mga tawo nga kinikilala nga mga pangulo han bungto, dad-a hira nganhi ha akon didto han akon Tulda, ngan patindoga hira didto, sapit ha imo.

en: Then I’ll descend and speak with you there. I’ll take some of the spirit that is on you and place it on them. Then they will carry the burden of the people with you so that you won’t bear it alone.
war: Malusad ako ngan makikighimangraw ako ha imo, ngan babahinan ko hira han espiritu nga akon iginhatag ha imo. Niyan makakabulig na hira ha imo hin pagtuman han katungdanan para hini nga mga tawo, ngan diri ka na maglulugaring hin pagdumara ha ira.

en: To the people you will say, ‘Make yourselves holy for tomorrow; then you will eat meat, for you’ve cried in the LORD ’s hearing, “Who will give us meat to eat? It was better for us in Egypt.” The LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
war: Yana sidnga an mga tawo, ‘Paglinis kamo han iyo kalugaringon para han buwas nga adlaw; magkakamay-ada na kamo karne nga kakaonon. Hinbatian kamo han Ginoo nga nagnginginorutob ngan sinasablok na kamo hin karne, ngan nasiring kamo, “Mauruupay pa an amon kamutangan didto ha Ehipto.” Yana tatagan kamo han Ginoo hin karne nga kakaonon niyo.

en: You won’t eat for just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
war: Kakaonon ini niyo diri la hin usa ka adlaw, o lima, o napulo, o bisan pa 20 ka adlaw,

en: but for a whole month until it comes out of your nostrils and nauseates you. You’ve rejected the LORD who’s been with you and you have cried before him, saying, “Why did we leave Egypt?” ’”
war: kundi sulod hin bug-os nga bulan, tubtob han pagsumhi ngan pagluwara ha iyo, nga kamo na an madiri hin pagkaon. Mahinanabo ini kay iginsikway niyo an Ginoo nga aanhi kaupod niyo, ngan nagngurutob kamo ha iya nga maupay pa unta waray kamo bumaya han Ehipto.’”

en: Moses said, “The people I’m with are six hundred thousand on foot and you’re saying, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
war: Nagsiring hi Moises han Ginoo , “Iini ako nga nagmamangulo hin 600,000 nga mga tawo, ngan nasiring ka nga tatagan mo hira hin karne nga igo para hin usa ka bulan?

en: Can flocks and herds be found and slaughtered for them? Or can all the fish in the sea be found and caught for them?”
war: May sadang ba kadamo nga mga baka ngan mga karnero para ha ira? Igo ba para ha ira an ngatanan nga kaisdaan ha dagat?”

en: The LORD said to Moses, “Is the LORD ’s power too weak? Now you will see whether my word will come true for you or not.”
war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “May-ada ba katubtoban an akon gahom? Makita ka kon mahinanabo ba o diri an akon iginsiring!”

en: So Moses went out and told the people the LORD ’s words. He assembled seventy men from the people’s elders and placed them around the tent.
war: Sanglit ginmawas hi Moises ngan ginsumatan niya an mga tawo han iginsiring han Ginoo . Gintirok niya in 70 han mga pangulo ngan iginbutang hira palibot han Tulda.

en: The LORD descended in a cloud, spoke to him, and took some of the spirit that was on him and placed it on the seventy elders. When the spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but only this once.
war: Niyan linmusad an Ginoo dida han dampog ngan nakighimangraw ha iya. Kinuha niya in bahin han espiritu nga iginhatag niya kan Moises ngan iginhatag ini ngadto han 70 nga mga pangulo. Han katagi na ha ira han espiritu, naggogliat hira sugad hin mga manaragna, kundi waray la pag-iha.

en: Two men had remained in the camp, one named Eldad and the second named Medad, and the spirit rested on them. They were among those registered, but they hadn’t gone out to the tent, so they prophesied in the camp.
war: Nagpabilin didto han kampo in duha han 70 nga mga pangulo, hira Eldad ug Medad, ngan waray hira gumawas ngadto han Tulda. Didto han kampo ihinatag ha ira an espiritu ngan naggogliat liwat hira sugad hin mga manaragna.

en: A young man ran and told Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
war: Dinmalagan in usa nga batan-on nga lalake hin pagsumat kan Moises han ginbubuhat nira Eldad ug Medad.

en: Joshua, Nun’s son and Moses’ assistant since his youth, responded, “My master Moses, stop them!”
war: Niyan nagyakan hi Josue nga anak ni Nun, nga nagin kabulig ni Moises tikang han batan-on pa hiya, ngan nagsiring kan Moises, “Agaron, sawaya hira!”

en: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? If only all the LORD ’s people were prophets with the LORD placing his spirit on them!”
war: Binmaton hi Moises, “Nababaraka ka ba tungod han akon kaupayan? Ihatag unta han Ginoo an iya espiritu ngadto han ngatanan niya nga mga tawo, ngan paguliaton hira ngatanan sugad hin mga manaragna!”

en: Moses and Israel’s elders were assembled in the camp.
war: Niyan binmalik ngadto han kampo hira Moises ngan an 70 nga mga pangulo han Israel.

en: A wind from the LORD blew up and brought quails from the sea. It let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey all around the camp and about three feet deep on the ground.
war: Ha gilayon inmabot in hangin nga sugo han Ginoo nga nagdara hin usa ka panon hin mga tuhil tikang ha dagat, nga nagkakalupad hin usa ka metro ha bawbaw han tuna. Nanhugdon ini dida han kampo ngan ginluob nira palibot han kampo ngan haluag hin duro an ira ginhagdonan.

en: Then the people arose and gathered the quail all that day, all night, and all the next day. The least collected was ten homers, and they laid them out around the camp.
war: Sanglit nagpinanakop an mga tawo hin mga tuhil ha bug-os hito nga adlaw ug gab-i, ngan ha bug-os pa han sunod nga adlaw; waray usa nga nakatirok hin kulang hin usa ka sako. Gin-ihaw ngan ginbulad nira ini palibot han kampo.

en: While the meat was still between their teeth and not yet consumed, the LORD ’s anger blazed against the people. The LORD struck the people with a very great punishment.
war: Samtang damo pa an ira pagkaon nga karne, nasina han mga tawo an Ginoo , ngan ginpadara in sakit ngada ha ira.

en: The name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving.
war: Ginngaranan adto nga dapit hin Kibrot-Hataara o “Mga Lubnganan hin Pag-ungara” kay didto iginlubong nira an mga tawo nga nag-ungara hin karne.

en: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people marched to Hazeroth.
war: Tikang didto nagbalhin han kampo an mga tawo ngadto ha Hazerot.

en: When they were in Hazeroth, Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses on account of the Cushite woman whom he had married—for he had married a Cushite woman.
war: Nangasawa hi Moises hin usa nga babaye nga taga-Cusi ngan tungod hini ginsusnan hiya nira Miriam ug Aaron.

en: They said, “Has the LORD spoken only through Moses? Hasn’t he also spoken through us?” The LORD heard it.
war: Nagsiring hira, “Naghimangraw ba an Ginoo pinaagipinaagi la kan Moises? Waray ba liwat hiya maghimangraw pinaagi ha amon?” Hinbatian han Ginoo an ira iginsiring. (

en: Now the man Moses was humble, more so than anyone on earth.
war: Mapinaubsanon nga tawo hi Moises, labaw pa kamapinaubsanon kay hin bisan hin-o dinhe ha tuna.)

en: Immediately, the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three go out to the meeting tent.” So the three of them went out.
war: Ha gilayon nagsiring an Ginoo kanda Moises, Aaron, ug Miriam, “Karuyag ko nga gumawas kamo nga tulo ngadto han akon Tulda.” Kinmadto hira,

en: Then the LORD descended in a column of cloud, stood at the entrance of the tent, and called to Aaron and Miriam. The two of them came forward.
war: ngan linmusad an Ginoo dida hin usa nga harigi nga dampog, tinmindog dida han agian han Tulda, ngan nagtawag, “Aaron! Miriam!” Kinmadto ha atubangan hira nga duha,

en: He said, “Listen to my words: If there is a prophet of the LORD among you, I make myself known to him in visions. I speak to him in dreams.
war: ngan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Yana pamatii an akon igsisiring! Kon may-ada mga manaragna dida ha iyo, nagpapadayag ako ha ira pinaagi hin mga panan-awon ngan naghihimangraw ako ha ira pinaagi hin mga inop.

en: But not with my servant Moses. He has proved to be reliable with all my household.
war: Iba ini kon naghihimangraw ako kan Moises nga akon surugoon; igintapod ko ha iya an ngatanan ko nga mga tawo nga Israelita.

en: I speak with him face-to-face, visibly, not in riddles. He sees the LORD ’s form. So why aren’t you afraid to criticize my servant Moses?”
war: Sanglit nakikighimangraw ako ha iya nga nag-aatubang kami; diri pinaagi hin mga tirigohon; hinkit-an nga ngani niya an akon dagway! Kay ano nga nagpasipara kamo hin pagyakan kontra kan Moises nga akon surugoon?”

en: The LORD ’s anger blazed against them, and they went back.
war: Nasina ha ira an Ginoo ; sanglit han pagbulag na han Ginoo ,

en: When the cloud went away from over the tent, Miriam suddenly developed a skin disease flaky like snow. Aaron turned toward Miriam and saw her skin disease.
war: ngan pagbaya na han dampog tikang han Tulda, naluob dayon an panit ni Miriam hin sanla nga sakit ngan nagburusag ini sugad hin gapas. Han pagsiplat ha iya ni Aaron ngan han paghikit-i nga naluob hi Miriam han sakit nga sanla,

en: Then Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my master, please don’t punish us for the sin that we foolishly committed.
war: nagsiring hiya kan Moises, “Mano, ayaw gad kami pagpaantosa hini nga kastigo tungod han amon linurong nga sala.

en: Please don’t let her be like the stillborn, whose flesh is half eaten as it comes out of the mother’s womb.”
war: Ayaw gad itugot nga masugad hiya hin natawo nga daan patay, kanay lawas hapit na madunot ha paggawas han tiyan ni iya nanay.”

en: So Moses cried to the LORD , “God, please heal her!”
war: Sanglit nagtawag hi Moises han Ginoo , “O Dyos, tambala gad hiya!”

en: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had spit in her face, would she not be shamed for seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp for seven days, and afterward she will be brought back.”
war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “Kon gintuprahan hiya han iya amay dida han iya bayhon, pag-aantoson niya sulod hin pito ka adlaw an iya kaarawdan. Sanglit igawas hiya han kampo sulod hin usa ka semana, ngan katapos hito makakahimo na hiya hin pakasulod.”

en: So they shut Miriam out of the camp seven days. And the people didn’t march until Miriam was brought back.
war: Iginggawas hi Miriam han kampo sulod hin pito ka adlaw, ngan waray magbalhin han kampo an mga tawo ngada han pakasulod na liwat ni Miriam han kampo.

en: Afterward the people marched from Hazeroth, and they camped in the Paran desert.
war: Niyan binmaya hira han Hazerot ngan nagkampo hira didto han kamingawan han Paran.

en: The LORD spoke to Moses:
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Send out men to explore the land of Canaan, which I’m giving to the Israelites. Send one man from each ancestral tribe, each a chief among them.
war: “Pagpili hin usa han mga pangulo ha kada usa han dose nga mga tribo, ngan sugoa hira nga mga espiya hin pag-usisa han tuna han Canaan nga akon ihahatag han mga Israelita.”

en: So Moses sent them out from the Paran desert according to the LORD ’s command. All the men were leaders among the Israelites.
war: 3-15 Sinmugot hi Moises ngan tikang han kamingawan han Paran ginsugo niya inin masunod nga mga pangulo:

war: Hi Igal nga anak ni Jose

en: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel, Gemalli’s son;
war: Efraim

en: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur, Michael’s son;
war: Hi Oseas nga anak ni Nun

en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, Vophsi’s son;
war: Benjamin

en: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel, Machi’s son.
war: Hi Falti nga anak ni Rafu

en: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent out to explore the land. Moses changed the name of Hoshea, Nun’s son, to Joshua.
war: Zabulon

en: When Moses sent them out to explore the land of Canaan, he said to them, “Go up there into the arid southern plain and into the mountains.
war: Hi Zadiel nga anak ni Sodi

en: You must inspect the land. What is it like? Are the people who live in it strong or weak, few or many?
war: Manases

en: Is the land in which they live good or bad? Are the towns in which they live camps or fortresses?
war: Hi Gadi nga anak ni Susi

en: Is the land rich or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous and bring back the land’s fruit.” It was the season of the first ripe grapes.
war: Dan

en: They went up and explored the land from the Zin desert to Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
war: Hi Amiel nga anak ni Gemali

en: They went up into the arid southern plain and entered Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of the Anakites, lived. (Hebron was built seven years before Tanis in Egypt.)
war: Aser

en: Then they entered the Cluster ravine, cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and carried it on a pole between them. They also took pomegranates and figs.
war: Hi Setur nga anak ni Miguel

en: That place was called the Cluster ravine because of the cluster of grapes that the Israelites cut down from there.
war: Neftali

en: They returned from exploring the land after forty days.
war: Hi Nabi nga anak ni Bapsi

en: They went directly to Moses, Aaron, and the entire Israelite community in the Paran desert at Kadesh. They brought back a report to them and to the entire community and showed them the land’s fruit.
war: Gad

en: Then they gave their report: “We entered the land to which you sent us. It’s actually full of milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
war: Hi Guel nga anak ni Maqui

en: There are, however, powerful people who live in the land. The cities have huge fortifications. And we even saw the descendants of the Anakites there.
war: Amo ini an mga espiya nga ginsugo ni Moises hin pag-usisa han tuna. Ginliwanan niya hin Josue an ngaran ni Oseas nga anak ni Nun.

en: The Amalekites live in the land of the arid southern plain; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the mountains; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
war: Han pagsugoa na ha ira ni Moises, iya ginsiring hira, “Tikang dinhe pakadto kamo ha amihanan, kahuman ngadto ha timogan nga bahin han tuna han Canaan, ngan pagpadayon kamo ngadto han sagkahon nga katunaan.

en: Now Caleb calmed the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of it, because we are more than able to do it.”
war: Panginanoa niyo kon ano ini nga tuna, kon damo ba an mga tawo nga nag-uokoy didto, ngan kon matiunan-o hin kamagkusog hira.

en: But the men who went up with him said, “We can’t go up against the people because they are stronger than we.”
war: Usisaha niyo kon maupay ba o maraot an tuna, ngan kon nag-uokoy an mga tawo dida hin mga bungto nga waray mga pader o dida ba hin pinaderan nga mga syudad.

en: The entire community raised their voice and the people wept that night.
war: Ha bug-os nga gab-i nagtinangis an mga tawo ha dako nga tingog tungod han ira kakurian.

en: All the Israelites criticized Moses and Aaron. The entire community said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt or if only we had died in this desert!
